verses.translation: Ye observe days, and months, and times, and years.

verses.original: φοβοῦμαι ὑμᾶς μή πως εἰκῇ κεκοπίακα εἰς ὑμᾶς.
verses.translit: fovoumai umas mi pos eike kekopiaka eis umas.
verses.translation: I am afraid of you, lest I have bestowed upon you labour in vain.

verses.original: Γίνεσθε ὡς ἐγώ, ὅτι κἀγὼ ὡς ὑμεῖς, ἀδελφοί, δέομαι ὑμῶν. οὐδέν με ἠδικήσατε·
verses.translit: Ginesthe os ego, oti kago os umeis, adelfoi, deomai umon. ouden me edikisate*
verses.translation: Brethren, I beseech you, be as I am ; for I am as ye are : ye have not injured me at all.

verses.original: οἴδατε δὲ ὅτι διʼ ἀσθένειαν τῆς σαρκὸς εὐηγγελισάμην ὑμῖν τὸ πρότερον,
verses.translit: oidate de oti di' astheneian tes sarkos euiggelisamin umin to proteron,
verses.translation: Ye know how through infirmity of the flesh I preached the gospel unto you at the first.

verses.original: καὶ τὸν πειρασμὸν ⸀ὑμῶν ἐν τῇ σαρκί μου οὐκ ἐξουθενήσατε οὐδὲ ἐξεπτύσατε, ἀλλὰ ὡς ἄγγελον θεοῦ ἐδέξασθέ με, ὡς Χριστὸν Ἰησοῦν.
verses.translit: kai ton peirasmon umon en te sarki moy ouk exoythenisate oude exeptysate, alla os aggelon theou edexasthe me, os Hriston Iisoun.
verses.translation: And my temptation which was in my flesh ye despised not, nor rejected; but received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.

verses.original: ⸀ποῦ ⸀οὖν ὁ μακαρισμὸς ὑμῶν; μαρτυρῶ γὰρ ὑμῖν ὅτι εἰ δυνατὸν τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς ὑμῶν ⸀ἐξορύξαντες ἐδώκατέ μοι.
verses.translit: pou oun o makarismos umon; martyro gar umin oti ei dynaton tous ofthalmous umon exoryxantes edokate moi.
verses.translation: Where is then the blessedness ye spake of? for I bear you record, that, if it had been possible, ye would have plucked out your own eyes, and have given them to me.

verses.original: ὥστε ἐχθρὸς ὑμῶν γέγονα ἀληθεύων ὑμῖν;
verses.translit: oste ehthros umon gegona alitheyon umin;
verses.translation: Am I therefore become your enemy, because I tell you the truth?

verses.original: ζηλοῦσιν ὑμᾶς οὐ καλῶς, ἀλλὰ ἐκκλεῖσαι ὑμᾶς θέλουσιν, ἵνα αὐτοὺς ζηλοῦτε.
verses.translit: zilousin umas ou kalos, alla ekkleisai umas theloysin, ina autous ziloute.
verses.translation: They zealously affect you, but not well; yea, they would exclude you, that ye might affect them.

verses.original: καλὸν ⸀δὲ ζηλοῦσθαι ἐν καλῷ πάντοτε, καὶ μὴ μόνον ἐν τῷ παρεῖναί με πρὸς ὑμᾶς,
verses.translit: kalon de zilousthai en kalo pantote, kai me monon en to pareinai me pros umas,
verses.translation: But it is good to be zealously affected always in a good thing , and not only when I am present with you.

verses.original: ⸀τέκνα μου, οὓς πάλιν ὠδίνω ⸀μέχρις οὗ μορφωθῇ Χριστὸς ἐν ὑμῖν·
verses.translit: tekna moy, ous palin odino mehris ou morfothe Hristos en umin*
verses.translation: My little children, of whom I travail in birth again until Christ be formed in you,

verses.original: ἤθελον δὲ παρεῖναι πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἄρτι, καὶ ἀλλάξαι τὴν φωνήν μου, ὅτι ἀποροῦμαι ἐν ὑμῖν.
verses.translit: ethelon de pareinai pros umas arti, kai allaxai ten fonin moy, oti aporoumai en umin.
verses.translation: I desire to be present with you now, and to change my voice; for I stand in doubt of you.

verses.original: Λέγετέ μοι, οἱ ὑπὸ νόμον θέλοντες εἶναι, τὸν νόμον οὐκ ἀκούετε;
verses.translit: Legete moi, oi upo nomon thelontes einai, ton nomon ouk akoyete;
verses.translation: Tell me, ye that desire to be under the law, do ye not hear the law?

verses.original: γέγραπται γὰρ ὅτι Ἀβραὰμ δύο υἱοὺς ἔσχεν, ἕνα ἐκ τῆς παιδίσκης καὶ ἕνα ἐκ τῆς ἐλευθέρας·
verses.translit: gegraptai gar oti Avraam dyo yious eshen, ena ek tes paidiskis kai ena ek tes eleytheras*
verses.translation: For it is written, that Abraham had two sons, the one by a bondmaid, the other by a freewoman.

verses.original: ἀλλʼ ὁ μὲν ἐκ τῆς παιδίσκης κατὰ σάρκα γεγέννηται, ὁ δὲ ἐκ τῆς ἐλευθέρας ⸀διʼ ἐπαγγελίας.
verses.translit: all' o men ek tes paidiskis kata sarka gegennitai, o de ek tes eleytheras di' epaggelias.
verses.translation: But he who was of the bondwoman was born after the flesh; but he of the freewoman was by promise.

verses.original: ἅτινά ἐστιν ἀλληγορούμενα· αὗται γάρ εἰσιν δύο διαθῆκαι, μία μὲν ἀπὸ ὄρους Σινᾶ, εἰς δουλείαν γεννῶσα, ἥτις ἐστὶν Ἁγάρ,
verses.translit: atina estin alligoroymena* autai gar eisin dyo diathekai, mia men apo oroys Sina, eis doyleian gennosa, etis estin Agar,
verses.translation: Which things are an allegory: for these are the two covenants; the one from the mount Sinai, which gendereth to bondage, which is Agar.

verses.original: τὸ ⸀δὲ Ἁγὰρ Σινᾶ ὄρος ἐστὶν ἐν τῇ Ἀραβίᾳ, συστοιχεῖ δὲ τῇ νῦν Ἰερουσαλήμ, δουλεύει ⸀γὰρ μετὰ τῶν τέκνων αὐτῆς·
verses.translit: to de Agar Sina oros estin en te Aravia, systoihei de te nun Ieroysalim, doyleyei gar meta ton teknon autes*
verses.translation: For this Agar is mount Sinai in Arabia, and answereth to Jerusalem which now is, and is in bondage with her children.

verses.original: ἡ δὲ ἄνω Ἰερουσαλὴμ ἐλευθέρα ἐστίν, ἥτις ἐστὶν ⸀μήτηρ ἡμῶν·
verses.translit: e de ano Ieroysalem eleythera estin, etis estin mitir emon*
verses.translation: But Jerusalem which is above is free, which is the mother of us all.

verses.original: γέγραπται γάρ· Εὐφράνθητι, στεῖρα ἡ οὐ τίκτουσα, ῥῆξον καὶ βόησον, ἡ οὐκ ὠδίνουσα· ὅτι πολλὰ τὰ τέκνα τῆς ἐρήμου μᾶλλον ἢ τῆς ἐχούσης τὸν ἄνδρα.
verses.translit: gegraptai gar* Eufranthiti, steira e ou tiktoysa, Rexon kai voison, e ouk odinoysa* oti polla ta tekna tes erimoy mallon e tes ehoysis ton andra.
verses.translation: For it is written, Rejoice, thou barren that bearest not; break forth and cry, thou that travailest not: for the desolate hath many more children than she which hath an husband.

verses.original: ⸂ὑμεῖς δέ, ἀδελφοί, κατὰ Ἰσαὰκ ἐπαγγελίας τέκνα ἐστέ⸃·
verses.translit: umeis de, adelfoi, kata Isaak epaggelias tekna este*
verses.translation: Now we, brethren, as Isaac was, are the children of promise.

verses.original: ἀλλʼ ὥσπερ τότε ὁ κατὰ σάρκα γεννηθεὶς ἐδίωκε τὸν κατὰ πνεῦμα, οὕτως καὶ νῦν.
verses.translit: all' osper tote o kata sarka gennitheis edioke ton kata pneuma, outos kai nun.
verses.translation: But as then he that was born after the flesh persecuted him that was born after the Spirit, even so it is now.

verses.original: ἀλλὰ τί λέγει ἡ γραφή; Ἔκβαλε τὴν παιδίσκην καὶ τὸν υἱὸν αὐτῆς, οὐ γὰρ μὴ ⸀κληρονομήσει ὁ υἱὸς τῆς παιδίσκης μετὰ τοῦ υἱοῦ τῆς ἐλευθέρας.
verses.translit: alla ti legei e grafi; Ekvale ten paidiskin kai ton yion autes, ou gar me klironomisei o yios tes paidiskis meta tou yiou tes eleytheras.
verses.translation: Nevertheless what saith the scripture? Cast out the bondwoman and her son: for the son of the bondwoman shall not be heir with the son of the freewoman.

verses.original: ⸀διό, ἀδελφοί, οὐκ ἐσμὲν παιδίσκης τέκνα ἀλλὰ τῆς ἐλευθέρας.
verses.translit: dio, adelfoi, ouk esmen paidiskis tekna alla tes eleytheras.
verses.translation: So then, brethren, we are not children of the bondwoman, but of the free.

verses.original: τῇ ἐλευθερίᾳ ⸂ἡμᾶς Χριστὸς ἠλευθέρωσεν· στήκετε οὖν⸃ καὶ μὴ πάλιν ζυγῷ δουλείας ἐνέχεσθε.
verses.translit: te eleytheria emas Hristos eleytherosen* stikete oun kai me palin zygo doyleias enehesthe.
verses.translation: Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.

verses.original: Ἴδε ἐγὼ Παῦλος λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ἐὰν περιτέμνησθε Χριστὸς ὑμᾶς οὐδὲν ὠφελήσει.
verses.translit: Ide ego Paulos lego umin oti ean peritemnisthe Hristos umas ouden ofelisei.
verses.translation: Behold, I Paul say unto you, that if ye be circumcised, Christ shall profit you nothing.

verses.original: μαρτύρομαι δὲ πάλιν παντὶ ἀνθρώπῳ περιτεμνομένῳ ὅτι ὀφειλέτης ἐστὶν ὅλον τὸν νόμον ποιῆσαι.
verses.translit: martyromai de palin panti anthropo peritemnomeno oti ofeiletis estin olon ton nomon poiesai.
verses.translation: For I testify again to every man that is circumcised, that he is a debtor to do the whole law.

verses.original: κατηργήθητε ⸀ἀπὸ Χριστοῦ οἵτινες ἐν νόμῳ δικαιοῦσθε, τῆς χάριτος ἐξεπέσατε.
verses.translit: katirgithite apo Hristou oitines en nomo dikaiousthe, tes haritos exepesate.
verses.translation: Christ is become of no effect unto you, whosoever of you are justified by the law; ye are fallen from grace.

verses.original: ἡμεῖς γὰρ πνεύματι ἐκ πίστεως ἐλπίδα δικαιοσύνης ἀπεκδεχόμεθα.
verses.translit: emeis gar pneymati ek pisteos elpida dikaiosynis apekdehometha.
verses.translation: For we through the Spirit wait for the hope of righteousness by faith.

verses.original: ἐν γὰρ Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ οὔτε περιτομή τι ἰσχύει οὔτε ἀκροβυστία, ἀλλὰ πίστις διʼ ἀγάπης ἐνεργουμένη.
verses.translit: en gar Hristo Iisou oute peritomi ti ishyei oute akrovystia, alla pistis di' agapis energoymeni.
verses.translation: For in Jesus Christ neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision; but faith which worketh by love.

verses.original: Ἐτρέχετε καλῶς· τίς ὑμᾶς ἐνέκοψεν ⸀τῇ ἀληθείᾳ μὴ πείθεσθαι;
verses.translit: Etrehete kalos* tis umas enekopsen te alitheia me peithesthai;
verses.translation: Ye did run well; who did hinder you that ye should not obey the truth?

verses.original: ἡ πεισμονὴ οὐκ ἐκ τοῦ καλοῦντος ὑμᾶς.
verses.translit: e peismone ouk ek tou kalountos umas.
verses.translation: This persuasion cometh not of him that calleth you.

verses.original: μικρὰ ζύμη ὅλον τὸ φύραμα ζυμοῖ.
verses.translit: mikra zymi olon to fyrama zymoi.
verses.translation: A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump.

verses.original: ἐγὼ πέποιθα εἰς ὑμᾶς ἐν κυρίῳ ὅτι οὐδὲν ἄλλο φρονήσετε· ὁ δὲ ταράσσων ὑμᾶς βαστάσει τὸ κρίμα, ὅστις ⸀ἐὰν ᾖ.
verses.translit: ego pepoitha eis umas en kyrio oti ouden allo fronisete* o de tarasson umas vastasei to krima, ostis ean e.
verses.translation: I have confidence in you through the Lord, that ye will be none otherwise minded: but he that troubleth you shall bear his judgment, whosoever he be.

verses.original: ἐγὼ δέ, ἀδελφοί, εἰ περιτομὴν ἔτι κηρύσσω, τί ἔτι διώκομαι; ἄρα κατήργηται τὸ σκάνδαλον τοῦ σταυροῦ.
verses.translit: ego de, adelfoi, ei peritomen eti kirysso, ti eti diokomai; ara katirgitai to skandalon tou stayrou.
verses.translation: And I, brethren, if I yet preach circumcision, why do I yet suffer persecution? then is the offence of the cross ceased.

verses.original: ὄφελον καὶ ἀποκόψονται οἱ ἀναστατοῦντες ὑμᾶς.
verses.translit: ofelon kai apokopsontai oi anastatountes umas.
verses.translation: I would they were even cut off which trouble you.

verses.original: Ὑμεῖς γὰρ ἐπʼ ἐλευθερίᾳ ἐκλήθητε, ἀδελφοί· μόνον μὴ τὴν ἐλευθερίαν εἰς ἀφορμὴν τῇ σαρκί, ἀλλὰ διὰ τῆς ἀγάπης δουλεύετε ἀλλήλοις·
verses.translit: Umeis gar ep' eleytheria eklithite, adelfoi* monon me ten eleytherian eis aformen te sarki, alla dia tes agapis doyleyete allilois*
verses.translation: For, brethren, ye have been called unto liberty; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh, but by love serve one another.

verses.original: ὁ γὰρ πᾶς νόμος ἐν ἑνὶ λόγῳ ⸀πεπλήρωται, ἐν τῷ· Ἀγαπήσεις τὸν πλησίον σου ὡς ⸀σεαυτόν.
verses.translit: o gar pas nomos en eni logo peplirotai, en to* Agapiseis ton plision soy os seayton.
verses.translation: For all the law is fulfilled in one word, even in this; Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

verses.original: εἰ δὲ ἀλλήλους δάκνετε καὶ κατεσθίετε, βλέπετε μὴ ὑπʼ ἀλλήλων ἀναλωθῆτε.
verses.translit: ei de alliloys daknete kai katesthiete, vlepete me up' allilon analothete.
verses.translation: But if ye bite and devour one another, take heed that ye be not consumed one of another.

verses.original: Λέγω δέ, πνεύματι περιπατεῖτε καὶ ἐπιθυμίαν σαρκὸς οὐ μὴ τελέσητε.
verses.translit: Lego de, pneymati peripateite kai epithymian sarkos ou me telesite.
verses.translation: This I say then, Walk in the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh.

verses.original: ἡ γὰρ σὰρξ ἐπιθυμεῖ κατὰ τοῦ πνεύματος, τὸ δὲ πνεῦμα κατὰ τῆς σαρκός, ταῦτα ⸀γὰρ ⸂ἀλλήλοις ἀντίκειται⸃, ἵνα μὴ ἃ ⸀ἐὰν θέλητε ταῦτα ποιῆτε.
verses.translit: e gar sarx epithymei kata tou pneymatos, to de pneuma kata tes sarkos, tauta gar allilois antikeitai, ina me a ean thelite tauta poiete.
verses.translation: For the flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh: and these are contrary the one to the other: so that ye cannot do the things that ye would.

verses.original: εἰ δὲ πνεύματι ἄγεσθε, οὐκ ἐστὲ ὑπὸ νόμον.
verses.translit: ei de pneymati agesthe, ouk este upo nomon.
verses.translation: But if ye be led of the Spirit, ye are not under the law.

verses.original: φανερὰ δέ ἐστιν τὰ ἔργα τῆς σαρκός, ἅτινά ⸀ἐστιν πορνεία, ἀκαθαρσία, ἀσέλγεια,
verses.translit: fanera de estin ta erga tes sarkos, atina estin porneia, akatharsia, aselgeia,
verses.translation: Now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are these ; Adultery, fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness,

verses.original: εἰδωλολατρία, φαρμακεία, ἔχθραι, ⸂ἔρις, ζῆλος⸃, θυμοί, ἐριθεῖαι, διχοστασίαι, αἱρέσεις,
verses.translit: eidololatria, farmakeia, ehthrai, eris, zelos, thymoi, eritheiai, dihostasiai, aireseis,
verses.translation: Idolatry, witchcraft, hatred, variance, emulations, wrath, strife, seditions, heresies,

verses.original: ⸀φθόνοι, μέθαι, κῶμοι, καὶ τὰ ὅμοια τούτοις, ἃ προλέγω ὑμῖν ⸀καθὼς προεῖπον ὅτι οἱ τὰ τοιαῦτα πράσσοντες βασιλείαν θεοῦ οὐ κληρονομήσουσιν.
verses.translit: fthonoi, methai, komoi, kai ta omoia toytois, a prolego umin kathos proeipon oti oi ta toiauta prassontes vasileian theou ou klironomisoysin.
verses.translation: Envyings, murders, drunkenness, revellings, and such like: of the which I tell you before, as I have also told you in time past, that they which do such things shall not inherit the kingdom of God.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ καρπὸς τοῦ πνεύματός ἐστιν ἀγάπη, χαρά, εἰρήνη, μακροθυμία, χρηστότης, ἀγαθωσύνη, πίστις,
verses.translit: O de karpos tou pneymatos estin agapi, hara, eirini, makrothymia, hristotis, agathosyni, pistis,
verses.translation: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,

verses.original: πραΰτης, ἐγκράτεια· κατὰ τῶν τοιούτων οὐκ ἔστιν νόμος.
verses.translit: praytis, egkrateia* kata ton toioyton ouk estin nomos.
verses.translation: Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.

verses.original: οἱ δὲ τοῦ ⸀Χριστοῦ τὴν σάρκα ἐσταύρωσαν σὺν τοῖς παθήμασιν καὶ ταῖς ἐπιθυμίαις.
verses.translit: oi de tou Hristou ten sarka estayrosan sun tois pathimasin kai tais epithymiais.
verses.translation: And they that are Christ’s have crucified the flesh with the affections and lusts.

verses.original: εἰ ζῶμεν πνεύματι, πνεύματι καὶ στοιχῶμεν.
verses.translit: ei zomen pneymati, pneymati kai stoihomen.
verses.translation: If we live in the Spirit, let us also walk in the Spirit.

verses.original: μὴ γινώμεθα κενόδοξοι, ἀλλήλους προκαλούμενοι, ἀλλήλοις φθονοῦντες.
verses.translit: me ginometha kenodoxoi, alliloys prokaloymenoi, allilois fthonountes.
verses.translation: Let us not be desirous of vain glory, provoking one another, envying one another.

verses.original: Ἀδελφοί, ἐὰν καὶ προλημφθῇ ἄνθρωπος ἔν τινι παραπτώματι, ὑμεῖς οἱ πνευματικοὶ καταρτίζετε τὸν τοιοῦτον ἐν πνεύματι πραΰτητος, σκοπῶν σεαυτόν, μὴ καὶ σὺ πειρασθῇς.
verses.translit: Adelfoi, ean kai prolimfthe anthropos en tini paraptomati, umeis oi pneymatikoi katartizete ton toiouton en pneymati praytitos, skopon seayton, me kai su peirasthes.
verses.translation: Brethren, if a man be overtaken in a fault, ye which are spiritual, restore such an one in the spirit of meekness; considering thyself, lest thou also be tempted.

verses.original: ἀλλήλων τὰ βάρη βαστάζετε, καὶ οὕτως ⸀ἀναπληρώσετε τὸν νόμον τοῦ Χριστοῦ.
verses.translit: allilon ta vari vastazete, kai outos anaplirosete ton nomon tou Hristou.
verses.translation: Bear ye one another’s burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.

verses.original: εἰ γὰρ δοκεῖ τις εἶναί τι μηδὲν ὤν, ⸂φρεναπατᾷ ἑαυτόν⸃·
verses.translit: ei gar dokei tis einai ti miden on, frenapata eayton*
verses.translation: For if a man think himself to be something, when he is nothing, he deceiveth himself.

verses.original: τὸ δὲ ἔργον ἑαυτοῦ δοκιμαζέτω ἕκαστος, καὶ τότε εἰς ἑαυτὸν μόνον τὸ καύχημα ἕξει καὶ οὐκ εἰς τὸν ἕτερον,
verses.translit: to de ergon eaytou dokimazeto ekastos, kai tote eis eayton monon to kayhima exei kai ouk eis ton eteron,
verses.translation: But let every man prove his own work, and then shall he have rejoicing in himself alone, and not in another.

verses.original: ἕκαστος γὰρ τὸ ἴδιον φορτίον βαστάσει.
verses.translit: ekastos gar to idion fortion vastasei.
verses.translation: For every man shall bear his own burden.

verses.original: Κοινωνείτω δὲ ὁ κατηχούμενος τὸν λόγον τῷ κατηχοῦντι ἐν πᾶσιν ἀγαθοῖς.
verses.translit: Koinoneito de o katihoymenos ton logon to katihounti en pasin agathois.
verses.translation: Let him that is taught in the word communicate unto him that teacheth in all good things.

verses.original: μὴ πλανᾶσθε, θεὸς οὐ μυκτηρίζεται· ὃ γὰρ ⸀ἐὰν σπείρῃ ἄνθρωπος, τοῦτο καὶ θερίσει·
verses.translit: me planasthe, theos ou myktirizetai* o gar ean speire anthropos, touto kai therisei*
verses.translation: Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.

verses.original: ὅτι ὁ σπείρων εἰς τὴν σάρκα ἑαυτοῦ ἐκ τῆς σαρκὸς θερίσει φθοράν, ὁ δὲ σπείρων εἰς τὸ πνεῦμα ἐκ τοῦ πνεύματος θερίσει ζωὴν αἰώνιον.
verses.translit: oti o speiron eis ten sarka eaytou ek tes sarkos therisei fthoran, o de speiron eis to pneuma ek tou pneymatos therisei zoen aionion.
verses.translation: For he that soweth to his flesh shall of the flesh reap corruption; but he that soweth to the Spirit shall of the Spirit reap life everlasting.

verses.original: τὸ δὲ καλὸν ποιοῦντες μὴ ⸀ἐγκακῶμεν, καιρῷ γὰρ ἰδίῳ θερίσομεν μὴ ἐκλυόμενοι.
verses.translit: to de kalon poiountes me egkakomen, kairo gar idio therisomen me eklyomenoi.
verses.translation: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.

verses.original: ἄρα οὖν ὡς καιρὸν ⸀ἔχομεν, ἐργαζώμεθα τὸ ἀγαθὸν πρὸς πάντας, μάλιστα δὲ πρὸς τοὺς οἰκείους τῆς πίστεως.
verses.translit: ara oun os kairon ehomen, ergazometha to agathon pros pantas, malista de pros tous oikeioys tes pisteos.
verses.translation: As we have therefore opportunity, let us do good unto all men , especially unto them who are of the household of faith.

verses.original: Ἴδετε πηλίκοις ὑμῖν γράμμασιν ἔγραψα τῇ ἐμῇ χειρί.
verses.translit: Idete pilikois umin grammasin egrapsa te eme heiri.
verses.translation: Ye see how large a letter I have written unto you with mine own hand.

verses.original: ὅσοι θέλουσιν εὐπροσωπῆσαι ἐν σαρκί, οὗτοι ἀναγκάζουσιν ὑμᾶς περιτέμνεσθαι, μόνον ⸀ἵνα τῷ σταυρῷ τοῦ ⸀Χριστοῦ ⸀μὴ διώκωνται·
verses.translit: osoi theloysin euprosopesai en sarki, outoi anagkazoysin umas peritemnesthai, monon ina to stayro tou Hristou me diokontai*
verses.translation: As many as desire to make a fair shew in the flesh, they constrain you to be circumcised; only lest they should suffer persecution for the cross of Christ.

verses.original: οὐδὲ γὰρ οἱ ⸀περιτεμνόμενοι αὐτοὶ νόμον φυλάσσουσιν, ἀλλὰ θέλουσιν ὑμᾶς περιτέμνεσθαι ἵνα ἐν τῇ ὑμετέρᾳ σαρκὶ καυχήσωνται.
verses.translit: oude gar oi peritemnomenoi autoi nomon fylassoysin, alla theloysin umas peritemnesthai ina en te umetera sarki kayhisontai.
verses.translation: For neither they themselves who are circumcised keep the law; but desire to have you circumcised, that they may glory in your flesh.

verses.original: ἐμοὶ δὲ μὴ γένοιτο καυχᾶσθαι εἰ μὴ ἐν τῷ σταυρῷ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, διʼ οὗ ἐμοὶ κόσμος ἐσταύρωται ⸀κἀγὼ κόσμῳ.
verses.translit: emoi de me genoito kayhasthai ei me en to stayro tou kyrioy emon Iisou Hristou, di' ou emoi kosmos estayrotai kago kosmo.
verses.translation: But God forbid that I should glory, save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom the world is crucified unto me, and I unto the world.

verses.original: ⸂οὔτε γὰρ⸃ περιτομή τί ⸀ἐστιν οὔτε ἀκροβυστία, ἀλλὰ καινὴ κτίσις.
verses.translit: oute gar peritomi ti estin oute akrovystia, alla kaine ktisis.
verses.translation: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision, but a new creature.

verses.original: καὶ ὅσοι τῷ κανόνι τούτῳ στοιχήσουσιν, εἰρήνη ἐπʼ αὐτοὺς καὶ ἔλεος, καὶ ἐπὶ τὸν Ἰσραὴλ τοῦ θεοῦ.
verses.translit: kai osoi to kanoni toyto stoihisoysin, eirini ep' autous kai eleos, kai epi ton Israel tou theou.
verses.translation: And as many as walk according to this rule, peace be on them, and mercy, and upon the Israel of God.

verses.original: Τοῦ λοιποῦ κόπους μοι μηδεὶς παρεχέτω, ἐγὼ γὰρ τὰ στίγματα ⸀τοῦ Ἰησοῦ ἐν τῷ σώματί μου βαστάζω.
verses.translit: Tou loipou kopoys moi mideis pareheto, ego gar ta stigmata tou Iisou en to somati moy vastazo.
verses.translation: From henceforth let no man trouble me: for I bear in my body the marks of the Lord Jesus.

verses.original: Ἡ χάρις τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ μετὰ τοῦ πνεύματος ὑμῶν, ἀδελφοί· ἀμήν.
verses.translit: E haris tou kyrioy emon Iisou Hristou meta tou pneymatos umon, adelfoi* amin.
verses.translation: Brethren, the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.

verses.original: Παῦλος ἀπόστολος ⸂Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ⸃ διὰ θελήματος θεοῦ τοῖς ἁγίοις τοῖς οὖσιν ⸂[ἐν Ἐφέσῳ]⸃ καὶ πιστοῖς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ·
verses.translit: Paulos apostolos Hristou Iisou dia thelimatos theou tois agiois tois ousin [en Efeso] kai pistois en Hristo Iisou*
verses.translation: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, to the saints which are at Ephesus, and to the faithful in Christ Jesus:

verses.original: χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη ἀπὸ θεοῦ πατρὸς ἡμῶν καὶ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.
verses.translit: haris umin kai eirini apo theou patros emon kai kyrioy Iisou Hristou.
verses.translation: Grace be to you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.original: Εὐλογητὸς ὁ θεὸς καὶ πατὴρ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, ὁ εὐλογήσας ἡμᾶς ἐν πάσῃ εὐλογίᾳ πνευματικῇ ἐν τοῖς ἐπουρανίοις ἐν Χριστῷ,
verses.translit: Eulogitos o theos kai pater tou kyrioy emon Iisou Hristou, o eulogisas emas en pase eulogia pneymatike en tois epoyraniois en Hristo,
verses.translation: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who hath blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ:

verses.original: καθὼς ἐξελέξατο ἡμᾶς ἐν αὐτῷ πρὸ καταβολῆς κόσμου, εἶναι ἡμᾶς ἁγίους καὶ ἀμώμους κατενώπιον αὐτοῦ ἐν ἀγάπῃ,
verses.translit: kathos exelexato emas en auto pro katavoles kosmoy, einai emas agioys kai amomoys katenopion autou en agape,
verses.translation: According as he hath chosen us in him before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and without blame before him in love:

verses.original: προορίσας ἡμᾶς εἰς υἱοθεσίαν διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ εἰς αὐτόν, κατὰ τὴν εὐδοκίαν τοῦ θελήματος αὐτοῦ,
verses.translit: proorisas emas eis yiothesian dia Iisou Hristou eis auton, kata ten eudokian tou thelimatos autou,
verses.translation: Having predestinated us unto the adoption of children by Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his will,

verses.original: εἰς ἔπαινον δόξης τῆς χάριτος αὐτοῦ ⸀ἧς ἐχαρίτωσεν ἡμᾶς ἐν τῷ ἠγαπημένῳ,
verses.translit: eis epainon doxis tes haritos autou es eharitosen emas en to egapimeno,
verses.translation: To the praise of the glory of his grace, wherein he hath made us accepted in the beloved.

verses.original: ἐν ᾧ ἔχομεν τὴν ἀπολύτρωσιν διὰ τοῦ αἵματος αὐτοῦ, τὴν ἄφεσιν τῶν παραπτωμάτων, κατὰ ⸂τὸ πλοῦτος⸃ τῆς χάριτος αὐτοῦ
verses.translit: en o ehomen ten apolytrosin dia tou aimatos autou, ten afesin ton paraptomaton, kata to ploutos tes haritos autou
verses.translation: In whom we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, according to the riches of his grace;

verses.original: ἧς ἐπερίσσευσεν εἰς ἡμᾶς ἐν πάσῃ σοφίᾳ καὶ φρονήσει
verses.translit: es eperisseysen eis emas en pase sofia kai fronisei
verses.translation: Wherein he hath abounded toward us in all wisdom and prudence;

verses.original: γνωρίσας ἡμῖν τὸ μυστήριον τοῦ θελήματος αὐτοῦ, κατὰ τὴν εὐδοκίαν αὐτοῦ ἣν προέθετο ἐν αὐτῷ
verses.translit: gnorisas emin to mystirion tou thelimatos autou, kata ten eudokian autou en proetheto en auto
verses.translation: Having made known unto us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he hath purposed in himself:

verses.original: εἰς οἰκονομίαν τοῦ πληρώματος τῶν καιρῶν, ἀνακεφαλαιώσασθαι τὰ πάντα ἐν τῷ Χριστῷ, τὰ ἐπὶ τοῖς οὐρανοῖς καὶ τὰ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς· ἐν αὐτῷ,
verses.translit: eis oikonomian tou pliromatos ton kairon, anakefalaiosasthai ta panta en to Hristo, ta epi tois ouranois kai ta epi tes ges* en auto,
verses.translation: That in the dispensation of the fulness of times he might gather together in one all things in Christ, both which are in heaven, and which are on earth; even in him:

verses.original: ἐν ᾧ καὶ ἐκληρώθημεν προορισθέντες κατὰ πρόθεσιν τοῦ τὰ πάντα ἐνεργοῦντος κατὰ τὴν βουλὴν τοῦ θελήματος αὐτοῦ,
verses.translit: en o kai eklirothimen prooristhentes kata prothesin tou ta panta energountos kata ten voylen tou thelimatos autou,
verses.translation: In whom also we have obtained an inheritance, being predestinated according to the purpose of him who worketh all things after the counsel of his own will:

verses.original: εἰς τὸ εἶναι ἡμᾶς εἰς ἔπαινον δόξης αὐτοῦ τοὺς προηλπικότας ἐν τῷ Χριστῷ·
verses.translit: eis to einai emas eis epainon doxis autou tous proilpikotas en to Hristo*
verses.translation: That we should be to the praise of his glory, who first trusted in Christ.

verses.original: ἐν ᾧ καὶ ὑμεῖς ἀκούσαντες τὸν λόγον τῆς ἀληθείας, τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τῆς σωτηρίας ὑμῶν, ἐν ᾧ καὶ πιστεύσαντες ἐσφραγίσθητε τῷ πνεύματι τῆς ἐπαγγελίας τῷ ἁγίῳ,
verses.translit: en o kai umeis akoysantes ton logon tes alitheias, to euaggelion tes sotirias umon, en o kai pisteysantes esfragisthite to pneymati tes epaggelias to agio,
verses.translation: In whom ye also trusted , after that ye heard the word of truth, the gospel of your salvation: in whom also after that ye believed, ye were sealed with that holy Spirit of promise,

verses.original: ⸀ὅ ἐστιν ἀρραβὼν τῆς κληρονομίας ἡμῶν, εἰς ἀπολύτρωσιν τῆς περιποιήσεως, εἰς ἔπαινον τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ.
verses.translit: o estin arravon tes klironomias emon, eis apolytrosin tes peripoiiseos, eis epainon tes doxis autou.
verses.translation: Which is the earnest of our inheritance until the redemption of the purchased possession, unto the praise of his glory.

verses.original: Διὰ τοῦτο κἀγώ, ἀκούσας τὴν καθʼ ὑμᾶς πίστιν ἐν τῷ κυρίῳ Ἰησοῦ καὶ τὴν ⸂ἀγάπην τὴν⸃ εἰς πάντας τοὺς ἁγίους,
verses.translit: Dia touto kago, akoysas ten kath' umas pistin en to kyrio Iisou kai ten agapin ten eis pantas tous agioys,
verses.translation: Wherefore I also, after I heard of your faith in the Lord Jesus, and love unto all the saints,

verses.original: οὐ παύομαι εὐχαριστῶν ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν ⸀μνείαν ποιούμενος ἐπὶ τῶν προσευχῶν μου,
verses.translit: ou payomai euhariston uper umon mneian poioymenos epi ton proseyhon moy,
verses.translation: Cease not to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers;

verses.original: ἵνα ὁ θεὸς τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, ὁ πατὴρ τῆς δόξης, δώῃ ὑμῖν πνεῦμα σοφίας καὶ ἀποκαλύψεως ἐν ἐπιγνώσει αὐτοῦ,
verses.translit: ina o theos tou kyrioy emon Iisou Hristou, o pater tes doxis, doe umin pneuma sofias kai apokalypseos en epignosei autou,
verses.translation: That the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give unto you the spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him:

verses.original: πεφωτισμένους τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς τῆς καρδίας ὑμῶν εἰς τὸ εἰδέναι ὑμᾶς τίς ἐστιν ἡ ἐλπὶς τῆς κλήσεως αὐτοῦ, ⸀τίς ὁ πλοῦτος τῆς δόξης τῆς κληρονομίας αὐτοῦ ἐν τοῖς ἁγίοις,
verses.translit: pefotismenoys tous ofthalmous tes kardias umon eis to eidenai umas tis estin e elpis tes kliseos autou, tis o ploutos tes doxis tes klironomias autou en tois agiois,
verses.translation: The eyes of your understanding being enlightened; that ye may know what is the hope of his calling, and what the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,

verses.original: καὶ τί τὸ ὑπερβάλλον μέγεθος τῆς δυνάμεως αὐτοῦ εἰς ἡμᾶς τοὺς πιστεύοντας κατὰ τὴν ἐνέργειαν τοῦ κράτους τῆς ἰσχύος αὐτοῦ
verses.translit: kai ti to upervallon megethos tes dynameos autou eis emas tous pisteyontas kata ten energeian tou kratoys tes ishyos autou
verses.translation: And what is the exceeding greatness of his power to us-ward who believe, according to the working of his mighty power,

verses.original: ἣν ⸀ἐνήργηκεν ἐν τῷ Χριστῷ ἐγείρας αὐτὸν ⸀ἐκ νεκρῶν, καὶ ⸀καθίσας ἐν δεξιᾷ αὐτοῦ ἐν τοῖς ἐπουρανίοις
verses.translit: en enirgiken en to Hristo egeiras auton ek nekron, kai kathisas en dexia autou en tois epoyraniois
verses.translation: Which he wrought in Christ, when he raised him from the dead, and set him at his own right hand in the heavenly places ,

verses.original: ὑπεράνω πάσης ἀρχῆς καὶ ἐξουσίας καὶ δυνάμεως καὶ κυριότητος καὶ παντὸς ὀνόματος ὀνομαζομένου οὐ μόνον ἐν τῷ αἰῶνι τούτῳ ἀλλὰ καὶ ἐν τῷ μέλλοντι·
verses.translit: uperano pasis arhes kai exoysias kai dynameos kai kyriotitos kai pantos onomatos onomazomenoy ou monon en to aioni toyto alla kai en to mellonti*
verses.translation: Far above all principality, and power, and might, and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this world, but also in that which is to come:

verses.original: καὶ πάντα ὑπέταξεν ὑπὸ τοὺς πόδας αὐτοῦ, καὶ αὐτὸν ἔδωκεν κεφαλὴν ὑπὲρ πάντα τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ,
verses.translit: kai panta upetaxen upo tous podas autou, kai auton edoken kefalen uper panta te ekklisia,
verses.translation: And hath put all things under his feet, and gave him to be the head over all things to the church,

verses.original: ἥτις ἐστὶν τὸ σῶμα αὐτοῦ, τὸ πλήρωμα τοῦ τὰ πάντα ἐν πᾶσιν πληρουμένου.
verses.translit: etis estin to soma autou, to pliroma tou ta panta en pasin pliroymenoy.
verses.translation: Which is his body, the fulness of him that filleth all in all.

verses.original: Καὶ ὑμᾶς ὄντας νεκροὺς τοῖς παραπτώμασιν καὶ ταῖς ἁμαρτίαις ⸀ὑμῶν,
verses.translit: Kai umas ontas nekrous tois paraptomasin kai tais amartiais umon,
verses.translation: And you hath he quickened , who were dead in trespasses and sins;

verses.original: ἐν αἷς ποτε περιεπατήσατε κατὰ τὸν αἰῶνα τοῦ κόσμου τούτου, κατὰ τὸν ἄρχοντα τῆς ἐξουσίας τοῦ ἀέρος, τοῦ πνεύματος τοῦ νῦν ἐνεργοῦντος ἐν τοῖς υἱοῖς τῆς ἀπειθείας·
verses.translit: en ais pote periepatisate kata ton aiona tou kosmoy toytoy, kata ton arhonta tes exoysias tou aeros, tou pneymatos tou nun energountos en tois yiois tes apeitheias*
verses.translation: Wherein in time past ye walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit that now worketh in the children of disobedience:

verses.original: ἐν οἷς καὶ ἡμεῖς πάντες ἀνεστράφημέν ποτε ἐν ταῖς ἐπιθυμίαις τῆς σαρκὸς ἡμῶν, ποιοῦντες τὰ θελήματα τῆς σαρκὸς καὶ τῶν διανοιῶν, καὶ ⸀ἤμεθα τέκνα φύσει ὀργῆς ὡς καὶ οἱ λοιποί·
verses.translit: en ois kai emeis pantes anestrafimen pote en tais epithymiais tes sarkos emon, poiountes ta thelimata tes sarkos kai ton dianoion, kai emetha tekna fysei orges os kai oi loipoi*
verses.translation: Among whom also we all had our conversation in times past in the lusts of our flesh, fulfilling the desires of the flesh and of the mind; and were by nature the children of wrath, even as others.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ θεὸς πλούσιος ὢν ἐν ἐλέει, διὰ τὴν πολλὴν ἀγάπην αὐτοῦ ἣν ἠγάπησεν ἡμᾶς,
verses.translit: o de theos ploysios on en eleei, dia ten pollen agapin autou en egapisen emas,
verses.translation: But God, who is rich in mercy, for his great love wherewith he loved us,

verses.original: καὶ ὄντας ἡμᾶς νεκροὺς τοῖς παραπτώμασιν συνεζωοποίησεν τῷ Χριστῷ— χάριτί ἐστε σεσῳσμένοι—
verses.translit: kai ontas emas nekrous tois paraptomasin synezoopoiisen to Hristo-- hariti este sesosmenoi--
verses.translation: Even when we were dead in sins, hath quickened us together with Christ, (by grace ye are saved;)

verses.original: καὶ συνήγειρεν καὶ συνεκάθισεν ἐν τοῖς ἐπουρανίοις ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ,
verses.translit: kai synigeiren kai synekathisen en tois epoyraniois en Hristo Iisou,
verses.translation: And hath raised us up together, and made us sit together in heavenly places in Christ Jesus:

verses.original: ἵνα ἐνδείξηται ἐν τοῖς αἰῶσιν τοῖς ἐπερχομένοις ⸂τὸ ὑπερβάλλον πλοῦτος⸃ τῆς χάριτος αὐτοῦ ἐν χρηστότητι ἐφʼ ἡμᾶς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ.
verses.translit: ina endeixitai en tois aiosin tois eperhomenois to upervallon ploutos tes haritos autou en hristotiti ef' emas en Hristo Iisou.
verses.translation: That in the ages to come he might shew the exceeding riches of his grace in his kindness toward us through Christ Jesus.

verses.original: τῇ γὰρ χάριτί ἐστε σεσῳσμένοι ⸀διὰ πίστεως· καὶ τοῦτο οὐκ ἐξ ὑμῶν, θεοῦ τὸ δῶρον·
verses.translit: te gar hariti este sesosmenoi dia pisteos* kai touto ouk ex umon, theou to doron*
verses.translation: For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God:

verses.original: οὐκ ἐξ ἔργων, ἵνα μή τις καυχήσηται.
verses.translit: ouk ex ergon, ina mi tis kayhisitai.
verses.translation: Not of works, lest any man should boast.

verses.original: αὐτοῦ γάρ ἐσμεν ποίημα, κτισθέντες ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ ἐπὶ ἔργοις ἀγαθοῖς οἷς προητοίμασεν ὁ θεὸς ἵνα ἐν αὐτοῖς περιπατήσωμεν.
verses.translit: autou gar esmen poiima, ktisthentes en Hristo Iisou epi ergois agathois ois proitoimasen o theos ina en autois peripatisomen.
verses.translation: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them.

verses.original: Διὸ μνημονεύετε ὅτι ⸂ποτὲ ὑμεῖς⸃ τὰ ἔθνη ἐν σαρκί, οἱ λεγόμενοι ἀκροβυστία ὑπὸ τῆς λεγομένης περιτομῆς ἐν σαρκὶ χειροποιήτου,
verses.translit: Dio mnimoneyete oti pote umeis ta ethni en sarki, oi legomenoi akrovystia upo tes legomenis peritomes en sarki heiropoiitoy,
verses.translation: Wherefore remember, that ye being in time past Gentiles in the flesh, who are called Uncircumcision by that which is called the Circumcision in the flesh made by hands;

verses.original: ὅτι ⸀ἦτε τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ χωρὶς Χριστοῦ, ἀπηλλοτριωμένοι τῆς πολιτείας τοῦ Ἰσραὴλ καὶ ξένοι τῶν διαθηκῶν τῆς ἐπαγγελίας, ἐλπίδα μὴ ἔχοντες καὶ ἄθεοι ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ.
verses.translit: oti ete to kairo ekeino horis Hristou, apillotriomenoi tes politeias tou Israel kai xenoi ton diathikon tes epaggelias, elpida me ehontes kai atheoi en to kosmo.
verses.translation: That at that time ye were without Christ, being aliens from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of promise, having no hope, and without God in the world:

verses.original: νυνὶ δὲ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ ὑμεῖς οἵ ποτε ὄντες μακρὰν ⸂ἐγενήθητε ἐγγὺς⸃ ἐν τῷ αἵματι τοῦ Χριστοῦ.
verses.translit: nyni de en Hristo Iisou umeis oi pote ontes makran egenithite eggus en to aimati tou Hristou.
verses.translation: But now in Christ Jesus ye who sometimes were far off are made nigh by the blood of Christ.

verses.original: αὐτὸς γάρ ἐστιν ἡ εἰρήνη ἡμῶν, ὁ ποιήσας τὰ ἀμφότερα ἓν καὶ τὸ μεσότοιχον τοῦ φραγμοῦ λύσας, τὴν ἔχθραν ἐν τῇ σαρκὶ αὐτοῦ,
verses.translit: autos gar estin e eirini emon, o poiisas ta amfotera en kai to mesotoihon tou fragmou lysas, ten ehthran en te sarki autou,
verses.translation: For he is our peace, who hath made both one, and hath broken down the middle wall of partition between us ;

verses.original: τὸν νόμον τῶν ἐντολῶν ἐν δόγμασιν καταργήσας, ἵνα τοὺς δύο κτίσῃ ἐν ⸀αὑτῷ εἰς ἕνα καινὸν ἄνθρωπον ποιῶν εἰρήνην,
verses.translit: ton nomon ton entolon en dogmasin katargisas, ina tous dyo ktise en auto eis ena kainon anthropon poion eirinin,
verses.translation: Having abolished in his flesh the enmity, even the law of commandments contained in ordinances; for to make in himself of twain one new man, so making peace;

verses.original: καὶ ἀποκαταλλάξῃ τοὺς ἀμφοτέρους ἐν ἑνὶ σώματι τῷ θεῷ διὰ τοῦ σταυροῦ ἀποκτείνας τὴν ἔχθραν ἐν αὐτῷ·
verses.translit: kai apokatallaxe tous amfoteroys en eni somati to theo dia tou stayrou apokteinas ten ehthran en auto*
verses.translation: And that he might reconcile both unto God in one body by the cross, having slain the enmity thereby:

verses.original: καὶ ἐλθὼν εὐηγγελίσατο εἰρήνην ὑμῖν τοῖς μακρὰν καὶ ⸀εἰρήνην τοῖς ἐγγύς·
verses.translit: kai elthon euiggelisato eirinin umin tois makran kai eirinin tois eggys*
verses.translation: And came and preached peace to you which were afar off, and to them that were nigh.

verses.original: ὅτι διʼ αὐτοῦ ἔχομεν τὴν προσαγωγὴν οἱ ἀμφότεροι ἐν ἑνὶ πνεύματι πρὸς τὸν πατέρα.
verses.translit: oti di' autou ehomen ten prosagogen oi amfoteroi en eni pneymati pros ton patera.
verses.translation: For through him we both have access by one Spirit unto the Father.

verses.original: ἄρα οὖν οὐκέτι ἐστὲ ξένοι καὶ πάροικοι, ἀλλὰ ⸀ἐστὲ συμπολῖται τῶν ἁγίων καὶ οἰκεῖοι τοῦ θεοῦ,
verses.translit: ara oun ouketi este xenoi kai paroikoi, alla este sympolitai ton agion kai oikeioi tou theou,
verses.translation: Now therefore ye are no more strangers and foreigners, but fellowcitizens with the saints, and of the household of God;

verses.original: ἐποικοδομηθέντες ἐπὶ τῷ θεμελίῳ τῶν ἀποστόλων καὶ προφητῶν, ὄντος ἀκρογωνιαίου αὐτοῦ ⸂Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ⸃,
verses.translit: epoikodomithentes epi to themelio ton apostolon kai profiton, ontos akrogoniaioy autou Hristou Iisou,
verses.translation: And are built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner stone ;

verses.original: ἐν ᾧ ⸀πᾶσα οἰκοδομὴ συναρμολογουμένη αὔξει εἰς ναὸν ἅγιον ἐν κυρίῳ,
verses.translit: en o pasa oikodome synarmologoymeni auxei eis naon agion en kyrio,
verses.translation: In whom all the building fitly framed together groweth unto an holy temple in the Lord:

verses.original: ἐν ᾧ καὶ ὑμεῖς συνοικοδομεῖσθε εἰς κατοικητήριον τοῦ θεοῦ ἐν πνεύματι.
verses.translit: en o kai umeis synoikodomeisthe eis katoikitirion tou theou en pneymati.
verses.translation: In whom ye also are builded together for an habitation of God through the Spirit.

verses.original: Τούτου χάριν ἐγὼ Παῦλος ὁ δέσμιος τοῦ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν τῶν ἐθνῶν—
verses.translit: Toytoy harin ego Paulos o desmios tou Hristou Iisou uper umon ton ethnon--
verses.translation: For this cause I Paul, the prisoner of Jesus Christ for you Gentiles,

verses.original: εἴ γε ἠκούσατε τὴν οἰκονομίαν τῆς χάριτος τοῦ θεοῦ τῆς δοθείσης μοι εἰς ὑμᾶς·
verses.translit: ei ge ekoysate ten oikonomian tes haritos tou theou tes dotheisis moi eis umas*
verses.translation: If ye have heard of the dispensation of the grace of God which is given me to you-ward:

verses.original: ⸀κατὰ ἀποκάλυψιν ⸀ἐγνωρίσθη μοι τὸ μυστήριον, καθὼς προέγραψα ἐν ὀλίγῳ,
verses.translit: kata apokalypsin egnoristhi moi to mystirion, kathos proegrapsa en oligo,
verses.translation: How that by revelation he made known unto me the mystery; (as I wrote afore in few words,

verses.original: πρὸς ὃ δύνασθε ἀναγινώσκοντες νοῆσαι τὴν σύνεσίν μου ἐν τῷ μυστηρίῳ τοῦ Χριστοῦ,
verses.translit: pros o dynasthe anaginoskontes noesai ten synesin moy en to mystirio tou Hristou,
verses.translation: Whereby, when ye read, ye may understand my knowledge in the mystery of Christ)

verses.original: ὃ ἑτέραις γενεαῖς οὐκ ἐγνωρίσθη τοῖς υἱοῖς τῶν ἀνθρώπων ὡς νῦν ἀπεκαλύφθη τοῖς ἁγίοις ἀποστόλοις αὐτοῦ καὶ προφήταις ἐν πνεύματι,
verses.translit: o eterais geneais ouk egnoristhi tois yiois ton anthropon os nun apekalyfthi tois agiois apostolois autou kai profitais en pneymati,
verses.translation: Which in other ages was not made known unto the sons of men, as it is now revealed unto his holy apostles and prophets by the Spirit;

verses.original: εἶναι τὰ ἔθνη συγκληρονόμα καὶ σύσσωμα καὶ συμμέτοχα τῆς ἐπαγγελίας ⸂ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ⸃ διὰ τοῦ εὐαγγελίου,
verses.translit: einai ta ethni sygklironoma kai syssoma kai symmetoha tes epaggelias en Hristo Iisou dia tou euaggelioy,
verses.translation: That the Gentiles should be fellowheirs, and of the same body, and partakers of his promise in Christ by the gospel:

verses.original: οὗ ⸀ἐγενήθην διάκονος κατὰ τὴν δωρεὰν τῆς χάριτος τοῦ θεοῦ ⸂τῆς δοθείσης⸃ μοι κατὰ τὴν ἐνέργειαν τῆς δυνάμεως αὐτοῦ—
verses.translit: ou egenithin diakonos kata ten dorean tes haritos tou theou tes dotheisis moi kata ten energeian tes dynameos autou--
verses.translation: Whereof I was made a minister, according to the gift of the grace of God given unto me by the effectual working of his power.

verses.original: ἐμοὶ τῷ ἐλαχιστοτέρῳ πάντων ἁγίων ἐδόθη ἡ χάρις αὕτη— ⸀τοῖς ἔθνεσιν εὐαγγελίσασθαι ⸂τὸ ἀνεξιχνίαστον πλοῦτος⸃ τοῦ Χριστοῦ,
verses.translit: emoi to elahistotero panton agion edothi e haris auti-- tois ethnesin euaggelisasthai to anexihniaston ploutos tou Hristou,
verses.translation: Unto me, who am less than the least of all saints, is this grace given, that I should preach among the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ;

verses.original: καὶ φωτίσαι ⸀πάντας τίς ἡ οἰκονομία τοῦ μυστηρίου τοῦ ἀποκεκρυμμένου ἀπὸ τῶν αἰώνων ἐν τῷ θεῷ τῷ τὰ πάντα ⸀κτίσαντι,
verses.translit: kai fotisai pantas tis e oikonomia tou mystirioy tou apokekrymmenoy apo ton aionon en to theo to ta panta ktisanti,
verses.translation: And to make all men see what is the fellowship of the mystery, which from the beginning of the world hath been hid in God, who created all things by Jesus Christ:

verses.original: ἵνα γνωρισθῇ νῦν ταῖς ἀρχαῖς καὶ ταῖς ἐξουσίαις ἐν τοῖς ἐπουρανίοις διὰ τῆς ἐκκλησίας ἡ πολυποίκιλος σοφία τοῦ θεοῦ,
verses.translit: ina gnoristhe nun tais arhais kai tais exoysiais en tois epoyraniois dia tes ekklisias e polypoikilos sofia tou theou,
verses.translation: To the intent that now unto the principalities and powers in heavenly places might be known by the church the manifold wisdom of God,

verses.original: κατὰ πρόθεσιν τῶν αἰώνων ἣν ἐποίησεν ἐν ⸀τῷ Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ τῷ κυρίῳ ἡμῶν,
verses.translit: kata prothesin ton aionon en epoiisen en to Hristo Iisou to kyrio emon,
verses.translation: According to the eternal purpose which he purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord:

verses.original: ἐν ᾧ ἔχομεν τὴν παρρησίαν ⸀καὶ προσαγωγὴν ἐν πεποιθήσει διὰ τῆς πίστεως αὐτοῦ.
verses.translit: en o ehomen ten parrisian kai prosagogen en pepoithisei dia tes pisteos autou.
verses.translation: In whom we have boldness and access with confidence by the faith of him.

verses.original: διὸ αἰτοῦμαι μὴ ⸀ἐγκακεῖν ἐν ταῖς θλίψεσίν μου ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν, ἥτις ἐστὶν δόξα ὑμῶν.
verses.translit: dio aitoumai me egkakein en tais thlipsesin moy uper umon, etis estin doxa umon.
verses.translation: Wherefore I desire that ye faint not at my tribulations for you, which is your glory.

verses.original: Τούτου χάριν κάμπτω τὰ γόνατά μου πρὸς τὸν ⸀πατέρα,
verses.translit: Toytoy harin kampto ta gonata moy pros ton patera,
verses.translation: For this cause I bow my knees unto the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,

verses.original: ἐξ οὗ πᾶσα πατριὰ ἐν οὐρανοῖς καὶ ἐπὶ γῆς ὀνομάζεται,
verses.translit: ex ou pasa patria en ouranois kai epi ges onomazetai,
verses.translation: Of whom the whole family in heaven and earth is named,

verses.original: ἵνα ⸀δῷ ὑμῖν κατὰ ⸂τὸ πλοῦτος⸃ τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ δυνάμει κραταιωθῆναι διὰ τοῦ πνεύματος αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸν ἔσω ἄνθρωπον,
verses.translit: ina do umin kata to ploutos tes doxis autou dynamei krataiothenai dia tou pneymatos autou eis ton eso anthropon,
verses.translation: That he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, to be strengthened with might by his Spirit in the inner man;

verses.original: κατοικῆσαι τὸν Χριστὸν διὰ τῆς πίστεως ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις ὑμῶν ἐν ἀγάπῃ· ἐρριζωμένοι καὶ τεθεμελιωμένοι,
verses.translit: katoikesai ton Hriston dia tes pisteos en tais kardiais umon en agape* errizomenoi kai tethemeliomenoi,
verses.translation: That Christ may dwell in your hearts by faith; that ye, being rooted and grounded in love,

verses.original: ἵνα ἐξισχύσητε καταλαβέσθαι σὺν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἁγίοις τί τὸ πλάτος καὶ μῆκος καὶ ⸂ὕψος καὶ βάθος⸃,
verses.translit: ina exishysite katalavesthai sun pasin tois agiois ti to platos kai mekos kai upsos kai vathos,
verses.translation: May be able to comprehend with all saints what is the breadth, and length, and depth, and height;

verses.original: γνῶναί τε τὴν ὑπερβάλλουσαν τῆς γνώσεως ἀγάπην τοῦ Χριστοῦ, ἵνα πληρωθῆτε εἰς πᾶν τὸ πλήρωμα τοῦ θεοῦ.
verses.translit: gnonai te ten upervalloysan tes gnoseos agapin tou Hristou, ina plirothete eis pan to pliroma tou theou.
verses.translation: And to know the love of Christ, which passeth knowledge, that ye might be filled with all the fulness of God.

verses.original: Τῷ δὲ δυναμένῳ ὑπὲρ πάντα ποιῆσαι ὑπερεκπερισσοῦ ὧν αἰτούμεθα ἢ νοοῦμεν κατὰ τὴν δύναμιν τὴν ἐνεργουμένην ἐν ἡμῖν,
verses.translit: To de dynameno uper panta poiesai uperekperissou on aitoymetha e nooumen kata ten dynamin ten energoymenin en emin,
verses.translation: Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that worketh in us,

verses.original: αὐτῷ ἡ δόξα ἐν τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ ⸀καὶ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ εἰς πάσας τὰς γενεὰς τοῦ αἰῶνος τῶν αἰώνων· ἀμήν.
verses.translit: auto e doxa en te ekklisia kai en Hristo Iisou eis pasas tas geneas tou aionos ton aionon* amin.
verses.translation: Unto him be glory in the church by Christ Jesus throughout all ages, world without end. Amen.

verses.original: Παρακαλῶ οὖν ὑμᾶς ἐγὼ ὁ δέσμιος ἐν κυρίῳ ἀξίως περιπατῆσαι τῆς κλήσεως ἧς ἐκλήθητε,
verses.translit: Parakalo oun umas ego o desmios en kyrio axios peripatesai tes kliseos es eklithite,
verses.translation: I therefore, the prisoner of the Lord, beseech you that ye walk worthy of the vocation wherewith ye are called,

verses.original: μετὰ πάσης ταπεινοφροσύνης καὶ πραΰτητος, μετὰ μακροθυμίας, ἀνεχόμενοι ἀλλήλων ἐν ἀγάπῃ,
verses.translit: meta pasis tapeinofrosynis kai praytitos, meta makrothymias, anehomenoi allilon en agape,
verses.translation: With all lowliness and meekness, with longsuffering, forbearing one another in love;

verses.original: σπουδάζοντες τηρεῖν τὴν ἑνότητα τοῦ πνεύματος ἐν τῷ συνδέσμῳ τῆς εἰρήνης·
verses.translit: spoydazontes tirein ten enotita tou pneymatos en to syndesmo tes eirinis*
verses.translation: Endeavouring to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.

verses.original: ἓν σῶμα καὶ ἓν πνεῦμα, καθὼς καὶ ἐκλήθητε ἐν μιᾷ ἐλπίδι τῆς κλήσεως ὑμῶν·
verses.translit: en soma kai en pneuma, kathos kai eklithite en mia elpidi tes kliseos umon*
verses.translation: There is one body, and one Spirit, even as ye are called in one hope of your calling;

verses.original: εἷς κύριος, μία πίστις, ἓν βάπτισμα·
verses.translit: eis kyrios, mia pistis, en vaptisma*
verses.translation: One Lord, one faith, one baptism,

verses.original: εἷς θεὸς καὶ πατὴρ πάντων, ὁ ἐπὶ πάντων καὶ διὰ πάντων καὶ ἐν ⸀πᾶσιν.
verses.translit: eis theos kai pater panton, o epi panton kai dia panton kai en pasin.
verses.translation: One God and Father of all, who is above all, and through all, and in you all.

verses.original: Ἑνὶ δὲ ἑκάστῳ ἡμῶν ἐδόθη ⸀ἡ χάρις κατὰ τὸ μέτρον τῆς δωρεᾶς τοῦ Χριστοῦ.
verses.translit: Eni de ekasto emon edothi e haris kata to metron tes doreas tou Hristou.
verses.translation: But unto every one of us is given grace according to the measure of the gift of Christ.

verses.original: διὸ λέγει· Ἀναβὰς εἰς ὕψος ᾐχμαλώτευσεν αἰχμαλωσίαν, ⸀ἔδωκεν δόματα τοῖς ἀνθρώποις.
verses.translit: dio legei* Anavas eis upsos ehmaloteysen aihmalosian, edoken domata tois anthropois.
verses.translation: Wherefore he saith, When he ascended up on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts unto men.

verses.original: τὸ δὲ Ἀνέβη τί ἐστιν εἰ μὴ ὅτι καὶ ⸀κατέβη εἰς τὰ κατώτερα μέρη τῆς γῆς;
verses.translit: to de Anevi ti estin ei me oti kai katevi eis ta katotera meri tes ges;
verses.translation: (Now that he ascended, what is it but that he also descended first into the lower parts of the earth?

verses.original: ὁ καταβὰς αὐτός ἐστιν καὶ ὁ ἀναβὰς ὑπεράνω πάντων τῶν οὐρανῶν, ἵνα πληρώσῃ τὰ πάντα.
verses.translit: o katavas autos estin kai o anavas uperano panton ton ouranon, ina plirose ta panta.
verses.translation: He that descended is the same also that ascended up far above all heavens, that he might fill all things.)

verses.original: καὶ αὐτὸς ἔδωκεν τοὺς μὲν ἀποστόλους, τοὺς δὲ προφήτας, τοὺς δὲ εὐαγγελιστάς, τοὺς δὲ ποιμένας καὶ διδασκάλους,
verses.translit: kai autos edoken tous men apostoloys, tous de profitas, tous de euaggelistas, tous de poimenas kai didaskaloys,
verses.translation: And he gave some, apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, pastors and teachers;

verses.original: πρὸς τὸν καταρτισμὸν τῶν ἁγίων εἰς ἔργον διακονίας, εἰς οἰκοδομὴν τοῦ σώματος τοῦ Χριστοῦ,
verses.translit: pros ton katartismon ton agion eis ergon diakonias, eis oikodomen tou somatos tou Hristou,
verses.translation: For the perfecting of the saints, for the work of the ministry, for the edifying of the body of Christ:

verses.original: μέχρι καταντήσωμεν οἱ πάντες εἰς τὴν ἑνότητα τῆς πίστεως καὶ τῆς ἐπιγνώσεως τοῦ υἱοῦ τοῦ θεοῦ, εἰς ἄνδρα τέλειον, εἰς μέτρον ἡλικίας τοῦ πληρώματος τοῦ Χριστοῦ,
verses.translit: mehri katantisomen oi pantes eis ten enotita tes pisteos kai tes epignoseos tou yiou tou theou, eis andra teleion, eis metron elikias tou pliromatos tou Hristou,
verses.translation: Till we all come in the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, unto a perfect man, unto the measure of the stature of the fulness of Christ:

verses.original: ἵνα μηκέτι ὦμεν νήπιοι, κλυδωνιζόμενοι καὶ περιφερόμενοι παντὶ ἀνέμῳ τῆς διδασκαλίας ἐν τῇ κυβείᾳ τῶν ἀνθρώπων ἐν πανουργίᾳ πρὸς τὴν μεθοδείαν τῆς πλάνης,
verses.translit: ina miketi omen nipioi, klydonizomenoi kai periferomenoi panti anemo tes didaskalias en te kyveia ton anthropon en panoyrgia pros ten methodeian tes planis,
verses.translation: That we henceforth be no more children, tossed to and fro, and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the sleight of men, and cunning craftiness, whereby they lie in wait to deceive;

verses.original: ἀληθεύοντες δὲ ἐν ἀγάπῃ αὐξήσωμεν εἰς αὐτὸν τὰ πάντα, ὅς ἐστιν ἡ κεφαλή, ⸀Χριστός,
verses.translit: alitheyontes de en agape auxisomen eis auton ta panta, os estin e kefali, Hristos,
verses.translation: But speaking the truth in love, may grow up into him in all things, which is the head, even Christ:

verses.original: ἐξ οὗ πᾶν τὸ σῶμα συναρμολογούμενον καὶ συμβιβαζόμενον διὰ πάσης ἁφῆς τῆς ἐπιχορηγίας κατʼ ἐνέργειαν ἐν μέτρῳ ἑνὸς ἑκάστου μέρους τὴν αὔξησιν τοῦ σώματος ποιεῖται εἰς οἰκοδομὴν ἑαυτοῦ ἐν ἀγάπῃ.
verses.translit: ex ou pan to soma synarmologoymenon kai symvivazomenon dia pasis afes tes epihorigias kat' energeian en metro enos ekastoy meroys ten auxisin tou somatos poieitai eis oikodomen eaytou en agape.
verses.translation: From whom the whole body fitly joined together and compacted by that which every joint supplieth, according to the effectual working in the measure of every part, maketh increase of the body unto the edifying of itself in love.

verses.original: Τοῦτο οὖν λέγω καὶ μαρτύρομαι ἐν κυρίῳ, μηκέτι ὑμᾶς περιπατεῖν καθὼς καὶ ⸀τὰ ἔθνη περιπατεῖ ἐν ματαιότητι τοῦ νοὸς αὐτῶν,
verses.translit: Touto oun lego kai martyromai en kyrio, miketi umas peripatein kathos kai ta ethni peripatei en mataiotiti tou noos auton,
verses.translation: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that ye henceforth walk not as other Gentiles walk, in the vanity of their mind,

verses.original: ⸀ἐσκοτωμένοι τῇ διανοίᾳ ὄντες, ἀπηλλοτριωμένοι τῆς ζωῆς τοῦ θεοῦ, διὰ τὴν ἄγνοιαν τὴν οὖσαν ἐν αὐτοῖς, διὰ τὴν πώρωσιν τῆς καρδίας αὐτῶν,
verses.translit: eskotomenoi te dianoia ontes, apillotriomenoi tes zoes tou theou, dia ten agnoian ten ousan en autois, dia ten porosin tes kardias auton,
verses.translation: Having the understanding darkened, being alienated from the life of God through the ignorance that is in them, because of the blindness of their heart:

verses.original: οἵτινες ἀπηλγηκότες ἑαυτοὺς παρέδωκαν τῇ ἀσελγείᾳ εἰς ἐργασίαν ἀκαθαρσίας πάσης ἐν πλεονεξίᾳ.
verses.translit: oitines apilgikotes eaytous paredokan te aselgeia eis ergasian akatharsias pasis en pleonexia.
verses.translation: Who being past feeling have given themselves over unto lasciviousness, to work all uncleanness with greediness.

verses.original: ὑμεῖς δὲ οὐχ οὕτως ἐμάθετε τὸν Χριστόν,
verses.translit: umeis de ouh outos emathete ton Hriston,
verses.translation: But ye have not so learned Christ;

verses.original: εἴ γε αὐτὸν ἠκούσατε καὶ ἐν αὐτῷ ἐδιδάχθητε, καθώς ἐστιν ἀλήθεια ἐν τῷ Ἰησοῦ,
verses.translit: ei ge auton ekoysate kai en auto edidahthite, kathos estin alitheia en to Iisou,
verses.translation: If so be that ye have heard him, and have been taught by him, as the truth is in Jesus:

verses.original: ἀποθέσθαι ὑμᾶς κατὰ τὴν προτέραν ἀναστροφὴν τὸν παλαιὸν ἄνθρωπον τὸν φθειρόμενον κατὰ τὰς ἐπιθυμίας τῆς ἀπάτης,
verses.translit: apothesthai umas kata ten proteran anastrofen ton palaion anthropon ton ftheiromenon kata tas epithymias tes apatis,
verses.translation: That ye put off concerning the former conversation the old man, which is corrupt according to the deceitful lusts;

verses.original: ἀνανεοῦσθαι δὲ τῷ πνεύματι τοῦ νοὸς ὑμῶν,
verses.translit: ananeousthai de to pneymati tou noos umon,
verses.translation: And be renewed in the spirit of your mind;

verses.original: καὶ ἐνδύσασθαι τὸν καινὸν ἄνθρωπον τὸν κατὰ θεὸν κτισθέντα ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ καὶ ὁσιότητι τῆς ἀληθείας.
verses.translit: kai endysasthai ton kainon anthropon ton kata theon ktisthenta en dikaiosyne kai osiotiti tes alitheias.
verses.translation: And that ye put on the new man, which after God is created in righteousness and true holiness.

verses.original: Διὸ ἀποθέμενοι τὸ ψεῦδος λαλεῖτε ἀλήθειαν ἕκαστος μετὰ τοῦ πλησίον αὐτοῦ, ὅτι ἐσμὲν ἀλλήλων μέλη.
verses.translit: Dio apothemenoi to pseudos laleite alitheian ekastos meta tou plision autou, oti esmen allilon meli.
verses.translation: Wherefore putting away lying, speak every man truth with his neighbour: for we are members one of another.

verses.original: ὀργίζεσθε καὶ μὴ ἁμαρτάνετε· ὁ ἥλιος μὴ ἐπιδυέτω ⸀ἐπὶ παροργισμῷ ὑμῶν,
verses.translit: orgizesthe kai me amartanete* o elios me epidyeto epi parorgismo umon,
verses.translation: Be ye angry, and sin not: let not the sun go down upon your wrath:

verses.original: μηδὲ δίδοτε τόπον τῷ διαβόλῳ.
verses.translit: mide didote topon to diavolo.
verses.translation: Neither give place to the devil.

verses.original: ὁ κλέπτων μηκέτι κλεπτέτω, μᾶλλον δὲ κοπιάτω ἐργαζόμενος ⸂ταῖς ἰδίαις χερσὶν τὸ ἀγαθόν⸃, ἵνα ἔχῃ μεταδιδόναι τῷ χρείαν ἔχοντι.
verses.translit: o klepton miketi klepteto, mallon de kopiato ergazomenos tais idiais hersin to agathon, ina ehe metadidonai to hreian ehonti.
verses.translation: Let him that stole steal no more: but rather let him labour, working with his hands the thing which is good, that he may have to give to him that needeth.

verses.original: πᾶς λόγος σαπρὸς ἐκ τοῦ στόματος ὑμῶν μὴ ἐκπορευέσθω, ἀλλὰ εἴ τις ἀγαθὸς πρὸς οἰκοδομὴν τῆς χρείας, ἵνα δῷ χάριν τοῖς ἀκούουσιν.
verses.translit: pas logos sapros ek tou stomatos umon me ekporeyestho, alla ei tis agathos pros oikodomen tes hreias, ina do harin tois akoyoysin.
verses.translation: Let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth, but that which is good to the use of edifying, that it may minister grace unto the hearers.

verses.original: καὶ μὴ λυπεῖτε τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἅγιον τοῦ θεοῦ, ἐν ᾧ ἐσφραγίσθητε εἰς ἡμέραν ἀπολυτρώσεως.
verses.translit: kai me lypeite to pneuma to agion tou theou, en o esfragisthite eis emeran apolytroseos.
verses.translation: And grieve not the holy Spirit of God, whereby ye are sealed unto the day of redemption.

verses.original: πᾶσα πικρία καὶ θυμὸς καὶ ὀργὴ καὶ κραυγὴ καὶ βλασφημία ἀρθήτω ἀφʼ ὑμῶν σὺν πάσῃ κακίᾳ.
verses.translit: pasa pikria kai thymos kai orge kai krayge kai vlasfimia arthito af' umon sun pase kakia.
verses.translation: Let all bitterness, and wrath, and anger, and clamour, and evil speaking, be put away from you, with all malice:

verses.original: ⸀γίνεσθε εἰς ἀλλήλους χρηστοί, εὔσπλαγχνοι, χαριζόμενοι ἑαυτοῖς καθὼς καὶ ὁ θεὸς ἐν Χριστῷ ἐχαρίσατο ⸀ὑμῖν.
verses.translit: ginesthe eis alliloys hristoi, eusplaghnoi, harizomenoi eaytois kathos kai o theos en Hristo eharisato umin.
verses.translation: And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ’s sake hath forgiven you.

verses.original: γίνεσθε οὖν μιμηταὶ τοῦ θεοῦ, ὡς τέκνα ἀγαπητά,
verses.translit: ginesthe oun mimitai tou theou, os tekna agapita,
verses.translation: Be ye therefore followers of God, as dear children;

verses.original: καὶ περιπατεῖτε ἐν ἀγάπῃ, καθὼς καὶ ὁ Χριστὸς ἠγάπησεν ⸀ἡμᾶς καὶ παρέδωκεν ἑαυτὸν ὑπὲρ ⸀ἡμῶν προσφορὰν καὶ θυσίαν τῷ θεῷ εἰς ὀσμὴν εὐωδίας.
verses.translit: kai peripateite en agape, kathos kai o Hristos egapisen emas kai paredoken eayton uper emon prosforan kai thysian to theo eis osmen euodias.
verses.translation: And walk in love, as Christ also hath loved us, and hath given himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweetsmelling savour.

verses.original: Πορνεία δὲ καὶ ⸂ἀκαθαρσία πᾶσα⸃ ἢ πλεονεξία μηδὲ ὀνομαζέσθω ἐν ὑμῖν, καθὼς πρέπει ἁγίοις,
verses.translit: Porneia de kai akatharsia pasa e pleonexia mide onomazestho en umin, kathos prepei agiois,
verses.translation: But fornication, and all uncleanness, or covetousness, let it not be once named among you, as becometh saints;

verses.original: καὶ αἰσχρότης καὶ μωρολογία ἢ εὐτραπελία, ⸂ἃ οὐκ ἀνῆκεν⸃, ἀλλὰ μᾶλλον εὐχαριστία.
verses.translit: kai aishrotis kai morologia e eutrapelia, a ouk aneken, alla mallon euharistia.
verses.translation: Neither filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not convenient: but rather giving of thanks.

verses.original: τοῦτο γὰρ ⸀ἴστε γινώσκοντες ὅτι πᾶς πόρνος ἢ ἀκάθαρτος ἢ πλεονέκτης, ⸀ὅ ἐστιν εἰδωλολάτρης, οὐκ ἔχει κληρονομίαν ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τοῦ Χριστοῦ καὶ θεοῦ.
verses.translit: touto gar iste ginoskontes oti pas pornos e akathartos e pleonektis, o estin eidololatris, ouk ehei klironomian en te vasileia tou Hristou kai theou.
verses.translation: For this ye know, that no whoremonger, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, hath any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.

verses.original: Μηδεὶς ὑμᾶς ἀπατάτω κενοῖς λόγοις, διὰ ταῦτα γὰρ ἔρχεται ἡ ὀργὴ τοῦ θεοῦ ἐπὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς τῆς ἀπειθείας.
verses.translit: Mideis umas apatato kenois logois, dia tauta gar erhetai e orge tou theou epi tous yious tes apeitheias.
verses.translation: Let no man deceive you with vain words: for because of these things cometh the wrath of God upon the children of disobedience.

verses.original: μὴ οὖν γίνεσθε συμμέτοχοι αὐτῶν·
verses.translit: me oun ginesthe symmetohoi auton*
verses.translation: Be not ye therefore partakers with them.

verses.original: ἦτε γάρ ποτε σκότος, νῦν δὲ φῶς ἐν κυρίῳ· ὡς τέκνα φωτὸς περιπατεῖτε,
verses.translit: ete gar pote skotos, nun de fos en kyrio* os tekna fotos peripateite,
verses.translation: For ye were sometimes darkness, but now are ye light in the Lord: walk as children of light:

verses.original: ὁ γὰρ καρπὸς τοῦ ⸀φωτὸς ἐν πάσῃ ἀγαθωσύνῃ καὶ δικαιοσύνῃ καὶ ἀληθείᾳ,
verses.translit: o gar karpos tou fotos en pase agathosyne kai dikaiosyne kai alitheia,
verses.translation: (For the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth;)

verses.original: δοκιμάζοντες τί ἐστιν εὐάρεστον τῷ κυρίῳ·
verses.translit: dokimazontes ti estin euareston to kyrio*
verses.translation: Proving what is acceptable unto the Lord.

verses.original: καὶ μὴ συγκοινωνεῖτε τοῖς ἔργοις τοῖς ἀκάρποις τοῦ σκότους, μᾶλλον δὲ καὶ ἐλέγχετε,
verses.translit: kai me sygkoinoneite tois ergois tois akarpois tou skotoys, mallon de kai eleghete,
verses.translation: And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather reprove them .

verses.original: τὰ γὰρ κρυφῇ γινόμενα ὑπʼ αὐτῶν αἰσχρόν ἐστιν καὶ λέγειν·
verses.translit: ta gar kryfe ginomena up' auton aishron estin kai legein*
verses.translation: For it is a shame even to speak of those things which are done of them in secret.

verses.original: τὰ δὲ πάντα ἐλεγχόμενα ὑπὸ τοῦ φωτὸς φανεροῦται,
verses.translit: ta de panta eleghomena upo tou fotos faneroutai,
verses.translation: But all things that are reproved are made manifest by the light: for whatsoever doth make manifest is light.

verses.original: πᾶν γὰρ τὸ φανερούμενον φῶς ἐστιν. διὸ λέγει· Ἔγειρε, ὁ καθεύδων, καὶ ἀνάστα ἐκ τῶν νεκρῶν, καὶ ἐπιφαύσει σοι ὁ Χριστός.
verses.translit: pan gar to faneroymenon fos estin. dio legei* Egeire, o katheydon, kai anasta ek ton nekron, kai epifaysei soi o Hristos.
verses.translation: Wherefore he saith, Awake thou that sleepest, and arise from the dead, and Christ shall give thee light.

verses.original: Βλέπετε οὖν ⸂ἀκριβῶς πῶς⸃ περιπατεῖτε, μὴ ὡς ἄσοφοι ἀλλʼ ὡς σοφοί,
verses.translit: Vlepete oun akrivos pos peripateite, me os asofoi all' os sofoi,
verses.translation: See then that ye walk circumspectly, not as fools, but as wise,

verses.original: ἐξαγοραζόμενοι τὸν καιρόν, ὅτι αἱ ἡμέραι πονηραί εἰσιν.
verses.translit: exagorazomenoi ton kairon, oti ai emerai ponirai eisin.
verses.translation: Redeeming the time, because the days are evil.

verses.original: διὰ τοῦτο μὴ γίνεσθε ἄφρονες, ἀλλὰ ⸀συνίετε τί τὸ θέλημα τοῦ κυρίου·
verses.translit: dia touto me ginesthe afrones, alla syniete ti to thelima tou kyrioy*
verses.translation: Wherefore be ye not unwise, but understanding what the will of the Lord is .

verses.original: καὶ μὴ μεθύσκεσθε οἴνῳ, ἐν ᾧ ἐστιν ἀσωτία, ἀλλὰ πληροῦσθε ἐν πνεύματι,
verses.translit: kai me methyskesthe oino, en o estin asotia, alla plirousthe en pneymati,
verses.translation: And be not drunk with wine, wherein is excess; but be filled with the Spirit;

verses.original: λαλοῦντες ⸀ἑαυτοῖς ψαλμοῖς καὶ ὕμνοις καὶ ᾠδαῖς πνευματικαῖς, ᾄδοντες καὶ ⸀ψάλλοντες τῇ καρδίᾳ ὑμῶν τῷ κυρίῳ,
verses.translit: lalountes eaytois psalmois kai umnois kai odais pneymatikais, adontes kai psallontes te kardia umon to kyrio,
verses.translation: Speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;

verses.original: εὐχαριστοῦντες πάντοτε ὑπὲρ πάντων ἐν ὀνόματι τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τῷ θεῷ καὶ πατρί,
verses.translit: euharistountes pantote uper panton en onomati tou kyrioy emon Iisou Hristou to theo kai patri,
verses.translation: Giving thanks always for all things unto God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ;

verses.original: ὑποτασσόμενοι ἀλλήλοις ἐν φόβῳ Χριστοῦ.
verses.translit: upotassomenoi allilois en fovo Hristou.
verses.translation: Submitting yourselves one to another in the fear of God.

verses.original: Αἱ γυναῖκες τοῖς ἰδίοις ⸀ἀνδράσιν ὡς τῷ κυρίῳ,
verses.translit: Ai gynaikes tois idiois andrasin os to kyrio,
verses.translation: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord.

verses.original: ὅτι ἀνήρ ἐστιν κεφαλὴ τῆς γυναικὸς ὡς καὶ ὁ Χριστὸς κεφαλὴ τῆς ἐκκλησίας, ⸀αὐτὸς σωτὴρ τοῦ σώματος.
verses.translit: oti anir estin kefale tes gynaikos os kai o Hristos kefale tes ekklisias, autos soter tou somatos.
verses.translation: For the husband is the head of the wife, even as Christ is the head of the church: and he is the saviour of the body.

verses.original: ἀλλὰ ⸀ὡς ἡ ἐκκλησία ὑποτάσσεται τῷ Χριστῷ, οὕτως καὶ αἱ γυναῖκες ⸀τοῖς ἀνδράσιν ἐν παντί.
verses.translit: alla os e ekklisia upotassetai to Hristo, outos kai ai gynaikes tois andrasin en panti.
verses.translation: Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing.

verses.original: Οἱ ἄνδρες, ἀγαπᾶτε τὰς ⸀γυναῖκας, καθὼς καὶ ὁ Χριστὸς ἠγάπησεν τὴν ἐκκλησίαν καὶ ἑαυτὸν παρέδωκεν ὑπὲρ αὐτῆς,
verses.translit: Oi andres, agapate tas gynaikas, kathos kai o Hristos egapisen ten ekklisian kai eayton paredoken uper autes,
verses.translation: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it;

verses.original: ἵνα αὐτὴν ἁγιάσῃ καθαρίσας τῷ λουτρῷ τοῦ ὕδατος ἐν ῥήματι,
verses.translit: ina auten agiase katharisas to loytro tou udatos en Rimati,
verses.translation: That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word,

verses.original: ἵνα παραστήσῃ ⸀αὐτὸς ἑαυτῷ ἔνδοξον τὴν ἐκκλησίαν, μὴ ἔχουσαν σπίλον ἢ ῥυτίδα ἤ τι τῶν τοιούτων, ἀλλʼ ἵνα ᾖ ἁγία καὶ ἄμωμος.
verses.translit: ina parastise autos eayto endoxon ten ekklisian, me ehoysan spilon e Rytida e ti ton toioyton, all' ina e agia kai amomos.
verses.translation: That he might present it to himself a glorious church, not having spot, or wrinkle, or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish.

verses.original: οὕτως ὀφείλουσιν ⸀καὶ οἱ ἄνδρες ἀγαπᾶν τὰς ἑαυτῶν γυναῖκας ὡς τὰ ἑαυτῶν σώματα· ὁ ἀγαπῶν τὴν ἑαυτοῦ γυναῖκα ἑαυτὸν ἀγαπᾷ,
verses.translit: outos ofeiloysin kai oi andres agapan tas eayton gynaikas os ta eayton somata* o agapon ten eaytou gynaika eayton agapa,
verses.translation: So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies. He that loveth his wife loveth himself.

verses.original: οὐδεὶς γάρ ποτε τὴν ἑαυτοῦ σάρκα ἐμίσησεν, ἀλλὰ ἐκτρέφει καὶ θάλπει αὐτήν, καθὼς καὶ ὁ ⸀Χριστὸς τὴν ἐκκλησίαν,
verses.translit: oudeis gar pote ten eaytou sarka emisisen, alla ektrefei kai thalpei autin, kathos kai o Hristos ten ekklisian,
verses.translation: For no man ever yet hated his own flesh; but nourisheth and cherisheth it, even as the Lord the church:

verses.original: ὅτι μέλη ἐσμὲν τοῦ σώματος ⸀αὐτοῦ.
verses.translit: oti meli esmen tou somatos autou.
verses.translation: For we are members of his body, of his flesh, and of his bones.

verses.original: ἀντὶ τούτου καταλείψει ἄνθρωπος ⸀τὸν ⸀πατέρα καὶ ⸀τὴν μητέρα καὶ προσκολληθήσεται ⸂τῇ γυναικὶ⸃ αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἔσονται οἱ δύο εἰς σάρκα μίαν.
verses.translit: anti toytoy kataleipsei anthropos ton patera kai ten mitera kai proskollithisetai te gynaiki autou, kai esontai oi dyo eis sarka mian.
verses.translation: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall be joined unto his wife, and they two shall be one flesh.

verses.original: τὸ μυστήριον τοῦτο μέγα ἐστίν, ἐγὼ δὲ λέγω εἰς Χριστὸν καὶ εἰς τὴν ἐκκλησίαν.
verses.translit: to mystirion touto mega estin, ego de lego eis Hriston kai eis ten ekklisian.
verses.translation: This is a great mystery: but I speak concerning Christ and the church.

verses.original: πλὴν καὶ ὑμεῖς οἱ καθʼ ἕνα ἕκαστος τὴν ἑαυτοῦ γυναῖκα οὕτως ἀγαπάτω ὡς ἑαυτόν, ἡ δὲ γυνὴ ἵνα φοβῆται τὸν ἄνδρα.
verses.translit: plen kai umeis oi kath' ena ekastos ten eaytou gynaika outos agapato os eayton, e de gyne ina fovetai ton andra.
verses.translation: Nevertheless let every one of you in particular so love his wife even as himself; and the wife see that she reverence her husband.

verses.original: Τὰ τέκνα, ὑπακούετε τοῖς γονεῦσιν ὑμῶν ἐν κυρίῳ, τοῦτο γάρ ἐστιν δίκαιον·
verses.translit: Ta tekna, upakoyete tois goneusin umon en kyrio, touto gar estin dikaion*
verses.translation: Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right.

verses.original: τίμα τὸν πατέρα σου καὶ τὴν μητέρα, ἥτις ἐστὶν ἐντολὴ πρώτη ἐν ἐπαγγελίᾳ,
verses.translit: tima ton patera soy kai ten mitera, etis estin entole proti en epaggelia,
verses.translation: Honour thy father and mother; (which is the first commandment with promise;)

verses.original: ἵνα εὖ σοι γένηται καὶ ἔσῃ μακροχρόνιος ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς.
verses.translit: ina eu soi genitai kai ese makrohronios epi tes ges.
verses.translation: That it may be well with thee, and thou mayest live long on the earth.

verses.original: Καὶ οἱ πατέρες, μὴ παροργίζετε τὰ τέκνα ὑμῶν, ἀλλὰ ἐκτρέφετε αὐτὰ ἐν παιδείᾳ καὶ νουθεσίᾳ κυρίου.
verses.translit: Kai oi pateres, me parorgizete ta tekna umon, alla ektrefete auta en paideia kai noythesia kyrioy.
verses.translation: And, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord.

verses.original: Οἱ δοῦλοι, ὑπακούετε τοῖς ⸂κατὰ σάρκα κυρίοις⸃ μετὰ φόβου καὶ τρόμου ἐν ἁπλότητι τῆς καρδίας ὑμῶν ὡς τῷ Χριστῷ,
verses.translit: Oi douloi, upakoyete tois kata sarka kyriois meta fovoy kai tromoy en aplotiti tes kardias umon os to Hristo,
verses.translation: Servants, be obedient to them that are your masters according to the flesh, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as unto Christ;

verses.original: μὴ κατʼ ὀφθαλμοδουλίαν ὡς ἀνθρωπάρεσκοι ἀλλʼ ὡς ⸀δοῦλοι Χριστοῦ ποιοῦντες τὸ θέλημα τοῦ θεοῦ, ἐκ ψυχῆς
verses.translit: me kat' ofthalmodoylian os anthropareskoi all' os douloi Hristou poiountes to thelima tou theou, ek psyhes
verses.translation: Not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but as the servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart;

verses.original: μετʼ εὐνοίας δουλεύοντες, ὡς τῷ κυρίῳ καὶ οὐκ ἀνθρώποις,
verses.translit: met' eunoias doyleyontes, os to kyrio kai ouk anthropois,
verses.translation: With good will doing service, as to the Lord, and not to men:

verses.original: εἰδότες ὅτι ⸂ἕκαστος, ὃ ἂν⸃ ποιήσῃ ἀγαθόν, τοῦτο ⸀κομίσεται ⸀παρὰ κυρίου, εἴτε δοῦλος εἴτε ἐλεύθερος.
verses.translit: eidotes oti ekastos, o an poiise agathon, touto komisetai para kyrioy, eite doulos eite eleytheros.
verses.translation: Knowing that whatsoever good thing any man doeth, the same shall he receive of the Lord, whether he be bond or free.

verses.original: Καὶ οἱ κύριοι, τὰ αὐτὰ ποιεῖτε πρὸς αὐτούς, ἀνιέντες τὴν ἀπειλήν, εἰδότες ὅτι καὶ ⸂αὐτῶν καὶ ὑμῶν⸃ ὁ κύριός ἐστιν ἐν οὐρανοῖς, καὶ προσωπολημψία οὐκ ἔστιν παρʼ αὐτῷ.
verses.translit: Kai oi kyrioi, ta auta poieite pros autoys, anientes ten apeilin, eidotes oti kai auton kai umon o kyrios estin en ouranois, kai prosopolimpsia ouk estin par' auto.
verses.translation: And, ye masters, do the same things unto them, forbearing threatening: knowing that your Master also is in heaven; neither is there respect of persons with him.

verses.original: ⸂Τοῦ λοιποῦ⸃ ἐνδυναμοῦσθε ἐν κυρίῳ καὶ ἐν τῷ κράτει τῆς ἰσχύος αὐτοῦ.
verses.translit: Tou loipou endynamousthe en kyrio kai en to kratei tes ishyos autou.
verses.translation: Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.

verses.original: ἐνδύσασθε τὴν πανοπλίαν τοῦ θεοῦ πρὸς τὸ δύνασθαι ὑμᾶς στῆναι πρὸς τὰς μεθοδείας τοῦ διαβόλου·
verses.translit: endysasthe ten panoplian tou theou pros to dynasthai umas stenai pros tas methodeias tou diavoloy*
verses.translation: Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.

verses.original: ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν ἡμῖν ἡ πάλη πρὸς αἷμα καὶ σάρκα, ἀλλὰ πρὸς τὰς ἀρχάς, πρὸς τὰς ἐξουσίας, πρὸς τοὺς κοσμοκράτορας τοῦ ⸀σκότους τούτου, πρὸς τὰ πνευματικὰ τῆς πονηρίας ἐν τοῖς ἐπουρανίοις.
verses.translit: oti ouk estin emin e pali pros aima kai sarka, alla pros tas arhas, pros tas exoysias, pros tous kosmokratoras tou skotoys toytoy, pros ta pneymatika tes ponirias en tois epoyraniois.
verses.translation: For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places .

verses.original: διὰ τοῦτο ἀναλάβετε τὴν πανοπλίαν τοῦ θεοῦ, ἵνα δυνηθῆτε ἀντιστῆναι ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ πονηρᾷ καὶ ἅπαντα κατεργασάμενοι στῆναι.
verses.translit: dia touto analavete ten panoplian tou theou, ina dynithete antistenai en te emera te ponira kai apanta katergasamenoi stenai.
verses.translation: Wherefore take unto you the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.

verses.original: στῆτε οὖν περιζωσάμενοι τὴν ὀσφὺν ὑμῶν ἐν ἀληθείᾳ, καὶ ἐνδυσάμενοι τὸν θώρακα τῆς δικαιοσύνης,
verses.translit: stete oun perizosamenoi ten osfun umon en alitheia, kai endysamenoi ton thoraka tes dikaiosynis,
verses.translation: Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness;

verses.original: καὶ ὑποδησάμενοι τοὺς πόδας ἐν ἑτοιμασίᾳ τοῦ εὐαγγελίου τῆς εἰρήνης,
verses.translit: kai upodisamenoi tous podas en etoimasia tou euaggelioy tes eirinis,
verses.translation: And your feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace;

verses.original: ⸀ἐν πᾶσιν ἀναλαβόντες τὸν θυρεὸν τῆς πίστεως, ἐν ᾧ δυνήσεσθε πάντα τὰ βέλη τοῦ ⸀πονηροῦ πεπυρωμένα σβέσαι·
verses.translit: en pasin analavontes ton thyreon tes pisteos, en o dynisesthe panta ta veli tou ponirou pepyromena svesai*
verses.translation: Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.

verses.original: καὶ τὴν περικεφαλαίαν τοῦ σωτηρίου ⸀δέξασθε, καὶ τὴν μάχαιραν τοῦ πνεύματος, ὅ ἐστιν ῥῆμα θεοῦ,
verses.translit: kai ten perikefalaian tou sotirioy dexasthe, kai ten mahairan tou pneymatos, o estin Rema theou,
verses.translation: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God:

verses.original: διὰ πάσης προσευχῆς καὶ δεήσεως, προσευχόμενοι ἐν παντὶ καιρῷ ἐν πνεύματι, καὶ εἰς ⸀αὐτὸ ἀγρυπνοῦντες ἐν πάσῃ προσκαρτερήσει καὶ δεήσει περὶ πάντων τῶν ἁγίων,
verses.translit: dia pasis proseyhes kai deiseos, proseyhomenoi en panti kairo en pneymati, kai eis auto agrypnountes en pase proskarterisei kai deisei peri panton ton agion,
verses.translation: Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints;

verses.original: καὶ ὑπὲρ ἐμοῦ, ἵνα μοι δοθῇ λόγος ἐν ἀνοίξει τοῦ στόματός μου, ἐν παρρησίᾳ γνωρίσαι τὸ μυστήριον τοῦ εὐαγγελίου
verses.translit: kai uper emou, ina moi dothe logos en anoixei tou stomatos moy, en parrisia gnorisai to mystirion tou euaggelioy
verses.translation: And for me, that utterance may be given unto me, that I may open my mouth boldly, to make known the mystery of the gospel,

verses.original: ὑπὲρ οὗ πρεσβεύω ἐν ἁλύσει, ἵνα ἐν αὐτῷ παρρησιάσωμαι ὡς δεῖ με λαλῆσαι.
verses.translit: uper ou presveyo en alysei, ina en auto parrisiasomai os dei me lalesai.
verses.translation: For which I am an ambassador in bonds: that therein I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.

verses.original: Ἵνα δὲ ⸂εἰδῆτε καὶ ὑμεῖς⸃ τὰ κατʼ ἐμέ, τί πράσσω, πάντα ⸂γνωρίσει ὑμῖν⸃ Τυχικὸς ὁ ἀγαπητὸς ἀδελφὸς καὶ πιστὸς διάκονος ἐν κυρίῳ,
verses.translit: Ina de eidete kai umeis ta kat' eme, ti prasso, panta gnorisei umin Tyhikos o agapitos adelfos kai pistos diakonos en kyrio,
verses.translation: But that ye also may know my affairs, and how I do, Tychicus, a beloved brother and faithful minister in the Lord, shall make known to you all things:

verses.original: ὃν ἔπεμψα πρὸς ὑμᾶς εἰς αὐτὸ τοῦτο ἵνα γνῶτε τὰ περὶ ἡμῶν καὶ παρακαλέσῃ τὰς καρδίας ὑμῶν.
verses.translit: on epempsa pros umas eis auto touto ina gnote ta peri emon kai parakalese tas kardias umon.
verses.translation: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that ye might know our affairs, and that he might comfort your hearts.

verses.original: Εἰρήνη τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς καὶ ἀγάπη μετὰ πίστεως ἀπὸ θεοῦ πατρὸς καὶ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.
verses.translit: Eirini tois adelfois kai agapi meta pisteos apo theou patros kai kyrioy Iisou Hristou.
verses.translation: Peace be to the brethren, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.original: ἡ χάρις μετὰ πάντων τῶν ἀγαπώντων τὸν κύριον ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦν Χριστὸν ἐν ⸀ἀφθαρσίᾳ.
verses.translit: e haris meta panton ton agaponton ton kyrion emon Iisoun Hriston en aftharsia.
verses.translation: Grace be with all them that love our Lord Jesus Christ in sincerity. Amen.

verses.original: Παῦλος καὶ Τιμόθεος δοῦλοι ⸂Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ⸃ πᾶσιν τοῖς ἁγίοις ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ τοῖς οὖσιν ἐν Φιλίπποις σὺν ἐπισκόποις καὶ διακόνοις·
verses.translit: Paulos kai Timotheos douloi Hristou Iisou pasin tois agiois en Hristo Iisou tois ousin en Filippois sun episkopois kai diakonois*
verses.translation: Paul and Timotheus, the servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus which are at Philippi, with the bishops and deacons:

verses.original: χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη ἀπὸ θεοῦ πατρὸς ἡμῶν καὶ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.
verses.translit: haris umin kai eirini apo theou patros emon kai kyrioy Iisou Hristou.
verses.translation: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.original: Εὐχαριστῶ τῷ θεῷ μου ἐπὶ πάσῃ τῇ μνείᾳ ὑμῶν
verses.translit: Euharisto to theo moy epi pase te mneia umon
verses.translation: I thank my God upon every remembrance of you,

verses.original: πάντοτε ἐν πάσῃ δεήσει μου ὑπὲρ πάντων ὑμῶν, μετὰ χαρᾶς τὴν δέησιν ποιούμενος,
verses.translit: pantote en pase deisei moy uper panton umon, meta haras ten deisin poioymenos,
verses.translation: Always in every prayer of mine for you all making request with joy,

verses.original: ἐπὶ τῇ κοινωνίᾳ ὑμῶν εἰς τὸ εὐαγγέλιον ἀπὸ ⸀τῆς πρώτης ἡμέρας ἄχρι τοῦ νῦν,
verses.translit: epi te koinonia umon eis to euaggelion apo tes protis emeras ahri tou nun,
verses.translation: For your fellowship in the gospel from the first day until now;

verses.original: πεποιθὼς αὐτὸ τοῦτο ὅτι ὁ ἐναρξάμενος ἐν ὑμῖν ἔργον ἀγαθὸν ἐπιτελέσει ἄχρι ἡμέρας ⸂Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ⸃·
verses.translit: pepoithos auto touto oti o enarxamenos en umin ergon agathon epitelesei ahri emeras Hristou Iisou*
verses.translation: Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ:

verses.original: καθώς ἐστιν δίκαιον ἐμοὶ τοῦτο φρονεῖν ὑπὲρ πάντων ὑμῶν, διὰ τὸ ἔχειν με ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ ὑμᾶς, ἔν τε τοῖς δεσμοῖς μου καὶ ἐν τῇ ἀπολογίᾳ καὶ βεβαιώσει τοῦ εὐαγγελίου συγκοινωνούς μου τῆς χάριτος πάντας ὑμᾶς ὄντας·
verses.translit: kathos estin dikaion emoi touto fronein uper panton umon, dia to ehein me en te kardia umas, en te tois desmois moy kai en te apologia kai vevaiosei tou euaggelioy sygkoinonoys moy tes haritos pantas umas ontas*
verses.translation: Even as it is meet for me to think this of you all, because I have you in my heart; inasmuch as both in my bonds, and in the defence and confirmation of the gospel, ye all are partakers of my grace.

verses.original: μάρτυς γάρ ⸀μου ὁ θεός, ὡς ἐπιποθῶ πάντας ὑμᾶς ἐν σπλάγχνοις ⸂Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ⸃.
verses.translit: martys gar moy o theos, os epipotho pantas umas en splaghnois Hristou Iisou.
verses.translation: For God is my record, how greatly I long after you all in the bowels of Jesus Christ.

verses.original: καὶ τοῦτο προσεύχομαι ἵνα ἡ ἀγάπη ὑμῶν ἔτι μᾶλλον καὶ μᾶλλον περισσεύῃ ἐν ἐπιγνώσει καὶ πάσῃ αἰσθήσει,
verses.translit: kai touto proseyhomai ina e agapi umon eti mallon kai mallon perisseye en epignosei kai pase aisthisei,
verses.translation: And this I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and in all judgment;

verses.original: εἰς τὸ δοκιμάζειν ὑμᾶς τὰ διαφέροντα, ἵνα ἦτε εἰλικρινεῖς καὶ ἀπρόσκοποι εἰς ἡμέραν Χριστοῦ,
verses.translit: eis to dokimazein umas ta diaferonta, ina ete eilikrineis kai aproskopoi eis emeran Hristou,
verses.translation: That ye may approve things that are excellent; that ye may be sincere and without offence till the day of Christ;

verses.original: πεπληρωμένοι ⸂καρπὸν δικαιοσύνης τὸν⸃ διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ εἰς δόξαν καὶ ἔπαινον θεοῦ.
verses.translit: pepliromenoi karpon dikaiosynis ton dia Iisou Hristou eis doxan kai epainon theou.
verses.translation: Being filled with the fruits of righteousness, which are by Jesus Christ, unto the glory and praise of God.

verses.original: Γινώσκειν δὲ ὑμᾶς βούλομαι, ἀδελφοί, ὅτι τὰ κατʼ ἐμὲ μᾶλλον εἰς προκοπὴν τοῦ εὐαγγελίου ἐλήλυθεν,
verses.translit: Ginoskein de umas voylomai, adelfoi, oti ta kat' eme mallon eis prokopen tou euaggelioy elilythen,
verses.translation: But I would ye should understand, brethren, that the things which happened unto me have fallen out rather unto the furtherance of the gospel;
