verses.original: ὥστε τοὺς δεσμούς μου φανεροὺς ἐν Χριστῷ γενέσθαι ἐν ὅλῳ τῷ πραιτωρίῳ καὶ τοῖς λοιποῖς πᾶσιν,
verses.translit: oste tous desmoys moy fanerous en Hristo genesthai en olo to praitorio kai tois loipois pasin,
verses.translation: So that my bonds in Christ are manifest in all the palace, and in all other places ;

verses.original: καὶ τοὺς πλείονας τῶν ἀδελφῶν ἐν κυρίῳ πεποιθότας τοῖς δεσμοῖς μου περισσοτέρως τολμᾶν ἀφόβως τὸν ⸀λόγον λαλεῖν.
verses.translit: kai tous pleionas ton adelfon en kyrio pepoithotas tois desmois moy perissoteros tolman afovos ton logon lalein.
verses.translation: And many of the brethren in the Lord, waxing confident by my bonds, are much more bold to speak the word without fear.

verses.original: Τινὲς μὲν καὶ διὰ φθόνον καὶ ἔριν, τινὲς δὲ καὶ διʼ εὐδοκίαν τὸν Χριστὸν κηρύσσουσιν·
verses.translit: Tines men kai dia fthonon kai erin, tines de kai di' eudokian ton Hriston kiryssoysin*
verses.translation: Some indeed preach Christ even of envy and strife; and some also of good will:

verses.original: οἱ μὲν ἐξ ⸂ἀγάπης, εἰδότες ὅτι εἰς ἀπολογίαν τοῦ εὐαγγελίου κεῖμαι⸃,
verses.translit: oi men ex agapis, eidotes oti eis apologian tou euaggelioy keimai,
verses.translation: The one preach Christ of contention, not sincerely, supposing to add affliction to my bonds:

verses.original: οἱ δὲ ἐξ ⸂ἐριθείας τὸν Χριστὸν καταγγέλλουσιν, οὐχ ἁγνῶς, οἰόμενοι θλῖψιν ἐγείρειν τοῖς δεσμοῖς μου⸃.
verses.translit: oi de ex eritheias ton Hriston kataggelloysin, ouh agnos, oiomenoi thlipsin egeirein tois desmois moy.
verses.translation: But the other of love, knowing that I am set for the defence of the gospel.

verses.original: τί γάρ; πλὴν ⸀ὅτι παντὶ τρόπῳ, εἴτε προφάσει εἴτε ἀληθείᾳ, Χριστὸς καταγγέλλεται, καὶ ἐν τούτῳ χαίρω· ἀλλὰ καὶ χαρήσομαι,
verses.translit: ti gar; plen oti panti tropo, eite profasei eite alitheia, Hristos kataggelletai, kai en toyto hairo* alla kai harisomai,
verses.translation: What then? notwithstanding, every way, whether in pretence, or in truth, Christ is preached; and I therein do rejoice, yea, and will rejoice.

verses.original: οἶδα γὰρ ὅτι τοῦτό μοι ἀποβήσεται εἰς σωτηρίαν διὰ τῆς ὑμῶν δεήσεως καὶ ἐπιχορηγίας τοῦ πνεύματος Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ,
verses.translit: oida gar oti touto moi apovisetai eis sotirian dia tes umon deiseos kai epihorigias tou pneymatos Iisou Hristou,
verses.translation: For I know that this shall turn to my salvation through your prayer, and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,

verses.original: κατὰ τὴν ἀποκαραδοκίαν καὶ ἐλπίδα μου ὅτι ἐν οὐδενὶ αἰσχυνθήσομαι, ἀλλʼ ἐν πάσῃ παρρησίᾳ ὡς πάντοτε καὶ νῦν μεγαλυνθήσεται Χριστὸς ἐν τῷ σώματί μου, εἴτε διὰ ζωῆς εἴτε διὰ θανάτου.
verses.translit: kata ten apokaradokian kai elpida moy oti en oudeni aishynthisomai, all' en pase parrisia os pantote kai nun megalynthisetai Hristos en to somati moy, eite dia zoes eite dia thanatoy.
verses.translation: According to my earnest expectation and my hope, that in nothing I shall be ashamed, but that with all boldness, as always, so now also Christ shall be magnified in my body, whether it be by life, or by death.

verses.original: ἐμοὶ γὰρ τὸ ζῆν Χριστὸς καὶ τὸ ἀποθανεῖν κέρδος.
verses.translit: emoi gar to zen Hristos kai to apothanein kerdos.
verses.translation: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.

verses.original: εἰ δὲ τὸ ζῆν ἐν σαρκί, τοῦτό μοι καρπὸς ἔργου— καὶ τί αἱρήσομαι οὐ γνωρίζω·
verses.translit: ei de to zen en sarki, touto moi karpos ergoy-- kai ti airisomai ou gnorizo*
verses.translation: But if I live in the flesh, this is the fruit of my labour: yet what I shall choose I wot not.

verses.original: συνέχομαι δὲ ἐκ τῶν δύο, τὴν ἐπιθυμίαν ἔχων εἰς τὸ ἀναλῦσαι καὶ σὺν Χριστῷ εἶναι, πολλῷ ⸀γὰρ μᾶλλον κρεῖσσον,
verses.translit: synehomai de ek ton dyo, ten epithymian ehon eis to analusai kai sun Hristo einai, pollo gar mallon kreisson,
verses.translation: For I am in a strait betwixt two, having a desire to depart, and to be with Christ; which is far better:

verses.original: τὸ δὲ ἐπιμένειν ⸀ἐν τῇ σαρκὶ ἀναγκαιότερον διʼ ὑμᾶς.
verses.translit: to de epimenein en te sarki anagkaioteron di' umas.
verses.translation: Nevertheless to abide in the flesh is more needful for you.

verses.original: καὶ τοῦτο πεποιθὼς οἶδα ὅτι μενῶ καὶ ⸀παραμενῶ πᾶσιν ὑμῖν εἰς τὴν ὑμῶν προκοπὴν καὶ χαρὰν τῆς πίστεως,
verses.translit: kai touto pepoithos oida oti meno kai parameno pasin umin eis ten umon prokopen kai haran tes pisteos,
verses.translation: And having this confidence, I know that I shall abide and continue with you all for your furtherance and joy of faith;

verses.original: ἵνα τὸ καύχημα ὑμῶν περισσεύῃ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ ἐν ἐμοὶ διὰ τῆς ἐμῆς παρουσίας πάλιν πρὸς ὑμᾶς.
verses.translit: ina to kayhima umon perisseye en Hristo Iisou en emoi dia tes emes paroysias palin pros umas.
verses.translation: That your rejoicing may be more abundant in Jesus Christ for me by my coming to you again.

verses.original: Μόνον ἀξίως τοῦ εὐαγγελίου τοῦ Χριστοῦ πολιτεύεσθε, ἵνα εἴτε ἐλθὼν καὶ ἰδὼν ὑμᾶς εἴτε ἀπὼν ⸀ἀκούω τὰ περὶ ὑμῶν, ὅτι στήκετε ἐν ἑνὶ πνεύματι, μιᾷ ψυχῇ συναθλοῦντες τῇ πίστει τοῦ εὐαγγελίου,
verses.translit: Monon axios tou euaggelioy tou Hristou politeyesthe, ina eite elthon kai idon umas eite apon akoyo ta peri umon, oti stikete en eni pneymati, mia psyhe synathlountes te pistei tou euaggelioy,
verses.translation: Only let your conversation be as it becometh the gospel of Christ: that whether I come and see you, or else be absent, I may hear of your affairs, that ye stand fast in one spirit, with one mind striving together for the faith of the gospel;

verses.original: καὶ μὴ πτυρόμενοι ἐν μηδενὶ ὑπὸ τῶν ἀντικειμένων (ἥτις ⸂ἐστὶν αὐτοῖς⸃ ἔνδειξις ἀπωλείας, ⸀ὑμῶν δὲ σωτηρίας, καὶ τοῦτο ἀπὸ θεοῦ,
verses.translit: kai me ptyromenoi en mideni upo ton antikeimenon (etis estin autois endeixis apoleias, umon de sotirias, kai touto apo theou,
verses.translation: And in nothing terrified by your adversaries: which is to them an evident token of perdition, but to you of salvation, and that of God.

verses.original: ὅτι ὑμῖν ἐχαρίσθη τὸ ὑπὲρ Χριστοῦ, οὐ μόνον τὸ εἰς αὐτὸν πιστεύειν ἀλλὰ καὶ τὸ ὑπὲρ αὐτοῦ πάσχειν),
verses.translit: oti umin eharisthi to uper Hristou, ou monon to eis auton pisteyein alla kai to uper autou pashein),
verses.translation: For unto you it is given in the behalf of Christ, not only to believe on him, but also to suffer for his sake;

verses.original: τὸν αὐτὸν ἀγῶνα ἔχοντες οἷον εἴδετε ἐν ἐμοὶ καὶ νῦν ἀκούετε ἐν ἐμοί.
verses.translit: ton auton agona ehontes oion eidete en emoi kai nun akoyete en emoi.
verses.translation: Having the same conflict which ye saw in me, and now hear to be in me.

verses.original: Εἴ τις οὖν παράκλησις ἐν Χριστῷ, εἴ τι παραμύθιον ἀγάπης, εἴ τις κοινωνία πνεύματος, εἴ τις σπλάγχνα καὶ οἰκτιρμοί,
verses.translit: Ei tis oun paraklisis en Hristo, ei ti paramythion agapis, ei tis koinonia pneymatos, ei tis splaghna kai oiktirmoi,
verses.translation: If there be therefore any consolation in Christ, if any comfort of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any bowels and mercies,

verses.original: πληρώσατέ μου τὴν χαρὰν ἵνα τὸ αὐτὸ φρονῆτε, τὴν αὐτὴν ἀγάπην ἔχοντες, σύμψυχοι, τὸ ἓν φρονοῦντες,
verses.translit: plirosate moy ten haran ina to auto fronete, ten auten agapin ehontes, sympsyhoi, to en fronountes,
verses.translation: Fulfil ye my joy, that ye be likeminded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind.

verses.original: μηδὲν κατʼ ἐριθείαν ⸂μηδὲ κατὰ⸃ κενοδοξίαν, ἀλλὰ τῇ ταπεινοφροσύνῃ ἀλλήλους ἡγούμενοι ὑπερέχοντας ἑαυτῶν,
verses.translit: miden kat' eritheian mide kata kenodoxian, alla te tapeinofrosyne alliloys egoymenoi uperehontas eayton,
verses.translation: Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves.

verses.original: μὴ τὰ ἑαυτῶν ⸀ἕκαστοι ⸀σκοποῦντες, ἀλλὰ καὶ τὰ ἑτέρων ⸁ἕκαστοι.
verses.translit: me ta eayton ekastoi skopountes, alla kai ta eteron ekastoi.
verses.translation: Look not every man on his own things, but every man also on the things of others.

verses.original: τοῦτο ⸀φρονεῖτε ἐν ὑμῖν ὃ καὶ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ,
verses.translit: touto froneite en umin o kai en Hristo Iisou,
verses.translation: Let this mind be in you, which was also in Christ Jesus:

verses.original: ὃς ἐν μορφῇ θεοῦ ὑπάρχων οὐχ ἁρπαγμὸν ἡγήσατο τὸ εἶναι ἴσα θεῷ,
verses.translit: os en morfe theou uparhon ouh arpagmon egisato to einai isa theo,
verses.translation: Who, being in the form of God, thought it not robbery to be equal with God:

verses.original: ἀλλὰ ἑαυτὸν ἐκένωσεν μορφὴν δούλου λαβών, ἐν ὁμοιώματι ἀνθρώπων γενόμενος· καὶ σχήματι εὑρεθεὶς ὡς ἄνθρωπος
verses.translit: alla eayton ekenosen morfen doyloy lavon, en omoiomati anthropon genomenos* kai shimati euretheis os anthropos
verses.translation: But made himself of no reputation, and took upon him the form of a servant, and was made in the likeness of men:

verses.original: ἐταπείνωσεν ἑαυτὸν γενόμενος ὑπήκοος μέχρι θανάτου, θανάτου δὲ σταυροῦ·
verses.translit: etapeinosen eayton genomenos upikoos mehri thanatoy, thanatoy de stayrou*
verses.translation: And being found in fashion as a man, he humbled himself, and became obedient unto death, even the death of the cross.

verses.original: διὸ καὶ ὁ θεὸς αὐτὸν ὑπερύψωσεν, καὶ ἐχαρίσατο αὐτῷ ⸀τὸ ὄνομα τὸ ὑπὲρ πᾶν ὄνομα,
verses.translit: dio kai o theos auton uperypsosen, kai eharisato auto to onoma to uper pan onoma,
verses.translation: Wherefore God also hath highly exalted him, and given him a name which is above every name:

verses.original: ἵνα ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι Ἰησοῦ πᾶν γόνυ κάμψῃ ἐπουρανίων καὶ ἐπιγείων καὶ καταχθονίων,
verses.translit: ina en to onomati Iisou pan gony kampse epoyranion kai epigeion kai katahthonion,
verses.translation: That at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of things in heaven, and things in earth, and things under the earth;

verses.original: καὶ πᾶσα γλῶσσα ἐξομολογήσηται ὅτι κύριος Ἰησοῦς Χριστὸς εἰς δόξαν θεοῦ πατρός.
verses.translit: kai pasa glossa exomologisitai oti kyrios Iisous Hristos eis doxan theou patros.
verses.translation: And that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

verses.original: Ὥστε, ἀγαπητοί μου, καθὼς πάντοτε ὑπηκούσατε, μὴ ὡς ἐν τῇ παρουσίᾳ μου μόνον ἀλλὰ νῦν πολλῷ μᾶλλον ἐν τῇ ἀπουσίᾳ μου, μετὰ φόβου καὶ τρόμου τὴν ἑαυτῶν σωτηρίαν κατεργάζεσθε,
verses.translit: Oste, agapitoi moy, kathos pantote upikoysate, me os en te paroysia moy monon alla nun pollo mallon en te apoysia moy, meta fovoy kai tromoy ten eayton sotirian katergazesthe,
verses.translation: Wherefore, my beloved, as ye have always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.

verses.original: ⸀θεὸς γάρ ἐστιν ὁ ἐνεργῶν ἐν ὑμῖν καὶ τὸ θέλειν καὶ τὸ ἐνεργεῖν ὑπὲρ τῆς εὐδοκίας.
verses.translit: theos gar estin o energon en umin kai to thelein kai to energein uper tes eudokias.
verses.translation: For it is God which worketh in you both to will and to do of his good pleasure.

verses.original: Πάντα ποιεῖτε χωρὶς γογγυσμῶν καὶ διαλογισμῶν,
verses.translit: Panta poieite horis goggysmon kai dialogismon,
verses.translation: Do all things without murmurings and disputings:

verses.original: ἵνα γένησθε ἄμεμπτοι καὶ ἀκέραιοι, τέκνα θεοῦ ⸂ἄμωμα μέσον⸃ γενεᾶς σκολιᾶς καὶ διεστραμμένης, ἐν οἷς φαίνεσθε ὡς φωστῆρες ἐν κόσμῳ
verses.translit: ina genisthe amemptoi kai akeraioi, tekna theou amoma meson geneas skolias kai diestrammenis, en ois fainesthe os fosteres en kosmo
verses.translation: That ye may be blameless and harmless, the sons of God, without rebuke, in the midst of a crooked and perverse nation, among whom ye shine as lights in the world;

verses.original: λόγον ζωῆς ἐπέχοντες, εἰς καύχημα ἐμοὶ εἰς ἡμέραν Χριστοῦ, ὅτι οὐκ εἰς κενὸν ἔδραμον οὐδὲ εἰς κενὸν ἐκοπίασα.
verses.translit: logon zoes epehontes, eis kayhima emoi eis emeran Hristou, oti ouk eis kenon edramon oude eis kenon ekopiasa.
verses.translation: Holding forth the word of life; that I may rejoice in the day of Christ, that I have not run in vain, neither laboured in vain.

verses.original: ἀλλὰ εἰ καὶ σπένδομαι ἐπὶ τῇ θυσίᾳ καὶ λειτουργίᾳ τῆς πίστεως ὑμῶν, χαίρω καὶ συγχαίρω πᾶσιν ὑμῖν·
verses.translit: alla ei kai spendomai epi te thysia kai leitoyrgia tes pisteos umon, hairo kai syghairo pasin umin*
verses.translation: Yea, and if I be offered upon the sacrifice and service of your faith, I joy, and rejoice with you all.

verses.original: τὸ δὲ αὐτὸ καὶ ὑμεῖς χαίρετε καὶ συγχαίρετέ μοι.
verses.translit: to de auto kai umeis hairete kai syghairete moi.
verses.translation: For the same cause also do ye joy, and rejoice with me.

verses.original: Ἐλπίζω δὲ ἐν κυρίῳ Ἰησοῦ Τιμόθεον ταχέως πέμψαι ὑμῖν, ἵνα κἀγὼ εὐψυχῶ γνοὺς τὰ περὶ ὑμῶν.
verses.translit: Elpizo de en kyrio Iisou Timotheon taheos pempsai umin, ina kago eupsyho gnous ta peri umon.
verses.translation: But I trust in the Lord Jesus to send Timotheus shortly unto you, that I also may be of good comfort, when I know your state.

verses.original: οὐδένα γὰρ ἔχω ἰσόψυχον ὅστις γνησίως τὰ περὶ ὑμῶν μεριμνήσει,
verses.translit: oudena gar eho isopsyhon ostis gnisios ta peri umon merimnisei,
verses.translation: For I have no man likeminded, who will naturally care for your state.

verses.original: οἱ πάντες γὰρ τὰ ἑαυτῶν ζητοῦσιν, οὐ τὰ ⸂Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ⸃.
verses.translit: oi pantes gar ta eayton zitousin, ou ta Iisou Hristou.
verses.translation: For all seek their own, not the things which are Jesus Christ’s.

verses.original: τὴν δὲ δοκιμὴν αὐτοῦ γινώσκετε, ὅτι ὡς πατρὶ τέκνον σὺν ἐμοὶ ἐδούλευσεν εἰς τὸ εὐαγγέλιον.
verses.translit: ten de dokimen autou ginoskete, oti os patri teknon sun emoi edoyleysen eis to euaggelion.
verses.translation: But ye know the proof of him, that, as a son with the father, he hath served with me in the gospel.

verses.original: τοῦτον μὲν οὖν ἐλπίζω πέμψαι ὡς ἂν ἀφίδω τὰ περὶ ἐμὲ ἐξαυτῆς·
verses.translit: touton men oun elpizo pempsai os an afido ta peri eme exaytes*
verses.translation: Him therefore I hope to send presently, so soon as I shall see how it will go with me.

verses.original: πέποιθα δὲ ἐν κυρίῳ ὅτι καὶ αὐτὸς ταχέως ἐλεύσομαι.
verses.translit: pepoitha de en kyrio oti kai autos taheos eleysomai.
verses.translation: But I trust in the Lord that I also myself shall come shortly.

verses.original: Ἀναγκαῖον δὲ ἡγησάμην Ἐπαφρόδιτον τὸν ἀδελφὸν καὶ συνεργὸν καὶ συστρατιώτην μου, ὑμῶν δὲ ἀπόστολον καὶ λειτουργὸν τῆς χρείας μου, πέμψαι πρὸς ὑμᾶς,
verses.translit: Anagkaion de egisamin Epafroditon ton adelfon kai synergon kai systratiotin moy, umon de apostolon kai leitoyrgon tes hreias moy, pempsai pros umas,
verses.translation: Yet I supposed it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, and companion in labour, and fellowsoldier, but your messenger, and he that ministered to my wants.

verses.original: ἐπειδὴ ἐπιποθῶν ἦν πάντας ⸀ὑμᾶς, καὶ ἀδημονῶν διότι ἠκούσατε ὅτι ἠσθένησεν.
verses.translit: epeide epipothon en pantas umas, kai adimonon dioti ekoysate oti esthenisen.
verses.translation: For he longed after you all, and was full of heaviness, because that ye had heard that he had been sick.

verses.original: καὶ γὰρ ἠσθένησεν παραπλήσιον ⸀θανάτῳ· ἀλλὰ ὁ θεὸς ⸂ἠλέησεν αὐτόν⸃, οὐκ αὐτὸν δὲ μόνον ἀλλὰ καὶ ἐμέ, ἵνα μὴ λύπην ἐπὶ λύπην σχῶ.
verses.translit: kai gar esthenisen paraplision thanato* alla o theos eleisen auton, ouk auton de monon alla kai eme, ina me lypin epi lypin sho.
verses.translation: For indeed he was sick nigh unto death: but God had mercy on him; and not on him only, but on me also, lest I should have sorrow upon sorrow.

verses.original: σπουδαιοτέρως οὖν ἔπεμψα αὐτὸν ἵνα ἰδόντες αὐτὸν πάλιν χαρῆτε κἀγὼ ἀλυπότερος ὦ.
verses.translit: spoydaioteros oun epempsa auton ina idontes auton palin harete kago alypoteros o.
verses.translation: I sent him therefore the more carefully, that, when ye see him again, ye may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.

verses.original: προσδέχεσθε οὖν αὐτὸν ἐν κυρίῳ μετὰ πάσης χαρᾶς, καὶ τοὺς τοιούτους ἐντίμους ἔχετε,
verses.translit: prosdehesthe oun auton en kyrio meta pasis haras, kai tous toioytoys entimoys ehete,
verses.translation: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all gladness; and hold such in reputation:

verses.original: ὅτι διὰ τὸ ἔργον ⸀Χριστοῦ μέχρι θανάτου ἤγγισεν, ⸀παραβολευσάμενος τῇ ψυχῇ ἵνα ἀναπληρώσῃ τὸ ὑμῶν ὑστέρημα τῆς πρός με λειτουργίας.
verses.translit: oti dia to ergon Hristou mehri thanatoy eggisen, paravoleysamenos te psyhe ina anaplirose to umon usterima tes pros me leitoyrgias.
verses.translation: Because for the work of Christ he was nigh unto death, not regarding his life, to supply your lack of service toward me.

verses.original: Τὸ λοιπόν, ἀδελφοί μου, χαίρετε ἐν κυρίῳ. τὰ αὐτὰ γράφειν ὑμῖν ἐμοὶ μὲν οὐκ ὀκνηρόν, ὑμῖν δὲ ἀσφαλές.
verses.translit: To loipon, adelfoi moy, hairete en kyrio. ta auta grafein umin emoi men ouk okniron, umin de asfales.
verses.translation: Finally, my brethren, rejoice in the Lord. To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not grievous, but for you it is safe.

verses.original: Βλέπετε τοὺς κύνας, βλέπετε τοὺς κακοὺς ἐργάτας, βλέπετε τὴν κατατομήν.
verses.translit: Vlepete tous kynas, vlepete tous kakous ergatas, vlepete ten katatomin.
verses.translation: Beware of dogs, beware of evil workers, beware of the concision.

verses.original: ἡμεῖς γάρ ἐσμεν ἡ περιτομή, οἱ πνεύματι θεοῦ λατρεύοντες καὶ καυχώμενοι ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ καὶ οὐκ ἐν σαρκὶ πεποιθότες,
verses.translit: emeis gar esmen e peritomi, oi pneymati theou latreyontes kai kayhomenoi en Hristo Iisou kai ouk en sarki pepoithotes,
verses.translation: For we are the circumcision, which worship God in the spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh.

verses.original: καίπερ ἐγὼ ἔχων πεποίθησιν καὶ ἐν σαρκί. Εἴ τις δοκεῖ ἄλλος πεποιθέναι ἐν σαρκί, ἐγὼ μᾶλλον·
verses.translit: kaiper ego ehon pepoithisin kai en sarki. Ei tis dokei allos pepoithenai en sarki, ego mallon*
verses.translation: Though I might also have confidence in the flesh. If any other man thinketh that he hath whereof he might trust in the flesh, I more:

verses.original: περιτομῇ ὀκταήμερος, ἐκ γένους Ἰσραήλ, φυλῆς Βενιαμίν, Ἑβραῖος ἐξ Ἑβραίων, κατὰ νόμον Φαρισαῖος,
verses.translit: peritome oktaimeros, ek genoys Israil, fyles Veniamin, Evraios ex Evraion, kata nomon Farisaios,
verses.translation: Circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, an Hebrew of the Hebrews; as touching the law, a Pharisee;

verses.original: κατὰ ⸀ζῆλος διώκων τὴν ἐκκλησίαν, κατὰ δικαιοσύνην τὴν ἐν νόμῳ γενόμενος ἄμεμπτος.
verses.translit: kata zelos diokon ten ekklisian, kata dikaiosynin ten en nomo genomenos amemptos.
verses.translation: Concerning zeal, persecuting the church; touching the righteousness which is in the law, blameless.

verses.original: Ἀλλὰ ἅτινα ἦν μοι κέρδη, ταῦτα ἥγημαι διὰ τὸν Χριστὸν ζημίαν.
verses.translit: Alla atina en moi kerdi, tauta egimai dia ton Hriston zimian.
verses.translation: But what things were gain to me, those I counted loss for Christ.

verses.original: ἀλλὰ ⸀μενοῦνγε καὶ ἡγοῦμαι πάντα ζημίαν εἶναι διὰ τὸ ὑπερέχον τῆς γνώσεως Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ τοῦ κυρίου μου διʼ ὃν τὰ πάντα ἐζημιώθην, καὶ ἡγοῦμαι ⸀σκύβαλα ἵνα Χριστὸν κερδήσω
verses.translit: alla menounge kai egoumai panta zimian einai dia to uperehon tes gnoseos Hristou Iisou tou kyrioy moy di' on ta panta ezimiothin, kai egoumai skyvala ina Hriston kerdiso
verses.translation: Yea doubtless, and I count all things but loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord: for whom I have suffered the loss of all things, and do count them but dung, that I may win Christ,

verses.original: καὶ εὑρεθῶ ἐν αὐτῷ, μὴ ἔχων ἐμὴν δικαιοσύνην τὴν ἐκ νόμου ἀλλὰ τὴν διὰ πίστεως Χριστοῦ, τὴν ἐκ θεοῦ δικαιοσύνην ἐπὶ τῇ πίστει,
verses.translit: kai euretho en auto, me ehon emen dikaiosynin ten ek nomoy alla ten dia pisteos Hristou, ten ek theou dikaiosynin epi te pistei,
verses.translation: And be found in him, not having mine own righteousness, which is of the law, but that which is through the faith of Christ, the righteousness which is of God by faith:

verses.original: τοῦ γνῶναι αὐτὸν καὶ τὴν δύναμιν τῆς ἀναστάσεως αὐτοῦ καὶ ⸀κοινωνίαν παθημάτων αὐτοῦ, ⸀συμμορφιζόμενος τῷ θανάτῳ αὐτοῦ,
verses.translit: tou gnonai auton kai ten dynamin tes anastaseos autou kai koinonian pathimaton autou, symmorfizomenos to thanato autou,
verses.translation: That I may know him, and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, being made conformable unto his death;

verses.original: εἴ πως καταντήσω εἰς τὴν ἐξανάστασιν ⸂τὴν ἐκ⸃ νεκρῶν.
verses.translit: ei pos katantiso eis ten exanastasin ten ek nekron.
verses.translation: If by any means I might attain unto the resurrection of the dead.

verses.original: Οὐχ ὅτι ἤδη ἔλαβον ἢ ἤδη τετελείωμαι, διώκω δὲ εἰ καὶ καταλάβω, ἐφʼ ᾧ καὶ κατελήμφθην ὑπὸ ⸀Χριστοῦ.
verses.translit: Ouh oti edi elavon e edi teteleiomai, dioko de ei kai katalavo, ef' o kai katelimfthin upo Hristou.
verses.translation: Not as though I had already attained, either were already perfect: but I follow after, if that I may apprehend that for which also I am apprehended of Christ Jesus.

verses.original: ἀδελφοί, ἐγὼ ἐμαυτὸν ⸀οὐ λογίζομαι κατειληφέναι· ἓν δέ, τὰ μὲν ὀπίσω ἐπιλανθανόμενος τοῖς δὲ ἔμπροσθεν ἐπεκτεινόμενος,
verses.translit: adelfoi, ego emayton ou logizomai kateilifenai* en de, ta men opiso epilanthanomenos tois de emprosthen epekteinomenos,
verses.translation: Brethren, I count not myself to have apprehended: but this one thing I do , forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forth unto those things which are before,

verses.original: κατὰ σκοπὸν διώκω ⸀εἰς τὸ βραβεῖον τῆς ἄνω κλήσεως τοῦ θεοῦ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ.
verses.translit: kata skopon dioko eis to vraveion tes ano kliseos tou theou en Hristo Iisou.
verses.translation: I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.

verses.original: ὅσοι οὖν τέλειοι, τοῦτο φρονῶμεν· καὶ εἴ τι ἑτέρως φρονεῖτε, καὶ τοῦτο ὁ θεὸς ὑμῖν ἀποκαλύψει·
verses.translit: osoi oun teleioi, touto fronomen* kai ei ti eteros froneite, kai touto o theos umin apokalypsei*
verses.translation: Let us therefore, as many as be perfect, be thus minded: and if in any thing ye be otherwise minded, God shall reveal even this unto you.

verses.original: πλὴν εἰς ὃ ἐφθάσαμεν, τῷ αὐτῷ ⸀στοιχεῖν.
verses.translit: plen eis o efthasamen, to auto stoihein.
verses.translation: Nevertheless, whereto we have already attained, let us walk by the same rule, let us mind the same thing.

verses.original: Συμμιμηταί μου γίνεσθε, ἀδελφοί, καὶ σκοπεῖτε τοὺς οὕτω περιπατοῦντας καθὼς ἔχετε τύπον ἡμᾶς·
verses.translit: Symmimitai moy ginesthe, adelfoi, kai skopeite tous outo peripatountas kathos ehete typon emas*
verses.translation: Brethren, be followers together of me, and mark them which walk so as ye have us for an ensample.

verses.original: πολλοὶ γὰρ περιπατοῦσιν οὓς πολλάκις ἔλεγον ὑμῖν, νῦν δὲ καὶ κλαίων λέγω, τοὺς ἐχθροὺς τοῦ σταυροῦ τοῦ Χριστοῦ,
verses.translit: polloi gar peripatousin ous pollakis elegon umin, nun de kai klaion lego, tous ehthrous tou stayrou tou Hristou,
verses.translation: (For many walk, of whom I have told you often, and now tell you even weeping, that they are the enemies of the cross of Christ:

verses.original: ὧν τὸ τέλος ἀπώλεια, ὧν ὁ θεὸς ἡ κοιλία καὶ ἡ δόξα ἐν τῇ αἰσχύνῃ αὐτῶν, οἱ τὰ ἐπίγεια φρονοῦντες.
verses.translit: on to telos apoleia, on o theos e koilia kai e doxa en te aishyne auton, oi ta epigeia fronountes.
verses.translation: Whose end is destruction, whose God is their belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who mind earthly things.)

verses.original: ἡμῶν γὰρ τὸ πολίτευμα ἐν οὐρανοῖς ὑπάρχει, ἐξ οὗ καὶ σωτῆρα ἀπεκδεχόμεθα κύριον Ἰησοῦν Χριστόν,
verses.translit: emon gar to politeyma en ouranois uparhei, ex ou kai sotera apekdehometha kyrion Iisoun Hriston,
verses.translation: For our conversation is in heaven; from whence also we look for the Saviour, the Lord Jesus Christ:

verses.original: ὃς μετασχηματίσει τὸ σῶμα τῆς ταπεινώσεως ⸀ἡμῶν σύμμορφον τῷ σώματι τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ κατὰ τὴν ἐνέργειαν τοῦ δύνασθαι αὐτὸν καὶ ὑποτάξαι ⸀αὑτῷ τὰ πάντα.
verses.translit: os metashimatisei to soma tes tapeinoseos emon symmorfon to somati tes doxis autou kata ten energeian tou dynasthai auton kai upotaxai auto ta panta.
verses.translation: Who shall change our vile body, that it may be fashioned like unto his glorious body, according to the working whereby he is able even to subdue all things unto himself.

verses.original: ὥστε, ἀδελφοί μου ἀγαπητοὶ καὶ ἐπιπόθητοι, χαρὰ καὶ στέφανός μου, οὕτως στήκετε ἐν κυρίῳ, ἀγαπητοί.
verses.translit: oste, adelfoi moy agapitoi kai epipothitoi, hara kai stefanos moy, outos stikete en kyrio, agapitoi.
verses.translation: Therefore, my brethren dearly beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, so stand fast in the Lord, my dearly beloved.

verses.original: Εὐοδίαν παρακαλῶ καὶ Συντύχην παρακαλῶ τὸ αὐτὸ φρονεῖν ἐν κυρίῳ.
verses.translit: Euodian parakalo kai Syntyhin parakalo to auto fronein en kyrio.
verses.translation: I beseech Euodias, and beseech Syntyche, that they be of the same mind in the Lord.

verses.original: ναὶ ἐρωτῶ καὶ σέ, ⸂γνήσιε σύζυγε⸃, συλλαμβάνου αὐταῖς, αἵτινες ἐν τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ συνήθλησάν μοι μετὰ καὶ Κλήμεντος καὶ τῶν λοιπῶν συνεργῶν μου, ὧν τὰ ὀνόματα ἐν βίβλῳ ζωῆς.
verses.translit: nai eroto kai se, gnisie syzyge, syllamvanoy autais, aitines en to euaggelio synithlisan moi meta kai Klimentos kai ton loipon synergon moy, on ta onomata en vivlo zoes.
verses.translation: And I intreat thee also, true yokefellow, help those women which laboured with me in the gospel, with Clement also, and with other my fellowlabourers, whose names are in the book of life.

verses.original: Χαίρετε ἐν κυρίῳ πάντοτε· πάλιν ἐρῶ, χαίρετε.
verses.translit: Hairete en kyrio pantote* palin ero, hairete.
verses.translation: Rejoice in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice.

verses.original: τὸ ἐπιεικὲς ὑμῶν γνωσθήτω πᾶσιν ἀνθρώποις. ὁ κύριος ἐγγύς·
verses.translit: to epieikes umon gnosthito pasin anthropois. o kyrios eggys*
verses.translation: Let your moderation be known unto all men. The Lord is at hand.

verses.original: μηδὲν μεριμνᾶτε, ἀλλʼ ἐν παντὶ τῇ προσευχῇ καὶ τῇ δεήσει μετʼ εὐχαριστίας τὰ αἰτήματα ὑμῶν γνωριζέσθω πρὸς τὸν θεόν·
verses.translit: miden merimnate, all' en panti te proseyhe kai te deisei met' euharistias ta aitimata umon gnorizestho pros ton theon*
verses.translation: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.

verses.original: καὶ ἡ εἰρήνη τοῦ θεοῦ ἡ ὑπερέχουσα πάντα νοῦν φρουρήσει τὰς καρδίας ὑμῶν καὶ τὰ νοήματα ὑμῶν ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ.
verses.translit: kai e eirini tou theou e uperehoysa panta noun froyrisei tas kardias umon kai ta noimata umon en Hristo Iisou.
verses.translation: And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.

verses.original: Τὸ λοιπόν, ἀδελφοί, ὅσα ἐστὶν ἀληθῆ, ὅσα σεμνά, ὅσα δίκαια, ὅσα ἁγνά, ὅσα προσφιλῆ, ὅσα εὔφημα, εἴ τις ἀρετὴ καὶ εἴ τις ἔπαινος, ταῦτα λογίζεσθε·
verses.translit: To loipon, adelfoi, osa estin alithe, osa semna, osa dikaia, osa agna, osa prosfile, osa eufima, ei tis arete kai ei tis epainos, tauta logizesthe*
verses.translation: Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things.

verses.original: ἃ καὶ ἐμάθετε καὶ παρελάβετε καὶ ἠκούσατε καὶ εἴδετε ἐν ἐμοί, ταῦτα πράσσετε· καὶ ὁ θεὸς τῆς εἰρήνης ἔσται μεθʼ ὑμῶν.
verses.translit: a kai emathete kai parelavete kai ekoysate kai eidete en emoi, tauta prassete* kai o theos tes eirinis estai meth' umon.
verses.translation: Those things, which ye have both learned, and received, and heard, and seen in me, do: and the God of peace shall be with you.

verses.original: Ἐχάρην δὲ ἐν κυρίῳ μεγάλως ὅτι ἤδη ποτὲ ἀνεθάλετε τὸ ὑπὲρ ἐμοῦ φρονεῖν, ἐφʼ ᾧ καὶ ἐφρονεῖτε ἠκαιρεῖσθε δέ.
verses.translit: Eharin de en kyrio megalos oti edi pote anethalete to uper emou fronein, ef' o kai efroneite ekaireisthe de.
verses.translation: But I rejoiced in the Lord greatly, that now at the last your care of me hath flourished again; wherein ye were also careful, but ye lacked opportunity.

verses.original: οὐχ ὅτι καθʼ ὑστέρησιν λέγω, ἐγὼ γὰρ ἔμαθον ἐν οἷς εἰμι αὐτάρκης εἶναι·
verses.translit: ouh oti kath' usterisin lego, ego gar emathon en ois eimi autarkis einai*
verses.translation: Not that I speak in respect of want: for I have learned, in whatsoever state I am, therewith to be content.

verses.original: οἶδα καὶ ταπεινοῦσθαι, οἶδα καὶ περισσεύειν· ἐν παντὶ καὶ ἐν πᾶσιν μεμύημαι, καὶ χορτάζεσθαι καὶ πεινᾶν, καὶ περισσεύειν καὶ ὑστερεῖσθαι·
verses.translit: oida kai tapeinousthai, oida kai perisseyein* en panti kai en pasin memyimai, kai hortazesthai kai peinan, kai perisseyein kai ustereisthai*
verses.translation: I know both how to be abased, and I know how to abound: every where and in all things I am instructed both to be full and to be hungry, both to abound and to suffer need.

verses.original: πάντα ἰσχύω ἐν τῷ ἐνδυναμοῦντί ⸀με.
verses.translit: panta ishyo en to endynamounti me.
verses.translation: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.

verses.original: πλὴν καλῶς ἐποιήσατε συγκοινωνήσαντές μου τῇ θλίψει.
verses.translit: plen kalos epoiisate sygkoinonisantes moy te thlipsei.
verses.translation: Notwithstanding ye have well done, that ye did communicate with my affliction.

verses.original: Οἴδατε δὲ καὶ ὑμεῖς, Φιλιππήσιοι, ὅτι ἐν ἀρχῇ τοῦ εὐαγγελίου, ὅτε ἐξῆλθον ἀπὸ Μακεδονίας, οὐδεμία μοι ἐκκλησία ἐκοινώνησεν εἰς λόγον δόσεως καὶ λήμψεως εἰ μὴ ὑμεῖς μόνοι,
verses.translit: Oidate de kai umeis, Filippisioi, oti en arhe tou euaggelioy, ote exelthon apo Makedonias, oudemia moi ekklisia ekoinonisen eis logon doseos kai limpseos ei me umeis monoi,
verses.translation: Now ye Philippians know also, that in the beginning of the gospel, when I departed from Macedonia, no church communicated with me as concerning giving and receiving, but ye only.

verses.original: ὅτι καὶ ἐν Θεσσαλονίκῃ καὶ ἅπαξ καὶ δὶς εἰς τὴν χρείαν μοι ἐπέμψατε.
verses.translit: oti kai en Thessalonike kai apax kai dis eis ten hreian moi epempsate.
verses.translation: For even in Thessalonica ye sent once and again unto my necessity.

verses.original: οὐχ ὅτι ἐπιζητῶ τὸ δόμα, ἀλλὰ ἐπιζητῶ τὸν καρπὸν τὸν πλεονάζοντα εἰς λόγον ὑμῶν.
verses.translit: ouh oti epizito to doma, alla epizito ton karpon ton pleonazonta eis logon umon.
verses.translation: Not because I desire a gift: but I desire fruit that may abound to your account.

verses.original: ἀπέχω δὲ πάντα καὶ περισσεύω· πεπλήρωμαι δεξάμενος παρὰ Ἐπαφροδίτου τὰ παρʼ ὑμῶν, ὀσμὴν εὐωδίας, θυσίαν δεκτήν, εὐάρεστον τῷ θεῷ.
verses.translit: apeho de panta kai perisseyo* pepliromai dexamenos para Epafroditoy ta par' umon, osmen euodias, thysian dektin, euareston to theo.
verses.translation: But I have all, and abound: I am full, having received of Epaphroditus the things which were sent from you, an odour of a sweet smell, a sacrifice acceptable, wellpleasing to God.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ θεός μου πληρώσει πᾶσαν χρείαν ὑμῶν κατὰ ⸂τὸ πλοῦτος⸃ αὐτοῦ ἐν δόξῃ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ.
verses.translit: o de theos moy plirosei pasan hreian umon kata to ploutos autou en doxe en Hristo Iisou.
verses.translation: But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.

verses.original: τῷ δὲ θεῷ καὶ πατρὶ ἡμῶν ἡ δόξα εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων· ἀμήν.
verses.translit: to de theo kai patri emon e doxa eis tous aionas ton aionon* amin.
verses.translation: Now unto God and our Father be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

verses.original: Ἀσπάσασθε πάντα ἅγιον ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ. ἀσπάζονται ὑμᾶς οἱ σὺν ἐμοὶ ἀδελφοί.
verses.translit: Aspasasthe panta agion en Hristo Iisou. aspazontai umas oi sun emoi adelfoi.
verses.translation: Salute every saint in Christ Jesus. The brethren which are with me greet you.

verses.original: ἀσπάζονται ὑμᾶς πάντες οἱ ἅγιοι, μάλιστα δὲ οἱ ἐκ τῆς Καίσαρος οἰκίας.
verses.translit: aspazontai umas pantes oi agioi, malista de oi ek tes Kaisaros oikias.
verses.translation: All the saints salute you, chiefly they that are of Caesar’s household.

verses.original: ἡ χάρις τοῦ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ μετὰ ⸂τοῦ πνεύματος⸃ ⸀ὑμῶν.
verses.translit: e haris tou kyrioy Iisou Hristou meta tou pneymatos umon.
verses.translation: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

verses.original: Παῦλος ἀπόστολος ⸂Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ⸃ διὰ θελήματος θεοῦ καὶ Τιμόθεος ὁ ἀδελφὸς
verses.translit: Paulos apostolos Hristou Iisou dia thelimatos theou kai Timotheos o adelfos
verses.translation: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timotheus our brother,

verses.original: τοῖς ἐν ⸀Κολοσσαῖς ἁγίοις καὶ πιστοῖς ἀδελφοῖς ἐν Χριστῷ· χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη ἀπὸ θεοῦ πατρὸς ⸀ἡμῶν.
verses.translit: tois en Kolossais agiois kai pistois adelfois en Hristo* haris umin kai eirini apo theou patros emon.
verses.translation: To the saints and faithful brethren in Christ which are at Colosse: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.original: Εὐχαριστοῦμεν τῷ ⸀θεῷ πατρὶ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ πάντοτε ⸀περὶ ὑμῶν προσευχόμενοι,
verses.translit: Euharistoumen to theo patri tou kyrioy emon Iisou Hristou pantote peri umon proseyhomenoi,
verses.translation: We give thanks to God and the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,

verses.original: ἀκούσαντες τὴν πίστιν ὑμῶν ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ καὶ τὴν ἀγάπην ⸂ἣν ἔχετε⸃ εἰς πάντας τοὺς ἁγίους
verses.translit: akoysantes ten pistin umon en Hristo Iisou kai ten agapin en ehete eis pantas tous agioys
verses.translation: Since we heard of your faith in Christ Jesus, and of the love which ye have to all the saints,

verses.original: διὰ τὴν ἐλπίδα τὴν ἀποκειμένην ὑμῖν ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς, ἣν προηκούσατε ἐν τῷ λόγῳ τῆς ἀληθείας τοῦ εὐαγγελίου
verses.translit: dia ten elpida ten apokeimenin umin en tois ouranois, en proikoysate en to logo tes alitheias tou euaggelioy
verses.translation: For the hope which is laid up for you in heaven, whereof ye heard before in the word of the truth of the gospel;

verses.original: τοῦ παρόντος εἰς ὑμᾶς, καθὼς καὶ ἐν παντὶ τῷ ⸀κόσμῳ ἐστὶν καρποφορούμενον καὶ αὐξανόμενον καθὼς καὶ ἐν ὑμῖν, ἀφʼ ἧς ἡμέρας ἠκούσατε καὶ ἐπέγνωτε τὴν χάριν τοῦ θεοῦ ἐν ἀληθείᾳ·
verses.translit: tou parontos eis umas, kathos kai en panti to kosmo estin karpoforoymenon kai auxanomenon kathos kai en umin, af' es emeras ekoysate kai epegnote ten harin tou theou en alitheia*
verses.translation: Which is come unto you, as it is in all the world; and bringeth forth fruit, as it doth also in you, since the day ye heard of it , and knew the grace of God in truth:

verses.original: ⸀καθὼς ἐμάθετε ἀπὸ Ἐπαφρᾶ τοῦ ἀγαπητοῦ συνδούλου ἡμῶν, ὅς ἐστιν πιστὸς ὑπὲρ ⸀ἡμῶν διάκονος τοῦ Χριστοῦ,
verses.translit: kathos emathete apo Epafra tou agapitou syndoyloy emon, os estin pistos uper emon diakonos tou Hristou,
verses.translation: As ye also learned of Epaphras our dear fellowservant, who is for you a faithful minister of Christ;

verses.original: ὁ καὶ δηλώσας ἡμῖν τὴν ὑμῶν ἀγάπην ἐν πνεύματι.
verses.translit: o kai dilosas emin ten umon agapin en pneymati.
verses.translation: Who also declared unto us your love in the Spirit.

verses.original: Διὰ τοῦτο καὶ ἡμεῖς, ἀφʼ ἧς ἡμέρας ἠκούσαμεν, οὐ παυόμεθα ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν προσευχόμενοι καὶ αἰτούμενοι ἵνα πληρωθῆτε τὴν ἐπίγνωσιν τοῦ θελήματος αὐτοῦ ἐν πάσῃ σοφίᾳ καὶ συνέσει πνευματικῇ,
verses.translit: Dia touto kai emeis, af' es emeras ekoysamen, ou payometha uper umon proseyhomenoi kai aitoymenoi ina plirothete ten epignosin tou thelimatos autou en pase sofia kai synesei pneymatike,
verses.translation: For this cause we also, since the day we heard it , do not cease to pray for you, and to desire that ye might be filled with the knowledge of his will in all wisdom and spiritual understanding;

verses.original: ⸀περιπατῆσαι ἀξίως τοῦ κυρίου εἰς πᾶσαν ἀρεσκείαν ἐν παντὶ ἔργῳ ἀγαθῷ καρποφοροῦντες καὶ αὐξανόμενοι ⸂τῇ ἐπιγνώσει⸃ τοῦ θεοῦ,
verses.translit: peripatesai axios tou kyrioy eis pasan areskeian en panti ergo agatho karpoforountes kai auxanomenoi te epignosei tou theou,
verses.translation: That ye might walk worthy of the Lord unto all pleasing, being fruitful in every good work, and increasing in the knowledge of God;

verses.original: ἐν πάσῃ δυνάμει δυναμούμενοι κατὰ τὸ κράτος τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ εἰς πᾶσαν ὑπομονὴν καὶ μακροθυμίαν μετὰ χαρᾶς,
verses.translit: en pase dynamei dynamoymenoi kata to kratos tes doxis autou eis pasan upomonen kai makrothymian meta haras,
verses.translation: Strengthened with all might, according to his glorious power, unto all patience and longsuffering with joyfulness;

verses.original: εὐχαριστοῦντες τῷ πατρὶ τῷ ἱκανώσαντι ⸀ὑμᾶς εἰς τὴν μερίδα τοῦ κλήρου τῶν ἁγίων ἐν τῷ φωτί,
verses.translit: euharistountes to patri to ikanosanti umas eis ten merida tou kliroy ton agion en to foti,
verses.translation: Giving thanks unto the Father, which hath made us meet to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light:

verses.original: ὃς ἐρρύσατο ἡμᾶς ἐκ τῆς ἐξουσίας τοῦ σκότους καὶ μετέστησεν εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ υἱοῦ τῆς ἀγάπης αὐτοῦ,
verses.translit: os errysato emas ek tes exoysias tou skotoys kai metestisen eis ten vasileian tou yiou tes agapis autou,
verses.translation: Who hath delivered us from the power of darkness, and hath translated us into the kingdom of his dear Son:

verses.original: ἐν ᾧ ἔχομεν τὴν ἀπολύτρωσιν, τὴν ἄφεσιν τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν·
verses.translit: en o ehomen ten apolytrosin, ten afesin ton amartion*
verses.translation: In whom we have redemption through his blood, even the forgiveness of sins:

verses.original: ὅς ἐστιν εἰκὼν τοῦ θεοῦ τοῦ ἀοράτου, πρωτότοκος πάσης κτίσεως,
verses.translit: os estin eikon tou theou tou aoratoy, prototokos pasis ktiseos,
verses.translation: Who is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of every creature:

verses.original: ὅτι ἐν αὐτῷ ἐκτίσθη τὰ ⸀πάντα ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς ⸀καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς, τὰ ὁρατὰ καὶ τὰ ἀόρατα, εἴτε θρόνοι εἴτε κυριότητες εἴτε ἀρχαὶ εἴτε ἐξουσίαι· τὰ πάντα διʼ αὐτοῦ καὶ εἰς αὐτὸν ἔκτισται·
verses.translit: oti en auto ektisthi ta panta en tois ouranois kai epi tes ges, ta orata kai ta aorata, eite thronoi eite kyriotites eite arhai eite exoysiai* ta panta di' autou kai eis auton ektistai*
verses.translation: For by him were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are in earth, visible and invisible, whether they be thrones, or dominions, or principalities, or powers: all things were created by him, and for him:

verses.original: καὶ αὐτός ἐστιν πρὸ πάντων καὶ τὰ πάντα ἐν αὐτῷ συνέστηκεν,
verses.translit: kai autos estin pro panton kai ta panta en auto synestiken,
verses.translation: And he is before all things, and by him all things consist.

verses.original: καὶ αὐτός ἐστιν ἡ κεφαλὴ τοῦ σώματος τῆς ἐκκλησίας· ὅς ⸀ἐστιν ἀρχή, πρωτότοκος ἐκ τῶν νεκρῶν, ἵνα γένηται ἐν πᾶσιν αὐτὸς πρωτεύων,
verses.translit: kai autos estin e kefale tou somatos tes ekklisias* os estin arhi, prototokos ek ton nekron, ina genitai en pasin autos proteyon,
verses.translation: And he is the head of the body, the church: who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead; that in all things he might have the preeminence.

verses.original: ὅτι ἐν αὐτῷ εὐδόκησεν πᾶν τὸ πλήρωμα κατοικῆσαι
verses.translit: oti en auto eudokisen pan to pliroma katoikesai
verses.translation: For it pleased the Father that in him should all fulness dwell;

verses.original: καὶ διʼ αὐτοῦ ἀποκαταλλάξαι τὰ πάντα εἰς αὐτόν, εἰρηνοποιήσας διὰ τοῦ αἵματος τοῦ σταυροῦ αὐτοῦ, ⸂[διʼ αὐτοῦ]⸃ εἴτε τὰ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς εἴτε τὰ ⸀ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς·
verses.translit: kai di' autou apokatallaxai ta panta eis auton, eirinopoiisas dia tou aimatos tou stayrou autou, [di' autou] eite ta epi tes ges eite ta en tois ouranois*
verses.translation: And, having made peace through the blood of his cross, by him to reconcile all things unto himself; by him, I say , whether they be things in earth, or things in heaven.

verses.original: καὶ ὑμᾶς ποτε ὄντας ἀπηλλοτριωμένους καὶ ἐχθροὺς τῇ διανοίᾳ ἐν τοῖς ἔργοις τοῖς πονηροῖς—
verses.translit: kai umas pote ontas apillotriomenoys kai ehthrous te dianoia en tois ergois tois ponirois--
verses.translation: And you, that were sometime alienated and enemies in your mind by wicked works, yet now hath he reconciled

verses.original: νυνὶ δὲ ⸀ἀποκατηλλάγητε ἐν τῷ σώματι τῆς σαρκὸς αὐτοῦ διὰ τοῦ θανάτου— παραστῆσαι ὑμᾶς ἁγίους καὶ ἀμώμους καὶ ἀνεγκλήτους κατενώπιον αὐτοῦ,
verses.translit: nyni de apokatillagite en to somati tes sarkos autou dia tou thanatoy-- parastesai umas agioys kai amomoys kai anegklitoys katenopion autou,
verses.translation: In the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and unblameable and unreproveable in his sight:

verses.original: εἴ γε ἐπιμένετε τῇ πίστει τεθεμελιωμένοι καὶ ἑδραῖοι καὶ μὴ μετακινούμενοι ἀπὸ τῆς ἐλπίδος τοῦ εὐαγγελίου οὗ ἠκούσατε, τοῦ κηρυχθέντος ἐν ⸀πάσῃ κτίσει τῇ ὑπὸ τὸν οὐρανόν, οὗ ἐγενόμην ἐγὼ Παῦλος διάκονος.
verses.translit: ei ge epimenete te pistei tethemeliomenoi kai edraioi kai me metakinoymenoi apo tes elpidos tou euaggelioy ou ekoysate, tou kiryhthentos en pase ktisei te upo ton ouranon, ou egenomin ego Paulos diakonos.
verses.translation: If ye continue in the faith grounded and settled, and be not moved away from the hope of the gospel, which ye have heard, and which was preached to every creature which is under heaven; whereof I Paul am made a minister;

verses.original: Νῦν χαίρω ἐν τοῖς παθήμασιν ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν, καὶ ἀνταναπληρῶ τὰ ὑστερήματα τῶν θλίψεων τοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐν τῇ σαρκί μου ὑπὲρ τοῦ σώματος αὐτοῦ, ὅ ἐστιν ἡ ἐκκλησία,
verses.translit: Nun hairo en tois pathimasin uper umon, kai antanapliro ta usterimata ton thlipseon tou Hristou en te sarki moy uper tou somatos autou, o estin e ekklisia,
verses.translation: Who now rejoice in my sufferings for you, and fill up that which is behind of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body’s sake, which is the church:

verses.original: ἧς ἐγενόμην ἐγὼ διάκονος κατὰ τὴν οἰκονομίαν τοῦ θεοῦ τὴν δοθεῖσάν μοι εἰς ὑμᾶς πληρῶσαι τὸν λόγον τοῦ θεοῦ,
verses.translit: es egenomin ego diakonos kata ten oikonomian tou theou ten dotheisan moi eis umas plirosai ton logon tou theou,
verses.translation: Whereof I am made a minister, according to the dispensation of God which is given to me for you, to fulfil the word of God;

verses.original: τὸ μυστήριον τὸ ἀποκεκρυμμένον ἀπὸ τῶν αἰώνων καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν γενεῶν,— ⸀νῦν δὲ ἐφανερώθη τοῖς ἁγίοις αὐτοῦ,
verses.translit: to mystirion to apokekrymmenon apo ton aionon kai apo ton geneon,-- nun de efanerothi tois agiois autou,
verses.translation: Even the mystery which hath been hid from ages and from generations, but now is made manifest to his saints:

verses.original: οἷς ἠθέλησεν ὁ θεὸς γνωρίσαι τί τὸ πλοῦτος τῆς δόξης τοῦ μυστηρίου τούτου ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν, ⸀ὅ ἐστιν Χριστὸς ἐν ὑμῖν, ἡ ἐλπὶς τῆς δόξης·
verses.translit: ois ethelisen o theos gnorisai ti to ploutos tes doxis tou mystirioy toytoy en tois ethnesin, o estin Hristos en umin, e elpis tes doxis*
verses.translation: To whom God would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles; which is Christ in you, the hope of glory:

verses.original: ὃν ἡμεῖς καταγγέλλομεν νουθετοῦντες πάντα ἄνθρωπον καὶ διδάσκοντες πάντα ἄνθρωπον ἐν πάσῃ σοφίᾳ, ἵνα παραστήσωμεν πάντα ἄνθρωπον τέλειον ἐν ⸀Χριστῷ·
verses.translit: on emeis kataggellomen noythetountes panta anthropon kai didaskontes panta anthropon en pase sofia, ina parastisomen panta anthropon teleion en Hristo*
verses.translation: Whom we preach, warning every man, and teaching every man in all wisdom; that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus:

verses.original: εἰς ὃ καὶ κοπιῶ ἀγωνιζόμενος κατὰ τὴν ἐνέργειαν αὐτοῦ τὴν ἐνεργουμένην ἐν ἐμοὶ ἐν δυνάμει.
verses.translit: eis o kai kopio agonizomenos kata ten energeian autou ten energoymenin en emoi en dynamei.
verses.translation: Whereunto I also labour, striving according to his working, which worketh in me mightily.

verses.original: Θέλω γὰρ ὑμᾶς εἰδέναι ἡλίκον ἀγῶνα ἔχω ⸀ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν καὶ τῶν ἐν Λαοδικείᾳ καὶ ὅσοι οὐχ ἑόρακαν τὸ πρόσωπόν μου ἐν σαρκί,
verses.translit: Thelo gar umas eidenai elikon agona eho uper umon kai ton en Laodikeia kai osoi ouh eorakan to prosopon moy en sarki,
verses.translation: For I would that ye knew what great conflict I have for you, and for them at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;

verses.original: ἵνα παρακληθῶσιν αἱ καρδίαι αὐτῶν, ⸀συμβιβασθέντες ἐν ἀγάπῃ καὶ εἰς ⸂πᾶν πλοῦτος⸃ τῆς πληροφορίας τῆς συνέσεως, εἰς ἐπίγνωσιν τοῦ μυστηρίου τοῦ ⸀θεοῦ, Χριστοῦ,
verses.translit: ina paraklithosin ai kardiai auton, symvivasthentes en agape kai eis pan ploutos tes pliroforias tes syneseos, eis epignosin tou mystirioy tou theou, Hristou,
verses.translation: That their hearts might be comforted, being knit together in love, and unto all riches of the full assurance of understanding, to the acknowledgement of the mystery of God, and of the Father, and of Christ;

verses.original: ἐν ᾧ εἰσιν πάντες οἱ θησαυροὶ τῆς σοφίας ⸀καὶ γνώσεως ἀπόκρυφοι.
verses.translit: en o eisin pantes oi thisayroi tes sofias kai gnoseos apokryfoi.
verses.translation: In whom are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.

verses.original: ⸀τοῦτο λέγω ἵνα ⸀μηδεὶς ὑμᾶς παραλογίζηται ἐν πιθανολογίᾳ.
verses.translit: touto lego ina mideis umas paralogizitai en pithanologia.
verses.translation: And this I say, lest any man should beguile you with enticing words.

verses.original: εἰ γὰρ καὶ τῇ σαρκὶ ἄπειμι, ἀλλὰ τῷ πνεύματι σὺν ὑμῖν εἰμι, χαίρων καὶ βλέπων ὑμῶν τὴν τάξιν καὶ τὸ στερέωμα τῆς εἰς Χριστὸν πίστεως ὑμῶν.
verses.translit: ei gar kai te sarki apeimi, alla to pneymati sun umin eimi, hairon kai vlepon umon ten taxin kai to stereoma tes eis Hriston pisteos umon.
verses.translation: For though I be absent in the flesh, yet am I with you in the spirit, joying and beholding your order, and the stedfastness of your faith in Christ.

verses.original: Ὡς οὖν παρελάβετε τὸν Χριστὸν Ἰησοῦν τὸν κύριον, ἐν αὐτῷ περιπατεῖτε,
verses.translit: Os oun parelavete ton Hriston Iisoun ton kyrion, en auto peripateite,
verses.translation: As ye have therefore received Christ Jesus the Lord, so walk ye in him:

verses.original: ἐρριζωμένοι καὶ ἐποικοδομούμενοι ἐν αὐτῷ καὶ ⸀βεβαιούμενοι τῇ πίστει καθὼς ἐδιδάχθητε, ⸀περισσεύοντες ἐν εὐχαριστίᾳ.
verses.translit: errizomenoi kai epoikodomoymenoi en auto kai vevaioymenoi te pistei kathos edidahthite, perisseyontes en euharistia.
verses.translation: Rooted and built up in him, and stablished in the faith, as ye have been taught, abounding therein with thanksgiving.

verses.original: Βλέπετε μή τις ὑμᾶς ἔσται ὁ συλαγωγῶν διὰ τῆς φιλοσοφίας καὶ κενῆς ἀπάτης κατὰ τὴν παράδοσιν τῶν ἀνθρώπων, κατὰ τὰ στοιχεῖα τοῦ κόσμου καὶ οὐ κατὰ Χριστόν·
verses.translit: Vlepete mi tis umas estai o sylagogon dia tes filosofias kai kenes apatis kata ten paradosin ton anthropon, kata ta stoiheia tou kosmoy kai ou kata Hriston*
verses.translation: Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world, and not after Christ.

verses.original: ὅτι ἐν αὐτῷ κατοικεῖ πᾶν τὸ πλήρωμα τῆς θεότητος σωματικῶς,
verses.translit: oti en auto katoikei pan to pliroma tes theotitos somatikos,
verses.translation: For in him dwelleth all the fulness of the Godhead bodily.

verses.original: καὶ ἐστὲ ἐν αὐτῷ πεπληρωμένοι, ὅς ἐστιν ἡ κεφαλὴ πάσης ἀρχῆς καὶ ἐξουσίας,
verses.translit: kai este en auto pepliromenoi, os estin e kefale pasis arhes kai exoysias,
verses.translation: And ye are complete in him, which is the head of all principality and power:

verses.original: ἐν ᾧ καὶ περιετμήθητε περιτομῇ ἀχειροποιήτῳ ἐν τῇ ἀπεκδύσει τοῦ ⸀σώματος τῆς σαρκός, ἐν τῇ περιτομῇ τοῦ Χριστοῦ,
verses.translit: en o kai perietmithite peritome aheiropoiito en te apekdysei tou somatos tes sarkos, en te peritome tou Hristou,
verses.translation: In whom also ye are circumcised with the circumcision made without hands, in putting off the body of the sins of the flesh by the circumcision of Christ:

verses.original: συνταφέντες αὐτῷ ἐν τῷ ⸀βαπτισμῷ, ἐν ᾧ καὶ συνηγέρθητε διὰ τῆς πίστεως τῆς ἐνεργείας τοῦ θεοῦ τοῦ ἐγείραντος αὐτὸν ⸀ἐκ νεκρῶν·
verses.translit: syntafentes auto en to vaptismo, en o kai synigerthite dia tes pisteos tes energeias tou theou tou egeirantos auton ek nekron*
verses.translation: Buried with him in baptism, wherein also ye are risen with him through the faith of the operation of God, who hath raised him from the dead.

verses.original: καὶ ὑμᾶς νεκροὺς ὄντας ⸀ἐν τοῖς παραπτώμασιν καὶ τῇ ἀκροβυστίᾳ τῆς σαρκὸς ὑμῶν, συνεζωοποίησεν ὑμᾶς σὺν αὐτῷ· χαρισάμενος ἡμῖν πάντα τὰ παραπτώματα,
verses.translit: kai umas nekrous ontas en tois paraptomasin kai te akrovystia tes sarkos umon, synezoopoiisen umas sun auto* harisamenos emin panta ta paraptomata,
verses.translation: And you, being dead in your sins and the uncircumcision of your flesh, hath he quickened together with him, having forgiven you all trespasses;

verses.original: ἐξαλείψας τὸ καθʼ ἡμῶν χειρόγραφον τοῖς δόγμασιν ὃ ἦν ὑπεναντίον ἡμῖν, καὶ αὐτὸ ἦρκεν ἐκ τοῦ μέσου προσηλώσας αὐτὸ τῷ σταυρῷ·
verses.translit: exaleipsas to kath' emon heirografon tois dogmasin o en upenantion emin, kai auto erken ek tou mesoy prosilosas auto to stayro*
verses.translation: Blotting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross;

verses.original: ἀπεκδυσάμενος τὰς ἀρχὰς καὶ τὰς ἐξουσίας ἐδειγμάτισεν ἐν παρρησίᾳ, θριαμβεύσας αὐτοὺς ἐν αὐτῷ.
verses.translit: apekdysamenos tas arhas kai tas exoysias edeigmatisen en parrisia, thriamveysas autous en auto.
verses.translation: And having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a shew of them openly, triumphing over them in it.

verses.original: Μὴ οὖν τις ὑμᾶς κρινέτω ἐν βρώσει ⸀ἢ ἐν πόσει ἢ ἐν μέρει ἑορτῆς ἢ νουμηνίας ἢ σαββάτων,
verses.translit: Me oun tis umas krineto en vrosei e en posei e en merei eortes e noyminias e savvaton,
verses.translation: Let no man therefore judge you in meat, or in drink, or in respect of an holyday, or of the new moon, or of the sabbath days :

verses.original: ἅ ἐστιν σκιὰ τῶν μελλόντων, τὸ δὲ σῶμα ⸀τοῦ Χριστοῦ.
verses.translit: a estin skia ton mellonton, to de soma tou Hristou.
verses.translation: Which are a shadow of things to come; but the body is of Christ.

verses.original: μηδεὶς ὑμᾶς καταβραβευέτω θέλων ἐν ταπεινοφροσύνῃ καὶ θρησκείᾳ τῶν ἀγγέλων, ⸀ἃ ἑόρακεν ἐμβατεύων, εἰκῇ φυσιούμενος ὑπὸ τοῦ νοὸς τῆς σαρκὸς αὐτοῦ,
verses.translit: mideis umas katavraveyeto thelon en tapeinofrosyne kai thriskeia ton aggelon, a eoraken emvateyon, eike fysioymenos upo tou noos tes sarkos autou,
verses.translation: Let no man beguile you of your reward in a voluntary humility and worshipping of angels, intruding into those things which he hath not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,

verses.original: καὶ οὐ κρατῶν τὴν κεφαλήν, ἐξ οὗ πᾶν τὸ σῶμα διὰ τῶν ἁφῶν καὶ συνδέσμων ἐπιχορηγούμενον καὶ συμβιβαζόμενον αὔξει τὴν αὔξησιν τοῦ θεοῦ.
verses.translit: kai ou kraton ten kefalin, ex ou pan to soma dia ton afon kai syndesmon epihorigoymenon kai symvivazomenon auxei ten auxisin tou theou.
verses.translation: And not holding the Head, from which all the body by joints and bands having nourishment ministered, and knit together, increaseth with the increase of God.

verses.original: Εἰ ἀπεθάνετε σὺν Χριστῷ ἀπὸ τῶν στοιχείων τοῦ κόσμου, τί ὡς ζῶντες ἐν κόσμῳ δογματίζεσθε·
verses.translit: Ei apethanete sun Hristo apo ton stoiheion tou kosmoy, ti os zontes en kosmo dogmatizesthe*
verses.translation: Wherefore if ye be dead with Christ from the rudiments of the world, why, as though living in the world, are ye subject to ordinances,

verses.original: Μὴ ἅψῃ μηδὲ γεύσῃ μηδὲ θίγῃς,
verses.translit: Me apse mide geyse mide thiges,
verses.translation: (Touch not; taste not; handle not;

verses.original: ἅ ἐστιν πάντα εἰς φθορὰν τῇ ἀποχρήσει, κατὰ τὰ ἐντάλματα καὶ διδασκαλίας τῶν ἀνθρώπων;
verses.translit: a estin panta eis fthoran te apohrisei, kata ta entalmata kai didaskalias ton anthropon;
verses.translation: Which all are to perish with the using;) after the commandments and doctrines of men?

verses.original: ἅτινά ἐστιν λόγον μὲν ἔχοντα σοφίας ἐν ἐθελοθρησκίᾳ καὶ ταπεινοφροσύνῃ καὶ ἀφειδίᾳ σώματος, οὐκ ἐν τιμῇ τινι πρὸς πλησμονὴν τῆς σαρκός.
verses.translit: atina estin logon men ehonta sofias en ethelothriskia kai tapeinofrosyne kai afeidia somatos, ouk en time tini pros plismonen tes sarkos.
verses.translation: Which things have indeed a shew of wisdom in will worship, and humility, and neglecting of the body; not in any honour to the satisfying of the flesh.

verses.original: Εἰ οὖν συνηγέρθητε τῷ Χριστῷ, τὰ ἄνω ζητεῖτε, οὗ ὁ Χριστός ἐστιν ἐν δεξιᾷ τοῦ θεοῦ καθήμενος·
verses.translit: Ei oun synigerthite to Hristo, ta ano ziteite, ou o Hristos estin en dexia tou theou kathimenos*
verses.translation: If ye then be risen with Christ, seek those things which are above, where Christ sitteth on the right hand of God.

verses.original: τὰ ἄνω φρονεῖτε, μὴ τὰ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς,
verses.translit: ta ano froneite, me ta epi tes ges,
verses.translation: Set your affection on things above, not on things on the earth.

verses.original: ἀπεθάνετε γάρ, καὶ ἡ ζωὴ ὑμῶν κέκρυπται σὺν τῷ Χριστῷ ἐν τῷ θεῷ·
verses.translit: apethanete gar, kai e zoe umon kekryptai sun to Hristo en to theo*
verses.translation: For ye are dead, and your life is hid with Christ in God.

verses.original: ὅταν ὁ Χριστὸς φανερωθῇ, ἡ ζωὴ ⸀ὑμῶν, τότε καὶ ὑμεῖς σὺν αὐτῷ φανερωθήσεσθε ἐν δόξῃ.
verses.translit: otan o Hristos fanerothe, e zoe umon, tote kai umeis sun auto fanerothisesthe en doxe.
verses.translation: When Christ, who is our life, shall appear, then shall ye also appear with him in glory.

verses.original: Νεκρώσατε οὖν τὰ ⸀μέλη τὰ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς, πορνείαν, ἀκαθαρσίαν, πάθος, ἐπιθυμίαν κακήν, καὶ τὴν πλεονεξίαν ἥτις ἐστὶν εἰδωλολατρία,
verses.translit: Nekrosate oun ta meli ta epi tes ges, porneian, akatharsian, pathos, epithymian kakin, kai ten pleonexian etis estin eidololatria,
verses.translation: Mortify therefore your members which are upon the earth; fornication, uncleanness, inordinate affection, evil concupiscence, and covetousness, which is idolatry:

verses.original: διʼ ἃ ἔρχεται ἡ ὀργὴ τοῦ θεοῦ ⸂ἐπὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς τῆς ἀπειθείας⸃·
verses.translit: di' a erhetai e orge tou theou epi tous yious tes apeitheias*
verses.translation: For which things’ sake the wrath of God cometh on the children of disobedience:

verses.original: ἐν οἷς καὶ ὑμεῖς περιεπατήσατέ ποτε ὅτε ἐζῆτε ἐν ⸀τούτοις·
verses.translit: en ois kai umeis periepatisate pote ote ezete en toytois*
verses.translation: In the which ye also walked some time, when ye lived in them.

verses.original: νυνὶ δὲ ἀπόθεσθε καὶ ὑμεῖς τὰ πάντα, ὀργήν, θυμόν, κακίαν, βλασφημίαν, αἰσχρολογίαν ἐκ τοῦ στόματος ὑμῶν·
verses.translit: nyni de apothesthe kai umeis ta panta, orgin, thymon, kakian, vlasfimian, aishrologian ek tou stomatos umon*
verses.translation: But now ye also put off all these; anger, wrath, malice, blasphemy, filthy communication out of your mouth.

verses.original: μὴ ψεύδεσθε εἰς ἀλλήλους· ἀπεκδυσάμενοι τὸν παλαιὸν ἄνθρωπον σὺν ταῖς πράξεσιν αὐτοῦ,
verses.translit: me pseydesthe eis alliloys* apekdysamenoi ton palaion anthropon sun tais praxesin autou,
verses.translation: Lie not one to another, seeing that ye have put off the old man with his deeds;

verses.original: καὶ ἐνδυσάμενοι τὸν νέον τὸν ἀνακαινούμενον εἰς ἐπίγνωσιν κατʼ εἰκόνα τοῦ κτίσαντος αὐτόν,
verses.translit: kai endysamenoi ton neon ton anakainoymenon eis epignosin kat' eikona tou ktisantos auton,
verses.translation: And have put on the new man , which is renewed in knowledge after the image of him that created him:

verses.original: ὅπου οὐκ ἔνι Ἕλλην καὶ Ἰουδαῖος, περιτομὴ καὶ ἀκροβυστία, βάρβαρος, Σκύθης, δοῦλος, ἐλεύθερος, ἀλλὰ ⸀τὰ πάντα καὶ ἐν πᾶσιν Χριστός.
verses.translit: opoy ouk eni Ellin kai Ioydaios, peritome kai akrovystia, varvaros, Skythis, doulos, eleytheros, alla ta panta kai en pasin Hristos.
verses.translation: Where there is neither Greek nor Jew, circumcision nor uncircumcision, Barbarian, Scythian, bond nor free: but Christ is all, and in all.

verses.original: Ἐνδύσασθε οὖν ὡς ἐκλεκτοὶ τοῦ θεοῦ, ἅγιοι καὶ ἠγαπημένοι, σπλάγχνα οἰκτιρμοῦ, χρηστότητα, ταπεινοφροσύνην, πραΰτητα, μακροθυμίαν,
verses.translit: Endysasthe oun os eklektoi tou theou, agioi kai egapimenoi, splaghna oiktirmou, hristotita, tapeinofrosynin, praytita, makrothymian,
verses.translation: Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering;

verses.original: ἀνεχόμενοι ἀλλήλων καὶ χαριζόμενοι ἑαυτοῖς ἐάν τις πρός τινα ἔχῃ μομφήν· καθὼς καὶ ὁ ⸀κύριος ἐχαρίσατο ὑμῖν οὕτως καὶ ὑμεῖς·
verses.translit: anehomenoi allilon kai harizomenoi eaytois ean tis pros tina ehe momfin* kathos kai o kyrios eharisato umin outos kai umeis*
verses.translation: Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also do ye.

verses.original: ἐπὶ πᾶσιν δὲ τούτοις τὴν ἀγάπην, ⸀ὅ ἐστιν σύνδεσμος τῆς τελειότητος.
verses.translit: epi pasin de toytois ten agapin, o estin syndesmos tes teleiotitos.
verses.translation: And above all these things put on charity, which is the bond of perfectness.

verses.original: καὶ ἡ εἰρήνη τοῦ ⸀Χριστοῦ βραβευέτω ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις ὑμῶν, εἰς ἣν καὶ ἐκλήθητε ἐν ἑνὶ σώματι· καὶ εὐχάριστοι γίνεσθε.
verses.translit: kai e eirini tou Hristou vraveyeto en tais kardiais umon, eis en kai eklithite en eni somati* kai euharistoi ginesthe.
verses.translation: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body; and be ye thankful.

verses.original: ὁ λόγος τοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐνοικείτω ἐν ὑμῖν πλουσίως ἐν πάσῃ σοφίᾳ· διδάσκοντες καὶ νουθετοῦντες ἑαυτοὺς ⸀ψαλμοῖς, ⸀ὕμνοις, ᾠδαῖς πνευματικαῖς ⸀ἐν χάριτι, ᾄδοντες ἐν ⸂ταῖς καρδίαις⸃ ὑμῶν τῷ ⸀θεῷ·
verses.translit: o logos tou Hristou enoikeito en umin ploysios en pase sofia* didaskontes kai noythetountes eaytous psalmois, umnois, odais pneymatikais en hariti, adontes en tais kardiais umon to theo*
verses.translation: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord.

verses.original: καὶ πᾶν ⸂ὅ τι⸃ ⸀ἐὰν ποιῆτε ἐν λόγῳ ἢ ἐν ἔργῳ, πάντα ἐν ὀνόματι κυρίου Ἰησοῦ, εὐχαριστοῦντες τῷ ⸀θεῷ πατρὶ διʼ αὐτοῦ.
verses.translit: kai pan o ti ean poiete en logo e en ergo, panta en onomati kyrioy Iisou, euharistountes to theo patri di' autou.
verses.translation: And whatsoever ye do in word or deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and the Father by him.

verses.original: Αἱ γυναῖκες, ὑποτάσσεσθε ⸀τοῖς ἀνδράσιν, ὡς ἀνῆκεν ἐν κυρίῳ.
verses.translit: Ai gynaikes, upotassesthe tois andrasin, os aneken en kyrio.
verses.translation: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as it is fit in the Lord.

verses.original: οἱ ἄνδρες, ἀγαπᾶτε τὰς γυναῖκας καὶ μὴ πικραίνεσθε πρὸς αὐτάς.
verses.translit: oi andres, agapate tas gynaikas kai me pikrainesthe pros autas.
verses.translation: Husbands, love your wives, and be not bitter against them.

verses.original: Τὰ τέκνα, ὑπακούετε τοῖς γονεῦσιν κατὰ πάντα, τοῦτο γὰρ ⸂εὐάρεστόν ἐστιν⸃ ἐν κυρίῳ.
verses.translit: Ta tekna, upakoyete tois goneusin kata panta, touto gar euareston estin en kyrio.
verses.translation: Children, obey your parents in all things: for this is well pleasing unto the Lord.

verses.original: οἱ πατέρες, μὴ ἐρεθίζετε τὰ τέκνα ὑμῶν, ἵνα μὴ ἀθυμῶσιν.
verses.translit: oi pateres, me erethizete ta tekna umon, ina me athymosin.
verses.translation: Fathers, provoke not your children to anger , lest they be discouraged.

verses.original: οἱ δοῦλοι, ὑπακούετε κατὰ πάντα τοῖς κατὰ σάρκα κυρίοις, μὴ ἐν ⸀ὀφθαλμοδουλίαις, ὡς ἀνθρωπάρεσκοι, ἀλλʼ ἐν ἁπλότητι καρδίας, φοβούμενοι τὸν ⸀κύριον.
verses.translit: oi douloi, upakoyete kata panta tois kata sarka kyriois, me en ofthalmodoyliais, os anthropareskoi, all' en aplotiti kardias, fovoymenoi ton kyrion.
verses.translation: Servants, obey in all things your masters according to the flesh; not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but in singleness of heart, fearing God:

verses.original: ⸀ὃ ἐὰν ποιῆτε, ἐκ ψυχῆς ἐργάζεσθε, ὡς τῷ κυρίῳ καὶ οὐκ ἀνθρώποις,
verses.translit: o ean poiete, ek psyhes ergazesthe, os to kyrio kai ouk anthropois,
verses.translation: And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;

verses.original: εἰδότες ὅτι ἀπὸ κυρίου ⸀ἀπολήμψεσθε τὴν ἀνταπόδοσιν τῆς κληρονομίας· ⸀τῷ κυρίῳ Χριστῷ δουλεύετε·
verses.translit: eidotes oti apo kyrioy apolimpsesthe ten antapodosin tes klironomias* to kyrio Hristo doyleyete*
verses.translation: Knowing that of the Lord ye shall receive the reward of the inheritance: for ye serve the Lord Christ.

verses.original: ὁ ⸀γὰρ ἀδικῶν κομίσεται ὃ ἠδίκησεν, καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν προσωπολημψία.
verses.translit: o gar adikon komisetai o edikisen, kai ouk estin prosopolimpsia.
verses.translation: But he that doeth wrong shall receive for the wrong which he hath done: and there is no respect of persons.

verses.original: οἱ κύριοι, τὸ δίκαιον καὶ τὴν ἰσότητα τοῖς δούλοις παρέχεσθε, εἰδότες ὅτι καὶ ὑμεῖς ἔχετε κύριον ἐν ⸀οὐρανῷ.
verses.translit: oi kyrioi, to dikaion kai ten isotita tois doylois parehesthe, eidotes oti kai umeis ehete kyrion en ourano.
verses.translation: Masters, give unto your servants that which is just and equal; knowing that ye also have a Master in heaven.

verses.original: Τῇ προσευχῇ προσκαρτερεῖτε, γρηγοροῦντες ἐν αὐτῇ ἐν εὐχαριστίᾳ,
verses.translit: Te proseyhe proskartereite, grigorountes en aute en euharistia,
verses.translation: Continue in prayer, and watch in the same with thanksgiving;

verses.original: προσευχόμενοι ἅμα καὶ περὶ ἡμῶν, ἵνα ὁ θεὸς ἀνοίξῃ ἡμῖν θύραν τοῦ λόγου, λαλῆσαι τὸ μυστήριον τοῦ Χριστοῦ, διʼ ὃ καὶ δέδεμαι,
verses.translit: proseyhomenoi ama kai peri emon, ina o theos anoixe emin thyran tou logoy, lalesai to mystirion tou Hristou, di' o kai dedemai,
verses.translation: Withal praying also for us, that God would open unto us a door of utterance, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds:

verses.original: ἵνα φανερώσω αὐτὸ ὡς δεῖ με λαλῆσαι.
verses.translit: ina faneroso auto os dei me lalesai.
verses.translation: That I may make it manifest, as I ought to speak.

verses.original: Ἐν σοφίᾳ περιπατεῖτε πρὸς τοὺς ἔξω, τὸν καιρὸν ἐξαγοραζόμενοι.
verses.translit: En sofia peripateite pros tous exo, ton kairon exagorazomenoi.
verses.translation: Walk in wisdom toward them that are without, redeeming the time.

verses.original: ὁ λόγος ὑμῶν πάντοτε ἐν χάριτι, ἅλατι ἠρτυμένος, εἰδέναι πῶς δεῖ ὑμᾶς ἑνὶ ἑκάστῳ ἀποκρίνεσθαι.
verses.translit: o logos umon pantote en hariti, alati ertymenos, eidenai pos dei umas eni ekasto apokrinesthai.
verses.translation: Let your speech be alway with grace, seasoned with salt, that ye may know how ye ought to answer every man.

verses.original: Τὰ κατʼ ἐμὲ πάντα γνωρίσει ὑμῖν Τυχικὸς ὁ ἀγαπητὸς ἀδελφὸς καὶ πιστὸς διάκονος καὶ σύνδουλος ἐν κυρίῳ,
verses.translit: Ta kat' eme panta gnorisei umin Tyhikos o agapitos adelfos kai pistos diakonos kai syndoylos en kyrio,
verses.translation: All my state shall Tychicus declare unto you, who is a beloved brother, and a faithful minister and fellowservant in the Lord:

verses.original: ὃν ἔπεμψα πρὸς ὑμᾶς εἰς αὐτὸ τοῦτο ἵνα ⸀γνῶτε τὰ περὶ ⸀ἡμῶν καὶ παρακαλέσῃ τὰς καρδίας ὑμῶν,
verses.translit: on epempsa pros umas eis auto touto ina gnote ta peri emon kai parakalese tas kardias umon,
verses.translation: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that he might know your estate, and comfort your hearts;

verses.original: σὺν Ὀνησίμῳ τῷ πιστῷ καὶ ἀγαπητῷ ἀδελφῷ, ὅς ἐστιν ἐξ ὑμῶν· πάντα ὑμῖν γνωρίσουσιν τὰ ὧδε.
verses.translit: sun Onisimo to pisto kai agapito adelfo, os estin ex umon* panta umin gnorisoysin ta ode.
verses.translation: With Onesimus, a faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They shall make known unto you all things which are done here.

verses.original: Ἀσπάζεται ὑμᾶς Ἀρίσταρχος ὁ συναιχμάλωτός μου, καὶ Μᾶρκος ὁ ἀνεψιὸς Βαρναβᾶ (περὶ οὗ ἐλάβετε ἐντολάς, ἐὰν ἔλθῃ πρὸς ὑμᾶς δέξασθε αὐτόν),
verses.translit: Aspazetai umas Aristarhos o synaihmalotos moy, kai Markos o anepsios Varnava (peri ou elavete entolas, ean elthe pros umas dexasthe auton),
verses.translation: Aristarchus my fellowprisoner saluteth you, and Marcus, sister’s son to Barnabas, (touching whom ye received commandments: if he come unto you, receive him;)

verses.original: καὶ Ἰησοῦς ὁ λεγόμενος Ἰοῦστος, οἱ ὄντες ἐκ περιτομῆς, οὗτοι μόνοι συνεργοὶ εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ θεοῦ, οἵτινες ἐγενήθησάν μοι παρηγορία.
verses.translit: kai Iisous o legomenos Ioustos, oi ontes ek peritomes, outoi monoi synergoi eis ten vasileian tou theou, oitines egenithisan moi parigoria.
verses.translation: And Jesus, which is called Justus, who are of the circumcision. These only are my fellowworkers unto the kingdom of God, which have been a comfort unto me.

verses.original: ἀσπάζεται ὑμᾶς Ἐπαφρᾶς ὁ ἐξ ὑμῶν, δοῦλος ⸀Χριστοῦ, πάντοτε ἀγωνιζόμενος ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν ἐν ταῖς προσευχαῖς, ἵνα ⸀σταθῆτε τέλειοι καὶ ⸀πεπληροφορημένοι ἐν παντὶ θελήματι τοῦ θεοῦ.
verses.translit: aspazetai umas Epafras o ex umon, doulos Hristou, pantote agonizomenos uper umon en tais proseyhais, ina stathete teleioi kai pepliroforimenoi en panti thelimati tou theou.
verses.translation: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, saluteth you, always labouring fervently for you in prayers, that ye may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.

verses.original: μαρτυρῶ γὰρ αὐτῷ ὅτι ἔχει ⸂πολὺν πόνον⸃ ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν καὶ τῶν ἐν Λαοδικείᾳ καὶ τῶν ἐν Ἱεραπόλει.
verses.translit: martyro gar auto oti ehei polun ponon uper umon kai ton en Laodikeia kai ton en Ierapolei.
verses.translation: For I bear him record, that he hath a great zeal for you, and them that are in Laodicea, and them in Hierapolis.

verses.original: ἀσπάζεται ὑμᾶς Λουκᾶς ὁ ἰατρὸς ὁ ἀγαπητὸς καὶ Δημᾶς.
verses.translit: aspazetai umas Loykas o iatros o agapitos kai Dimas.
verses.translation: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas, greet you.

verses.original: ἀσπάσασθε τοὺς ἐν Λαοδικείᾳ ἀδελφοὺς καὶ ⸂Νύμφαν καὶ τὴν κατʼ οἶκον αὐτῆς⸃ ἐκκλησίαν.
verses.translit: aspasasthe tous en Laodikeia adelfous kai Nymfan kai ten kat' oikon autes ekklisian.
verses.translation: Salute the brethren which are in Laodicea, and Nymphas, and the church which is in his house.

verses.original: καὶ ὅταν ἀναγνωσθῇ παρʼ ὑμῖν ἡ ἐπιστολή, ποιήσατε ἵνα καὶ ἐν τῇ ⸀Λαοδικέων ἐκκλησίᾳ ἀναγνωσθῇ, καὶ τὴν ἐκ Λαοδικείας ἵνα καὶ ὑμεῖς ἀναγνῶτε.
verses.translit: kai otan anagnosthe par' umin e epistoli, poiisate ina kai en te Laodikeon ekklisia anagnosthe, kai ten ek Laodikeias ina kai umeis anagnote.
verses.translation: And when this epistle is read among you, cause that it be read also in the church of the Laodiceans; and that ye likewise read the epistle from Laodicea.

verses.original: καὶ εἴπατε Ἀρχίππῳ· Βλέπε τὴν διακονίαν ἣν παρέλαβες ἐν κυρίῳ, ἵνα αὐτὴν πληροῖς.
verses.translit: kai eipate Arhippo* Vlepe ten diakonian en parelaves en kyrio, ina auten plirois.
verses.translation: And say to Archippus, Take heed to the ministry which thou hast received in the Lord, that thou fulfil it.

verses.original: Ὁ ἀσπασμὸς τῇ ἐμῇ χειρὶ Παύλου. μνημονεύετέ μου τῶν δεσμῶν. ἡ χάρις μεθʼ ⸀ὑμῶν.
verses.translit: O aspasmos te eme heiri Payloy. mnimoneyete moy ton desmon. e haris meth' umon.
verses.translation: The salutation by the hand of me Paul. Remember my bonds. Grace be with you. Amen.

verses.original: Παῦλος καὶ Σιλουανὸς καὶ Τιμόθεος τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ Θεσσαλονικέων ἐν θεῷ πατρὶ καὶ κυρίῳ Ἰησοῦ Χριστῷ· χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ ⸀εἰρήνη.
verses.translit: Paulos kai Siloyanos kai Timotheos te ekklisia Thessalonikeon en theo patri kai kyrio Iisou Hristo* haris umin kai eirini.
verses.translation: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians which is in God the Father and in the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.original: Εὐχαριστοῦμεν τῷ θεῷ πάντοτε περὶ πάντων ὑμῶν ⸀μνείαν ποιούμενοι ἐπὶ τῶν προσευχῶν ἡμῶν, ἀδιαλείπτως
verses.translit: Euharistoumen to theo pantote peri panton umon mneian poioymenoi epi ton proseyhon emon, adialeiptos
verses.translation: We give thanks to God always for you all, making mention of you in our prayers;

verses.original: μνημονεύοντες ὑμῶν τοῦ ἔργου τῆς πίστεως καὶ τοῦ κόπου τῆς ἀγάπης καὶ τῆς ὑπομονῆς τῆς ἐλπίδος τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ πατρὸς ἡμῶν,
verses.translit: mnimoneyontes umon tou ergoy tes pisteos kai tou kopoy tes agapis kai tes upomones tes elpidos tou kyrioy emon Iisou Hristou emprosthen tou theou kai patros emon,
verses.translation: Remembering without ceasing your work of faith, and labour of love, and patience of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, in the sight of God and our Father;

verses.original: εἰδότες, ἀδελφοὶ ἠγαπημένοι ὑπὸ ⸀θεοῦ, τὴν ἐκλογὴν ὑμῶν,
verses.translit: eidotes, adelfoi egapimenoi upo theou, ten eklogen umon,
verses.translation: Knowing, brethren beloved, your election of God.

verses.original: ὅτι τὸ εὐαγγέλιον ἡμῶν οὐκ ἐγενήθη εἰς ὑμᾶς ἐν λόγῳ μόνον ἀλλὰ καὶ ἐν δυνάμει καὶ ἐν πνεύματι ἁγίῳ ⸀καὶ πληροφορίᾳ πολλῇ, καθὼς οἴδατε οἷοι ἐγενήθημεν ⸀ἐν ὑμῖν διʼ ὑμᾶς·
verses.translit: oti to euaggelion emon ouk egenithi eis umas en logo monon alla kai en dynamei kai en pneymati agio kai pliroforia polle, kathos oidate oioi egenithimen en umin di' umas*
verses.translation: For our gospel came not unto you in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Ghost, and in much assurance; as ye know what manner of men we were among you for your sake.

verses.original: καὶ ὑμεῖς μιμηταὶ ἡμῶν ἐγενήθητε καὶ τοῦ κυρίου, δεξάμενοι τὸν λόγον ἐν θλίψει πολλῇ μετὰ χαρᾶς πνεύματος ἁγίου,
verses.translit: kai umeis mimitai emon egenithite kai tou kyrioy, dexamenoi ton logon en thlipsei polle meta haras pneymatos agioy,
verses.translation: And ye became followers of us, and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Ghost:

verses.original: ὥστε γενέσθαι ὑμᾶς ⸀τύπον πᾶσιν τοῖς πιστεύουσιν ἐν τῇ Μακεδονίᾳ καὶ ⸀ἐν τῇ Ἀχαΐᾳ.
verses.translit: oste genesthai umas typon pasin tois pisteyoysin en te Makedonia kai en te AhaIa.
verses.translation: So that ye were ensamples to all that believe in Macedonia and Achaia.

verses.original: ἀφʼ ὑμῶν γὰρ ἐξήχηται ὁ λόγος τοῦ κυρίου οὐ μόνον ἐν τῇ Μακεδονίᾳ ⸀καὶ Ἀχαΐᾳ, ⸀ἀλλʼ ἐν παντὶ τόπῳ ἡ πίστις ὑμῶν ἡ πρὸς τὸν θεὸν ἐξελήλυθεν, ὥστε μὴ χρείαν ⸂ἔχειν ἡμᾶς⸃ λαλεῖν τι·
verses.translit: af' umon gar exihitai o logos tou kyrioy ou monon en te Makedonia kai AhaIa, all' en panti topo e pistis umon e pros ton theon exelilythen, oste me hreian ehein emas lalein ti*
verses.translation: For from you sounded out the word of the Lord not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith to God-ward is spread abroad; so that we need not to speak any thing.

verses.original: αὐτοὶ γὰρ περὶ ἡμῶν ἀπαγγέλλουσιν ὁποίαν εἴσοδον ἔσχομεν πρὸς ὑμᾶς, καὶ πῶς ἐπεστρέψατε πρὸς τὸν θεὸν ἀπὸ τῶν εἰδώλων δουλεύειν θεῷ ζῶντι καὶ ἀληθινῷ,
verses.translit: autoi gar peri emon apaggelloysin opoian eisodon eshomen pros umas, kai pos epestrepsate pros ton theon apo ton eidolon doyleyein theo zonti kai alithino,
verses.translation: For they themselves shew of us what manner of entering in we had unto you, and how ye turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God;

verses.original: καὶ ἀναμένειν τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ ἐκ τῶν οὐρανῶν, ὃν ἤγειρεν ἐκ τῶν νεκρῶν, Ἰησοῦν τὸν ῥυόμενον ἡμᾶς ⸀ἐκ τῆς ὀργῆς τῆς ἐρχομένης.
verses.translit: kai anamenein ton yion autou ek ton ouranon, on egeiren ek ton nekron, Iisoun ton Ryomenon emas ek tes orges tes erhomenis.
verses.translation: And to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead, even Jesus, which delivered us from the wrath to come.

verses.original: Αὐτοὶ γὰρ οἴδατε, ἀδελφοί, τὴν εἴσοδον ἡμῶν τὴν πρὸς ὑμᾶς ὅτι οὐ κενὴ γέγονεν,
verses.translit: Autoi gar oidate, adelfoi, ten eisodon emon ten pros umas oti ou kene gegonen,
verses.translation: For yourselves, brethren, know our entrance in unto you, that it was not in vain:

verses.original: ἀλλὰ προπαθόντες καὶ ὑβρισθέντες καθὼς οἴδατε ἐν Φιλίπποις ἐπαρρησιασάμεθα ἐν τῷ θεῷ ἡμῶν λαλῆσαι πρὸς ὑμᾶς τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ θεοῦ ἐν πολλῷ ἀγῶνι.
verses.translit: alla propathontes kai uvristhentes kathos oidate en Filippois eparrisiasametha en to theo emon lalesai pros umas to euaggelion tou theou en pollo agoni.
verses.translation: But even after that we had suffered before, and were shamefully entreated, as ye know, at Philippi, we were bold in our God to speak unto you the gospel of God with much contention.

verses.original: ἡ γὰρ παράκλησις ἡμῶν οὐκ ἐκ πλάνης οὐδὲ ἐξ ἀκαθαρσίας ⸀οὐδὲ ἐν δόλῳ,
verses.translit: e gar paraklisis emon ouk ek planis oude ex akatharsias oude en dolo,
verses.translation: For our exhortation was not of deceit, nor of uncleanness, nor in guile:

verses.original: ἀλλὰ καθὼς δεδοκιμάσμεθα ὑπὸ τοῦ θεοῦ πιστευθῆναι τὸ εὐαγγέλιον οὕτως λαλοῦμεν, οὐχ ὡς ἀνθρώποις ἀρέσκοντες ἀλλὰ ⸀θεῷ τῷ δοκιμάζοντι τὰς καρδίας ἡμῶν.
verses.translit: alla kathos dedokimasmetha upo tou theou pisteythenai to euaggelion outos laloumen, ouh os anthropois areskontes alla theo to dokimazonti tas kardias emon.
verses.translation: But as we were allowed of God to be put in trust with the gospel, even so we speak; not as pleasing men, but God, which trieth our hearts.

verses.original: οὔτε γάρ ποτε ἐν λόγῳ κολακείας ἐγενήθημεν, καθὼς οἴδατε, οὔτε ⸀ἐν προφάσει πλεονεξίας, θεὸς μάρτυς,
verses.translit: oute gar pote en logo kolakeias egenithimen, kathos oidate, oute en profasei pleonexias, theos martys,
verses.translation: For neither at any time used we flattering words, as ye know, nor a cloke of covetousness; God is witness:

verses.original: οὔτε ζητοῦντες ἐξ ἀνθρώπων δόξαν, οὔτε ἀφʼ ὑμῶν οὔτε ἀπʼ ἄλλων,
verses.translit: oute zitountes ex anthropon doxan, oute af' umon oute ap' allon,
verses.translation: Nor of men sought we glory, neither of you, nor yet of others, when we might have been burdensome, as the apostles of Christ.

verses.original: δυνάμενοι ἐν βάρει εἶναι ὡς Χριστοῦ ἀπόστολοι· ἀλλὰ ἐγενήθημεν ⸀ἤπιοι ἐν μέσῳ ὑμῶν, ὡς ⸀ἐὰν τροφὸς θάλπῃ τὰ ἑαυτῆς τέκνα·
verses.translit: dynamenoi en varei einai os Hristou apostoloi* alla egenithimen epioi en meso umon, os ean trofos thalpe ta eaytes tekna*
verses.translation: But we were gentle among you, even as a nurse cherisheth her children:

verses.original: οὕτως ὁμειρόμενοι ὑμῶν εὐδοκοῦμεν μεταδοῦναι ὑμῖν οὐ μόνον τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ θεοῦ ἀλλὰ καὶ τὰς ἑαυτῶν ψυχάς, διότι ἀγαπητοὶ ἡμῖν ⸀ἐγενήθητε.
verses.translit: outos omeiromenoi umon eudokoumen metadounai umin ou monon to euaggelion tou theou alla kai tas eayton psyhas, dioti agapitoi emin egenithite.
verses.translation: So being affectionately desirous of you, we were willing to have imparted unto you, not the gospel of God only, but also our own souls, because ye were dear unto us.

verses.original: Μνημονεύετε γάρ, ἀδελφοί, τὸν κόπον ἡμῶν καὶ τὸν μόχθον· ⸀νυκτὸς καὶ ἡμέρας ἐργαζόμενοι πρὸς τὸ μὴ ἐπιβαρῆσαί τινα ὑμῶν ἐκηρύξαμεν εἰς ὑμᾶς τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ θεοῦ.
verses.translit: Mnimoneyete gar, adelfoi, ton kopon emon kai ton mohthon* nyktos kai emeras ergazomenoi pros to me epivaresai tina umon ekiryxamen eis umas to euaggelion tou theou.
verses.translation: For ye remember, brethren, our labour and travail: for labouring night and day, because we would not be chargeable unto any of you, we preached unto you the gospel of God.

verses.original: ὑμεῖς μάρτυρες καὶ ὁ θεός, ὡς ὁσίως καὶ δικαίως καὶ ἀμέμπτως ὑμῖν τοῖς πιστεύουσιν ἐγενήθημεν,
verses.translit: umeis martyres kai o theos, os osios kai dikaios kai amemptos umin tois pisteyoysin egenithimen,
verses.translation: Ye are witnesses, and God also , how holily and justly and unblameably we behaved ourselves among you that believe:

verses.original: καθάπερ οἴδατε ὡς ἕνα ἕκαστον ὑμῶν ὡς πατὴρ τέκνα ἑαυτοῦ
verses.translit: kathaper oidate os ena ekaston umon os pater tekna eaytou
verses.translation: As ye know how we exhorted and comforted and charged every one of you, as a father doth his children,

verses.original: παρακαλοῦντες ὑμᾶς καὶ παραμυθούμενοι καὶ μαρτυρόμενοι, εἰς τὸ ⸀περιπατεῖν ὑμᾶς ἀξίως τοῦ θεοῦ τοῦ καλοῦντος ὑμᾶς εἰς τὴν ἑαυτοῦ βασιλείαν καὶ δόξαν.
verses.translit: parakalountes umas kai paramythoymenoi kai martyromenoi, eis to peripatein umas axios tou theou tou kalountos umas eis ten eaytou vasileian kai doxan.
verses.translation: That ye would walk worthy of God, who hath called you unto his kingdom and glory.

verses.original: ⸀Καὶ διὰ τοῦτο καὶ ἡμεῖς εὐχαριστοῦμεν τῷ θεῷ ἀδιαλείπτως, ὅτι παραλαβόντες λόγον ἀκοῆς παρʼ ἡμῶν τοῦ θεοῦ ἐδέξασθε οὐ λόγον ἀνθρώπων ἀλλὰ καθὼς ⸂ἀληθῶς ἐστὶν⸃ λόγον θεοῦ, ὃς καὶ ἐνεργεῖται ἐν ὑμῖν τοῖς πιστεύουσιν.
verses.translit: Kai dia touto kai emeis euharistoumen to theo adialeiptos, oti paralavontes logon akoes par' emon tou theou edexasthe ou logon anthropon alla kathos alithos estin logon theou, os kai energeitai en umin tois pisteyoysin.
verses.translation: For this cause also thank we God without ceasing, because, when ye received the word of God which ye heard of us, ye received it not as the word of men, but as it is in truth, the word of God, which effectually worketh also in you that believe.

verses.original: ὑμεῖς γὰρ μιμηταὶ ἐγενήθητε, ἀδελφοί, τῶν ἐκκλησιῶν τοῦ θεοῦ τῶν οὐσῶν ἐν τῇ Ἰουδαίᾳ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ, ὅτι τὰ αὐτὰ ἐπάθετε καὶ ὑμεῖς ὑπὸ τῶν ἰδίων συμφυλετῶν καθὼς καὶ αὐτοὶ ὑπὸ τῶν Ἰουδαίων
verses.translit: umeis gar mimitai egenithite, adelfoi, ton ekklision tou theou ton ouson en te Ioydaia en Hristo Iisou, oti ta auta epathete kai umeis upo ton idion symfyleton kathos kai autoi upo ton Ioydaion
verses.translation: For ye, brethren, became followers of the churches of God which in Judaea are in Christ Jesus: for ye also have suffered like things of your own countrymen, even as they have of the Jews:

verses.original: τῶν καὶ τὸν κύριον ἀποκτεινάντων Ἰησοῦν καὶ ⸀τοὺς προφήτας καὶ ἡμᾶς ἐκδιωξάντων, καὶ θεῷ μὴ ἀρεσκόντων, καὶ πᾶσιν ἀνθρώποις ἐναντίων,
verses.translit: ton kai ton kyrion apokteinanton Iisoun kai tous profitas kai emas ekdioxanton, kai theo me areskonton, kai pasin anthropois enantion,
verses.translation: Who both killed the Lord Jesus, and their own prophets, and have persecuted us; and they please not God, and are contrary to all men:

verses.original: κωλυόντων ἡμᾶς τοῖς ἔθνεσιν λαλῆσαι ἵνα σωθῶσιν, εἰς τὸ ἀναπληρῶσαι αὐτῶν τὰς ἁμαρτίας πάντοτε. ἔφθασεν δὲ ἐπʼ αὐτοὺς ἡ ⸀ὀργὴ εἰς τέλος.
verses.translit: kolyonton emas tois ethnesin lalesai ina sothosin, eis to anaplirosai auton tas amartias pantote. efthasen de ep' autous e orge eis telos.
verses.translation: Forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they might be saved, to fill up their sins alway: for the wrath is come upon them to the uttermost.
