verses.original: Ἡμεῖς δέ, ἀδελφοί, ἀπορφανισθέντες ἀφʼ ὑμῶν πρὸς καιρὸν ὥρας, προσώπῳ οὐ καρδίᾳ, περισσοτέρως ἐσπουδάσαμεν τὸ πρόσωπον ὑμῶν ἰδεῖν ἐν πολλῇ ἐπιθυμίᾳ.
verses.translit: Emeis de, adelfoi, aporfanisthentes af' umon pros kairon oras, prosopo ou kardia, perissoteros espoydasamen to prosopon umon idein en polle epithymia.
verses.translation: But we, brethren, being taken from you for a short time in presence, not in heart, endeavoured the more abundantly to see your face with great desire.

verses.original: ⸀διότι ἠθελήσαμεν ἐλθεῖν πρὸς ὑμᾶς, ἐγὼ μὲν Παῦλος καὶ ἅπαξ καὶ δίς, καὶ ἐνέκοψεν ἡμᾶς ὁ Σατανᾶς.
verses.translit: dioti ethelisamen elthein pros umas, ego men Paulos kai apax kai dis, kai enekopsen emas o Satanas.
verses.translation: Wherefore we would have come unto you, even I Paul, once and again; but Satan hindered us.

verses.original: τίς γὰρ ἡμῶν ἐλπὶς ἢ χαρὰ ἢ στέφανος καυχήσεως— ἢ οὐχὶ καὶ ὑμεῖς— ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ ἐν τῇ αὐτοῦ παρουσίᾳ;
verses.translit: tis gar emon elpis e hara e stefanos kayhiseos-- e ouhi kai umeis-- emprosthen tou kyrioy emon Iisou en te autou paroysia;
verses.translation: For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? Are not even ye in the presence of our Lord Jesus Christ at his coming?

verses.original: ὑμεῖς γάρ ἐστε ἡ δόξα ἡμῶν καὶ ἡ χαρά.
verses.translit: umeis gar este e doxa emon kai e hara.
verses.translation: For ye are our glory and joy.

verses.original: Διὸ μηκέτι στέγοντες εὐδοκήσαμεν καταλειφθῆναι ἐν Ἀθήναις μόνοι,
verses.translit: Dio miketi stegontes eudokisamen kataleifthenai en Athinais monoi,
verses.translation: Wherefore when we could no longer forbear, we thought it good to be left at Athens alone;

verses.original: καὶ ἐπέμψαμεν Τιμόθεον, τὸν ἀδελφὸν ἡμῶν καὶ ⸀συνεργὸν τοῦ ⸀θεοῦ ἐν τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ τοῦ Χριστοῦ, εἰς τὸ στηρίξαι ὑμᾶς καὶ παρακαλέσαι ⸀ὑπὲρ τῆς πίστεως ὑμῶν
verses.translit: kai epempsamen Timotheon, ton adelfon emon kai synergon tou theou en to euaggelio tou Hristou, eis to stirixai umas kai parakalesai uper tes pisteos umon
verses.translation: And sent Timotheus, our brother, and minister of God, and our fellowlabourer in the gospel of Christ, to establish you, and to comfort you concerning your faith:

verses.original: τὸ μηδένα σαίνεσθαι ἐν ταῖς θλίψεσιν ταύταις. αὐτοὶ γὰρ οἴδατε ὅτι εἰς τοῦτο κείμεθα·
verses.translit: to midena sainesthai en tais thlipsesin taytais. autoi gar oidate oti eis touto keimetha*
verses.translation: That no man should be moved by these afflictions: for yourselves know that we are appointed thereunto.

verses.original: καὶ γὰρ ὅτε πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἦμεν, προελέγομεν ὑμῖν ὅτι μέλλομεν θλίβεσθαι, καθὼς καὶ ἐγένετο καὶ οἴδατε.
verses.translit: kai gar ote pros umas emen, proelegomen umin oti mellomen thlivesthai, kathos kai egeneto kai oidate.
verses.translation: For verily, when we were with you, we told you before that we should suffer tribulation; even as it came to pass, and ye know.

verses.original: διὰ τοῦτο κἀγὼ μηκέτι στέγων ἔπεμψα εἰς τὸ γνῶναι τὴν πίστιν ὑμῶν, μή πως ἐπείρασεν ὑμᾶς ὁ πειράζων καὶ εἰς κενὸν γένηται ὁ κόπος ἡμῶν.
verses.translit: dia touto kago miketi stegon epempsa eis to gnonai ten pistin umon, mi pos epeirasen umas o peirazon kai eis kenon genitai o kopos emon.
verses.translation: For this cause, when I could no longer forbear, I sent to know your faith, lest by some means the tempter have tempted you, and our labour be in vain.

verses.original: Ἄρτι δὲ ἐλθόντος Τιμοθέου πρὸς ἡμᾶς ἀφʼ ὑμῶν καὶ εὐαγγελισαμένου ἡμῖν τὴν πίστιν καὶ τὴν ἀγάπην ὑμῶν, καὶ ὅτι ἔχετε μνείαν ἡμῶν ἀγαθὴν πάντοτε ἐπιποθοῦντες ἡμᾶς ἰδεῖν καθάπερ καὶ ἡμεῖς ὑμᾶς,
verses.translit: Arti de elthontos Timotheoy pros emas af' umon kai euaggelisamenoy emin ten pistin kai ten agapin umon, kai oti ehete mneian emon agathen pantote epipothountes emas idein kathaper kai emeis umas,
verses.translation: But now when Timotheus came from you unto us, and brought us good tidings of your faith and charity, and that ye have good remembrance of us always, desiring greatly to see us, as we also to see you:

verses.original: διὰ τοῦτο παρεκλήθημεν, ἀδελφοί, ἐφʼ ὑμῖν ἐπὶ πάσῃ τῇ ⸂ἀνάγκῃ καὶ θλίψει⸃ ἡμῶν διὰ τῆς ὑμῶν πίστεως,
verses.translit: dia touto pareklithimen, adelfoi, ef' umin epi pase te anagke kai thlipsei emon dia tes umon pisteos,
verses.translation: Therefore, brethren, we were comforted over you in all our affliction and distress by your faith:

verses.original: ὅτι νῦν ζῶμεν ἐὰν ὑμεῖς στήκετε ἐν κυρίῳ.
verses.translit: oti nun zomen ean umeis stikete en kyrio.
verses.translation: For now we live, if ye stand fast in the Lord.

verses.original: τίνα γὰρ εὐχαριστίαν δυνάμεθα τῷ θεῷ ἀνταποδοῦναι περὶ ὑμῶν ἐπὶ πάσῃ τῇ χαρᾷ ᾗ χαίρομεν διʼ ὑμᾶς ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν,
verses.translit: tina gar euharistian dynametha to theo antapodounai peri umon epi pase te hara e hairomen di' umas emprosthen tou theou emon,
verses.translation: For what thanks can we render to God again for you, for all the joy wherewith we joy for your sakes before our God;

verses.original: νυκτὸς καὶ ἡμέρας ὑπερεκπερισσοῦ δεόμενοι εἰς τὸ ἰδεῖν ὑμῶν τὸ πρόσωπον καὶ καταρτίσαι τὰ ὑστερήματα τῆς πίστεως ὑμῶν;
verses.translit: nyktos kai emeras uperekperissou deomenoi eis to idein umon to prosopon kai katartisai ta usterimata tes pisteos umon;
verses.translation: Night and day praying exceedingly that we might see your face, and might perfect that which is lacking in your faith?

verses.original: Αὐτὸς δὲ ὁ θεὸς καὶ πατὴρ ἡμῶν καὶ ὁ κύριος ἡμῶν ⸀Ἰησοῦς κατευθύναι τὴν ὁδὸν ἡμῶν πρὸς ὑμᾶς·
verses.translit: Autos de o theos kai pater emon kai o kyrios emon Iisous kateythynai ten odon emon pros umas*
verses.translation: Now God himself and our Father, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way unto you.

verses.original: ὑμᾶς δὲ ὁ κύριος πλεονάσαι καὶ περισσεύσαι τῇ ἀγάπῃ εἰς ἀλλήλους καὶ εἰς πάντας, καθάπερ καὶ ἡμεῖς εἰς ὑμᾶς,
verses.translit: umas de o kyrios pleonasai kai perisseysai te agape eis alliloys kai eis pantas, kathaper kai emeis eis umas,
verses.translation: And the Lord make you to increase and abound in love one toward another, and toward all men , even as we do toward you:

verses.original: εἰς τὸ στηρίξαι ὑμῶν τὰς καρδίας ἀμέμπτους ἐν ἁγιωσύνῃ ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ πατρὸς ἡμῶν ἐν τῇ παρουσίᾳ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν ⸀Ἰησοῦ μετὰ πάντων τῶν ἁγίων ⸀αὐτοῦ.
verses.translit: eis to stirixai umon tas kardias amemptoys en agiosyne emprosthen tou theou kai patros emon en te paroysia tou kyrioy emon Iisou meta panton ton agion autou.
verses.translation: To the end he may stablish your hearts unblameable in holiness before God, even our Father, at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ with all his saints.

verses.original: Λοιπὸν ⸀οὖν, ἀδελφοί, ἐρωτῶμεν ὑμᾶς καὶ παρακαλοῦμεν ἐν κυρίῳ Ἰησοῦ, ⸀ἵνα καθὼς παρελάβετε παρʼ ἡμῶν τὸ πῶς δεῖ ὑμᾶς περιπατεῖν καὶ ἀρέσκειν θεῷ, ⸂καθὼς καὶ περιπατεῖτε⸃, ἵνα περισσεύητε μᾶλλον.
verses.translit: Loipon oun, adelfoi, erotomen umas kai parakaloumen en kyrio Iisou, ina kathos parelavete par' emon to pos dei umas peripatein kai areskein theo, kathos kai peripateite, ina perisseyite mallon.
verses.translation: Furthermore then we beseech you, brethren, and exhort you by the Lord Jesus, that as ye have received of us how ye ought to walk and to please God, so ye would abound more and more.

verses.original: οἴδατε γὰρ τίνας παραγγελίας ἐδώκαμεν ὑμῖν διὰ τοῦ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ.
verses.translit: oidate gar tinas paraggelias edokamen umin dia tou kyrioy Iisou.
verses.translation: For ye know what commandments we gave you by the Lord Jesus.

verses.original: τοῦτο γάρ ἐστιν θέλημα τοῦ θεοῦ, ὁ ἁγιασμὸς ὑμῶν, ἀπέχεσθαι ὑμᾶς ἀπὸ τῆς πορνείας,
verses.translit: touto gar estin thelima tou theou, o agiasmos umon, apehesthai umas apo tes porneias,
verses.translation: For this is the will of God, even your sanctification, that ye should abstain from fornication:

verses.original: εἰδέναι ἕκαστον ὑμῶν τὸ ἑαυτοῦ σκεῦος κτᾶσθαι ἐν ἁγιασμῷ καὶ τιμῇ,
verses.translit: eidenai ekaston umon to eaytou skeuos ktasthai en agiasmo kai time,
verses.translation: That every one of you should know how to possess his vessel in sanctification and honour;

verses.original: μὴ ἐν πάθει ἐπιθυμίας καθάπερ καὶ τὰ ἔθνη τὰ μὴ εἰδότα τὸν θεόν,
verses.translit: me en pathei epithymias kathaper kai ta ethni ta me eidota ton theon,
verses.translation: Not in the lust of concupiscence, even as the Gentiles which know not God:

verses.original: τὸ μὴ ὑπερβαίνειν καὶ πλεονεκτεῖν ἐν τῷ πράγματι τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ, διότι ἔκδικος ⸀κύριος περὶ πάντων τούτων, καθὼς καὶ προείπαμεν ὑμῖν καὶ διεμαρτυράμεθα.
verses.translit: to me upervainein kai pleonektein en to pragmati ton adelfon autou, dioti ekdikos kyrios peri panton toyton, kathos kai proeipamen umin kai diemartyrametha.
verses.translation: That no man go beyond and defraud his brother in any matter: because that the Lord is the avenger of all such, as we also have forewarned you and testified.

verses.original: οὐ γὰρ ἐκάλεσεν ἡμᾶς ὁ θεὸς ἐπὶ ἀκαθαρσίᾳ ἀλλʼ ἐν ἁγιασμῷ.
verses.translit: ou gar ekalesen emas o theos epi akatharsia all' en agiasmo.
verses.translation: For God hath not called us unto uncleanness, but unto holiness.

verses.original: τοιγαροῦν ὁ ἀθετῶν οὐκ ἄνθρωπον ἀθετεῖ ἀλλὰ τὸν θεὸν τὸν ⸀καὶ ⸀διδόντα τὸ πνεῦμα αὐτοῦ τὸ ἅγιον εἰς ὑμᾶς.
verses.translit: toigaroun o atheton ouk anthropon athetei alla ton theon ton kai didonta to pneuma autou to agion eis umas.
verses.translation: He therefore that despiseth, despiseth not man, but God, who hath also given unto us his holy Spirit.

verses.original: Περὶ δὲ τῆς φιλαδελφίας οὐ χρείαν ἔχετε γράφειν ὑμῖν, αὐτοὶ γὰρ ὑμεῖς θεοδίδακτοί ἐστε εἰς τὸ ἀγαπᾶν ἀλλήλους·
verses.translit: Peri de tes filadelfias ou hreian ehete grafein umin, autoi gar umeis theodidaktoi este eis to agapan alliloys*
verses.translation: But as touching brotherly love ye need not that I write unto you: for ye yourselves are taught of God to love one another.

verses.original: καὶ γὰρ ποιεῖτε αὐτὸ εἰς πάντας τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς τοὺς ἐν ὅλῃ τῇ Μακεδονίᾳ. παρακαλοῦμεν δὲ ὑμᾶς, ἀδελφοί, περισσεύειν μᾶλλον,
verses.translit: kai gar poieite auto eis pantas tous adelfous tous en ole te Makedonia. parakaloumen de umas, adelfoi, perisseyein mallon,
verses.translation: And indeed ye do it toward all the brethren which are in all Macedonia: but we beseech you, brethren, that ye increase more and more;

verses.original: καὶ φιλοτιμεῖσθαι ἡσυχάζειν καὶ πράσσειν τὰ ἴδια καὶ ἐργάζεσθαι ⸀ταῖς χερσὶν ὑμῶν, καθὼς ὑμῖν παρηγγείλαμεν,
verses.translit: kai filotimeisthai esyhazein kai prassein ta idia kai ergazesthai tais hersin umon, kathos umin pariggeilamen,
verses.translation: And that ye study to be quiet, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, as we commanded you;

verses.original: ἵνα περιπατῆτε εὐσχημόνως πρὸς τοὺς ἔξω καὶ μηδενὸς χρείαν ἔχητε.
verses.translit: ina peripatete eushimonos pros tous exo kai midenos hreian ehite.
verses.translation: That ye may walk honestly toward them that are without, and that ye may have lack of nothing.

verses.original: Οὐ θέλομεν δὲ ὑμᾶς ἀγνοεῖν, ἀδελφοί, περὶ τῶν ⸀κοιμωμένων, ἵνα μὴ λυπῆσθε καθὼς καὶ οἱ λοιποὶ οἱ μὴ ἔχοντες ἐλπίδα.
verses.translit: Ou thelomen de umas agnoein, adelfoi, peri ton koimomenon, ina me lypesthe kathos kai oi loipoi oi me ehontes elpida.
verses.translation: But I would not have you to be ignorant, brethren, concerning them which are asleep, that ye sorrow not, even as others which have no hope.

verses.original: εἰ γὰρ πιστεύομεν ὅτι Ἰησοῦς ἀπέθανεν καὶ ἀνέστη, οὕτως καὶ ὁ θεὸς τοὺς κοιμηθέντας διὰ τοῦ Ἰησοῦ ἄξει σὺν αὐτῷ.
verses.translit: ei gar pisteyomen oti Iisous apethanen kai anesti, outos kai o theos tous koimithentas dia tou Iisou axei sun auto.
verses.translation: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so them also which sleep in Jesus will God bring with him.

verses.original: τοῦτο γὰρ ὑμῖν λέγομεν ἐν λόγῳ κυρίου, ὅτι ἡμεῖς οἱ ζῶντες οἱ περιλειπόμενοι εἰς τὴν παρουσίαν τοῦ κυρίου οὐ μὴ φθάσωμεν τοὺς κοιμηθέντας·
verses.translit: touto gar umin legomen en logo kyrioy, oti emeis oi zontes oi perileipomenoi eis ten paroysian tou kyrioy ou me fthasomen tous koimithentas*
verses.translation: For this we say unto you by the word of the Lord, that we which are alive and remain unto the coming of the Lord shall not prevent them which are asleep.

verses.original: ὅτι αὐτὸς ὁ κύριος ἐν κελεύσματι, ἐν φωνῇ ἀρχαγγέλου καὶ ἐν σάλπιγγι θεοῦ, καταβήσεται ἀπʼ οὐρανοῦ, καὶ οἱ νεκροὶ ἐν Χριστῷ ἀναστήσονται πρῶτον,
verses.translit: oti autos o kyrios en keleysmati, en fone arhaggeloy kai en salpiggi theou, katavisetai ap' ouranou, kai oi nekroi en Hristo anastisontai proton,
verses.translation: For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of God: and the dead in Christ shall rise first:

verses.original: ἔπειτα ἡμεῖς οἱ ζῶντες οἱ περιλειπόμενοι ἅμα σὺν αὐτοῖς ἁρπαγησόμεθα ἐν νεφέλαις εἰς ἀπάντησιν τοῦ κυρίου εἰς ἀέρα· καὶ οὕτως πάντοτε σὺν κυρίῳ ἐσόμεθα.
verses.translit: epeita emeis oi zontes oi perileipomenoi ama sun autois arpagisometha en nefelais eis apantisin tou kyrioy eis aera* kai outos pantote sun kyrio esometha.
verses.translation: Then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.

verses.original: ὥστε παρακαλεῖτε ἀλλήλους ἐν τοῖς λόγοις τούτοις.
verses.translit: oste parakaleite alliloys en tois logois toytois.
verses.translation: Wherefore comfort one another with these words.

verses.original: Περὶ δὲ τῶν χρόνων καὶ τῶν καιρῶν, ἀδελφοί, οὐ χρείαν ἔχετε ὑμῖν γράφεσθαι,
verses.translit: Peri de ton hronon kai ton kairon, adelfoi, ou hreian ehete umin grafesthai,
verses.translation: But of the times and the seasons, brethren, ye have no need that I write unto you.

verses.original: αὐτοὶ γὰρ ἀκριβῶς οἴδατε ⸀ὅτι ἡμέρα κυρίου ὡς κλέπτης ἐν νυκτὶ οὕτως ἔρχεται.
verses.translit: autoi gar akrivos oidate oti emera kyrioy os kleptis en nykti outos erhetai.
verses.translation: For yourselves know perfectly that the day of the Lord so cometh as a thief in the night.

verses.original: ⸀ὅταν λέγωσιν· Εἰρήνη καὶ ἀσφάλεια, τότε αἰφνίδιος αὐτοῖς ἐφίσταται ὄλεθρος ὥσπερ ἡ ὠδὶν τῇ ἐν γαστρὶ ἐχούσῃ, καὶ οὐ μὴ ἐκφύγωσιν.
verses.translit: otan legosin* Eirini kai asfaleia, tote aifnidios autois efistatai olethros osper e odin te en gastri ehoyse, kai ou me ekfygosin.
verses.translation: For when they shall say, Peace and safety; then sudden destruction cometh upon them, as travail upon a woman with child; and they shall not escape.

verses.original: ὑμεῖς δέ, ἀδελφοί, οὐκ ἐστὲ ἐν σκότει, ἵνα ἡ ἡμέρα ὑμᾶς ὡς ⸀κλέπτης καταλάβῃ,
verses.translit: umeis de, adelfoi, ouk este en skotei, ina e emera umas os kleptis katalave,
verses.translation: But ye, brethren, are not in darkness, that that day should overtake you as a thief.

verses.original: πάντες ⸀γὰρ ὑμεῖς υἱοὶ φωτός ἐστε καὶ υἱοὶ ἡμέρας. οὐκ ἐσμὲν νυκτὸς οὐδὲ σκότους·
verses.translit: pantes gar umeis yioi fotos este kai yioi emeras. ouk esmen nyktos oude skotoys*
verses.translation: Ye are all the children of light, and the children of the day: we are not of the night, nor of darkness.

verses.original: ἄρα οὖν μὴ καθεύδωμεν ⸀ὡς οἱ λοιποί, ἀλλὰ γρηγορῶμεν καὶ νήφωμεν.
verses.translit: ara oun me katheydomen os oi loipoi, alla grigoromen kai nifomen.
verses.translation: Therefore let us not sleep, as do others; but let us watch and be sober.

verses.original: οἱ γὰρ καθεύδοντες νυκτὸς καθεύδουσιν, καὶ οἱ μεθυσκόμενοι νυκτὸς μεθύουσιν·
verses.translit: oi gar katheydontes nyktos katheydoysin, kai oi methyskomenoi nyktos methyoysin*
verses.translation: For they that sleep sleep in the night; and they that be drunken are drunken in the night.

verses.original: ἡμεῖς δὲ ἡμέρας ὄντες νήφωμεν, ἐνδυσάμενοι θώρακα πίστεως καὶ ἀγάπης καὶ περικεφαλαίαν ἐλπίδα σωτηρίας·
verses.translit: emeis de emeras ontes nifomen, endysamenoi thoraka pisteos kai agapis kai perikefalaian elpida sotirias*
verses.translation: But let us, who are of the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for an helmet, the hope of salvation.

verses.original: ὅτι οὐκ ἔθετο ἡμᾶς ὁ θεὸς εἰς ὀργὴν ἀλλὰ εἰς περιποίησιν σωτηρίας διὰ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ,
verses.translit: oti ouk etheto emas o theos eis orgen alla eis peripoiisin sotirias dia tou kyrioy emon Iisou Hristou,
verses.translation: For God hath not appointed us to wrath, but to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus Christ,

verses.original: τοῦ ἀποθανόντος ⸀περὶ ἡμῶν ἵνα εἴτε γρηγορῶμεν εἴτε καθεύδωμεν ἅμα σὺν αὐτῷ ζήσωμεν.
verses.translit: tou apothanontos peri emon ina eite grigoromen eite katheydomen ama sun auto zisomen.
verses.translation: Who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.

verses.original: διὸ παρακαλεῖτε ἀλλήλους καὶ οἰκοδομεῖτε εἷς τὸν ἕνα, καθὼς καὶ ποιεῖτε.
verses.translit: dio parakaleite alliloys kai oikodomeite eis ton ena, kathos kai poieite.
verses.translation: Wherefore comfort yourselves together, and edify one another, even as also ye do.

verses.original: Ἐρωτῶμεν δὲ ὑμᾶς, ἀδελφοί, εἰδέναι τοὺς κοπιῶντας ἐν ὑμῖν καὶ προϊσταμένους ὑμῶν ἐν κυρίῳ καὶ νουθετοῦντας ὑμᾶς,
verses.translit: Erotomen de umas, adelfoi, eidenai tous kopiontas en umin kai proistamenoys umon en kyrio kai noythetountas umas,
verses.translation: And we beseech you, brethren, to know them which labour among you, and are over you in the Lord, and admonish you;

verses.original: καὶ ἡγεῖσθαι αὐτοὺς ⸀ὑπερεκπερισσοῦ ἐν ἀγάπῃ διὰ τὸ ἔργον αὐτῶν. εἰρηνεύετε ἐν ⸀ἑαυτοῖς.
verses.translit: kai egeisthai autous uperekperissou en agape dia to ergon auton. eirineyete en eaytois.
verses.translation: And to esteem them very highly in love for their work’s sake. And be at peace among yourselves.

verses.original: παρακαλοῦμεν δὲ ὑμᾶς, ἀδελφοί, νουθετεῖτε τοὺς ἀτάκτους, παραμυθεῖσθε τοὺς ὀλιγοψύχους, ἀντέχεσθε τῶν ἀσθενῶν, μακροθυμεῖτε πρὸς πάντας.
verses.translit: parakaloumen de umas, adelfoi, noytheteite tous ataktoys, paramytheisthe tous oligopsyhoys, antehesthe ton asthenon, makrothymeite pros pantas.
verses.translation: Now we exhort you, brethren, warn them that are unruly, comfort the feebleminded, support the weak, be patient toward all men .

verses.original: ὁρᾶτε μή τις κακὸν ἀντὶ κακοῦ τινι ἀποδῷ, ἀλλὰ πάντοτε τὸ ἀγαθὸν ⸀διώκετε εἰς ἀλλήλους καὶ εἰς πάντας.
verses.translit: orate mi tis kakon anti kakou tini apodo, alla pantote to agathon diokete eis alliloys kai eis pantas.
verses.translation: See that none render evil for evil unto any man ; but ever follow that which is good, both among yourselves, and to all men .

verses.original: πάντοτε χαίρετε,
verses.translit: pantote hairete,
verses.translation: Rejoice evermore.

verses.original: ἀδιαλείπτως προσεύχεσθε,
verses.translit: adialeiptos proseyhesthe,
verses.translation: Pray without ceasing.

verses.original: ἐν παντὶ εὐχαριστεῖτε· τοῦτο γὰρ θέλημα θεοῦ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ εἰς ὑμᾶς.
verses.translit: en panti euharisteite* touto gar thelima theou en Hristo Iisou eis umas.
verses.translation: In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.

verses.original: τὸ πνεῦμα μὴ σβέννυτε,
verses.translit: to pneuma me svennyte,
verses.translation: Quench not the Spirit.

verses.original: προφητείας μὴ ἐξουθενεῖτε·
verses.translit: profiteias me exoytheneite*
verses.translation: Despise not prophesyings.

verses.original: πάντα δὲ δοκιμάζετε, τὸ καλὸν κατέχετε,
verses.translit: panta de dokimazete, to kalon katehete,
verses.translation: Prove all things; hold fast that which is good.

verses.original: ἀπὸ παντὸς εἴδους πονηροῦ ἀπέχεσθε.
verses.translit: apo pantos eidoys ponirou apehesthe.
verses.translation: Abstain from all appearance of evil.

verses.original: Αὐτὸς δὲ ὁ θεὸς τῆς εἰρήνης ἁγιάσαι ὑμᾶς ὁλοτελεῖς, καὶ ὁλόκληρον ὑμῶν τὸ πνεῦμα καὶ ἡ ψυχὴ καὶ τὸ σῶμα ἀμέμπτως ἐν τῇ παρουσίᾳ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τηρηθείη.
verses.translit: Autos de o theos tes eirinis agiasai umas oloteleis, kai olokliron umon to pneuma kai e psyhe kai to soma amemptos en te paroysia tou kyrioy emon Iisou Hristou tiritheii.
verses.translation: And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly; and I pray God your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless unto the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.original: πιστὸς ὁ καλῶν ὑμᾶς, ὃς καὶ ποιήσει.
verses.translit: pistos o kalon umas, os kai poiisei.
verses.translation: Faithful is he that calleth you, who also will do it.

verses.original: Ἀδελφοί, ⸀προσεύχεσθε περὶ ἡμῶν.
verses.translit: Adelfoi, proseyhesthe peri emon.
verses.translation: Brethren, pray for us.

verses.original: ἀσπάσασθε τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς πάντας ἐν φιλήματι ἁγίῳ.
verses.translit: aspasasthe tous adelfous pantas en filimati agio.
verses.translation: Greet all the brethren with an holy kiss.

verses.original: ⸀ἐνορκίζω ὑμᾶς τὸν κύριον ἀναγνωσθῆναι τὴν ἐπιστολὴν πᾶσιν ⸀τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς.
verses.translit: enorkizo umas ton kyrion anagnosthenai ten epistolen pasin tois adelfois.
verses.translation: I charge you by the Lord that this epistle be read unto all the holy brethren.

verses.original: ἡ χάρις τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ μεθʼ ⸀ὑμῶν.
verses.translit: e haris tou kyrioy emon Iisou Hristou meth' umon.
verses.translation: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.

verses.original: Παῦλος καὶ Σιλουανὸς καὶ Τιμόθεος τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ Θεσσαλονικέων ἐν θεῷ πατρὶ ἡμῶν καὶ κυρίῳ Ἰησοῦ Χριστῷ·
verses.translit: Paulos kai Siloyanos kai Timotheos te ekklisia Thessalonikeon en theo patri emon kai kyrio Iisou Hristo*
verses.translation: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:

verses.original: χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη ἀπὸ θεοῦ ⸀πατρὸς καὶ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.
verses.translit: haris umin kai eirini apo theou patros kai kyrioy Iisou Hristou.
verses.translation: Grace unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.original: Εὐχαριστεῖν ὀφείλομεν τῷ θεῷ πάντοτε περὶ ὑμῶν, ἀδελφοί, καθὼς ἄξιόν ἐστιν, ὅτι ὑπεραυξάνει ἡ πίστις ὑμῶν καὶ πλεονάζει ἡ ἀγάπη ἑνὸς ἑκάστου πάντων ὑμῶν εἰς ἀλλήλους,
verses.translit: Euharistein ofeilomen to theo pantote peri umon, adelfoi, kathos axion estin, oti uperayxanei e pistis umon kai pleonazei e agapi enos ekastoy panton umon eis alliloys,
verses.translation: We are bound to thank God always for you, brethren, as it is meet, because that your faith groweth exceedingly, and the charity of every one of you all toward each other aboundeth;

verses.original: ὥστε ⸂αὐτοὺς ἡμᾶς⸃ ἐν ὑμῖν ⸀ἐγκαυχᾶσθαι ἐν ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις τοῦ θεοῦ ὑπὲρ τῆς ὑπομονῆς ὑμῶν καὶ πίστεως ἐν πᾶσιν τοῖς διωγμοῖς ὑμῶν καὶ ταῖς θλίψεσιν αἷς ἀνέχεσθε,
verses.translit: oste autous emas en umin egkayhasthai en tais ekklisiais tou theou uper tes upomones umon kai pisteos en pasin tois diogmois umon kai tais thlipsesin ais anehesthe,
verses.translation: So that we ourselves glory in you in the churches of God for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and tribulations that ye endure:

verses.original: ἔνδειγμα τῆς δικαίας κρίσεως τοῦ θεοῦ, εἰς τὸ καταξιωθῆναι ὑμᾶς τῆς βασιλείας τοῦ θεοῦ, ὑπὲρ ἧς καὶ πάσχετε,
verses.translit: endeigma tes dikaias kriseos tou theou, eis to kataxiothenai umas tes vasileias tou theou, uper es kai pashete,
verses.translation: Which is a manifest token of the righteous judgment of God, that ye may be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which ye also suffer:

verses.original: εἴπερ δίκαιον παρὰ θεῷ ἀνταποδοῦναι τοῖς θλίβουσιν ὑμᾶς θλῖψιν
verses.translit: eiper dikaion para theo antapodounai tois thlivoysin umas thlipsin
verses.translation: Seeing it is a righteous thing with God to recompense tribulation to them that trouble you;

verses.original: καὶ ὑμῖν τοῖς θλιβομένοις ἄνεσιν μεθʼ ἡμῶν ἐν τῇ ἀποκαλύψει τοῦ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ ἀπʼ οὐρανοῦ μετʼ ἀγγέλων δυνάμεως αὐτοῦ
verses.translit: kai umin tois thlivomenois anesin meth' emon en te apokalypsei tou kyrioy Iisou ap' ouranou met' aggelon dynameos autou
verses.translation: And to you who are troubled rest with us, when the Lord Jesus shall be revealed from heaven with his mighty angels,

verses.original: ἐν ⸂φλογὶ πυρός⸃, διδόντος ἐκδίκησιν τοῖς μὴ εἰδόσι θεὸν καὶ τοῖς μὴ ὑπακούουσιν τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ,
verses.translit: en flogi pyros, didontos ekdikisin tois me eidosi theon kai tois me upakoyoysin to euaggelio tou kyrioy emon Iisou,
verses.translation: In flaming fire taking vengeance on them that know not God, and that obey not the gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ:

verses.original: οἵτινες δίκην τίσουσιν ὄλεθρον αἰώνιον ἀπὸ προσώπου τοῦ κυρίου καὶ ἀπὸ τῆς δόξης τῆς ἰσχύος αὐτοῦ,
verses.translit: oitines dikin tisoysin olethron aionion apo prosopoy tou kyrioy kai apo tes doxis tes ishyos autou,
verses.translation: Who shall be punished with everlasting destruction from the presence of the Lord, and from the glory of his power;

verses.original: ὅταν ἔλθῃ ἐνδοξασθῆναι ἐν τοῖς ἁγίοις αὐτοῦ καὶ θαυμασθῆναι ἐν πᾶσιν τοῖς πιστεύσασιν, ὅτι ἐπιστεύθη τὸ μαρτύριον ἡμῶν ἐφʼ ὑμᾶς, ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ.
verses.translit: otan elthe endoxasthenai en tois agiois autou kai thaymasthenai en pasin tois pisteysasin, oti episteythi to martyrion emon ef' umas, en te emera ekeine.
verses.translation: When he shall come to be glorified in his saints, and to be admired in all them that believe (because our testimony among you was believed) in that day.

verses.original: εἰς ὃ καὶ προσευχόμεθα πάντοτε περὶ ὑμῶν, ἵνα ὑμᾶς ἀξιώσῃ τῆς κλήσεως ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν καὶ πληρώσῃ πᾶσαν εὐδοκίαν ἀγαθωσύνης καὶ ἔργον πίστεως ἐν δυνάμει,
verses.translit: eis o kai proseyhometha pantote peri umon, ina umas axiose tes kliseos o theos emon kai plirose pasan eudokian agathosynis kai ergon pisteos en dynamei,
verses.translation: Wherefore also we pray always for you, that our God would count you worthy of this calling, and fulfil all the good pleasure of his goodness, and the work of faith with power:

verses.original: ὅπως ἐνδοξασθῇ τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ ἐν ὑμῖν, καὶ ὑμεῖς ἐν αὐτῷ, κατὰ τὴν χάριν τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν καὶ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.
verses.translit: opos endoxasthe to onoma tou kyrioy emon Iisou en umin, kai umeis en auto, kata ten harin tou theou emon kai kyrioy Iisou Hristou.
verses.translation: That the name of our Lord Jesus Christ may be glorified in you, and ye in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.original: Ἐρωτῶμεν δὲ ὑμᾶς, ἀδελφοί, ὑπὲρ τῆς παρουσίας τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ καὶ ἡμῶν ἐπισυναγωγῆς ἐπʼ αὐτόν,
verses.translit: Erotomen de umas, adelfoi, uper tes paroysias tou kyrioy emon Iisou Hristou kai emon episynagoges ep' auton,
verses.translation: Now we beseech you, brethren, by the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, and by our gathering together unto him,

verses.original: εἰς τὸ μὴ ταχέως σαλευθῆναι ὑμᾶς ἀπὸ τοῦ νοὸς ⸀μηδὲ θροεῖσθαι μήτε διὰ πνεύματος μήτε διὰ λόγου μήτε διʼ ἐπιστολῆς ὡς διʼ ἡμῶν, ὡς ὅτι ἐνέστηκεν ἡ ἡμέρα τοῦ ⸀κυρίου.
verses.translit: eis to me taheos saleythenai umas apo tou noos mide throeisthai mite dia pneymatos mite dia logoy mite di' epistoles os di' emon, os oti enestiken e emera tou kyrioy.
verses.translation: That ye be not soon shaken in mind, or be troubled, neither by spirit, nor by word, nor by letter as from us, as that the day of Christ is at hand.

verses.original: μή τις ὑμᾶς ἐξαπατήσῃ κατὰ μηδένα τρόπον· ὅτι ἐὰν μὴ ἔλθῃ ἡ ἀποστασία πρῶτον καὶ ἀποκαλυφθῇ ὁ ἄνθρωπος τῆς ⸀ἀνομίας, ὁ υἱὸς τῆς ἀπωλείας,
verses.translit: mi tis umas exapatise kata midena tropon* oti ean me elthe e apostasia proton kai apokalyfthe o anthropos tes anomias, o yios tes apoleias,
verses.translation: Let no man deceive you by any means: for that day shall not come , except there come a falling away first, and that man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition;

verses.original: ὁ ἀντικείμενος καὶ ὑπεραιρόμενος ἐπὶ πάντα λεγόμενον θεὸν ἢ σέβασμα, ὥστε αὐτὸν εἰς τὸν ναὸν τοῦ ⸀θεοῦ καθίσαι ἀποδεικνύντα ἑαυτὸν ὅτι ἔστιν θεός.
verses.translit: o antikeimenos kai uperairomenos epi panta legomenon theon e sevasma, oste auton eis ton naon tou theou kathisai apodeiknynta eayton oti estin theos.
verses.translation: Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God, or that is worshipped; so that he as God sitteth in the temple of God, shewing himself that he is God.

verses.original: οὐ μνημονεύετε ὅτι ἔτι ὢν πρὸς ὑμᾶς ταῦτα ἔλεγον ὑμῖν;
verses.translit: ou mnimoneyete oti eti on pros umas tauta elegon umin;
verses.translation: Remember ye not, that, when I was yet with you, I told you these things?

verses.original: καὶ νῦν τὸ κατέχον οἴδατε, εἰς τὸ ἀποκαλυφθῆναι αὐτὸν ἐν τῷ ⸀ἑαυτοῦ καιρῷ·
verses.translit: kai nun to katehon oidate, eis to apokalyfthenai auton en to eaytou kairo*
verses.translation: And now ye know what withholdeth that he might be revealed in his time.

verses.original: τὸ γὰρ μυστήριον ἤδη ἐνεργεῖται τῆς ἀνομίας· μόνον ὁ κατέχων ἄρτι ἕως ἐκ μέσου γένηται.
verses.translit: to gar mystirion edi energeitai tes anomias* monon o katehon arti eos ek mesoy genitai.
verses.translation: For the mystery of iniquity doth already work: only he who now letteth will let , until he be taken out of the way.

verses.original: καὶ τότε ἀποκαλυφθήσεται ὁ ἄνομος, ὃν ὁ κύριος ⸀Ἰησοῦς ⸀ἀνελεῖ τῷ πνεύματι τοῦ στόματος αὐτοῦ καὶ καταργήσει τῇ ἐπιφανείᾳ τῆς παρουσίας αὐτοῦ,
verses.translit: kai tote apokalyfthisetai o anomos, on o kyrios Iisous anelei to pneymati tou stomatos autou kai katargisei te epifaneia tes paroysias autou,
verses.translation: And then shall that Wicked be revealed, whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth, and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming:

verses.original: οὗ ἐστιν ἡ παρουσία κατʼ ἐνέργειαν τοῦ Σατανᾶ ἐν πάσῃ δυνάμει καὶ σημείοις καὶ τέρασιν ψεύδους
verses.translit: ou estin e paroysia kat' energeian tou Satana en pase dynamei kai simeiois kai terasin pseydoys
verses.translation: Even him , whose coming is after the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,

verses.original: καὶ ἐν πάσῃ ἀπάτῃ ⸀ἀδικίας τοῖς ἀπολλυμένοις, ἀνθʼ ὧν τὴν ἀγάπην τῆς ἀληθείας οὐκ ἐδέξαντο εἰς τὸ σωθῆναι αὐτούς·
verses.translit: kai en pase apate adikias tois apollymenois, anth' on ten agapin tes alitheias ouk edexanto eis to sothenai autoys*
verses.translation: And with all deceivableness of unrighteousness in them that perish; because they received not the love of the truth, that they might be saved.

verses.original: καὶ διὰ τοῦτο ⸀πέμπει αὐτοῖς ὁ θεὸς ἐνέργειαν πλάνης εἰς τὸ πιστεῦσαι αὐτοὺς τῷ ψεύδει,
verses.translit: kai dia touto pempei autois o theos energeian planis eis to pisteusai autous to pseydei,
verses.translation: And for this cause God shall send them strong delusion, that they should believe a lie:

verses.original: ἵνα κριθῶσιν ⸀πάντες οἱ μὴ πιστεύσαντες τῇ ἀληθείᾳ ἀλλὰ εὐδοκήσαντες ⸀τῇ ἀδικίᾳ.
verses.translit: ina krithosin pantes oi me pisteysantes te alitheia alla eudokisantes te adikia.
verses.translation: That they all might be damned who believed not the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.

verses.original: Ἡμεῖς δὲ ὀφείλομεν εὐχαριστεῖν τῷ θεῷ πάντοτε περὶ ὑμῶν, ἀδελφοὶ ἠγαπημένοι ὑπὸ κυρίου, ὅτι εἵλατο ὑμᾶς ὁ θεὸς ⸀ἀπαρχὴν εἰς σωτηρίαν ἐν ἁγιασμῷ πνεύματος καὶ πίστει ἀληθείας,
verses.translit: Emeis de ofeilomen euharistein to theo pantote peri umon, adelfoi egapimenoi upo kyrioy, oti eilato umas o theos aparhen eis sotirian en agiasmo pneymatos kai pistei alitheias,
verses.translation: But we are bound to give thanks alway to God for you, brethren beloved of the Lord, because God hath from the beginning chosen you to salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth:

verses.original: εἰς ⸀ὃ ἐκάλεσεν ὑμᾶς διὰ τοῦ εὐαγγελίου ἡμῶν, εἰς περιποίησιν δόξης τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.
verses.translit: eis o ekalesen umas dia tou euaggelioy emon, eis peripoiisin doxis tou kyrioy emon Iisou Hristou.
verses.translation: Whereunto he called you by our gospel, to the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.original: ἄρα οὖν, ἀδελφοί, στήκετε, καὶ κρατεῖτε τὰς παραδόσεις ἃς ἐδιδάχθητε εἴτε διὰ λόγου εἴτε διʼ ἐπιστολῆς ἡμῶν.
verses.translit: ara oun, adelfoi, stikete, kai krateite tas paradoseis as edidahthite eite dia logoy eite di' epistoles emon.
verses.translation: Therefore, brethren, stand fast, and hold the traditions which ye have been taught, whether by word, or our epistle.

verses.original: Αὐτὸς δὲ ὁ κύριος ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦς Χριστὸς καὶ ⸀θεὸς ⸀ὁ πατὴρ ἡμῶν, ὁ ἀγαπήσας ἡμᾶς καὶ δοὺς παράκλησιν αἰωνίαν καὶ ἐλπίδα ἀγαθὴν ἐν χάριτι,
verses.translit: Autos de o kyrios emon Iisous Hristos kai theos o pater emon, o agapisas emas kai dous paraklisin aionian kai elpida agathen en hariti,
verses.translation: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God, even our Father, which hath loved us, and hath given us everlasting consolation and good hope through grace,

verses.original: παρακαλέσαι ὑμῶν τὰς καρδίας καὶ ⸀στηρίξαι ἐν παντὶ ⸂ἔργῳ καὶ λόγῳ⸃ ἀγαθῷ.
verses.translit: parakalesai umon tas kardias kai stirixai en panti ergo kai logo agatho.
verses.translation: Comfort your hearts, and stablish you in every good word and work.

verses.original: Τὸ λοιπὸν προσεύχεσθε, ἀδελφοί, περὶ ἡμῶν, ἵνα ὁ λόγος τοῦ κυρίου τρέχῃ καὶ δοξάζηται καθὼς καὶ πρὸς ὑμᾶς,
verses.translit: To loipon proseyhesthe, adelfoi, peri emon, ina o logos tou kyrioy trehe kai doxazitai kathos kai pros umas,
verses.translation: Finally, brethren, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may have free course, and be glorified, even as it is with you:

verses.original: καὶ ἵνα ῥυσθῶμεν ἀπὸ τῶν ἀτόπων καὶ πονηρῶν ἀνθρώπων, οὐ γὰρ πάντων ἡ πίστις.
verses.translit: kai ina Rysthomen apo ton atopon kai poniron anthropon, ou gar panton e pistis.
verses.translation: And that we may be delivered from unreasonable and wicked men: for all men have not faith.

verses.original: πιστὸς δέ ἐστιν ὁ κύριος, ὃς στηρίξει ὑμᾶς καὶ φυλάξει ἀπὸ τοῦ πονηροῦ.
verses.translit: pistos de estin o kyrios, os stirixei umas kai fylaxei apo tou ponirou.
verses.translation: But the Lord is faithful, who shall stablish you, and keep you from evil.

verses.original: πεποίθαμεν δὲ ἐν κυρίῳ ἐφʼ ὑμᾶς, ὅτι ἃ ⸀παραγγέλλομεν καὶ ποιεῖτε καὶ ποιήσετε.
verses.translit: pepoithamen de en kyrio ef' umas, oti a paraggellomen kai poieite kai poiisete.
verses.translation: And we have confidence in the Lord touching you, that ye both do and will do the things which we command you.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ κύριος κατευθύναι ὑμῶν τὰς καρδίας εἰς τὴν ἀγάπην τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ εἰς τὴν ὑπομονὴν τοῦ Χριστοῦ.
verses.translit: o de kyrios kateythynai umon tas kardias eis ten agapin tou theou kai eis ten upomonen tou Hristou.
verses.translation: And the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God, and into the patient waiting for Christ.

verses.original: Παραγγέλλομεν δὲ ὑμῖν, ἀδελφοί, ἐν ὀνόματι τοῦ κυρίου ⸀ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ στέλλεσθαι ὑμᾶς ἀπὸ παντὸς ἀδελφοῦ ἀτάκτως περιπατοῦντος καὶ μὴ κατὰ τὴν παράδοσιν ἣν ⸀παρελάβοσαν παρʼ ἡμῶν.
verses.translit: Paraggellomen de umin, adelfoi, en onomati tou kyrioy emon Iisou Hristou stellesthai umas apo pantos adelfou ataktos peripatountos kai me kata ten paradosin en parelavosan par' emon.
verses.translation: Now we command you, brethren, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye withdraw yourselves from every brother that walketh disorderly, and not after the tradition which he received of us.

verses.original: αὐτοὶ γὰρ οἴδατε πῶς δεῖ μιμεῖσθαι ἡμᾶς, ὅτι οὐκ ἠτακτήσαμεν ἐν ὑμῖν
verses.translit: autoi gar oidate pos dei mimeisthai emas, oti ouk etaktisamen en umin
verses.translation: For yourselves know how ye ought to follow us: for we behaved not ourselves disorderly among you;

verses.original: οὐδὲ δωρεὰν ἄρτον ἐφάγομεν παρά τινος, ἀλλʼ ἐν κόπῳ καὶ μόχθῳ ⸂νυκτὸς καὶ ἡμέρας⸃ ἐργαζόμενοι πρὸς τὸ μὴ ἐπιβαρῆσαί τινα ὑμῶν·
verses.translit: oude dorean arton efagomen para tinos, all' en kopo kai mohtho nyktos kai emeras ergazomenoi pros to me epivaresai tina umon*
verses.translation: Neither did we eat any man’s bread for nought; but wrought with labour and travail night and day, that we might not be chargeable to any of you:

verses.original: οὐχ ὅτι οὐκ ἔχομεν ἐξουσίαν, ἀλλʼ ἵνα ἑαυτοὺς τύπον δῶμεν ὑμῖν εἰς τὸ μιμεῖσθαι ἡμᾶς.
verses.translit: ouh oti ouk ehomen exoysian, all' ina eaytous typon domen umin eis to mimeisthai emas.
verses.translation: Not because we have not power, but to make ourselves an ensample unto you to follow us.

verses.original: καὶ γὰρ ὅτε ἦμεν πρὸς ὑμᾶς, τοῦτο παρηγγέλλομεν ὑμῖν, ὅτι εἴ τις οὐ θέλει ἐργάζεσθαι μηδὲ ἐσθιέτω.
verses.translit: kai gar ote emen pros umas, touto pariggellomen umin, oti ei tis ou thelei ergazesthai mide esthieto.
verses.translation: For even when we were with you, this we commanded you, that if any would not work, neither should he eat.

verses.original: ἀκούομεν γάρ τινας περιπατοῦντας ἐν ὑμῖν ἀτάκτως, μηδὲν ἐργαζομένους ἀλλὰ περιεργαζομένους·
verses.translit: akoyomen gar tinas peripatountas en umin ataktos, miden ergazomenoys alla periergazomenoys*
verses.translation: For we hear that there are some which walk among you disorderly, working not at all, but are busybodies.

verses.original: τοῖς δὲ τοιούτοις παραγγέλλομεν καὶ παρακαλοῦμεν ⸂ἐν κυρίῳ Ἰησοῦ Χριστῷ⸃ ἵνα μετὰ ἡσυχίας ἐργαζόμενοι τὸν ἑαυτῶν ἄρτον ἐσθίωσιν.
verses.translit: tois de toioytois paraggellomen kai parakaloumen en kyrio Iisou Hristo ina meta esyhias ergazomenoi ton eayton arton esthiosin.
verses.translation: Now them that are such we command and exhort by our Lord Jesus Christ, that with quietness they work, and eat their own bread.

verses.original: ὑμεῖς δέ, ἀδελφοί, μὴ ⸀ἐγκακήσητε καλοποιοῦντες.
verses.translit: umeis de, adelfoi, me egkakisite kalopoiountes.
verses.translation: But ye, brethren, be not weary in well doing.

verses.original: Εἰ δέ τις οὐχ ὑπακούει τῷ λόγῳ ἡμῶν διὰ τῆς ἐπιστολῆς, τοῦτον σημειοῦσθε, ⸀μὴ ⸀συναναμίγνυσθαι αὐτῷ, ἵνα ἐντραπῇ·
verses.translit: Ei de tis ouh upakoyei to logo emon dia tes epistoles, touton simeiousthe, me synanamignysthai auto, ina entrape*
verses.translation: And if any man obey not our word by this epistle, note that man, and have no company with him, that he may be ashamed.

verses.original: καὶ μὴ ὡς ἐχθρὸν ἡγεῖσθε, ἀλλὰ νουθετεῖτε ὡς ἀδελφόν.
verses.translit: kai me os ehthron egeisthe, alla noytheteite os adelfon.
verses.translation: Yet count him not as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.

verses.original: Αὐτὸς δὲ ὁ κύριος τῆς εἰρήνης δῴη ὑμῖν τὴν εἰρήνην διὰ παντὸς ἐν παντὶ τρόπῳ. ὁ κύριος μετὰ πάντων ὑμῶν.
verses.translit: Autos de o kyrios tes eirinis doi umin ten eirinin dia pantos en panti tropo. o kyrios meta panton umon.
verses.translation: Now the Lord of peace himself give you peace always by all means. The Lord be with you all.

verses.original: Ὁ ἀσπασμὸς τῇ ἐμῇ χειρὶ Παύλου, ὅ ἐστιν σημεῖον ἐν πάσῃ ἐπιστολῇ· οὕτως γράφω.
verses.translit: O aspasmos te eme heiri Payloy, o estin simeion en pase epistole* outos grafo.
verses.translation: The salutation of Paul with mine own hand, which is the token in every epistle: so I write.

verses.original: ἡ χάρις τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ μετὰ πάντων ⸀ὑμῶν.
verses.translit: e haris tou kyrioy emon Iisou Hristou meta panton umon.
verses.translation: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

verses.original: Παῦλος ἀπόστολος ⸂Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ⸃ κατʼ ἐπιταγὴν θεοῦ σωτῆρος ἡμῶν καὶ ⸂Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ⸃ τῆς ἐλπίδος ἡμῶν
verses.translit: Paulos apostolos Hristou Iisou kat' epitagen theou soteros emon kai Hristou Iisou tes elpidos emon
verses.translation: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the commandment of God our Saviour, and Lord Jesus Christ, which is our hope;

verses.original: Τιμοθέῳ γνησίῳ τέκνῳ ἐν πίστει· χάρις, ἔλεος, εἰρήνη ἀπὸ θεοῦ ⸀πατρὸς καὶ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν.
verses.translit: Timotheo gnisio tekno en pistei* haris, eleos, eirini apo theou patros kai Hristou Iisou tou kyrioy emon.
verses.translation: Unto Timothy, my own son in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God our Father and Jesus Christ our Lord.

verses.original: Καθὼς παρεκάλεσά σε προσμεῖναι ἐν Ἐφέσῳ, πορευόμενος εἰς Μακεδονίαν, ἵνα παραγγείλῃς τισὶν μὴ ἑτεροδιδασκαλεῖν
verses.translit: Kathos parekalesa se prosmeinai en Efeso, poreyomenos eis Makedonian, ina paraggeiles tisin me eterodidaskalein
verses.translation: As I besought thee to abide still at Ephesus, when I went into Macedonia, that thou mightest charge some that they teach no other doctrine,

verses.original: μηδὲ προσέχειν μύθοις καὶ γενεαλογίαις ἀπεράντοις, αἵτινες ⸀ἐκζητήσεις παρέχουσι μᾶλλον ἢ οἰκονομίαν θεοῦ τὴν ἐν πίστει—
verses.translit: mide prosehein mythois kai genealogiais aperantois, aitines ekzitiseis parehoysi mallon e oikonomian theou ten en pistei--
verses.translation: Neither give heed to fables and endless genealogies, which minister questions, rather than godly edifying which is in faith: so do .

verses.original: τὸ δὲ τέλος τῆς παραγγελίας ἐστὶν ἀγάπη ἐκ καθαρᾶς καρδίας καὶ συνειδήσεως ἀγαθῆς καὶ πίστεως ἀνυποκρίτου,
verses.translit: to de telos tes paraggelias estin agapi ek katharas kardias kai syneidiseos agathes kai pisteos anypokritoy,
verses.translation: Now the end of the commandment is charity out of a pure heart, and of a good conscience, and of faith unfeigned:

verses.original: ὧν τινες ἀστοχήσαντες ἐξετράπησαν εἰς ματαιολογίαν,
verses.translit: on tines astohisantes exetrapisan eis mataiologian,
verses.translation: From which some having swerved have turned aside unto vain jangling;

verses.original: θέλοντες εἶναι νομοδιδάσκαλοι, μὴ νοοῦντες μήτε ἃ λέγουσιν μήτε περὶ τίνων διαβεβαιοῦνται.
verses.translit: thelontes einai nomodidaskaloi, me noountes mite a legoysin mite peri tinon diavevaiountai.
verses.translation: Desiring to be teachers of the law; understanding neither what they say, nor whereof they affirm.

verses.original: Οἴδαμεν δὲ ὅτι καλὸς ὁ νόμος ἐάν τις αὐτῷ νομίμως χρῆται,
verses.translit: Oidamen de oti kalos o nomos ean tis auto nomimos hretai,
verses.translation: But we know that the law is good, if a man use it lawfully;

verses.original: εἰδὼς τοῦτο, ὅτι δικαίῳ νόμος οὐ κεῖται, ἀνόμοις δὲ καὶ ἀνυποτάκτοις, ἀσεβέσι καὶ ἁμαρτωλοῖς, ἀνοσίοις καὶ βεβήλοις, πατρολῴαις καὶ μητρολῴαις, ἀνδροφόνοις,
verses.translit: eidos touto, oti dikaio nomos ou keitai, anomois de kai anypotaktois, asevesi kai amartolois, anosiois kai vevilois, patroloais kai mitroloais, androfonois,
verses.translation: Knowing this, that the law is not made for a righteous man, but for the lawless and disobedient, for the ungodly and for sinners, for unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,

verses.original: πόρνοις, ἀρσενοκοίταις, ἀνδραποδισταῖς, ψεύσταις, ἐπιόρκοις, καὶ εἴ τι ἕτερον τῇ ὑγιαινούσῃ διδασκαλίᾳ ἀντίκειται,
verses.translit: pornois, arsenokoitais, andrapodistais, pseystais, epiorkois, kai ei ti eteron te ugiainoyse didaskalia antikeitai,
verses.translation: For whoremongers, for them that defile themselves with mankind, for menstealers, for liars, for perjured persons, and if there be any other thing that is contrary to sound doctrine;

verses.original: κατὰ τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τῆς δόξης τοῦ μακαρίου θεοῦ, ὃ ἐπιστεύθην ἐγώ.
verses.translit: kata to euaggelion tes doxis tou makarioy theou, o episteythin ego.
verses.translation: According to the glorious gospel of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.

verses.original: ⸀Χάριν ἔχω τῷ ἐνδυναμώσαντί με Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ τῷ κυρίῳ ἡμῶν, ὅτι πιστόν με ἡγήσατο θέμενος εἰς διακονίαν,
verses.translit: Harin eho to endynamosanti me Hristo Iisou to kyrio emon, oti piston me egisato themenos eis diakonian,
verses.translation: And I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who hath enabled me, for that he counted me faithful, putting me into the ministry;

verses.original: ⸀τὸ πρότερον ὄντα βλάσφημον καὶ διώκτην καὶ ὑβριστήν· ἀλλὰ ἠλεήθην, ὅτι ἀγνοῶν ἐποίησα ἐν ἀπιστίᾳ,
verses.translit: to proteron onta vlasfimon kai dioktin kai uvristin* alla eleithin, oti agnoon epoiisa en apistia,
verses.translation: Who was before a blasphemer, and a persecutor, and injurious: but I obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.

verses.original: ὑπερεπλεόνασεν δὲ ἡ χάρις τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν μετὰ πίστεως καὶ ἀγάπης τῆς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ.
verses.translit: uperepleonasen de e haris tou kyrioy emon meta pisteos kai agapis tes en Hristo Iisou.
verses.translation: And the grace of our Lord was exceeding abundant with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

verses.original: πιστὸς ὁ λόγος καὶ πάσης ἀποδοχῆς ἄξιος, ὅτι Χριστὸς Ἰησοῦς ἦλθεν εἰς τὸν κόσμον ἁμαρτωλοὺς σῶσαι· ὧν πρῶτός εἰμι ἐγώ,
verses.translit: pistos o logos kai pasis apodohes axios, oti Hristos Iisous elthen eis ton kosmon amartolous sosai* on protos eimi ego,
verses.translation: This is a faithful saying, and worthy of all acceptation, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief.

verses.original: ἀλλὰ διὰ τοῦτο ἠλεήθην, ἵνα ἐν ἐμοὶ πρώτῳ ἐνδείξηται ⸂Χριστὸς Ἰησοῦς⸃ τὴν ⸀ἅπασαν μακροθυμίαν, πρὸς ὑποτύπωσιν τῶν μελλόντων πιστεύειν ἐπʼ αὐτῷ εἰς ζωὴν αἰώνιον.
verses.translit: alla dia touto eleithin, ina en emoi proto endeixitai Hristos Iisous ten apasan makrothymian, pros upotyposin ton mellonton pisteyein ep' auto eis zoen aionion.
verses.translation: Howbeit for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first Jesus Christ might shew forth all longsuffering, for a pattern to them which should hereafter believe on him to life everlasting.

verses.original: τῷ δὲ βασιλεῖ τῶν αἰώνων, ἀφθάρτῳ, ἀοράτῳ, ⸀μόνῳ θεῷ, τιμὴ καὶ δόξα εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων· ἀμήν.
verses.translit: to de vasilei ton aionon, aftharto, aorato, mono theo, time kai doxa eis tous aionas ton aionon* amin.
verses.translation: Now unto the King eternal, immortal, invisible, the only wise God, be honour and glory for ever and ever. Amen.

verses.original: Ταύτην τὴν παραγγελίαν παρατίθεμαί σοι, τέκνον Τιμόθεε, κατὰ τὰς προαγούσας ἐπὶ σὲ προφητείας, ἵνα ⸀στρατεύῃ ἐν αὐταῖς τὴν καλὴν στρατείαν,
verses.translit: Taytin ten paraggelian paratithemai soi, teknon Timothee, kata tas proagoysas epi se profiteias, ina strateye en autais ten kalen strateian,
verses.translation: This charge I commit unto thee, son Timothy, according to the prophecies which went before on thee, that thou by them mightest war a good warfare;

verses.original: ἔχων πίστιν καὶ ἀγαθὴν συνείδησιν, ἥν τινες ἀπωσάμενοι περὶ τὴν πίστιν ἐναυάγησαν·
verses.translit: ehon pistin kai agathen syneidisin, en tines aposamenoi peri ten pistin enayagisan*
verses.translation: Holding faith, and a good conscience; which some having put away concerning faith have made shipwreck:

verses.original: ὧν ἐστιν Ὑμέναιος καὶ Ἀλέξανδρος, οὓς παρέδωκα τῷ Σατανᾷ ἵνα παιδευθῶσι μὴ βλασφημεῖν.
verses.translit: on estin Umenaios kai Alexandros, ous paredoka to Satana ina paideythosi me vlasfimein.
verses.translation: Of whom is Hymenaeus and Alexander; whom I have delivered unto Satan, that they may learn not to blaspheme.

verses.original: Παρακαλῶ οὖν πρῶτον πάντων ποιεῖσθαι δεήσεις, προσευχάς, ἐντεύξεις, εὐχαριστίας, ὑπὲρ πάντων ἀνθρώπων,
verses.translit: Parakalo oun proton panton poieisthai deiseis, proseyhas, enteyxeis, euharistias, uper panton anthropon,
verses.translation: I exhort therefore, that, first of all, supplications, prayers, intercessions, and giving of thanks, be made for all men;

verses.original: ὑπὲρ βασιλέων καὶ πάντων τῶν ἐν ὑπεροχῇ ὄντων, ἵνα ἤρεμον καὶ ἡσύχιον βίον διάγωμεν ἐν πάσῃ εὐσεβείᾳ καὶ σεμνότητι.
verses.translit: uper vasileon kai panton ton en uperohe onton, ina eremon kai esyhion vion diagomen en pase euseveia kai semnotiti.
verses.translation: For kings, and for all that are in authority; that we may lead a quiet and peaceable life in all godliness and honesty.

verses.original: ⸀τοῦτο καλὸν καὶ ἀπόδεκτον ἐνώπιον τοῦ σωτῆρος ἡμῶν θεοῦ,
verses.translit: touto kalon kai apodekton enopion tou soteros emon theou,
verses.translation: For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Saviour;

verses.original: ὃς πάντας ἀνθρώπους θέλει σωθῆναι καὶ εἰς ἐπίγνωσιν ἀληθείας ἐλθεῖν.
verses.translit: os pantas anthropoys thelei sothenai kai eis epignosin alitheias elthein.
verses.translation: Who will have all men to be saved, and to come unto the knowledge of the truth.

verses.original: εἷς γὰρ θεός, εἷς καὶ μεσίτης θεοῦ καὶ ἀνθρώπων ἄνθρωπος Χριστὸς Ἰησοῦς,
verses.translit: eis gar theos, eis kai mesitis theou kai anthropon anthropos Hristos Iisous,
verses.translation: For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus;

verses.original: ὁ δοὺς ἑαυτὸν ἀντίλυτρον ὑπὲρ πάντων, τὸ μαρτύριον καιροῖς ἰδίοις·
verses.translit: o dous eayton antilytron uper panton, to martyrion kairois idiois*
verses.translation: Who gave himself a ransom for all, to be testified in due time.

verses.original: εἰς ὃ ἐτέθην ἐγὼ κῆρυξ καὶ ἀπόστολος— ἀλήθειαν ⸀λέγω, οὐ ψεύδομαι— διδάσκαλος ἐθνῶν ἐν πίστει καὶ ἀληθείᾳ.
verses.translit: eis o etethin ego keryx kai apostolos-- alitheian lego, ou pseydomai-- didaskalos ethnon en pistei kai alitheia.
verses.translation: Whereunto I am ordained a preacher, and an apostle, (I speak the truth in Christ, and lie not;) a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and verity.

verses.original: Βούλομαι οὖν προσεύχεσθαι τοὺς ἄνδρας ἐν παντὶ τόπῳ, ἐπαίροντας ὁσίους χεῖρας χωρὶς ὀργῆς καὶ ⸀διαλογισμοῦ.
verses.translit: Voylomai oun proseyhesthai tous andras en panti topo, epairontas osioys heiras horis orges kai dialogismou.
verses.translation: I will therefore that men pray every where, lifting up holy hands, without wrath and doubting.

verses.original: ὡσαύτως ⸀καὶ γυναῖκας ἐν καταστολῇ κοσμίῳ μετὰ αἰδοῦς καὶ σωφροσύνης κοσμεῖν ἑαυτάς, μὴ ἐν πλέγμασιν ⸀καὶ ⸀χρυσίῳ ἢ μαργαρίταις ἢ ἱματισμῷ πολυτελεῖ,
verses.translit: osaytos kai gynaikas en katastole kosmio meta aidous kai sofrosynis kosmein eaytas, me en plegmasin kai hrysio e margaritais e imatismo polytelei,
verses.translation: In like manner also, that women adorn themselves in modest apparel, with shamefacedness and sobriety; not with broided hair, or gold, or pearls, or costly array;

verses.original: ἀλλʼ ὃ πρέπει γυναιξὶν ἐπαγγελλομέναις θεοσέβειαν, διʼ ἔργων ἀγαθῶν.
verses.translit: all' o prepei gynaixin epaggellomenais theoseveian, di' ergon agathon.
verses.translation: But (which becometh women professing godliness) with good works.

verses.original: γυνὴ ἐν ἡσυχίᾳ μανθανέτω ἐν πάσῃ ὑποταγῇ·
verses.translit: gyne en esyhia manthaneto en pase upotage*
verses.translation: Let the woman learn in silence with all subjection.

verses.original: ⸂διδάσκειν δὲ γυναικὶ⸃ οὐκ ἐπιτρέπω, οὐδὲ αὐθεντεῖν ἀνδρός, ἀλλʼ εἶναι ἐν ἡσυχίᾳ.
verses.translit: didaskein de gynaiki ouk epitrepo, oude authentein andros, all' einai en esyhia.
verses.translation: But I suffer not a woman to teach, nor to usurp authority over the man, but to be in silence.

verses.original: Ἀδὰμ γὰρ πρῶτος ἐπλάσθη, εἶτα Εὕα·
verses.translit: Adam gar protos eplasthi, eita Eua*
verses.translation: For Adam was first formed, then Eve.

verses.original: καὶ Ἀδὰμ οὐκ ἠπατήθη, ἡ δὲ γυνὴ ⸀ἐξαπατηθεῖσα ἐν παραβάσει γέγονεν.
verses.translit: kai Adam ouk epatithi, e de gyne exapatitheisa en paravasei gegonen.
verses.translation: And Adam was not deceived, but the woman being deceived was in the transgression.

verses.original: σωθήσεται δὲ διὰ τῆς τεκνογονίας, ἐὰν μείνωσιν ἐν πίστει καὶ ἀγάπῃ καὶ ἁγιασμῷ μετὰ σωφροσύνης.
verses.translit: sothisetai de dia tes teknogonias, ean meinosin en pistei kai agape kai agiasmo meta sofrosynis.
verses.translation: Notwithstanding she shall be saved in childbearing, if they continue in faith and charity and holiness with sobriety.

verses.original: Πιστὸς ὁ λόγος· εἴ τις ἐπισκοπῆς ὀρέγεται, καλοῦ ἔργου ἐπιθυμεῖ.
verses.translit: Pistos o logos* ei tis episkopes oregetai, kalou ergoy epithymei.
verses.translation: This is a true saying, If a man desire the office of a bishop, he desireth a good work.

verses.original: δεῖ οὖν τὸν ἐπίσκοπον ἀνεπίλημπτον εἶναι, μιᾶς γυναικὸς ἄνδρα, νηφάλιον, σώφρονα, κόσμιον, φιλόξενον, διδακτικόν,
verses.translit: dei oun ton episkopon anepilimpton einai, mias gynaikos andra, nifalion, sofrona, kosmion, filoxenon, didaktikon,
verses.translation: A bishop then must be blameless, the husband of one wife, vigilant, sober, of good behaviour, given to hospitality, apt to teach;

verses.original: μὴ πάροινον, μὴ ⸀πλήκτην, ἀλλὰ ἐπιεικῆ, ἄμαχον, ἀφιλάργυρον,
verses.translit: me paroinon, me pliktin, alla epieike, amahon, afilargyron,
verses.translation: Not given to wine, no striker, not greedy of filthy lucre; but patient, not a brawler, not covetous;

verses.original: τοῦ ἰδίου οἴκου καλῶς προϊστάμενον, τέκνα ἔχοντα ἐν ὑποταγῇ μετὰ πάσης σεμνότητος·
verses.translit: tou idioy oikoy kalos proistamenon, tekna ehonta en upotage meta pasis semnotitos*
verses.translation: One that ruleth well his own house, having his children in subjection with all gravity;

verses.original: (εἰ δέ τις τοῦ ἰδίου οἴκου προστῆναι οὐκ οἶδεν, πῶς ἐκκλησίας θεοῦ ἐπιμελήσεται;)
verses.translit: (ei de tis tou idioy oikoy prostenai ouk oiden, pos ekklisias theou epimelisetai;)
verses.translation: (For if a man know not how to rule his own house, how shall he take care of the church of God?)

verses.original: μὴ νεόφυτον, ἵνα μὴ τυφωθεὶς εἰς κρίμα ἐμπέσῃ τοῦ διαβόλου.
verses.translit: me neofyton, ina me tyfotheis eis krima empese tou diavoloy.
verses.translation: Not a novice, lest being lifted up with pride he fall into the condemnation of the devil.

verses.original: δεῖ ⸀δὲ καὶ μαρτυρίαν καλὴν ἔχειν ἀπὸ τῶν ἔξωθεν, ἵνα μὴ εἰς ὀνειδισμὸν ἐμπέσῃ καὶ παγίδα τοῦ διαβόλου.
verses.translit: dei de kai martyrian kalen ehein apo ton exothen, ina me eis oneidismon empese kai pagida tou diavoloy.
verses.translation: Moreover he must have a good report of them which are without; lest he fall into reproach and the snare of the devil.

verses.original: Διακόνους ὡσαύτως σεμνούς, μὴ διλόγους, μὴ οἴνῳ πολλῷ προσέχοντας, μὴ αἰσχροκερδεῖς,
verses.translit: Diakonoys osaytos semnoys, me dilogoys, me oino pollo prosehontas, me aishrokerdeis,
verses.translation: Likewise must the deacons be grave, not doubletongued, not given to much wine, not greedy of filthy lucre;

verses.original: ἔχοντας τὸ μυστήριον τῆς πίστεως ἐν καθαρᾷ συνειδήσει.
verses.translit: ehontas to mystirion tes pisteos en kathara syneidisei.
verses.translation: Holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.

verses.original: καὶ οὗτοι δὲ δοκιμαζέσθωσαν πρῶτον, εἶτα διακονείτωσαν ἀνέγκλητοι ὄντες.
verses.translit: kai outoi de dokimazesthosan proton, eita diakoneitosan anegklitoi ontes.
verses.translation: And let these also first be proved; then let them use the office of a deacon, being found blameless.

verses.original: γυναῖκας ὡσαύτως σεμνάς, μὴ διαβόλους, νηφαλίους, πιστὰς ἐν πᾶσιν.
verses.translit: gynaikas osaytos semnas, me diavoloys, nifalioys, pistas en pasin.
verses.translation: Even so must their wives be grave, not slanderers, sober, faithful in all things.

verses.original: διάκονοι ἔστωσαν μιᾶς γυναικὸς ἄνδρες, τέκνων καλῶς προϊστάμενοι καὶ τῶν ἰδίων οἴκων·
verses.translit: diakonoi estosan mias gynaikos andres, teknon kalos proistamenoi kai ton idion oikon*
verses.translation: Let the deacons be the husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.

verses.original: οἱ γὰρ καλῶς διακονήσαντες βαθμὸν ἑαυτοῖς καλὸν περιποιοῦνται καὶ πολλὴν παρρησίαν ἐν πίστει τῇ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ.
verses.translit: oi gar kalos diakonisantes vathmon eaytois kalon peripoiountai kai pollen parrisian en pistei te en Hristo Iisou.
verses.translation: For they that have used the office of a deacon well purchase to themselves a good degree, and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.

verses.original: Ταῦτά σοι γράφω, ἐλπίζων ἐλθεῖν πρὸς σὲ ⸂ἐν τάχει⸃,
verses.translit: Tauta soi grafo, elpizon elthein pros se en tahei,
verses.translation: These things write I unto thee, hoping to come unto thee shortly:

verses.original: ἐὰν δὲ βραδύνω, ἵνα εἰδῇς πῶς δεῖ ἐν οἴκῳ θεοῦ ἀναστρέφεσθαι, ἥτις ἐστὶν ἐκκλησία θεοῦ ζῶντος, στῦλος καὶ ἑδραίωμα τῆς ἀληθείας·
verses.translit: ean de vradyno, ina eides pos dei en oiko theou anastrefesthai, etis estin ekklisia theou zontos, stulos kai edraioma tes alitheias*
verses.translation: But if I tarry long, that thou mayest know how thou oughtest to behave thyself in the house of God, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.

verses.original: καὶ ὁμολογουμένως μέγα ἐστὶν τὸ τῆς εὐσεβείας μυστήριον· ⸀Ὃς ἐφανερώθη ἐν σαρκί, ἐδικαιώθη ἐν πνεύματι, ὤφθη ἀγγέλοις, ἐκηρύχθη ἐν ἔθνεσιν, ἐπιστεύθη ἐν κόσμῳ, ἀνελήμφθη ἐν δόξῃ.
verses.translit: kai omologoymenos mega estin to tes euseveias mystirion* Os efanerothi en sarki, edikaiothi en pneymati, ofthi aggelois, ekiryhthi en ethnesin, episteythi en kosmo, anelimfthi en doxe.
verses.translation: And without controversy great is the mystery of godliness: God was manifest in the flesh, justified in the Spirit, seen of angels, preached unto the Gentiles, believed on in the world, received up into glory.

verses.original: Τὸ δὲ πνεῦμα ῥητῶς λέγει ὅτι ἐν ὑστέροις καιροῖς ἀποστήσονταί τινες τῆς πίστεως, προσέχοντες πνεύμασι πλάνοις καὶ διδασκαλίαις δαιμονίων
verses.translit: To de pneuma Ritos legei oti en usterois kairois apostisontai tines tes pisteos, prosehontes pneymasi planois kai didaskaliais daimonion
verses.translation: Now the Spirit speaketh expressly, that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits, and doctrines of devils;

verses.original: ἐν ὑποκρίσει ψευδολόγων, κεκαυστηριασμένων τὴν ἰδίαν συνείδησιν,
verses.translit: en upokrisei pseydologon, kekaystiriasmenon ten idian syneidisin,
verses.translation: Speaking lies in hypocrisy; having their conscience seared with a hot iron;

verses.original: κωλυόντων γαμεῖν, ἀπέχεσθαι βρωμάτων ἃ ὁ θεὸς ἔκτισεν εἰς μετάλημψιν μετὰ εὐχαριστίας τοῖς πιστοῖς καὶ ἐπεγνωκόσι τὴν ἀλήθειαν.
verses.translit: kolyonton gamein, apehesthai vromaton a o theos ektisen eis metalimpsin meta euharistias tois pistois kai epegnokosi ten alitheian.
verses.translation: Forbidding to marry, and commanding to abstain from meats, which God hath created to be received with thanksgiving of them which believe and know the truth.

verses.original: ὅτι πᾶν κτίσμα θεοῦ καλόν, καὶ οὐδὲν ἀπόβλητον μετὰ εὐχαριστίας λαμβανόμενον,
verses.translit: oti pan ktisma theou kalon, kai ouden apovliton meta euharistias lamvanomenon,
verses.translation: For every creature of God is good, and nothing to be refused, if it be received with thanksgiving:

verses.original: ἁγιάζεται γὰρ διὰ λόγου θεοῦ καὶ ἐντεύξεως.
verses.translit: agiazetai gar dia logoy theou kai enteyxeos.
verses.translation: For it is sanctified by the word of God and prayer.

verses.original: Ταῦτα ὑποτιθέμενος τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς καλὸς ἔσῃ διάκονος ⸂Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ⸃, ἐντρεφόμενος τοῖς λόγοις τῆς πίστεως καὶ τῆς καλῆς διδασκαλίας ᾗ παρηκολούθηκας,
verses.translit: Tauta upotithemenos tois adelfois kalos ese diakonos Hristou Iisou, entrefomenos tois logois tes pisteos kai tes kales didaskalias e parikoloythikas,
verses.translation: If thou put the brethren in remembrance of these things, thou shalt be a good minister of Jesus Christ, nourished up in the words of faith and of good doctrine, whereunto thou hast attained.

verses.original: τοὺς δὲ βεβήλους καὶ γραώδεις μύθους παραιτοῦ. γύμναζε δὲ σεαυτὸν πρὸς εὐσέβειαν·
verses.translit: tous de veviloys kai graodeis mythoys paraitou. gymnaze de seayton pros euseveian*
verses.translation: But refuse profane and old wives’ fables, and exercise thyself rather unto godliness.

verses.original: ἡ γὰρ σωματικὴ γυμνασία πρὸς ὀλίγον ἐστὶν ὠφέλιμος, ἡ δὲ εὐσέβεια πρὸς πάντα ὠφέλιμός ἐστιν, ἐπαγγελίαν ἔχουσα ζωῆς τῆς νῦν καὶ τῆς μελλούσης.
verses.translit: e gar somatike gymnasia pros oligon estin ofelimos, e de euseveia pros panta ofelimos estin, epaggelian ehoysa zoes tes nun kai tes melloysis.
verses.translation: For bodily exercise profiteth little: but godliness is profitable unto all things, having promise of the life that now is, and of that which is to come.

verses.original: πιστὸς ὁ λόγος καὶ πάσης ἀποδοχῆς ἄξιος,
verses.translit: pistos o logos kai pasis apodohes axios,
verses.translation: This is a faithful saying and worthy of all acceptation.

verses.original: εἰς τοῦτο ⸀γὰρ κοπιῶμεν καὶ ⸀ὀνειδιζόμεθα, ὅτι ἠλπίκαμεν ἐπὶ θεῷ ζῶντι, ὅς ἐστιν σωτὴρ πάντων ἀνθρώπων, μάλιστα πιστῶν.
verses.translit: eis touto gar kopiomen kai oneidizometha, oti elpikamen epi theo zonti, os estin soter panton anthropon, malista piston.
verses.translation: For therefore we both labour and suffer reproach, because we trust in the living God, who is the Saviour of all men, specially of those that believe.

verses.original: Παράγγελλε ταῦτα καὶ δίδασκε.
verses.translit: Paraggelle tauta kai didaske.
verses.translation: These things command and teach.

verses.original: μηδείς σου τῆς νεότητος καταφρονείτω, ἀλλὰ τύπος γίνου τῶν πιστῶν ἐν λόγῳ, ἐν ἀναστροφῇ, ἐν ⸀ἀγάπῃ, ἐν πίστει, ἐν ἁγνείᾳ.
verses.translit: mideis soy tes neotitos katafroneito, alla typos ginoy ton piston en logo, en anastrofe, en agape, en pistei, en agneia.
verses.translation: Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.

verses.original: ἕως ἔρχομαι πρόσεχε τῇ ἀναγνώσει, τῇ παρακλήσει, τῇ διδασκαλίᾳ.
verses.translit: eos erhomai prosehe te anagnosei, te paraklisei, te didaskalia.
verses.translation: Till I come, give attendance to reading, to exhortation, to doctrine.

verses.original: μὴ ἀμέλει τοῦ ἐν σοὶ χαρίσματος, ὃ ἐδόθη σοι διὰ προφητείας μετὰ ἐπιθέσεως τῶν χειρῶν τοῦ πρεσβυτερίου.
verses.translit: me amelei tou en soi harismatos, o edothi soi dia profiteias meta epitheseos ton heiron tou presvyterioy.
verses.translation: Neglect not the gift that is in thee, which was given thee by prophecy, with the laying on of the hands of the presbytery.

verses.original: ταῦτα μελέτα, ἐν τούτοις ἴσθι, ἵνα σου ἡ προκοπὴ φανερὰ ⸀ᾖ πᾶσιν·
verses.translit: tauta meleta, en toytois isthi, ina soy e prokope fanera e pasin*
verses.translation: Meditate upon these things; give thyself wholly to them; that thy profiting may appear to all.

verses.original: ἔπεχε σεαυτῷ καὶ τῇ διδασκαλίᾳ· ἐπίμενε αὐτοῖς· τοῦτο γὰρ ποιῶν καὶ σεαυτὸν σώσεις καὶ τοὺς ἀκούοντάς σου.
verses.translit: epehe seayto kai te didaskalia* epimene autois* touto gar poion kai seayton soseis kai tous akoyontas soy.
verses.translation: Take heed unto thyself, and unto the doctrine; continue in them: for in doing this thou shalt both save thyself, and them that hear thee.

verses.original: Πρεσβυτέρῳ μὴ ἐπιπλήξῃς, ἀλλὰ παρακάλει ὡς πατέρα, νεωτέρους ὡς ἀδελφούς,
verses.translit: Presvytero me epiplixes, alla parakalei os patera, neoteroys os adelfoys,
verses.translation: Rebuke not an elder, but intreat him as a father; and the younger men as brethren;

verses.original: πρεσβυτέρας ὡς μητέρας, νεωτέρας ὡς ἀδελφὰς ἐν πάσῃ ἁγνείᾳ.
verses.translit: presvyteras os miteras, neoteras os adelfas en pase agneia.
verses.translation: The elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, with all purity.

verses.original: Χήρας τίμα τὰς ὄντως χήρας.
verses.translit: Hiras tima tas ontos hiras.
verses.translation: Honour widows that are widows indeed.

verses.original: εἰ δέ τις χήρα τέκνα ἢ ἔκγονα ἔχει, μανθανέτωσαν πρῶτον τὸν ἴδιον οἶκον εὐσεβεῖν καὶ ἀμοιβὰς ἀποδιδόναι τοῖς προγόνοις, τοῦτο γάρ ἐστιν ἀπόδεκτον ἐνώπιον τοῦ θεοῦ.
verses.translit: ei de tis hira tekna e ekgona ehei, manthanetosan proton ton idion oikon eusevein kai amoivas apodidonai tois progonois, touto gar estin apodekton enopion tou theou.
verses.translation: But if any widow have children or nephews, let them learn first to shew piety at home, and to requite their parents: for that is good and acceptable before God.

verses.original: ἡ δὲ ὄντως χήρα καὶ μεμονωμένη ἤλπικεν ἐπὶ ⸀θεὸν καὶ προσμένει ταῖς δεήσεσιν καὶ ταῖς προσευχαῖς νυκτὸς καὶ ἡμέρας·
verses.translit: e de ontos hira kai memonomeni elpiken epi theon kai prosmenei tais deisesin kai tais proseyhais nyktos kai emeras*
verses.translation: Now she that is a widow indeed, and desolate, trusteth in God, and continueth in supplications and prayers night and day.

verses.original: ἡ δὲ σπαταλῶσα ζῶσα τέθνηκεν.
verses.translit: e de spatalosa zosa tethniken.
verses.translation: But she that liveth in pleasure is dead while she liveth.

verses.original: καὶ ταῦτα παράγγελλε, ἵνα ἀνεπίλημπτοι ὦσιν·
verses.translit: kai tauta paraggelle, ina anepilimptoi osin*
verses.translation: And these things give in charge, that they may be blameless.

verses.original: εἰ δέ τις τῶν ἰδίων καὶ ⸀μάλιστα οἰκείων οὐ ⸀προνοεῖ, τὴν πίστιν ἤρνηται καὶ ἔστιν ἀπίστου χείρων.
verses.translit: ei de tis ton idion kai malista oikeion ou pronoei, ten pistin ernitai kai estin apistoy heiron.
verses.translation: But if any provide not for his own, and specially for those of his own house, he hath denied the faith, and is worse than an infidel.

verses.original: Χήρα καταλεγέσθω μὴ ἔλαττον ἐτῶν ἑξήκοντα γεγονυῖα, ἑνὸς ἀνδρὸς γυνή,
verses.translit: Hira katalegestho me elatton eton exikonta gegonyia, enos andros gyni,
verses.translation: Let not a widow be taken into the number under threescore years old, having been the wife of one man,

verses.original: ἐν ἔργοις καλοῖς μαρτυρουμένη, εἰ ἐτεκνοτρόφησεν, εἰ ἐξενοδόχησεν, εἰ ἁγίων πόδας ἔνιψεν, εἰ θλιβομένοις ἐπήρκεσεν, εἰ παντὶ ἔργῳ ἀγαθῷ ἐπηκολούθησεν.
verses.translit: en ergois kalois martyroymeni, ei eteknotrofisen, ei exenodohisen, ei agion podas enipsen, ei thlivomenois epirkesen, ei panti ergo agatho epikoloythisen.
verses.translation: Well reported of for good works; if she have brought up children, if she have lodged strangers, if she have washed the saints’ feet, if she have relieved the afflicted, if she have diligently followed every good work.

verses.original: νεωτέρας δὲ χήρας παραιτοῦ· ὅταν γὰρ καταστρηνιάσωσιν τοῦ Χριστοῦ, γαμεῖν θέλουσιν,
verses.translit: neoteras de hiras paraitou* otan gar katastriniasosin tou Hristou, gamein theloysin,
verses.translation: But the younger widows refuse: for when they have begun to wax wanton against Christ, they will marry;

verses.original: ἔχουσαι κρίμα ὅτι τὴν πρώτην πίστιν ἠθέτησαν·
verses.translit: ehoysai krima oti ten protin pistin ethetisan*
verses.translation: Having damnation, because they have cast off their first faith.

verses.original: ἅμα δὲ καὶ ἀργαὶ μανθάνουσιν, περιερχόμεναι τὰς οἰκίας, οὐ μόνον δὲ ἀργαὶ ἀλλὰ καὶ φλύαροι καὶ περίεργοι, λαλοῦσαι τὰ μὴ δέοντα.
verses.translit: ama de kai argai manthanoysin, perierhomenai tas oikias, ou monon de argai alla kai flyaroi kai periergoi, lalousai ta me deonta.
verses.translation: And withal they learn to be idle, wandering about from house to house; and not only idle, but tattlers also and busybodies, speaking things which they ought not.

verses.original: βούλομαι οὖν νεωτέρας γαμεῖν, τεκνογονεῖν, οἰκοδεσποτεῖν, μηδεμίαν ἀφορμὴν διδόναι τῷ ἀντικειμένῳ λοιδορίας χάριν·
verses.translit: voylomai oun neoteras gamein, teknogonein, oikodespotein, midemian aformen didonai to antikeimeno loidorias harin*
verses.translation: I will therefore that the younger women marry, bear children, guide the house, give none occasion to the adversary to speak reproachfully.

verses.original: ἤδη γάρ τινες ἐξετράπησαν ὀπίσω τοῦ Σατανᾶ.
verses.translit: edi gar tines exetrapisan opiso tou Satana.
verses.translation: For some are already turned aside after Satan.

verses.original: εἴ ⸀τις πιστὴ ἔχει χήρας, ⸀ἐπαρκείτω αὐταῖς, καὶ μὴ βαρείσθω ἡ ἐκκλησία, ἵνα ταῖς ὄντως χήραις ἐπαρκέσῃ.
verses.translit: ei tis piste ehei hiras, eparkeito autais, kai me vareistho e ekklisia, ina tais ontos hirais eparkese.
verses.translation: If any man or woman that believeth have widows, let them relieve them, and let not the church be charged; that it may relieve them that are widows indeed.

verses.original: Οἱ καλῶς προεστῶτες πρεσβύτεροι διπλῆς τιμῆς ἀξιούσθωσαν, μάλιστα οἱ κοπιῶντες ἐν λόγῳ καὶ διδασκαλίᾳ·
verses.translit: Oi kalos proestotes presvyteroi diples times axioysthosan, malista oi kopiontes en logo kai didaskalia*
verses.translation: Let the elders that rule well be counted worthy of double honour, especially they who labour in the word and doctrine.

verses.original: λέγει γὰρ ἡ γραφή· Βοῦν ἀλοῶντα οὐ φιμώσεις, καί· Ἄξιος ὁ ἐργάτης τοῦ μισθοῦ αὐτοῦ.
verses.translit: legei gar e grafi* Voun aloonta ou fimoseis, kai* Axios o ergatis tou misthou autou.
verses.translation: For the scripture saith, Thou shalt not muzzle the ox that treadeth out the corn. And, The labourer is worthy of his reward.

verses.original: κατὰ πρεσβυτέρου κατηγορίαν μὴ παραδέχου, ἐκτὸς εἰ μὴ ἐπὶ δύο ἢ τριῶν μαρτύρων·
verses.translit: kata presvyteroy katigorian me paradehoy, ektos ei me epi dyo e trion martyron*
verses.translation: Against an elder receive not an accusation, but before two or three witnesses.

verses.original: ⸀τοὺς ἁμαρτάνοντας ἐνώπιον πάντων ἔλεγχε, ἵνα καὶ οἱ λοιποὶ φόβον ἔχωσιν.
verses.translit: tous amartanontas enopion panton eleghe, ina kai oi loipoi fovon ehosin.
verses.translation: Them that sin rebuke before all, that others also may fear.

verses.original: διαμαρτύρομαι ἐνώπιον τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ ⸂Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ⸃ καὶ τῶν ἐκλεκτῶν ἀγγέλων, ἵνα ταῦτα φυλάξῃς χωρὶς προκρίματος, μηδὲν ποιῶν κατὰ πρόσκλισιν.
verses.translit: diamartyromai enopion tou theou kai Hristou Iisou kai ton eklekton aggelon, ina tauta fylaxes horis prokrimatos, miden poion kata prosklisin.
verses.translation: I charge thee before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the elect angels, that thou observe these things without preferring one before another, doing nothing by partiality.

verses.original: χεῖρας ταχέως μηδενὶ ἐπιτίθει, μηδὲ κοινώνει ἁμαρτίαις ἀλλοτρίαις· σεαυτὸν ἁγνὸν τήρει.
verses.translit: heiras taheos mideni epitithei, mide koinonei amartiais allotriais* seayton agnon tirei.
verses.translation: Lay hands suddenly on no man, neither be partaker of other men’s sins: keep thyself pure.

verses.original: μηκέτι ὑδροπότει, ἀλλὰ οἴνῳ ὀλίγῳ χρῶ διὰ τὸν ⸀στόμαχον καὶ τὰς πυκνάς σου ἀσθενείας.
verses.translit: miketi udropotei, alla oino oligo hro dia ton stomahon kai tas pyknas soy astheneias.
verses.translation: Drink no longer water, but use a little wine for thy stomach’s sake and thine often infirmities.

verses.original: Τινῶν ἀνθρώπων αἱ ἁμαρτίαι πρόδηλοί εἰσιν, προάγουσαι εἰς κρίσιν, τισὶν δὲ καὶ ἐπακολουθοῦσιν·
verses.translit: Tinon anthropon ai amartiai prodiloi eisin, proagoysai eis krisin, tisin de kai epakoloythousin*
verses.translation: Some men’s sins are open beforehand, going before to judgment; and some men they follow after.

verses.original: ὡσαύτως καὶ τὰ ⸂ἔργα τὰ καλὰ⸃ ⸀πρόδηλα, καὶ τὰ ἄλλως ἔχοντα κρυβῆναι οὐ δύνανται.
verses.translit: osaytos kai ta erga ta kala prodila, kai ta allos ehonta kryvenai ou dynantai.
verses.translation: Likewise also the good works of some are manifest beforehand; and they that are otherwise cannot be hid.

verses.original: Ὅσοι εἰσὶν ὑπὸ ζυγὸν δοῦλοι, τοὺς ἰδίους δεσπότας πάσης τιμῆς ἀξίους ἡγείσθωσαν, ἵνα μὴ τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ ἡ διδασκαλία βλασφημῆται.
verses.translit: Osoi eisin upo zygon douloi, tous idioys despotas pasis times axioys egeisthosan, ina me to onoma tou theou kai e didaskalia vlasfimetai.
verses.translation: Let as many servants as are under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honour, that the name of God and his doctrine be not blasphemed.

verses.original: οἱ δὲ πιστοὺς ἔχοντες δεσπότας μὴ καταφρονείτωσαν, ὅτι ἀδελφοί εἰσιν· ἀλλὰ μᾶλλον δουλευέτωσαν, ὅτι πιστοί εἰσιν καὶ ἀγαπητοὶ οἱ τῆς εὐεργεσίας ἀντιλαμβανόμενοι. Ταῦτα δίδασκε καὶ παρακάλει.
verses.translit: oi de pistous ehontes despotas me katafroneitosan, oti adelfoi eisin* alla mallon doyleyetosan, oti pistoi eisin kai agapitoi oi tes euergesias antilamvanomenoi. Tauta didaske kai parakalei.
verses.translation: And they that have believing masters, let them not despise them , because they are brethren; but rather do them service, because they are faithful and beloved, partakers of the benefit. These things teach and exhort.

verses.original: εἴ τις ἑτεροδιδασκαλεῖ καὶ μὴ προσέρχεται ὑγιαίνουσι λόγοις, τοῖς τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, καὶ τῇ κατʼ εὐσέβειαν διδασκαλίᾳ,
verses.translit: ei tis eterodidaskalei kai me proserhetai ugiainoysi logois, tois tou kyrioy emon Iisou Hristou, kai te kat' euseveian didaskalia,
verses.translation: If any man teach otherwise, and consent not to wholesome words, even the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the doctrine which is according to godliness;

verses.original: τετύφωται, μηδὲν ἐπιστάμενος, ἀλλὰ νοσῶν περὶ ζητήσεις καὶ λογομαχίας, ἐξ ὧν γίνεται φθόνος, ἔρις, βλασφημίαι, ὑπόνοιαι πονηραί,
verses.translit: tetyfotai, miden epistamenos, alla noson peri zitiseis kai logomahias, ex on ginetai fthonos, eris, vlasfimiai, uponoiai ponirai,
verses.translation: He is proud, knowing nothing, but doting about questions and strifes of words, whereof cometh envy, strife, railings, evil surmisings,

verses.original: διαπαρατριβαὶ διεφθαρμένων ἀνθρώπων τὸν νοῦν καὶ ἀπεστερημένων τῆς ἀληθείας, νομιζόντων πορισμὸν εἶναι τὴν ⸀εὐσέβειαν.
verses.translit: diaparatrivai dieftharmenon anthropon ton noun kai apesterimenon tes alitheias, nomizonton porismon einai ten euseveian.
verses.translation: Perverse disputings of men of corrupt minds, and destitute of the truth, supposing that gain is godliness: from such withdraw thyself.

verses.original: ἔστιν δὲ πορισμὸς μέγας ἡ εὐσέβεια μετὰ αὐταρκείας·
verses.translit: estin de porismos megas e euseveia meta autarkeias*
verses.translation: But godliness with contentment is great gain.

verses.original: οὐδὲν γὰρ εἰσηνέγκαμεν εἰς τὸν κόσμον, ⸀ὅτι οὐδὲ ἐξενεγκεῖν τι δυνάμεθα·
verses.translit: ouden gar eisinegkamen eis ton kosmon, oti oude exenegkein ti dynametha*
verses.translation: For we brought nothing into this world, and it is certain we can carry nothing out.

verses.original: ἔχοντες δὲ διατροφὰς καὶ σκεπάσματα, τούτοις ἀρκεσθησόμεθα.
verses.translit: ehontes de diatrofas kai skepasmata, toytois arkesthisometha.
verses.translation: And having food and raiment let us be therewith content.

verses.original: οἱ δὲ βουλόμενοι πλουτεῖν ἐμπίπτουσιν εἰς πειρασμὸν καὶ παγίδα καὶ ἐπιθυμίας πολλὰς ἀνοήτους καὶ βλαβεράς, αἵτινες βυθίζουσι τοὺς ἀνθρώπους εἰς ὄλεθρον καὶ ἀπώλειαν·
verses.translit: oi de voylomenoi ploytein empiptoysin eis peirasmon kai pagida kai epithymias pollas anoitoys kai vlaveras, aitines vythizoysi tous anthropoys eis olethron kai apoleian*
verses.translation: But they that will be rich fall into temptation and a snare, and into many foolish and hurtful lusts, which drown men in destruction and perdition.

verses.original: ῥίζα γὰρ πάντων τῶν κακῶν ἐστιν ἡ φιλαργυρία, ἧς τινες ὀρεγόμενοι ἀπεπλανήθησαν ἀπὸ τῆς πίστεως καὶ ἑαυτοὺς περιέπειραν ὀδύναις πολλαῖς.
verses.translit: Riza gar panton ton kakon estin e filargyria, es tines oregomenoi apeplanithisan apo tes pisteos kai eaytous periepeiran odynais pollais.
verses.translation: For the love of money is the root of all evil: which while some coveted after, they have erred from the faith, and pierced themselves through with many sorrows.

verses.original: Σὺ δέ, ὦ ἄνθρωπε ⸀θεοῦ, ταῦτα φεῦγε· δίωκε δὲ δικαιοσύνην, εὐσέβειαν, πίστιν, ἀγάπην, ὑπομονήν, ⸀πραϋπαθίαν.
verses.translit: Su de, o anthrope theou, tauta feuge* dioke de dikaiosynin, euseveian, pistin, agapin, upomonin, praypathian.
verses.translation: But thou, O man of God, flee these things; and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, patience, meekness.

verses.original: ἀγωνίζου τὸν καλὸν ἀγῶνα τῆς πίστεως, ἐπιλαβοῦ τῆς αἰωνίου ζωῆς, εἰς ἣν ἐκλήθης καὶ ὡμολόγησας τὴν καλὴν ὁμολογίαν ἐνώπιον πολλῶν μαρτύρων.
verses.translit: agonizoy ton kalon agona tes pisteos, epilavou tes aionioy zoes, eis en eklithis kai omologisas ten kalen omologian enopion pollon martyron.
verses.translation: Fight the good fight of faith, lay hold on eternal life, whereunto thou art also called, and hast professed a good profession before many witnesses.

verses.original: παραγγέλλω σοι ἐνώπιον τοῦ θεοῦ τοῦ ⸀ζῳογονοῦντος τὰ πάντα καὶ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ τοῦ μαρτυρήσαντος ἐπὶ Ποντίου Πιλάτου τὴν καλὴν ὁμολογίαν,
verses.translit: paraggello soi enopion tou theou tou zoogonountos ta panta kai Hristou Iisou tou martyrisantos epi Pontioy Pilatoy ten kalen omologian,
verses.translation: I give thee charge in the sight of God, who quickeneth all things, and before Christ Jesus, who before Pontius Pilate witnessed a good confession;

verses.original: τηρῆσαί σε τὴν ἐντολὴν ἄσπιλον ἀνεπίλημπτον μέχρι τῆς ἐπιφανείας τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ,
verses.translit: tiresai se ten entolen aspilon anepilimpton mehri tes epifaneias tou kyrioy emon Iisou Hristou,
verses.translation: That thou keep this commandment without spot, unrebukeable, until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ:

verses.original: ἣν καιροῖς ἰδίοις δείξει ὁ μακάριος καὶ μόνος δυνάστης, ὁ βασιλεὺς τῶν βασιλευόντων καὶ κύριος τῶν κυριευόντων,
verses.translit: en kairois idiois deixei o makarios kai monos dynastis, o vasileus ton vasileyonton kai kyrios ton kyrieyonton,
verses.translation: Which in his times he shall shew, who is the blessed and only Potentate, the King of kings, and Lord of lords;

verses.original: ὁ μόνος ἔχων ἀθανασίαν, φῶς οἰκῶν ἀπρόσιτον, ὃν εἶδεν οὐδεὶς ἀνθρώπων οὐδὲ ἰδεῖν δύναται· ᾧ τιμὴ καὶ κράτος αἰώνιον· ἀμήν.
verses.translit: o monos ehon athanasian, fos oikon aprositon, on eiden oudeis anthropon oude idein dynatai* o time kai kratos aionion* amin.
verses.translation: Who only hath immortality, dwelling in the light which no man can approach unto; whom no man hath seen, nor can see: to whom be honour and power everlasting. Amen.

verses.original: Τοῖς πλουσίοις ἐν τῷ νῦν αἰῶνι παράγγελλε μὴ ὑψηλοφρονεῖν μηδὲ ἠλπικέναι ἐπὶ πλούτου ἀδηλότητι, ἀλλʼ ⸀ἐπὶ ⸀θεῷ τῷ παρέχοντι ἡμῖν πάντα πλουσίως εἰς ἀπόλαυσιν,
verses.translit: Tois ploysiois en to nun aioni paraggelle me upsilofronein mide elpikenai epi ploytoy adilotiti, all' epi theo to parehonti emin panta ploysios eis apolaysin,
verses.translation: Charge them that are rich in this world, that they be not highminded, nor trust in uncertain riches, but in the living God, who giveth us richly all things to enjoy;

verses.original: ἀγαθοεργεῖν, πλουτεῖν ἐν ἔργοις καλοῖς, εὐμεταδότους εἶναι, κοινωνικούς,
verses.translit: agathoergein, ploytein en ergois kalois, eumetadotoys einai, koinonikoys,
verses.translation: That they do good, that they be rich in good works, ready to distribute, willing to communicate;

verses.original: ἀποθησαυρίζοντας ἑαυτοῖς θεμέλιον καλὸν εἰς τὸ μέλλον, ἵνα ἐπιλάβωνται τῆς ⸀ὄντως ζωῆς.
verses.translit: apothisayrizontas eaytois themelion kalon eis to mellon, ina epilavontai tes ontos zoes.
verses.translation: Laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold on eternal life.

verses.original: Ὦ Τιμόθεε, τὴν παραθήκην φύλαξον, ἐκτρεπόμενος τὰς βεβήλους κενοφωνίας καὶ ἀντιθέσεις τῆς ψευδωνύμου γνώσεως,
verses.translit: O Timothee, ten parathikin fylaxon, ektrepomenos tas veviloys kenofonias kai antitheseis tes pseydonymoy gnoseos,
verses.translation: O Timothy, keep that which is committed to thy trust, avoiding profane and vain babblings, and oppositions of science falsely so called:

verses.original: ἥν τινες ἐπαγγελλόμενοι περὶ τὴν πίστιν ἠστόχησαν. Ἡ χάρις ⸂μεθʼ ὑμῶν⸃.
