verses.translit: en tines epaggellomenoi peri ten pistin estohisan. E haris meth' umon.
verses.translation: Which some professing have erred concerning the faith. Grace be with thee. Amen.

verses.original: Παῦλος ἀπόστολος ⸂Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ⸃ διὰ θελήματος θεοῦ κατʼ ἐπαγγελίαν ζωῆς τῆς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ
verses.translit: Paulos apostolos Hristou Iisou dia thelimatos theou kat' epaggelian zoes tes en Hristo Iisou
verses.translation: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, according to the promise of life which is in Christ Jesus,

verses.original: Τιμοθέῳ ἀγαπητῷ τέκνῳ· χάρις, ἔλεος, εἰρήνη ἀπὸ θεοῦ πατρὸς καὶ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν.
verses.translit: Timotheo agapito tekno* haris, eleos, eirini apo theou patros kai Hristou Iisou tou kyrioy emon.
verses.translation: To Timothy, my dearly beloved son: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

verses.original: Χάριν ἔχω τῷ θεῷ, ᾧ λατρεύω ἀπὸ προγόνων ἐν καθαρᾷ συνειδήσει, ὡς ἀδιάλειπτον ἔχω τὴν περὶ σοῦ μνείαν ἐν ταῖς δεήσεσίν μου, νυκτὸς καὶ ἡμέρας
verses.translit: Harin eho to theo, o latreyo apo progonon en kathara syneidisei, os adialeipton eho ten peri sou mneian en tais deisesin moy, nyktos kai emeras
verses.translation: I thank God, whom I serve from my forefathers with pure conscience, that without ceasing I have remembrance of thee in my prayers night and day;

verses.original: ἐπιποθῶν σε ἰδεῖν, μεμνημένος σου τῶν δακρύων, ἵνα χαρᾶς πληρωθῶ
verses.translit: epipothon se idein, memnimenos soy ton dakryon, ina haras plirotho
verses.translation: Greatly desiring to see thee, being mindful of thy tears, that I may be filled with joy;

verses.original: ὑπόμνησιν ⸀λαβὼν τῆς ἐν σοὶ ἀνυποκρίτου πίστεως, ἥτις ἐνῴκησεν πρῶτον ἐν τῇ μάμμῃ σου Λωΐδι καὶ τῇ μητρί σου Εὐνίκῃ, πέπεισμαι δὲ ὅτι καὶ ἐν σοί.
verses.translit: upomnisin lavon tes en soi anypokritoy pisteos, etis enokisen proton en te mamme soy LoIdi kai te mitri soy Eunike, pepeismai de oti kai en soi.
verses.translation: When I call to remembrance the unfeigned faith that is in thee, which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois, and thy mother Eunice; and I am persuaded that in thee also.

verses.original: διʼ ἣν αἰτίαν ἀναμιμνῄσκω σε ἀναζωπυρεῖν τὸ χάρισμα τοῦ θεοῦ, ὅ ἐστιν ἐν σοὶ διὰ τῆς ἐπιθέσεως τῶν χειρῶν μου·
verses.translit: di' en aitian anamimnesko se anazopyrein to harisma tou theou, o estin en soi dia tes epitheseos ton heiron moy*
verses.translation: Wherefore I put thee in remembrance that thou stir up the gift of God, which is in thee by the putting on of my hands.

verses.original: οὐ γὰρ ἔδωκεν ἡμῖν ὁ θεὸς πνεῦμα δειλίας, ἀλλὰ δυνάμεως καὶ ἀγάπης καὶ σωφρονισμοῦ.
verses.translit: ou gar edoken emin o theos pneuma deilias, alla dynameos kai agapis kai sofronismou.
verses.translation: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.

verses.original: Μὴ οὖν ἐπαισχυνθῇς τὸ μαρτύριον τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν μηδὲ ἐμὲ τὸν δέσμιον αὐτοῦ, ἀλλὰ συγκακοπάθησον τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ κατὰ δύναμιν θεοῦ,
verses.translit: Me oun epaishynthes to martyrion tou kyrioy emon mide eme ton desmion autou, alla sygkakopathison to euaggelio kata dynamin theou,
verses.translation: Be not thou therefore ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner: but be thou partaker of the afflictions of the gospel according to the power of God;

verses.original: τοῦ σώσαντος ἡμᾶς καὶ καλέσαντος κλήσει ἁγίᾳ, οὐ κατὰ τὰ ἔργα ἡμῶν ἀλλὰ κατὰ ἰδίαν πρόθεσιν καὶ χάριν, τὴν δοθεῖσαν ἡμῖν ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ πρὸ χρόνων αἰωνίων,
verses.translit: tou sosantos emas kai kalesantos klisei agia, ou kata ta erga emon alla kata idian prothesin kai harin, ten dotheisan emin en Hristo Iisou pro hronon aionion,
verses.translation: Who hath saved us, and called us with an holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given us in Christ Jesus before the world began,

verses.original: φανερωθεῖσαν δὲ νῦν διὰ τῆς ἐπιφανείας τοῦ σωτῆρος ἡμῶν ⸂Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ⸃, καταργήσαντος μὲν τὸν θάνατον φωτίσαντος δὲ ζωὴν καὶ ἀφθαρσίαν διὰ τοῦ εὐαγγελίου,
verses.translit: fanerotheisan de nun dia tes epifaneias tou soteros emon Iisou Hristou, katargisantos men ton thanaton fotisantos de zoen kai aftharsian dia tou euaggelioy,
verses.translation: But is now made manifest by the appearing of our Saviour Jesus Christ, who hath abolished death, and hath brought life and immortality to light through the gospel:

verses.original: εἰς ὃ ἐτέθην ἐγὼ κῆρυξ καὶ ἀπόστολος καὶ ⸀διδάσκαλος.
verses.translit: eis o etethin ego keryx kai apostolos kai didaskalos.
verses.translation: Whereunto I am appointed a preacher, and an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.

verses.original: διʼ ἣν αἰτίαν καὶ ταῦτα πάσχω, ἀλλʼ οὐκ ἐπαισχύνομαι, οἶδα γὰρ ᾧ πεπίστευκα, καὶ πέπεισμαι ὅτι δυνατός ἐστιν τὴν παραθήκην μου φυλάξαι εἰς ἐκείνην τὴν ἡμέραν.
verses.translit: di' en aitian kai tauta pasho, all' ouk epaishynomai, oida gar o pepisteyka, kai pepeismai oti dynatos estin ten parathikin moy fylaxai eis ekeinin ten emeran.
verses.translation: For the which cause I also suffer these things: nevertheless I am not ashamed: for I know whom I have believed, and am persuaded that he is able to keep that which I have committed unto him against that day.

verses.original: ὑποτύπωσιν ἔχε ὑγιαινόντων λόγων ὧν παρʼ ἐμοῦ ἤκουσας ἐν πίστει καὶ ἀγάπῃ τῇ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ·
verses.translit: upotyposin ehe ugiainonton logon on par' emou ekoysas en pistei kai agape te en Hristo Iisou*
verses.translation: Hold fast the form of sound words, which thou hast heard of me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

verses.original: τὴν καλὴν παραθήκην φύλαξον διὰ πνεύματος ἁγίου τοῦ ἐνοικοῦντος ἐν ἡμῖν.
verses.translit: ten kalen parathikin fylaxon dia pneymatos agioy tou enoikountos en emin.
verses.translation: That good thing which was committed unto thee keep by the Holy Ghost which dwelleth in us.

verses.original: Οἶδας τοῦτο ὅτι ἀπεστράφησάν με πάντες οἱ ἐν τῇ Ἀσίᾳ, ὧν ἐστιν Φύγελος καὶ Ἑρμογένης.
verses.translit: Oidas touto oti apestrafisan me pantes oi en te Asia, on estin Fygelos kai Ermogenis.
verses.translation: This thou knowest, that all they which are in Asia be turned away from me; of whom are Phygellus and Hermogenes.

verses.original: δῴη ἔλεος ὁ κύριος τῷ Ὀνησιφόρου οἴκῳ, ὅτι πολλάκις με ἀνέψυξεν, καὶ τὴν ἅλυσίν μου οὐκ ἐπαισχύνθη·
verses.translit: doi eleos o kyrios to Onisiforoy oiko, oti pollakis me anepsyxen, kai ten alysin moy ouk epaishynthi*
verses.translation: The Lord give mercy unto the house of Onesiphorus; for he oft refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain:

verses.original: ἀλλὰ γενόμενος ἐν Ῥώμῃ ⸀σπουδαίως ἐζήτησέν με καὶ εὗρεν—
verses.translit: alla genomenos en Rome spoydaios ezitisen me kai euren--
verses.translation: But, when he was in Rome, he sought me out very diligently, and found me .

verses.original: δῴη αὐτῷ ὁ κύριος εὑρεῖν ἔλεος παρὰ κυρίου ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ— καὶ ὅσα ἐν Ἐφέσῳ διηκόνησεν, βέλτιον σὺ γινώσκεις.
verses.translit: doi auto o kyrios eurein eleos para kyrioy en ekeine te emera-- kai osa en Efeso diikonisen, veltion su ginoskeis.
verses.translation: The Lord grant unto him that he may find mercy of the Lord in that day: and in how many things he ministered unto me at Ephesus, thou knowest very well.

verses.original: Σὺ οὖν, τέκνον μου, ἐνδυναμοῦ ἐν τῇ χάριτι τῇ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ,
verses.translit: Su oun, teknon moy, endynamou en te hariti te en Hristo Iisou,
verses.translation: Thou therefore, my son, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.

verses.original: καὶ ἃ ἤκουσας παρʼ ἐμοῦ διὰ πολλῶν μαρτύρων, ταῦτα παράθου πιστοῖς ἀνθρώποις, οἵτινες ἱκανοὶ ἔσονται καὶ ἑτέρους διδάξαι.
verses.translit: kai a ekoysas par' emou dia pollon martyron, tauta parathoy pistois anthropois, oitines ikanoi esontai kai eteroys didaxai.
verses.translation: And the things that thou hast heard of me among many witnesses, the same commit thou to faithful men, who shall be able to teach others also.

verses.original: ⸀συγκακοπάθησον ὡς καλὸς στρατιώτης ⸂Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ⸃.
verses.translit: sygkakopathison os kalos stratiotis Hristou Iisou.
verses.translation: Thou therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ.

verses.original: οὐδεὶς στρατευόμενος ἐμπλέκεται ταῖς τοῦ βίου πραγματείαις, ἵνα τῷ στρατολογήσαντι ἀρέσῃ·
verses.translit: oudeis strateyomenos empleketai tais tou vioy pragmateiais, ina to stratologisanti arese*
verses.translation: No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of this life; that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier.

verses.original: ἐὰν δὲ καὶ ἀθλῇ τις, οὐ στεφανοῦται ἐὰν μὴ νομίμως ἀθλήσῃ·
verses.translit: ean de kai athle tis, ou stefanoutai ean me nomimos athlise*
verses.translation: And if a man also strive for masteries, yet is he not crowned, except he strive lawfully.

verses.original: τὸν κοπιῶντα γεωργὸν δεῖ πρῶτον τῶν καρπῶν μεταλαμβάνειν.
verses.translit: ton kopionta georgon dei proton ton karpon metalamvanein.
verses.translation: The husbandman that laboureth must be first partaker of the fruits.

verses.original: νόει ⸀ὃ λέγω· ⸀δώσει γάρ σοι ὁ κύριος σύνεσιν ἐν πᾶσιν.
verses.translit: noei o lego* dosei gar soi o kyrios synesin en pasin.
verses.translation: Consider what I say; and the Lord give thee understanding in all things.

verses.original: Μνημόνευε Ἰησοῦν Χριστὸν ἐγηγερμένον ἐκ νεκρῶν, ἐκ σπέρματος Δαυίδ, κατὰ τὸ εὐαγγέλιόν μου·
verses.translit: Mnimoneye Iisoun Hriston egigermenon ek nekron, ek spermatos Dayid, kata to euaggelion moy*
verses.translation: Remember that Jesus Christ of the seed of David was raised from the dead according to my gospel:

verses.original: ἐν ᾧ κακοπαθῶ μέχρι δεσμῶν ὡς κακοῦργος. ἀλλὰ ὁ λόγος τοῦ θεοῦ οὐ δέδεται·
verses.translit: en o kakopatho mehri desmon os kakourgos. alla o logos tou theou ou dedetai*
verses.translation: Wherein I suffer trouble, as an evil doer, even unto bonds; but the word of God is not bound.

verses.original: διὰ τοῦτο πάντα ὑπομένω διὰ τοὺς ἐκλεκτούς, ἵνα καὶ αὐτοὶ σωτηρίας τύχωσιν τῆς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ μετὰ δόξης αἰωνίου.
verses.translit: dia touto panta upomeno dia tous eklektoys, ina kai autoi sotirias tyhosin tes en Hristo Iisou meta doxis aionioy.
verses.translation: Therefore I endure all things for the elect’s sakes, that they may also obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.

verses.original: πιστὸς ὁ λόγος· εἰ γὰρ συναπεθάνομεν, καὶ συζήσομεν·
verses.translit: pistos o logos* ei gar synapethanomen, kai syzisomen*
verses.translation: It is a faithful saying: For if we be dead with him , we shall also live with him :

verses.original: εἰ ὑπομένομεν, καὶ συμβασιλεύσομεν· εἰ ⸀ἀρνησόμεθα, κἀκεῖνος ἀρνήσεται ἡμᾶς·
verses.translit: ei upomenomen, kai symvasileysomen* ei arnisometha, kakeinos arnisetai emas*
verses.translation: If we suffer, we shall also reign with him : if we deny him , he also will deny us:

verses.original: εἰ ἀπιστοῦμεν, ἐκεῖνος πιστὸς μένει· ⸀ἀρνήσασθαι ἑαυτὸν οὐ δύναται.
verses.translit: ei apistoumen, ekeinos pistos menei* arnisasthai eayton ou dynatai.
verses.translation: If we believe not, yet he abideth faithful: he cannot deny himself.

verses.original: Ταῦτα ὑπομίμνῃσκε, διαμαρτυρόμενος ἐνώπιον τοῦ ⸀κυρίου, μὴ λογομαχεῖν, ⸀ἐπʼ οὐδὲν χρήσιμον, ἐπὶ καταστροφῇ τῶν ἀκουόντων.
verses.translit: Tauta upomimneske, diamartyromenos enopion tou kyrioy, me logomahein, ep' ouden hrisimon, epi katastrofe ton akoyonton.
verses.translation: Of these things put them in remembrance, charging them before the Lord that they strive not about words to no profit, but to the subverting of the hearers.

verses.original: σπούδασον σεαυτὸν δόκιμον παραστῆσαι τῷ θεῷ, ἐργάτην ἀνεπαίσχυντον, ὀρθοτομοῦντα τὸν λόγον τῆς ἀληθείας.
verses.translit: spoydason seayton dokimon parastesai to theo, ergatin anepaishynton, orthotomounta ton logon tes alitheias.
verses.translation: Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.

verses.original: τὰς δὲ βεβήλους κενοφωνίας περιΐστασο· ἐπὶ πλεῖον γὰρ προκόψουσιν ἀσεβείας,
verses.translit: tas de veviloys kenofonias periIstaso* epi pleion gar prokopsoysin aseveias,
verses.translation: But shun profane and vain babblings: for they will increase unto more ungodliness.

verses.original: καὶ ὁ λόγος αὐτῶν ὡς γάγγραινα νομὴν ἕξει· ὧν ἐστιν Ὑμέναιος καὶ Φίλητος,
verses.translit: kai o logos auton os gaggraina nomen exei* on estin Umenaios kai Filitos,
verses.translation: And their word will eat as doth a canker: of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus;

verses.original: οἵτινες περὶ τὴν ἀλήθειαν ἠστόχησαν, ⸀λέγοντες ἀνάστασιν ἤδη γεγονέναι, καὶ ἀνατρέπουσιν τήν τινων πίστιν.
verses.translit: oitines peri ten alitheian estohisan, legontes anastasin edi gegonenai, kai anatrepoysin tin tinon pistin.
verses.translation: Who concerning the truth have erred, saying that the resurrection is past already; and overthrow the faith of some.

verses.original: ὁ μέντοι στερεὸς θεμέλιος τοῦ θεοῦ ἕστηκεν, ἔχων τὴν σφραγῖδα ταύτην· Ἔγνω κύριος τοὺς ὄντας αὐτοῦ, καί· Ἀποστήτω ἀπὸ ἀδικίας πᾶς ὁ ὀνομάζων τὸ ὄνομα κυρίου.
verses.translit: o mentoi stereos themelios tou theou estiken, ehon ten sfragida taytin* Egno kyrios tous ontas autou, kai* Apostito apo adikias pas o onomazon to onoma kyrioy.
verses.translation: Nevertheless the foundation of God standeth sure, having this seal, The Lord knoweth them that are his. And, Let every one that nameth the name of Christ depart from iniquity.

verses.original: Ἐν μεγάλῃ δὲ οἰκίᾳ οὐκ ἔστιν μόνον σκεύη χρυσᾶ καὶ ἀργυρᾶ ἀλλὰ καὶ ξύλινα καὶ ὀστράκινα, καὶ ἃ μὲν εἰς τιμὴν ἃ δὲ εἰς ἀτιμίαν·
verses.translit: En megale de oikia ouk estin monon skeyi hrysa kai argyra alla kai xylina kai ostrakina, kai a men eis timen a de eis atimian*
verses.translation: But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth; and some to honour, and some to dishonour.

verses.original: ἐὰν οὖν τις ἐκκαθάρῃ ἑαυτὸν ἀπὸ τούτων, ἔσται σκεῦος εἰς τιμήν, ἡγιασμένον, ⸀εὔχρηστον τῷ δεσπότῃ, εἰς πᾶν ἔργον ἀγαθὸν ἡτοιμασμένον.
verses.translit: ean oun tis ekkathare eayton apo toyton, estai skeuos eis timin, egiasmenon, euhriston to despote, eis pan ergon agathon etoimasmenon.
verses.translation: If a man therefore purge himself from these, he shall be a vessel unto honour, sanctified, and meet for the master’s use, and prepared unto every good work.

verses.original: τὰς δὲ νεωτερικὰς ἐπιθυμίας φεῦγε, δίωκε δὲ δικαιοσύνην, πίστιν, ἀγάπην, εἰρήνην μετὰ τῶν ἐπικαλουμένων τὸν κύριον ἐκ καθαρᾶς καρδίας.
verses.translit: tas de neoterikas epithymias feuge, dioke de dikaiosynin, pistin, agapin, eirinin meta ton epikaloymenon ton kyrion ek katharas kardias.
verses.translation: Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.

verses.original: τὰς δὲ μωρὰς καὶ ἀπαιδεύτους ζητήσεις παραιτοῦ, εἰδὼς ὅτι γεννῶσι μάχας·
verses.translit: tas de moras kai apaideytoys zitiseis paraitou, eidos oti gennosi mahas*
verses.translation: But foolish and unlearned questions avoid, knowing that they do gender strifes.

verses.original: δοῦλον δὲ κυρίου οὐ δεῖ μάχεσθαι, ἀλλὰ ἤπιον εἶναι πρὸς πάντας, διδακτικόν, ἀνεξίκακον,
verses.translit: doulon de kyrioy ou dei mahesthai, alla epion einai pros pantas, didaktikon, anexikakon,
verses.translation: And the servant of the Lord must not strive; but be gentle unto all men , apt to teach, patient,

verses.original: ἐν πραΰτητι παιδεύοντα τοὺς ἀντιδιατιθεμένους, μήποτε ⸀δώῃ αὐτοῖς ὁ θεὸς μετάνοιαν εἰς ἐπίγνωσιν ἀληθείας,
verses.translit: en praytiti paideyonta tous antidiatithemenoys, mipote doe autois o theos metanoian eis epignosin alitheias,
verses.translation: In meekness instructing those that oppose themselves; if God peradventure will give them repentance to the acknowledging of the truth;

verses.original: καὶ ἀνανήψωσιν ἐκ τῆς τοῦ διαβόλου παγίδος, ἐζωγρημένοι ὑπʼ αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸ ἐκείνου θέλημα.
verses.translit: kai ananipsosin ek tes tou diavoloy pagidos, ezogrimenoi up' autou eis to ekeinoy thelima.
verses.translation: And that they may recover themselves out of the snare of the devil, who are taken captive by him at his will.

verses.original: Τοῦτο δὲ γίνωσκε ὅτι ἐν ἐσχάταις ἡμέραις ἐνστήσονται καιροὶ χαλεποί·
verses.translit: Touto de ginoske oti en eshatais emerais enstisontai kairoi halepoi*
verses.translation: This know also, that in the last days perilous times shall come.

verses.original: ἔσονται γὰρ οἱ ἄνθρωποι φίλαυτοι, φιλάργυροι, ἀλαζόνες, ὑπερήφανοι, βλάσφημοι, γονεῦσιν ἀπειθεῖς, ἀχάριστοι, ἀνόσιοι,
verses.translit: esontai gar oi anthropoi filaytoi, filargyroi, alazones, uperifanoi, vlasfimoi, goneusin apeitheis, aharistoi, anosioi,
verses.translation: For men shall be lovers of their own selves, covetous, boasters, proud, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,

verses.original: ἄστοργοι, ἄσπονδοι, διάβολοι, ἀκρατεῖς, ἀνήμεροι, ἀφιλάγαθοι,
verses.translit: astorgoi, aspondoi, diavoloi, akrateis, animeroi, afilagathoi,
verses.translation: Without natural affection, trucebreakers, false accusers, incontinent, fierce, despisers of those that are good,

verses.original: προδόται, προπετεῖς, τετυφωμένοι, φιλήδονοι μᾶλλον ἢ φιλόθεοι,
verses.translit: prodotai, propeteis, tetyfomenoi, filidonoi mallon e filotheoi,
verses.translation: Traitors, heady, highminded, lovers of pleasures more than lovers of God;

verses.original: ἔχοντες μόρφωσιν εὐσεβείας τὴν δὲ δύναμιν αὐτῆς ἠρνημένοι· καὶ τούτους ἀποτρέπου.
verses.translit: ehontes morfosin euseveias ten de dynamin autes ernimenoi* kai toytoys apotrepoy.
verses.translation: Having a form of godliness, but denying the power thereof: from such turn away.

verses.original: ἐκ τούτων γάρ εἰσιν οἱ ἐνδύνοντες εἰς τὰς οἰκίας καὶ ⸀αἰχμαλωτίζοντες γυναικάρια σεσωρευμένα ἁμαρτίαις, ἀγόμενα ἐπιθυμίαις ποικίλαις,
verses.translit: ek toyton gar eisin oi endynontes eis tas oikias kai aihmalotizontes gynaikaria sesoreymena amartiais, agomena epithymiais poikilais,
verses.translation: For of this sort are they which creep into houses, and lead captive silly women laden with sins, led away with divers lusts,

verses.original: πάντοτε μανθάνοντα καὶ μηδέποτε εἰς ἐπίγνωσιν ἀληθείας ἐλθεῖν δυνάμενα.
verses.translit: pantote manthanonta kai midepote eis epignosin alitheias elthein dynamena.
verses.translation: Ever learning, and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.

verses.original: ὃν τρόπον δὲ Ἰάννης καὶ Ἰαμβρῆς ἀντέστησαν Μωϋσεῖ, οὕτως καὶ οὗτοι ἀνθίστανται τῇ ἀληθείᾳ, ἄνθρωποι κατεφθαρμένοι τὸν νοῦν, ἀδόκιμοι περὶ τὴν πίστιν.
verses.translit: on tropon de Iannis kai Iamvres antestisan Moysei, outos kai outoi anthistantai te alitheia, anthropoi kateftharmenoi ton noun, adokimoi peri ten pistin.
verses.translation: Now as Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses, so do these also resist the truth: men of corrupt minds, reprobate concerning the faith.

verses.original: ἀλλʼ οὐ προκόψουσιν ἐπὶ πλεῖον, ἡ γὰρ ἄνοια αὐτῶν ἔκδηλος ἔσται πᾶσιν, ὡς καὶ ἡ ἐκείνων ἐγένετο.
verses.translit: all' ou prokopsoysin epi pleion, e gar anoia auton ekdilos estai pasin, os kai e ekeinon egeneto.
verses.translation: But they shall proceed no further: for their folly shall be manifest unto all men , as theirs also was.

verses.original: Σὺ δὲ ⸀παρηκολούθησάς μου τῇ διδασκαλίᾳ, τῇ ἀγωγῇ, τῇ προθέσει, τῇ πίστει, τῇ μακροθυμίᾳ, τῇ ἀγάπῃ, τῇ ὑπομονῇ,
verses.translit: Su de parikoloythisas moy te didaskalia, te agoge, te prothesei, te pistei, te makrothymia, te agape, te upomone,
verses.translation: But thou hast fully known my doctrine, manner of life, purpose, faith, longsuffering, charity, patience,

verses.original: τοῖς διωγμοῖς, τοῖς παθήμασιν, οἷά μοι ἐγένετο ἐν Ἀντιοχείᾳ, ἐν Ἰκονίῳ, ἐν Λύστροις, οἵους διωγμοὺς ὑπήνεγκα· καὶ ἐκ πάντων με ἐρρύσατο ὁ κύριος.
verses.translit: tois diogmois, tois pathimasin, oia moi egeneto en Antioheia, en Ikonio, en Lystrois, oioys diogmous upinegka* kai ek panton me errysato o kyrios.
verses.translation: Persecutions, afflictions, which came unto me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra; what persecutions I endured: but out of them all the Lord delivered me.

verses.original: καὶ πάντες δὲ οἱ θέλοντες ⸂ζῆν εὐσεβῶς⸃ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ διωχθήσονται·
verses.translit: kai pantes de oi thelontes zen eusevos en Hristo Iisou diohthisontai*
verses.translation: Yea, and all that will live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution.

verses.original: πονηροὶ δὲ ἄνθρωποι καὶ γόητες προκόψουσιν ἐπὶ τὸ χεῖρον, πλανῶντες καὶ πλανώμενοι.
verses.translit: poniroi de anthropoi kai goites prokopsoysin epi to heiron, planontes kai planomenoi.
verses.translation: But evil men and seducers shall wax worse and worse, deceiving, and being deceived.

verses.original: σὺ δὲ μένε ἐν οἷς ἔμαθες καὶ ἐπιστώθης, εἰδὼς παρὰ ⸀τίνων ἔμαθες,
verses.translit: su de mene en ois emathes kai epistothis, eidos para tinon emathes,
verses.translation: But continue thou in the things which thou hast learned and hast been assured of, knowing of whom thou hast learned them ;

verses.original: καὶ ὅτι ἀπὸ βρέφους ⸀ἱερὰ γράμματα οἶδας, τὰ δυνάμενά σε σοφίσαι εἰς σωτηρίαν διὰ πίστεως τῆς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ·
verses.translit: kai oti apo vrefoys iera grammata oidas, ta dynamena se sofisai eis sotirian dia pisteos tes en Hristo Iisou*
verses.translation: And that from a child thou hast known the holy scriptures, which are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.

verses.original: πᾶσα γραφὴ θεόπνευστος καὶ ὠφέλιμος πρὸς διδασκαλίαν, πρὸς ⸀ἐλεγμόν, πρὸς ἐπανόρθωσιν, πρὸς παιδείαν τὴν ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ,
verses.translit: pasa grafe theopneystos kai ofelimos pros didaskalian, pros elegmon, pros epanorthosin, pros paideian ten en dikaiosyne,
verses.translation: All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness:

verses.original: ἵνα ἄρτιος ᾖ ὁ τοῦ θεοῦ ἄνθρωπος, πρὸς πᾶν ἔργον ἀγαθὸν ἐξηρτισμένος.
verses.translit: ina artios e o tou theou anthropos, pros pan ergon agathon exirtismenos.
verses.translation: That the man of God may be perfect, throughly furnished unto all good works.

verses.original: ⸀Διαμαρτύρομαι ἐνώπιον τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ ⸂Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ⸃, τοῦ μέλλοντος κρίνειν ζῶντας καὶ νεκρούς, ⸀καὶ τὴν ἐπιφάνειαν αὐτοῦ καὶ τὴν βασιλείαν αὐτοῦ·
verses.translit: Diamartyromai enopion tou theou kai Hristou Iisou, tou mellontos krinein zontas kai nekroys, kai ten epifaneian autou kai ten vasileian autou*
verses.translation: I charge thee therefore before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, who shall judge the quick and the dead at his appearing and his kingdom;

verses.original: κήρυξον τὸν λόγον, ἐπίστηθι εὐκαίρως ἀκαίρως, ἔλεγξον, ἐπιτίμησον, παρακάλεσον, ἐν πάσῃ μακροθυμίᾳ καὶ διδαχῇ.
verses.translit: kiryxon ton logon, epistithi eukairos akairos, elegxon, epitimison, parakaleson, en pase makrothymia kai didahe.
verses.translation: Preach the word; be instant in season, out of season; reprove, rebuke, exhort with all longsuffering and doctrine.

verses.original: ἔσται γὰρ καιρὸς ὅτε τῆς ὑγιαινούσης διδασκαλίας οὐκ ἀνέξονται, ἀλλὰ κατὰ τὰς ⸂ἰδίας ἐπιθυμίας⸃ ἑαυτοῖς ἐπισωρεύσουσιν διδασκάλους κνηθόμενοι τὴν ἀκοήν,
verses.translit: estai gar kairos ote tes ugiainoysis didaskalias ouk anexontai, alla kata tas idias epithymias eaytois episoreysoysin didaskaloys knithomenoi ten akoin,
verses.translation: For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine; but after their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers, having itching ears;

verses.original: καὶ ἀπὸ μὲν τῆς ἀληθείας τὴν ἀκοὴν ἀποστρέψουσιν, ἐπὶ δὲ τοὺς μύθους ἐκτραπήσονται.
verses.translit: kai apo men tes alitheias ten akoen apostrepsoysin, epi de tous mythoys ektrapisontai.
verses.translation: And they shall turn away their ears from the truth, and shall be turned unto fables.

verses.original: σὺ δὲ νῆφε ἐν πᾶσιν, κακοπάθησον, ἔργον ποίησον εὐαγγελιστοῦ, τὴν διακονίαν σου πληροφόρησον.
verses.translit: su de nefe en pasin, kakopathison, ergon poiison euaggelistou, ten diakonian soy pliroforison.
verses.translation: But watch thou in all things, endure afflictions, do the work of an evangelist, make full proof of thy ministry.

verses.original: Ἐγὼ γὰρ ἤδη σπένδομαι, καὶ ὁ καιρὸς τῆς ⸂ἀναλύσεώς μου⸃ ἐφέστηκεν.
verses.translit: Ego gar edi spendomai, kai o kairos tes analyseos moy efestiken.
verses.translation: For I am now ready to be offered, and the time of my departure is at hand.

verses.original: τὸν ⸂καλὸν ἀγῶνα⸃ ἠγώνισμαι, τὸν δρόμον τετέλεκα, τὴν πίστιν τετήρηκα·
verses.translit: ton kalon agona egonismai, ton dromon teteleka, ten pistin tetirika*
verses.translation: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:

verses.original: λοιπὸν ἀπόκειταί μοι ὁ τῆς δικαιοσύνης στέφανος, ὃν ἀποδώσει μοι ὁ κύριος ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ, ὁ δίκαιος κριτής, οὐ μόνον δὲ ἐμοὶ ἀλλὰ καὶ πᾶσιν τοῖς ἠγαπηκόσι τὴν ἐπιφάνειαν αὐτοῦ.
verses.translit: loipon apokeitai moi o tes dikaiosynis stefanos, on apodosei moi o kyrios en ekeine te emera, o dikaios kritis, ou monon de emoi alla kai pasin tois egapikosi ten epifaneian autou.
verses.translation: Henceforth there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give me at that day: and not to me only, but unto all them also that love his appearing.

verses.original: Σπούδασον ἐλθεῖν πρός με ταχέως·
verses.translit: Spoydason elthein pros me taheos*
verses.translation: Do thy diligence to come shortly unto me:

verses.original: Δημᾶς γάρ με ⸀ἐγκατέλιπεν ἀγαπήσας τὸν νῦν αἰῶνα, καὶ ἐπορεύθη εἰς Θεσσαλονίκην, Κρήσκης εἰς Γαλατίαν, Τίτος εἰς Δαλματίαν·
verses.translit: Dimas gar me egkatelipen agapisas ton nun aiona, kai eporeythi eis Thessalonikin, Kriskis eis Galatian, Titos eis Dalmatian*
verses.translation: For Demas hath forsaken me, having loved this present world, and is departed unto Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia, Titus unto Dalmatia.

verses.original: Λουκᾶς ἐστιν μόνος μετʼ ἐμοῦ. Μᾶρκον ἀναλαβὼν ἄγε μετὰ σεαυτοῦ, ἔστιν γάρ μοι εὔχρηστος εἰς διακονίαν,
verses.translit: Loykas estin monos met' emou. Markon analavon age meta seaytou, estin gar moi euhristos eis diakonian,
verses.translation: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark, and bring him with thee: for he is profitable to me for the ministry.

verses.original: Τυχικὸν δὲ ἀπέστειλα εἰς Ἔφεσον.
verses.translit: Tyhikon de apesteila eis Efeson.
verses.translation: And Tychicus have I sent to Ephesus.

verses.original: τὸν φαιλόνην, ὃν ⸀ἀπέλιπον ἐν Τρῳάδι παρὰ Κάρπῳ, ἐρχόμενος φέρε, καὶ τὰ βιβλία, μάλιστα τὰς μεμβράνας.
verses.translit: ton failonin, on apelipon en Troadi para Karpo, erhomenos fere, kai ta vivlia, malista tas memvranas.
verses.translation: The cloke that I left at Troas with Carpus, when thou comest, bring with thee , and the books, but especially the parchments.

verses.original: Ἀλέξανδρος ὁ χαλκεὺς πολλά μοι κακὰ ἐνεδείξατο— ⸀ἀποδώσει αὐτῷ ὁ κύριος κατὰ τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ—
verses.translit: Alexandros o halkeus polla moi kaka enedeixato-- apodosei auto o kyrios kata ta erga autou--
verses.translation: Alexander the coppersmith did me much evil: the Lord reward him according to his works:

verses.original: ὃν καὶ σὺ φυλάσσου, λίαν γὰρ ⸀ἀντέστη τοῖς ἡμετέροις λόγοις.
verses.translit: on kai su fylassoy, lian gar antesti tois emeterois logois.
verses.translation: Of whom be thou ware also; for he hath greatly withstood our words.

verses.original: Ἐν τῇ πρώτῃ μου ἀπολογίᾳ οὐδείς μοι ⸀παρεγένετο, ἀλλὰ πάντες με ⸀ἐγκατέλιπον— μὴ αὐτοῖς λογισθείη—
verses.translit: En te prote moy apologia oudeis moi paregeneto, alla pantes me egkatelipon-- me autois logistheii--
verses.translation: At my first answer no man stood with me, but all men forsook me: I pray God that it may not be laid to their charge.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ κύριός μοι παρέστη καὶ ἐνεδυνάμωσέν με, ἵνα διʼ ἐμοῦ τὸ κήρυγμα πληροφορηθῇ καὶ ⸀ἀκούσωσιν πάντα τὰ ἔθνη, καὶ ἐρρύσθην ἐκ στόματος λέοντος.
verses.translit: o de kyrios moi paresti kai enedynamosen me, ina di' emou to kirygma pliroforithe kai akoysosin panta ta ethni, kai errysthin ek stomatos leontos.
verses.translation: Notwithstanding the Lord stood with me, and strengthened me; that by me the preaching might be fully known, and that all the Gentiles might hear: and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.

verses.original: ⸀ῥύσεταί με ὁ κύριος ἀπὸ παντὸς ἔργου πονηροῦ καὶ σώσει εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν αὐτοῦ τὴν ἐπουράνιον· ᾧ ἡ δόξα εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων, ἀμήν.
verses.translit: Rysetai me o kyrios apo pantos ergoy ponirou kai sosei eis ten vasileian autou ten epoyranion* o e doxa eis tous aionas ton aionon, amin.
verses.translation: And the Lord shall deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve me unto his heavenly kingdom: to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

verses.original: Ἄσπασαι Πρίσκαν καὶ Ἀκύλαν καὶ τὸν Ὀνησιφόρου οἶκον.
verses.translit: Aspasai Priskan kai Akylan kai ton Onisiforoy oikon.
verses.translation: Salute Prisca and Aquila, and the household of Onesiphorus.

verses.original: Ἔραστος ἔμεινεν ἐν Κορίνθῳ, Τρόφιμον δὲ ⸀ἀπέλιπον ἐν Μιλήτῳ ἀσθενοῦντα.
verses.translit: Erastos emeinen en Korintho, Trofimon de apelipon en Milito asthenounta.
verses.translation: Erastus abode at Corinth: but Trophimus have I left at Miletum sick.

verses.original: Σπούδασον πρὸ χειμῶνος ἐλθεῖν. Ἀσπάζεταί σε Εὔβουλος καὶ Πούδης καὶ Λίνος καὶ Κλαυδία καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ πάντες.
verses.translit: Spoydason pro heimonos elthein. Aspazetai se Euvoylos kai Poydis kai Linos kai Klaydia kai oi adelfoi pantes.
verses.translation: Do thy diligence to come before winter. Eubulus greeteth thee, and Pudens, and Linus, and Claudia, and all the brethren.

verses.original: Ὁ ⸀κύριος μετὰ τοῦ πνεύματός σου. ἡ χάρις μεθʼ ⸀ὑμῶν.
verses.translit: O kyrios meta tou pneymatos soy. e haris meth' umon.
verses.translation: The Lord Jesus Christ be with thy spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.

verses.original: Παῦλος δοῦλος θεοῦ, ἀπόστολος δὲ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ κατὰ πίστιν ἐκλεκτῶν θεοῦ καὶ ἐπίγνωσιν ἀληθείας τῆς κατʼ εὐσέβειαν
verses.translit: Paulos doulos theou, apostolos de Iisou Hristou kata pistin eklekton theou kai epignosin alitheias tes kat' euseveian
verses.translation: Paul, a servant of God, and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God’s elect, and the acknowledging of the truth which is after godliness;

verses.original: ἐπʼ ἐλπίδι ζωῆς αἰωνίου, ἣν ἐπηγγείλατο ὁ ἀψευδὴς θεὸς πρὸ χρόνων αἰωνίων
verses.translit: ep' elpidi zoes aionioy, en epiggeilato o apseydes theos pro hronon aionion
verses.translation: In hope of eternal life, which God, that cannot lie, promised before the world began;

verses.original: ἐφανέρωσεν δὲ καιροῖς ἰδίοις, τὸν λόγον αὐτοῦ ἐν κηρύγματι ὃ ἐπιστεύθην ἐγὼ κατʼ ἐπιταγὴν τοῦ σωτῆρος ἡμῶν θεοῦ,
verses.translit: efanerosen de kairois idiois, ton logon autou en kirygmati o episteythin ego kat' epitagen tou soteros emon theou,
verses.translation: But hath in due times manifested his word through preaching, which is committed unto me according to the commandment of God our Saviour;

verses.original: Τίτῳ γνησίῳ τέκνῳ κατὰ κοινὴν πίστιν· χάρις ⸀καὶ εἰρήνη ἀπὸ θεοῦ πατρὸς καὶ ⸂Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ⸃ τοῦ σωτῆρος ἡμῶν.
verses.translit: Tito gnisio tekno kata koinen pistin* haris kai eirini apo theou patros kai Hristou Iisou tou soteros emon.
verses.translation: To Titus, mine own son after the common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Saviour.

verses.original: Τούτου χάριν ⸀ἀπέλιπόν σε ἐν Κρήτῃ ἵνα τὰ λείποντα ἐπιδιορθώσῃ, καὶ καταστήσῃς κατὰ πόλιν πρεσβυτέρους, ὡς ἐγώ σοι διεταξάμην,
verses.translit: Toytoy harin apelipon se en Krite ina ta leiponta epidiorthose, kai katastises kata polin presvyteroys, os ego soi dietaxamin,
verses.translation: For this cause left I thee in Crete, that thou shouldest set in order the things that are wanting, and ordain elders in every city, as I had appointed thee:

verses.original: εἴ τίς ἐστιν ἀνέγκλητος, μιᾶς γυναικὸς ἀνήρ, τέκνα ἔχων πιστά, μὴ ἐν κατηγορίᾳ ἀσωτίας ἢ ἀνυπότακτα.
verses.translit: ei tis estin anegklitos, mias gynaikos anir, tekna ehon pista, me en katigoria asotias e anypotakta.
verses.translation: If any be blameless, the husband of one wife, having faithful children not accused of riot or unruly.

verses.original: δεῖ γὰρ τὸν ἐπίσκοπον ἀνέγκλητον εἶναι ὡς θεοῦ οἰκονόμον, μὴ αὐθάδη, μὴ ὀργίλον, μὴ πάροινον, μὴ πλήκτην, μὴ αἰσχροκερδῆ,
verses.translit: dei gar ton episkopon anegkliton einai os theou oikonomon, me authadi, me orgilon, me paroinon, me pliktin, me aishrokerde,
verses.translation: For a bishop must be blameless, as the steward of God; not selfwilled, not soon angry, not given to wine, no striker, not given to filthy lucre;

verses.original: ἀλλὰ φιλόξενον, φιλάγαθον, σώφρονα, δίκαιον, ὅσιον, ἐγκρατῆ,
verses.translit: alla filoxenon, filagathon, sofrona, dikaion, osion, egkrate,
verses.translation: But a lover of hospitality, a lover of good men, sober, just, holy, temperate;

verses.original: ἀντεχόμενον τοῦ κατὰ τὴν διδαχὴν πιστοῦ λόγου, ἵνα δυνατὸς ᾖ καὶ παρακαλεῖν ἐν τῇ διδασκαλίᾳ τῇ ὑγιαινούσῃ καὶ τοὺς ἀντιλέγοντας ἐλέγχειν.
verses.translit: antehomenon tou kata ten didahen pistou logoy, ina dynatos e kai parakalein en te didaskalia te ugiainoyse kai tous antilegontas eleghein.
verses.translation: Holding fast the faithful word as he hath been taught, that he may be able by sound doctrine both to exhort and to convince the gainsayers.

verses.original: Εἰσὶν γὰρ πολλοὶ ⸀καὶ ἀνυπότακτοι, ματαιολόγοι καὶ φρεναπάται, μάλιστα οἱ ἐκ ⸀τῆς περιτομῆς,
verses.translit: Eisin gar polloi kai anypotaktoi, mataiologoi kai frenapatai, malista oi ek tes peritomes,
verses.translation: For there are many unruly and vain talkers and deceivers, specially they of the circumcision:

verses.original: οὓς δεῖ ἐπιστομίζειν, οἵτινες ὅλους οἴκους ἀνατρέπουσιν διδάσκοντες ἃ μὴ δεῖ αἰσχροῦ κέρδους χάριν.
verses.translit: ous dei epistomizein, oitines oloys oikoys anatrepoysin didaskontes a me dei aishrou kerdoys harin.
verses.translation: Whose mouths must be stopped, who subvert whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for filthy lucre’s sake.

verses.original: εἶπέν τις ἐξ αὐτῶν, ἴδιος αὐτῶν προφήτης, Κρῆτες ἀεὶ ψεῦσται, κακὰ θηρία, γαστέρες ἀργαί·
verses.translit: eipen tis ex auton, idios auton profitis, Kretes aei pseustai, kaka thiria, gasteres argai*
verses.translation: One of themselves, even a prophet of their own, said, The Cretians are alway liars, evil beasts, slow bellies.

verses.original: ἡ μαρτυρία αὕτη ἐστὶν ἀληθής. διʼ ἣν αἰτίαν ἔλεγχε αὐτοὺς ἀποτόμως, ἵνα ὑγιαίνωσιν ἐν τῇ πίστει,
verses.translit: e martyria auti estin alithis. di' en aitian eleghe autous apotomos, ina ugiainosin en te pistei,
verses.translation: This witness is true. Wherefore rebuke them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith;

verses.original: μὴ προσέχοντες Ἰουδαϊκοῖς μύθοις καὶ ἐντολαῖς ἀνθρώπων ἀποστρεφομένων τὴν ἀλήθειαν.
verses.translit: me prosehontes Ioydaikois mythois kai entolais anthropon apostrefomenon ten alitheian.
verses.translation: Not giving heed to Jewish fables, and commandments of men, that turn from the truth.

verses.original: ⸀πάντα καθαρὰ τοῖς καθαροῖς· τοῖς δὲ μεμιαμμένοις καὶ ἀπίστοις οὐδὲν καθαρόν, ἀλλὰ μεμίανται αὐτῶν καὶ ὁ νοῦς καὶ ἡ συνείδησις.
verses.translit: panta kathara tois katharois* tois de memiammenois kai apistois ouden katharon, alla memiantai auton kai o nous kai e syneidisis.
verses.translation: Unto the pure all things are pure: but unto them that are defiled and unbelieving is nothing pure; but even their mind and conscience is defiled.

verses.original: θεὸν ὁμολογοῦσιν εἰδέναι, τοῖς δὲ ἔργοις ἀρνοῦνται, βδελυκτοὶ ὄντες καὶ ἀπειθεῖς καὶ πρὸς πᾶν ἔργον ἀγαθὸν ἀδόκιμοι.
verses.translit: theon omologousin eidenai, tois de ergois arnountai, vdelyktoi ontes kai apeitheis kai pros pan ergon agathon adokimoi.
verses.translation: They profess that they know God; but in works they deny him , being abominable, and disobedient, and unto every good work reprobate.

verses.original: Σὺ δὲ λάλει ἃ πρέπει τῇ ὑγιαινούσῃ διδασκαλίᾳ.
verses.translit: Su de lalei a prepei te ugiainoyse didaskalia.
verses.translation: But speak thou the things which become sound doctrine:

verses.original: πρεσβύτας νηφαλίους εἶναι, σεμνούς, σώφρονας, ὑγιαίνοντας τῇ πίστει, τῇ ἀγάπῃ, τῇ ὑπομονῇ.
verses.translit: presvytas nifalioys einai, semnoys, sofronas, ugiainontas te pistei, te agape, te upomone.
verses.translation: That the aged men be sober, grave, temperate, sound in faith, in charity, in patience.

verses.original: Πρεσβύτιδας ὡσαύτως ἐν καταστήματι ἱεροπρεπεῖς, μὴ διαβόλους ⸀μηδὲ οἴνῳ πολλῷ δεδουλωμένας, καλοδιδασκάλους,
verses.translit: Presvytidas osaytos en katastimati ieroprepeis, me diavoloys mide oino pollo dedoylomenas, kalodidaskaloys,
verses.translation: The aged women likewise, that they be in behaviour as becometh holiness, not false accusers, not given to much wine, teachers of good things;

verses.original: ἵνα ⸀σωφρονίζωσι τὰς νέας φιλάνδρους εἶναι, φιλοτέκνους,
verses.translit: ina sofronizosi tas neas filandroys einai, filoteknoys,
verses.translation: That they may teach the young women to be sober, to love their husbands, to love their children,

verses.original: σώφρονας, ἁγνάς, ⸀οἰκουργούς, ἀγαθάς, ὑποτασσομένας τοῖς ἰδίοις ἀνδράσιν, ἵνα μὴ ὁ λόγος τοῦ θεοῦ βλασφημῆται.
verses.translit: sofronas, agnas, oikoyrgoys, agathas, upotassomenas tois idiois andrasin, ina me o logos tou theou vlasfimetai.
verses.translation: To be discreet, chaste, keepers at home, good, obedient to their own husbands, that the word of God be not blasphemed.

verses.original: Τοὺς νεωτέρους ὡσαύτως παρακάλει σωφρονεῖν·
verses.translit: Tous neoteroys osaytos parakalei sofronein*
verses.translation: Young men likewise exhort to be sober minded.

verses.original: περὶ πάντα σεαυτὸν παρεχόμενος τύπον καλῶν ἔργων, ἐν τῇ διδασκαλίᾳ ⸀ἀφθορίαν, ⸀σεμνότητα,
verses.translit: peri panta seayton parehomenos typon kalon ergon, en te didaskalia afthorian, semnotita,
verses.translation: In all things shewing thyself a pattern of good works: in doctrine shewing uncorruptness, gravity, sincerity,

verses.original: λόγον ὑγιῆ ἀκατάγνωστον, ἵνα ὁ ἐξ ἐναντίας ἐντραπῇ μηδὲν ἔχων ⸂λέγειν περὶ ἡμῶν⸃ φαῦλον.
verses.translit: logon ugie akatagnoston, ina o ex enantias entrape miden ehon legein peri emon faulon.
verses.translation: Sound speech, that cannot be condemned; that he that is of the contrary part may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say of you.

verses.original: Δούλους ἰδίοις δεσπόταις ὑποτάσσεσθαι ἐν πᾶσιν, εὐαρέστους εἶναι, μὴ ἀντιλέγοντας,
verses.translit: Doyloys idiois despotais upotassesthai en pasin, euarestoys einai, me antilegontas,
verses.translation: Exhort servants to be obedient unto their own masters, and to please them well in all things ; not answering again;

verses.original: μὴ νοσφιζομένους, ἀλλὰ ⸂πᾶσαν πίστιν⸃ ἐνδεικνυμένους ἀγαθήν, ἵνα τὴν διδασκαλίαν ⸀τὴν τοῦ σωτῆρος ἡμῶν θεοῦ κοσμῶσιν ἐν πᾶσιν.
verses.translit: me nosfizomenoys, alla pasan pistin endeiknymenoys agathin, ina ten didaskalian ten tou soteros emon theou kosmosin en pasin.
verses.translation: Not purloining, but shewing all good fidelity; that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Saviour in all things.

verses.original: Ἐπεφάνη γὰρ ἡ χάρις τοῦ ⸀θεοῦ σωτήριος πᾶσιν ἀνθρώποις
verses.translit: Epefani gar e haris tou theou sotirios pasin anthropois
verses.translation: For the grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared to all men,

verses.original: παιδεύουσα ἡμᾶς, ἵνα ἀρνησάμενοι τὴν ἀσέβειαν καὶ τὰς κοσμικὰς ἐπιθυμίας σωφρόνως καὶ δικαίως καὶ εὐσεβῶς ζήσωμεν ἐν τῷ νῦν αἰῶνι,
verses.translit: paideyoysa emas, ina arnisamenoi ten aseveian kai tas kosmikas epithymias sofronos kai dikaios kai eusevos zisomen en to nun aioni,
verses.translation: Teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly, righteously, and godly, in this present world;

verses.original: προσδεχόμενοι τὴν μακαρίαν ἐλπίδα καὶ ἐπιφάνειαν τῆς δόξης τοῦ μεγάλου θεοῦ καὶ σωτῆρος ἡμῶν ⸂Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ⸃,
verses.translit: prosdehomenoi ten makarian elpida kai epifaneian tes doxis tou megaloy theou kai soteros emon Iisou Hristou,
verses.translation: Looking for that blessed hope, and the glorious appearing of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ;

verses.original: ὃς ἔδωκεν ἑαυτὸν ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν ἵνα λυτρώσηται ἡμᾶς ἀπὸ πάσης ἀνομίας καὶ καθαρίσῃ ἑαυτῷ λαὸν περιούσιον, ζηλωτὴν καλῶν ἔργων.
verses.translit: os edoken eayton uper emon ina lytrositai emas apo pasis anomias kai katharise eayto laon perioysion, ziloten kalon ergon.
verses.translation: Who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify unto himself a peculiar people, zealous of good works.

verses.original: Ταῦτα λάλει καὶ παρακάλει καὶ ἔλεγχε μετὰ πάσης ἐπιταγῆς· μηδείς σου περιφρονείτω.
verses.translit: Tauta lalei kai parakalei kai eleghe meta pasis epitages* mideis soy perifroneito.
verses.translation: These things speak, and exhort, and rebuke with all authority. Let no man despise thee.

verses.original: Ὑπομίμνῃσκε αὐτοὺς ⸀ἀρχαῖς ἐξουσίαις ὑποτάσσεσθαι πειθαρχεῖν, πρὸς πᾶν ἔργον ἀγαθὸν ἑτοίμους εἶναι,
verses.translit: Upomimneske autous arhais exoysiais upotassesthai peitharhein, pros pan ergon agathon etoimoys einai,
verses.translation: Put them in mind to be subject to principalities and powers, to obey magistrates, to be ready to every good work,

verses.original: μηδένα βλασφημεῖν, ἀμάχους εἶναι, ἐπιεικεῖς, πᾶσαν ἐνδεικνυμένους πραΰτητα πρὸς πάντας ἀνθρώπους.
verses.translit: midena vlasfimein, amahoys einai, epieikeis, pasan endeiknymenoys praytita pros pantas anthropoys.
verses.translation: To speak evil of no man, to be no brawlers, but gentle, shewing all meekness unto all men.

verses.original: ἦμεν γάρ ποτε καὶ ἡμεῖς ἀνόητοι, ἀπειθεῖς, πλανώμενοι, δουλεύοντες ἐπιθυμίαις καὶ ἡδοναῖς ποικίλαις, ἐν κακίᾳ καὶ φθόνῳ διάγοντες, στυγητοί, μισοῦντες ἀλλήλους.
verses.translit: emen gar pote kai emeis anoitoi, apeitheis, planomenoi, doyleyontes epithymiais kai edonais poikilais, en kakia kai fthono diagontes, stygitoi, misountes alliloys.
verses.translation: For we ourselves also were sometimes foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving divers lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.

verses.original: ὅτε δὲ ἡ χρηστότης καὶ ἡ φιλανθρωπία ἐπεφάνη τοῦ σωτῆρος ἡμῶν θεοῦ,
verses.translit: ote de e hristotis kai e filanthropia epefani tou soteros emon theou,
verses.translation: But after that the kindness and love of God our Saviour toward man appeared,

verses.original: οὐκ ἐξ ἔργων τῶν ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ ⸀ἃ ἐποιήσαμεν ἡμεῖς ἀλλὰ κατὰ ⸂τὸ αὐτοῦ ἔλεος⸃ ἔσωσεν ἡμᾶς διὰ λουτροῦ παλιγγενεσίας καὶ ἀνακαινώσεως πνεύματος ἁγίου,
verses.translit: ouk ex ergon ton en dikaiosyne a epoiisamen emeis alla kata to autou eleos esosen emas dia loytrou paliggenesias kai anakainoseos pneymatos agioy,
verses.translation: Not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to his mercy he saved us, by the washing of regeneration, and renewing of the Holy Ghost;

verses.original: οὗ ἐξέχεεν ἐφʼ ἡμᾶς πλουσίως διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τοῦ σωτῆρος ἡμῶν,
verses.translit: ou exeheen ef' emas ploysios dia Iisou Hristou tou soteros emon,
verses.translation: Which he shed on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Saviour;

verses.original: ἵνα δικαιωθέντες τῇ ἐκείνου χάριτι κληρονόμοι ⸀γενηθῶμεν κατʼ ἐλπίδα ζωῆς αἰωνίου.
verses.translit: ina dikaiothentes te ekeinoy hariti klironomoi genithomen kat' elpida zoes aionioy.
verses.translation: That being justified by his grace, we should be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.

verses.original: Πιστὸς ὁ λόγος, καὶ περὶ τούτων βούλομαί σε διαβεβαιοῦσθαι, ἵνα φροντίζωσιν καλῶν ἔργων προΐστασθαι οἱ πεπιστευκότες θεῷ. ταῦτά ⸀ἐστιν καλὰ καὶ ὠφέλιμα τοῖς ἀνθρώποις·
verses.translit: Pistos o logos, kai peri toyton voylomai se diavevaiousthai, ina frontizosin kalon ergon proIstasthai oi pepisteykotes theo. tauta estin kala kai ofelima tois anthropois*
verses.translation: This is a faithful saying, and these things I will that thou affirm constantly, that they which have believed in God might be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable unto men.

verses.original: μωρὰς δὲ ζητήσεις καὶ γενεαλογίας καὶ ⸀ἔρεις καὶ μάχας νομικὰς περιΐστασο, εἰσὶν γὰρ ἀνωφελεῖς καὶ μάταιοι.
verses.translit: moras de zitiseis kai genealogias kai ereis kai mahas nomikas periIstaso, eisin gar anofeleis kai mataioi.
verses.translation: But avoid foolish questions, and genealogies, and contentions, and strivings about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.

verses.original: αἱρετικὸν ἄνθρωπον μετὰ μίαν καὶ δευτέραν νουθεσίαν παραιτοῦ,
verses.translit: airetikon anthropon meta mian kai deyteran noythesian paraitou,
verses.translation: A man that is an heretick after the first and second admonition reject;

verses.original: εἰδὼς ὅτι ἐξέστραπται ὁ τοιοῦτος καὶ ἁμαρτάνει, ὢν αὐτοκατάκριτος.
verses.translit: eidos oti exestraptai o toioutos kai amartanei, on autokatakritos.
verses.translation: Knowing that he that is such is subverted, and sinneth, being condemned of himself.

verses.original: Ὅταν πέμψω Ἀρτεμᾶν πρὸς σὲ ἢ Τυχικόν, σπούδασον ἐλθεῖν πρός με εἰς Νικόπολιν, ἐκεῖ γὰρ κέκρικα παραχειμάσαι.
verses.translit: Otan pempso Arteman pros se e Tyhikon, spoydason elthein pros me eis Nikopolin, ekei gar kekrika paraheimasai.
verses.translation: When I shall send Artemas unto thee, or Tychicus, be diligent to come unto me to Nicopolis: for I have determined there to winter.

verses.original: Ζηνᾶν τὸν νομικὸν καὶ ⸀Ἀπολλῶν σπουδαίως πρόπεμψον, ἵνα μηδὲν αὐτοῖς λείπῃ.
verses.translit: Zinan ton nomikon kai Apollon spoydaios propempson, ina miden autois leipe.
verses.translation: Bring Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey diligently, that nothing be wanting unto them.

verses.original: μανθανέτωσαν δὲ καὶ οἱ ἡμέτεροι καλῶν ἔργων προΐστασθαι εἰς τὰς ἀναγκαίας χρείας, ἵνα μὴ ὦσιν ἄκαρποι.
verses.translit: manthanetosan de kai oi emeteroi kalon ergon proIstasthai eis tas anagkaias hreias, ina me osin akarpoi.
verses.translation: And let ours also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses, that they be not unfruitful.

verses.original: Ἀσπάζονταί σε οἱ μετʼ ἐμοῦ πάντες. ἄσπασαι τοὺς φιλοῦντας ἡμᾶς ἐν πίστει. ἡ χάρις μετὰ πάντων ⸀ὑμῶν.
verses.translit: Aspazontai se oi met' emou pantes. aspasai tous filountas emas en pistei. e haris meta panton umon.
verses.translation: All that are with me salute thee. Greet them that love us in the faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.

verses.original: Παῦλος δέσμιος Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ καὶ Τιμόθεος ὁ ἀδελφὸς Φιλήμονι τῷ ἀγαπητῷ καὶ συνεργῷ ἡμῶν
verses.translit: Paulos desmios Hristou Iisou kai Timotheos o adelfos Filimoni to agapito kai synergo emon
verses.translation: Paul, a prisoner of Jesus Christ, and Timothy our brother, unto Philemon our dearly beloved, and fellowlabourer,

verses.original: καὶ Ἀπφίᾳ τῇ ⸀ἀδελφῇ καὶ Ἀρχίππῳ τῷ συστρατιώτῃ ἡμῶν καὶ τῇ κατʼ οἶκόν σου ἐκκλησίᾳ·
verses.translit: kai Apfia te adelfe kai Arhippo to systratiote emon kai te kat' oikon soy ekklisia*
verses.translation: And to our beloved Apphia, and Archippus our fellowsoldier, and to the church in thy house:

verses.original: χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη ἀπὸ θεοῦ πατρὸς ἡμῶν καὶ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.
verses.translit: haris umin kai eirini apo theou patros emon kai kyrioy Iisou Hristou.
verses.translation: Grace to you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.original: Εὐχαριστῶ τῷ θεῷ μου πάντοτε μνείαν σου ποιούμενος ἐπὶ τῶν προσευχῶν μου,
verses.translit: Euharisto to theo moy pantote mneian soy poioymenos epi ton proseyhon moy,
verses.translation: I thank my God, making mention of thee always in my prayers,

verses.original: ἀκούων σου τὴν ἀγάπην καὶ τὴν πίστιν ἣν ἔχεις ⸀πρὸς τὸν κύριον Ἰησοῦν καὶ εἰς πάντας τοὺς ἁγίους,
verses.translit: akoyon soy ten agapin kai ten pistin en eheis pros ton kyrion Iisoun kai eis pantas tous agioys,
verses.translation: Hearing of thy love and faith, which thou hast toward the Lord Jesus, and toward all saints;

verses.original: ὅπως ἡ κοινωνία τῆς πίστεώς σου ἐνεργὴς γένηται ἐν ἐπιγνώσει παντὸς ἀγαθοῦ ⸀τοῦ ἐν ἡμῖν εἰς ⸀Χριστόν·
verses.translit: opos e koinonia tes pisteos soy energes genitai en epignosei pantos agathou tou en emin eis Hriston*
verses.translation: That the communication of thy faith may become effectual by the acknowledging of every good thing which is in you in Christ Jesus.

verses.original: ⸀χαρὰν γὰρ ⸂πολλὴν ἔσχον⸃ καὶ παράκλησιν ἐπὶ τῇ ἀγάπῃ σου, ὅτι τὰ σπλάγχνα τῶν ἁγίων ἀναπέπαυται διὰ σοῦ, ἀδελφέ.
verses.translit: haran gar pollen eshon kai paraklisin epi te agape soy, oti ta splaghna ton agion anapepaytai dia sou, adelfe.
verses.translation: For we have great joy and consolation in thy love, because the bowels of the saints are refreshed by thee, brother.

verses.original: Διό, πολλὴν ἐν Χριστῷ παρρησίαν ἔχων ἐπιτάσσειν σοι τὸ ἀνῆκον,
verses.translit: Dio, pollen en Hristo parrisian ehon epitassein soi to anekon,
verses.translation: Wherefore, though I might be much bold in Christ to enjoin thee that which is convenient,

verses.original: διὰ τὴν ἀγάπην μᾶλλον παρακαλῶ, τοιοῦτος ὢν ὡς Παῦλος πρεσβύτης νυνὶ δὲ καὶ δέσμιος ⸂Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ⸃—
verses.translit: dia ten agapin mallon parakalo, toioutos on os Paulos presvytis nyni de kai desmios Hristou Iisou--
verses.translation: Yet for love’s sake I rather beseech thee , being such an one as Paul the aged, and now also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.

verses.original: παρακαλῶ σε περὶ τοῦ ἐμοῦ τέκνου, ὃν ἐγέννησα ἐν τοῖς ⸀δεσμοῖς Ὀνήσιμον,
verses.translit: parakalo se peri tou emou teknoy, on egennisa en tois desmois Onisimon,
verses.translation: I beseech thee for my son Onesimus, whom I have begotten in my bonds:

verses.original: τόν ποτέ σοι ἄχρηστον νυνὶ ⸀δὲ σοὶ καὶ ἐμοὶ εὔχρηστον,
verses.translit: ton pote soi ahriston nyni de soi kai emoi euhriston,
verses.translation: Which in time past was to thee unprofitable, but now profitable to thee and to me:

verses.original: ὃν ἀνέπεμψά ⸂σοι αὐτόν, τοῦτʼ ἔστιν τὰ ἐμὰ σπλάγχνα⸃·
verses.translit: on anepempsa soi auton, tout' estin ta ema splaghna*
verses.translation: Whom I have sent again: thou therefore receive him, that is, mine own bowels:

verses.original: ὃν ἐγὼ ἐβουλόμην πρὸς ἐμαυτὸν κατέχειν, ἵνα ὑπὲρ σοῦ ⸂μοι διακονῇ⸃ ἐν τοῖς δεσμοῖς τοῦ εὐαγγελίου,
verses.translit: on ego evoylomin pros emayton katehein, ina uper sou moi diakone en tois desmois tou euaggelioy,
verses.translation: Whom I would have retained with me, that in thy stead he might have ministered unto me in the bonds of the gospel:

verses.original: χωρὶς δὲ τῆς σῆς γνώμης οὐδὲν ἠθέλησα ποιῆσαι, ἵνα μὴ ὡς κατὰ ἀνάγκην τὸ ἀγαθόν σου ᾖ ἀλλὰ κατὰ ἑκούσιον·
verses.translit: horis de tes ses gnomis ouden ethelisa poiesai, ina me os kata anagkin to agathon soy e alla kata ekoysion*
verses.translation: But without thy mind would I do nothing; that thy benefit should not be as it were of necessity, but willingly.

verses.original: τάχα γὰρ διὰ τοῦτο ἐχωρίσθη πρὸς ὥραν ἵνα αἰώνιον αὐτὸν ἀπέχῃς,
verses.translit: taha gar dia touto ehoristhi pros oran ina aionion auton apehes,
verses.translation: For perhaps he therefore departed for a season, that thou shouldest receive him for ever;

verses.original: οὐκέτι ὡς δοῦλον ἀλλὰ ὑπὲρ δοῦλον, ἀδελφὸν ἀγαπητόν, μάλιστα ἐμοί, πόσῳ δὲ μᾶλλον σοὶ καὶ ἐν σαρκὶ καὶ ἐν κυρίῳ.
verses.translit: ouketi os doulon alla uper doulon, adelfon agapiton, malista emoi, poso de mallon soi kai en sarki kai en kyrio.
verses.translation: Not now as a servant, but above a servant, a brother beloved, specially to me, but how much more unto thee, both in the flesh, and in the Lord?

verses.original: Εἰ οὖν με ἔχεις κοινωνόν, προσλαβοῦ αὐτὸν ὡς ἐμέ.
verses.translit: Ei oun me eheis koinonon, proslavou auton os eme.
verses.translation: If thou count me therefore a partner, receive him as myself.

verses.original: εἰ δέ τι ἠδίκησέν σε ἢ ὀφείλει, τοῦτο ἐμοὶ ⸀ἐλλόγα·
verses.translit: ei de ti edikisen se e ofeilei, touto emoi elloga*
verses.translation: If he hath wronged thee, or oweth thee ought, put that on mine account;

verses.original: ἐγὼ Παῦλος ἔγραψα τῇ ἐμῇ χειρί, ἐγὼ ἀποτίσω· ἵνα μὴ λέγω σοι ὅτι καὶ σεαυτόν μοι προσοφείλεις.
verses.translit: ego Paulos egrapsa te eme heiri, ego apotiso* ina me lego soi oti kai seayton moi prosofeileis.
verses.translation: I Paul have written it with mine own hand, I will repay it : albeit I do not say to thee how thou owest unto me even thine own self besides.

verses.original: ναί, ἀδελφέ, ἐγώ σου ὀναίμην ἐν κυρίῳ· ἀνάπαυσόν μου τὰ σπλάγχνα ἐν ⸀Χριστῷ.
verses.translit: nai, adelfe, ego soy onaimin en kyrio* anapayson moy ta splaghna en Hristo.
verses.translation: Yea, brother, let me have joy of thee in the Lord: refresh my bowels in the Lord.

verses.original: πεποιθὼς τῇ ὑπακοῇ σου ἔγραψά σοι, εἰδὼς ὅτι καὶ ὑπὲρ ⸀ἃ λέγω ποιήσεις.
verses.translit: pepoithos te upakoe soy egrapsa soi, eidos oti kai uper a lego poiiseis.
verses.translation: Having confidence in thy obedience I wrote unto thee, knowing that thou wilt also do more than I say.

verses.original: ἅμα δὲ καὶ ἑτοίμαζέ μοι ξενίαν, ἐλπίζω γὰρ ὅτι διὰ τῶν προσευχῶν ὑμῶν χαρισθήσομαι ὑμῖν.
verses.translit: ama de kai etoimaze moi xenian, elpizo gar oti dia ton proseyhon umon haristhisomai umin.
verses.translation: But withal prepare me also a lodging: for I trust that through your prayers I shall be given unto you.

verses.original: ⸀Ἀσπάζεταί σε Ἐπαφρᾶς ὁ συναιχμάλωτός μου ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ,
verses.translit: Aspazetai se Epafras o synaihmalotos moy en Hristo Iisou,
verses.translation: There salute thee Epaphras, my fellowprisoner in Christ Jesus;

verses.original: Μᾶρκος, Ἀρίσταρχος, Δημᾶς, Λουκᾶς, οἱ συνεργοί μου.
verses.translit: Markos, Aristarhos, Dimas, Loykas, oi synergoi moy.
verses.translation: Marcus, Aristarchus, Demas, Lucas, my fellowlabourers.

verses.original: Ἡ χάρις τοῦ ⸀κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ μετὰ τοῦ πνεύματος ⸀ὑμῶν.
verses.translit: E haris tou kyrioy Iisou Hristou meta tou pneymatos umon.
verses.translation: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.

verses.original: Πολυμερῶς καὶ πολυτρόπως πάλαι ὁ θεὸς λαλήσας τοῖς πατράσιν ἐν τοῖς προφήταις
verses.translit: Polymeros kai polytropos palai o theos lalisas tois patrasin en tois profitais
verses.translation: God, who at sundry times and in divers manners spake in time past unto the fathers by the prophets,

verses.original: ἐπʼ ἐσχάτου τῶν ἡμερῶν τούτων ἐλάλησεν ἡμῖν ἐν υἱῷ, ὃν ἔθηκεν κληρονόμον πάντων, διʼ οὗ καὶ ⸂ἐποίησεν τοὺς αἰῶνας⸃·
verses.translit: ep' eshatoy ton emeron toyton elalisen emin en yio, on ethiken klironomon panton, di' ou kai epoiisen tous aionas*
verses.translation: Hath in these last days spoken unto us by his Son, whom he hath appointed heir of all things, by whom also he made the worlds;

verses.original: ὃς ὢν ἀπαύγασμα τῆς δόξης καὶ χαρακτὴρ τῆς ὑποστάσεως αὐτοῦ, φέρων τε τὰ πάντα τῷ ῥήματι τῆς δυνάμεως, ⸂διʼ αὑτοῦ⸃ καθαρισμὸν ⸂τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν ποιησάμενος⸃ ἐκάθισεν ἐν δεξιᾷ τῆς μεγαλωσύνης ἐν ὑψηλοῖς,
verses.translit: os on apaygasma tes doxis kai harakter tes upostaseos autou, feron te ta panta to Rimati tes dynameos, di' autou katharismon ton amartion poiisamenos ekathisen en dexia tes megalosynis en upsilois,
verses.translation: Who being the brightness of his glory, and the express image of his person, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself purged our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high;

verses.original: τοσούτῳ κρείττων γενόμενος τῶν ἀγγέλων ὅσῳ διαφορώτερον παρʼ αὐτοὺς κεκληρονόμηκεν ὄνομα.
verses.translit: tosoyto kreitton genomenos ton aggelon oso diaforoteron par' autous keklironomiken onoma.
verses.translation: Being made so much better than the angels, as he hath by inheritance obtained a more excellent name than they.

verses.original: Τίνι γὰρ εἶπέν ποτε τῶν ἀγγέλων· Υἱός μου εἶ σύ, ἐγὼ σήμερον γεγέννηκά σε, καὶ πάλιν· Ἐγὼ ἔσομαι αὐτῷ εἰς πατέρα, καὶ αὐτὸς ἔσται μοι εἰς υἱόν;
verses.translit: Tini gar eipen pote ton aggelon* Yios moy ei sy, ego simeron gegennika se, kai palin* Ego esomai auto eis patera, kai autos estai moi eis yion;
verses.translation: For unto which of the angels said he at any time, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee? And again, I will be to him a Father, and he shall be to me a Son?

verses.original: ὅταν δὲ πάλιν εἰσαγάγῃ τὸν πρωτότοκον εἰς τὴν οἰκουμένην, λέγει· Καὶ προσκυνησάτωσαν αὐτῷ πάντες ἄγγελοι θεοῦ.
verses.translit: otan de palin eisagage ton prototokon eis ten oikoymenin, legei* Kai proskynisatosan auto pantes aggeloi theou.
verses.translation: And again, when he bringeth in the firstbegotten into the world, he saith, And let all the angels of God worship him.

verses.original: καὶ πρὸς μὲν τοὺς ἀγγέλους λέγει· Ὁ ποιῶν τοὺς ἀγγέλους αὐτοῦ πνεύματα, καὶ τοὺς λειτουργοὺς αὐτοῦ πυρὸς φλόγα·
verses.translit: kai pros men tous aggeloys legei* O poion tous aggeloys autou pneymata, kai tous leitoyrgous autou pyros floga*
verses.translation: And of the angels he saith, Who maketh his angels spirits, and his ministers a flame of fire.

verses.original: πρὸς δὲ τὸν υἱόν· Ὁ θρόνος σου ὁ θεὸς εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τοῦ αἰῶνος, ⸂καὶ ἡ ῥάβδος τῆς εὐθύτητος⸃ ῥάβδος τῆς βασιλείας ⸀σου.
verses.translit: pros de ton yion* O thronos soy o theos eis ton aiona tou aionos, kai e Ravdos tes euthytitos Ravdos tes vasileias soy.
verses.translation: But unto the Son he saith , Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: a sceptre of righteousness is the sceptre of thy kingdom.

verses.original: ἠγάπησας δικαιοσύνην καὶ ἐμίσησας ἀνομίαν· διὰ τοῦτο ἔχρισέν σε ὁ θεός, ὁ θεός σου, ἔλαιον ἀγαλλιάσεως παρὰ τοὺς μετόχους σου·
verses.translit: egapisas dikaiosynin kai emisisas anomian* dia touto ehrisen se o theos, o theos soy, elaion agalliaseos para tous metohoys soy*
verses.translation: Thou hast loved righteousness, and hated iniquity; therefore God, even thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.

verses.original: καί· Σὺ κατʼ ἀρχάς, κύριε, τὴν γῆν ἐθεμελίωσας, καὶ ἔργα τῶν χειρῶν σού εἰσιν οἱ οὐρανοί·
verses.translit: kai* Su kat' arhas, kyrie, ten gen ethemeliosas, kai erga ton heiron soy eisin oi ouranoi*
verses.translation: And, Thou, Lord, in the beginning hast laid the foundation of the earth; and the heavens are the works of thine hands:

verses.original: αὐτοὶ ἀπολοῦνται, σὺ δὲ διαμένεις· καὶ πάντες ὡς ἱμάτιον παλαιωθήσονται,
verses.translit: autoi apolountai, su de diameneis* kai pantes os imation palaiothisontai,
verses.translation: They shall perish; but thou remainest; and they all shall wax old as doth a garment;

verses.original: καὶ ὡσεὶ περιβόλαιον ἑλίξεις αὐτούς, ⸂ὡς ἱμάτιον⸃ καὶ ἀλλαγήσονται· σὺ δὲ ὁ αὐτὸς εἶ, καὶ τὰ ἔτη σου οὐκ ἐκλείψουσιν.
verses.translit: kai osei perivolaion elixeis autoys, os imation kai allagisontai* su de o autos ei, kai ta eti soy ouk ekleipsoysin.
verses.translation: And as a vesture shalt thou fold them up, and they shall be changed: but thou art the same, and thy years shall not fail.

verses.original: πρὸς τίνα δὲ τῶν ἀγγέλων εἴρηκέν ποτε· Κάθου ἐκ δεξιῶν μου ἕως ἂν θῶ τοὺς ἐχθρούς σου ὑποπόδιον τῶν ποδῶν σου;
verses.translit: pros tina de ton aggelon eiriken pote* Kathoy ek dexion moy eos an tho tous ehthroys soy upopodion ton podon soy;
verses.translation: But to which of the angels said he at any time, Sit on my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool?

verses.original: οὐχὶ πάντες εἰσὶν λειτουργικὰ πνεύματα εἰς διακονίαν ἀποστελλόμενα διὰ τοὺς μέλλοντας κληρονομεῖν σωτηρίαν;
verses.translit: ouhi pantes eisin leitoyrgika pneymata eis diakonian apostellomena dia tous mellontas klironomein sotirian;
verses.translation: Are they not all ministering spirits, sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation?

verses.original: Διὰ τοῦτο δεῖ περισσοτέρως ⸂προσέχειν ἡμᾶς⸃ τοῖς ἀκουσθεῖσιν, μήποτε παραρυῶμεν.
verses.translit: Dia touto dei perissoteros prosehein emas tois akoystheisin, mipote pararyomen.
verses.translation: Therefore we ought to give the more earnest heed to the things which we have heard, lest at any time we should let them slip.

verses.original: εἰ γὰρ ὁ διʼ ἀγγέλων λαληθεὶς λόγος ἐγένετο βέβαιος, καὶ πᾶσα παράβασις καὶ παρακοὴ ἔλαβεν ἔνδικον μισθαποδοσίαν,
verses.translit: ei gar o di' aggelon lalitheis logos egeneto vevaios, kai pasa paravasis kai parakoe elaven endikon misthapodosian,
verses.translation: For if the word spoken by angels was stedfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just recompence of reward;

verses.original: πῶς ἡμεῖς ἐκφευξόμεθα τηλικαύτης ἀμελήσαντες σωτηρίας, ἥτις, ἀρχὴν λαβοῦσα λαλεῖσθαι διὰ τοῦ κυρίου, ὑπὸ τῶν ἀκουσάντων εἰς ἡμᾶς ἐβεβαιώθη,
verses.translit: pos emeis ekfeyxometha tilikaytis amelisantes sotirias, etis, arhen lavousa laleisthai dia tou kyrioy, upo ton akoysanton eis emas evevaiothi,
verses.translation: How shall we escape, if we neglect so great salvation; which at the first began to be spoken by the Lord, and was confirmed unto us by them that heard him ;

verses.original: συνεπιμαρτυροῦντος τοῦ θεοῦ σημείοις τε καὶ τέρασιν καὶ ποικίλαις δυνάμεσιν καὶ πνεύματος ἁγίου μερισμοῖς κατὰ τὴν αὐτοῦ θέλησιν;
verses.translit: synepimartyrountos tou theou simeiois te kai terasin kai poikilais dynamesin kai pneymatos agioy merismois kata ten autou thelisin;
verses.translation: God also bearing them witness, both with signs and wonders, and with divers miracles, and gifts of the Holy Ghost, according to his own will?

verses.original: Οὐ γὰρ ἀγγέλοις ὑπέταξεν τὴν οἰκουμένην τὴν μέλλουσαν, περὶ ἧς λαλοῦμεν·
verses.translit: Ou gar aggelois upetaxen ten oikoymenin ten melloysan, peri es laloumen*
verses.translation: For unto the angels hath he not put in subjection the world to come, whereof we speak.

verses.original: διεμαρτύρατο δέ πού τις λέγων· Τί ἐστιν ἄνθρωπος ὅτι μιμνῄσκῃ αὐτοῦ, ἢ υἱὸς ἀνθρώπου ὅτι ἐπισκέπτῃ αὐτόν;
verses.translit: diemartyrato de poy tis legon* Ti estin anthropos oti mimneske autou, e yios anthropoy oti episkepte auton;
verses.translation: But one in a certain place testified, saying, What is man, that thou art mindful of him? or the son of man, that thou visitest him?

verses.original: ἠλάττωσας αὐτὸν βραχύ τι παρʼ ἀγγέλους, δόξῃ καὶ τιμῇ ἐστεφάνωσας ⸀αὐτόν,
verses.translit: elattosas auton vrahy ti par' aggeloys, doxe kai time estefanosas auton,
verses.translation: Thou madest him a little lower than the angels; thou crownedst him with glory and honour, and didst set him over the works of thy hands:

verses.original: πάντα ὑπέταξας ὑποκάτω τῶν ποδῶν αὐτοῦ· ἐν ⸂τῷ γὰρ⸃ ⸀ὑποτάξαι τὰ πάντα οὐδὲν ἀφῆκεν αὐτῷ ἀνυπότακτον. νῦν δὲ οὔπω ὁρῶμεν αὐτῷ τὰ πάντα ὑποτεταγμένα·
verses.translit: panta upetaxas upokato ton podon autou* en to gar upotaxai ta panta ouden afeken auto anypotakton. nun de oupo oromen auto ta panta upotetagmena*
verses.translation: Thou hast put all things in subjection under his feet. For in that he put all in subjection under him, he left nothing that is not put under him. But now we see not yet all things put under him.

verses.original: τὸν δὲ βραχύ τι παρʼ ἀγγέλους ἠλαττωμένον βλέπομεν Ἰησοῦν διὰ τὸ πάθημα τοῦ θανάτου δόξῃ καὶ τιμῇ ἐστεφανωμένον, ὅπως ⸀χωρὶς θεοῦ ὑπὲρ παντὸς γεύσηται θανάτου.
verses.translit: ton de vrahy ti par' aggeloys elattomenon vlepomen Iisoun dia to pathima tou thanatoy doxe kai time estefanomenon, opos horis theou uper pantos geysitai thanatoy.
verses.translation: But we see Jesus, who was made a little lower than the angels for the suffering of death, crowned with glory and honour; that he by the grace of God should taste death for every man.

verses.original: Ἔπρεπεν γὰρ αὐτῷ, διʼ ὃν τὰ πάντα καὶ διʼ οὗ τὰ πάντα, πολλοὺς υἱοὺς εἰς δόξαν ἀγαγόντα τὸν ἀρχηγὸν τῆς σωτηρίας αὐτῶν διὰ παθημάτων τελειῶσαι.
verses.translit: Eprepen gar auto, di' on ta panta kai di' ou ta panta, pollous yious eis doxan agagonta ton arhigon tes sotirias auton dia pathimaton teleiosai.
verses.translation: For it became him, for whom are all things, and by whom are all things, in bringing many sons unto glory, to make the captain of their salvation perfect through sufferings.

verses.original: ὅ τε γὰρ ἁγιάζων καὶ οἱ ἁγιαζόμενοι ἐξ ἑνὸς πάντες· διʼ ἣν αἰτίαν οὐκ ἐπαισχύνεται ἀδελφοὺς αὐτοὺς καλεῖν,
verses.translit: o te gar agiazon kai oi agiazomenoi ex enos pantes* di' en aitian ouk epaishynetai adelfous autous kalein,
verses.translation: For both he that sanctifieth and they who are sanctified are all of one: for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brethren,

verses.original: λέγων· Ἀπαγγελῶ τὸ ὄνομά σου τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς μου, ἐν μέσῳ ἐκκλησίας ὑμνήσω σε·
verses.translit: legon* Apaggelo to onoma soy tois adelfois moy, en meso ekklisias umniso se*
verses.translation: Saying, I will declare thy name unto my brethren, in the midst of the church will I sing praise unto thee.

verses.original: καὶ πάλιν· Ἐγὼ ἔσομαι πεποιθὼς ἐπʼ αὐτῷ· καὶ πάλιν· Ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ καὶ τὰ παιδία ἅ μοι ἔδωκεν ὁ θεός.
verses.translit: kai palin* Ego esomai pepoithos ep' auto* kai palin* Idou ego kai ta paidia a moi edoken o theos.
verses.translation: And again, I will put my trust in him. And again, Behold I and the children which God hath given me.

verses.original: Ἐπεὶ οὖν τὰ παιδία κεκοινώνηκεν ⸂αἵματος καὶ σαρκός⸃, καὶ αὐτὸς παραπλησίως μετέσχεν τῶν αὐτῶν, ἵνα διὰ τοῦ θανάτου καταργήσῃ τὸν τὸ κράτος ἔχοντα τοῦ θανάτου, τοῦτʼ ἔστι τὸν διάβολον,
verses.translit: Epei oun ta paidia kekoinoniken aimatos kai sarkos, kai autos paraplisios meteshen ton auton, ina dia tou thanatoy katargise ton to kratos ehonta tou thanatoy, tout' esti ton diavolon,
verses.translation: Forasmuch then as the children are partakers of flesh and blood, he also himself likewise took part of the same; that through death he might destroy him that had the power of death, that is, the devil;

verses.original: καὶ ἀπαλλάξῃ τούτους, ὅσοι φόβῳ θανάτου διὰ παντὸς τοῦ ζῆν ἔνοχοι ἦσαν δουλείας.
verses.translit: kai apallaxe toytoys, osoi fovo thanatoy dia pantos tou zen enohoi esan doyleias.
verses.translation: And deliver them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.

verses.original: οὐ γὰρ δήπου ἀγγέλων ἐπιλαμβάνεται, ἀλλὰ σπέρματος Ἀβραὰμ ἐπιλαμβάνεται.
verses.translit: ou gar dipoy aggelon epilamvanetai, alla spermatos Avraam epilamvanetai.
verses.translation: For verily he took not on him the nature of angels; but he took on him the seed of Abraham.

verses.original: ὅθεν ὤφειλεν κατὰ πάντα τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς ὁμοιωθῆναι, ἵνα ἐλεήμων γένηται καὶ πιστὸς ἀρχιερεὺς τὰ πρὸς τὸν θεόν, εἰς τὸ ἱλάσκεσθαι τὰς ἁμαρτίας τοῦ λαοῦ·
verses.translit: othen ofeilen kata panta tois adelfois omoiothenai, ina eleimon genitai kai pistos arhiereus ta pros ton theon, eis to ilaskesthai tas amartias tou laou*
verses.translation: Wherefore in all things it behoved him to be made like unto his brethren, that he might be a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make reconciliation for the sins of the people.

verses.original: ἐν ᾧ γὰρ πέπονθεν αὐτὸς πειρασθείς, δύναται τοῖς πειραζομένοις βοηθῆσαι.
verses.translit: en o gar peponthen autos peirastheis, dynatai tois peirazomenois voithesai.
verses.translation: For in that he himself hath suffered being tempted, he is able to succour them that are tempted.

verses.original: Ὅθεν, ἀδελφοὶ ἅγιοι, κλήσεως ἐπουρανίου μέτοχοι, κατανοήσατε τὸν ἀπόστολον καὶ ἀρχιερέα τῆς ὁμολογίας ἡμῶν ⸀Ἰησοῦν,
verses.translit: Othen, adelfoi agioi, kliseos epoyranioy metohoi, katanoisate ton apostolon kai arhierea tes omologias emon Iisoun,
verses.translation: Wherefore, holy brethren, partakers of the heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our profession, Christ Jesus;

verses.original: πιστὸν ὄντα τῷ ποιήσαντι αὐτὸν ὡς καὶ Μωϋσῆς ⸀ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ αὐτοῦ.
verses.translit: piston onta to poiisanti auton os kai Moyses en to oiko autou.
verses.translation: Who was faithful to him that appointed him, as also Moses was faithful in all his house.

verses.original: πλείονος γὰρ ⸂οὗτος δόξης⸃ παρὰ Μωϋσῆν ἠξίωται καθʼ ὅσον πλείονα τιμὴν ἔχει τοῦ οἴκου ὁ κατασκευάσας αὐτόν·
verses.translit: pleionos gar outos doxis para Moysen exiotai kath' oson pleiona timen ehei tou oikoy o kataskeyasas auton*
verses.translation: For this man was counted worthy of more glory than Moses, inasmuch as he who hath builded the house hath more honour than the house.

verses.original: πᾶς γὰρ οἶκος κατασκευάζεται ὑπό τινος, ὁ ⸀δὲ πάντα κατασκευάσας θεός.
verses.translit: pas gar oikos kataskeyazetai upo tinos, o de panta kataskeyasas theos.
verses.translation: For every house is builded by some man ; but he that built all things is God.

verses.original: καὶ Μωϋσῆς μὲν πιστὸς ἐν ὅλῳ τῷ οἴκῳ αὐτοῦ ὡς θεράπων εἰς μαρτύριον τῶν λαληθησομένων,
verses.translit: kai Moyses men pistos en olo to oiko autou os therapon eis martyrion ton lalithisomenon,
verses.translation: And Moses verily was faithful in all his house, as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were to be spoken after;

verses.original: Χριστὸς δὲ ὡς υἱὸς ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ· ⸀ὃς οἶκός ἐσμεν ἡμεῖς, ⸀ἐὰν τὴν παρρησίαν καὶ τὸ καύχημα τῆς ⸀ἐλπίδος κατάσχωμεν.
verses.translit: Hristos de os yios epi ton oikon autou* os oikos esmen emeis, ean ten parrisian kai to kayhima tes elpidos katashomen.
verses.translation: But Christ as a son over his own house; whose house are we, if we hold fast the confidence and the rejoicing of the hope firm unto the end.

verses.original: Διό, καθὼς λέγει τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἅγιον· Σήμερον ἐὰν τῆς φωνῆς αὐτοῦ ἀκούσητε,
verses.translit: Dio, kathos legei to pneuma to agion* Simeron ean tes fones autou akoysite,
verses.translation: Wherefore (as the Holy Ghost saith, To day if ye will hear his voice,

verses.original: μὴ σκληρύνητε τὰς καρδίας ὑμῶν ὡς ἐν τῷ παραπικρασμῷ, κατὰ τὴν ἡμέραν τοῦ πειρασμοῦ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ,
verses.translit: me sklirynite tas kardias umon os en to parapikrasmo, kata ten emeran tou peirasmou en te erimo,
verses.translation: Harden not your hearts, as in the provocation, in the day of temptation in the wilderness:

verses.original: οὗ ⸀ἐπείρασαν οἱ πατέρες ὑμῶν ⸂ἐν δοκιμασίᾳ⸃ καὶ εἶδον τὰ ἔργα μου
verses.translit: ou epeirasan oi pateres umon en dokimasia kai eidon ta erga moy
verses.translation: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my works forty years.

verses.original: τεσσεράκοντα ἔτη· διὸ προσώχθισα τῇ γενεᾷ ⸀ταύτῃ καὶ εἶπον· Ἀεὶ πλανῶνται τῇ καρδίᾳ· αὐτοὶ δὲ οὐκ ἔγνωσαν τὰς ὁδούς μου·
verses.translit: tesserakonta eti* dio prosohthisa te genea tayte kai eipon* Aei planontai te kardia* autoi de ouk egnosan tas odoys moy*
verses.translation: Wherefore I was grieved with that generation, and said, They do alway err in their heart; and they have not known my ways.

verses.original: ὡς ὤμοσα ἐν τῇ ὀργῇ μου· Εἰ εἰσελεύσονται εἰς τὴν κατάπαυσίν μου.
verses.translit: os omosa en te orge moy* Ei eiseleysontai eis ten katapaysin moy.
verses.translation: So I sware in my wrath, They shall not enter into my rest.)

verses.original: βλέπετε, ἀδελφοί, μήποτε ἔσται ἔν τινι ὑμῶν καρδία πονηρὰ ἀπιστίας ἐν τῷ ἀποστῆναι ἀπὸ θεοῦ ζῶντος,
verses.translit: vlepete, adelfoi, mipote estai en tini umon kardia ponira apistias en to apostenai apo theou zontos,
verses.translation: Take heed, brethren, lest there be in any of you an evil heart of unbelief, in departing from the living God.

verses.original: ἀλλὰ παρακαλεῖτε ἑαυτοὺς καθʼ ἑκάστην ἡμέραν, ἄχρις οὗ τὸ Σήμερον καλεῖται, ἵνα μὴ σκληρυνθῇ ⸂τις ἐξ ὑμῶν⸃ ἀπάτῃ τῆς ἁμαρτίας·
verses.translit: alla parakaleite eaytous kath' ekastin emeran, ahris ou to Simeron kaleitai, ina me sklirynthe tis ex umon apate tes amartias*
verses.translation: But exhort one another daily, while it is called To day; lest any of you be hardened through the deceitfulness of sin.

verses.original: μέτοχοι γὰρ ⸂τοῦ Χριστοῦ γεγόναμεν⸃, ἐάνπερ τὴν ἀρχὴν τῆς ὑποστάσεως μέχρι τέλους βεβαίαν κατάσχωμεν.
verses.translit: metohoi gar tou Hristou gegonamen, eanper ten arhen tes upostaseos mehri teloys vevaian katashomen.
verses.translation: For we are made partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence stedfast unto the end;

verses.original: ἐν τῷ λέγεσθαι· Σήμερον ἐὰν τῆς φωνῆς αὐτοῦ ἀκούσητε, Μὴ σκληρύνητε τὰς καρδίας ὑμῶν ὡς ἐν τῷ παραπικρασμῷ.
verses.translit: en to legesthai* Simeron ean tes fones autou akoysite, Me sklirynite tas kardias umon os en to parapikrasmo.
verses.translation: While it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts, as in the provocation.

verses.original: τίνες γὰρ ἀκούσαντες παρεπίκραναν; ἀλλʼ οὐ πάντες οἱ ἐξελθόντες ἐξ Αἰγύπτου διὰ Μωϋσέως;
verses.translit: tines gar akoysantes parepikranan; all' ou pantes oi exelthontes ex Aigyptoy dia Moyseos;
verses.translation: For some, when they had heard, did provoke: howbeit not all that came out of Egypt by Moses.

verses.original: τίσιν δὲ προσώχθισεν τεσσεράκοντα ἔτη; οὐχὶ τοῖς ἁμαρτήσασιν, ὧν τὰ κῶλα ἔπεσεν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ;
verses.translit: tisin de prosohthisen tesserakonta eti; ouhi tois amartisasin, on ta kola epesen en te erimo;
verses.translation: But with whom was he grieved forty years? was it not with them that had sinned, whose carcases fell in the wilderness?

verses.original: τίσιν δὲ ὤμοσεν μὴ εἰσελεύσεσθαι εἰς τὴν κατάπαυσιν αὐτοῦ εἰ μὴ τοῖς ἀπειθήσασιν;
verses.translit: tisin de omosen me eiseleysesthai eis ten katapaysin autou ei me tois apeithisasin;
verses.translation: And to whom sware he that they should not enter into his rest, but to them that believed not?

verses.original: καὶ βλέπομεν ὅτι οὐκ ἠδυνήθησαν εἰσελθεῖν διʼ ἀπιστίαν.
verses.translit: kai vlepomen oti ouk edynithisan eiselthein di' apistian.
verses.translation: So we see that they could not enter in because of unbelief.

verses.original: Φοβηθῶμεν οὖν μήποτε καταλειπομένης ἐπαγγελίας εἰσελθεῖν εἰς τὴν κατάπαυσιν αὐτοῦ δοκῇ τις ἐξ ὑμῶν ὑστερηκέναι·
verses.translit: Fovithomen oun mipote kataleipomenis epaggelias eiselthein eis ten katapaysin autou doke tis ex umon usterikenai*
verses.translation: Let us therefore fear, lest, a promise being left us of entering into his rest, any of you should seem to come short of it.

verses.original: καὶ γάρ ἐσμεν εὐηγγελισμένοι καθάπερ κἀκεῖνοι, ἀλλʼ οὐκ ὠφέλησεν ὁ λόγος τῆς ἀκοῆς ἐκείνους, μὴ ⸀συγκεκερασμένους τῇ πίστει τοῖς ἀκούσασιν.
verses.translit: kai gar esmen euiggelismenoi kathaper kakeinoi, all' ouk ofelisen o logos tes akoes ekeinoys, me sygkekerasmenoys te pistei tois akoysasin.
verses.translation: For unto us was the gospel preached, as well as unto them: but the word preached did not profit them, not being mixed with faith in them that heard it .

verses.original: εἰσερχόμεθα γὰρ ⸀εἰς κατάπαυσιν οἱ πιστεύσαντες, καθὼς εἴρηκεν· Ὡς ὤμοσα ἐν τῇ ὀργῇ μου, Εἰ εἰσελεύσονται εἰς τὴν κατάπαυσίν μου, καίτοι τῶν ἔργων ἀπὸ καταβολῆς κόσμου γενηθέντων,
verses.translit: eiserhometha gar eis katapaysin oi pisteysantes, kathos eiriken* Os omosa en te orge moy, Ei eiseleysontai eis ten katapaysin moy, kaitoi ton ergon apo katavoles kosmoy genithenton,
verses.translation: For we which have believed do enter into rest, as he said, As I have sworn in my wrath, if they shall enter into my rest: although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.

verses.original: εἴρηκεν γάρ που περὶ τῆς ἑβδόμης οὕτως· Καὶ κατέπαυσεν ὁ θεὸς ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ἑβδόμῃ ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν ἔργων αὐτοῦ,
verses.translit: eiriken gar poy peri tes evdomis outos* Kai katepaysen o theos en te emera te evdome apo panton ton ergon autou,
verses.translation: For he spake in a certain place of the seventh day on this wise, And God did rest the seventh day from all his works.

verses.original: καὶ ἐν τούτῳ πάλιν· Εἰ εἰσελεύσονται εἰς τὴν κατάπαυσίν μου.
verses.translit: kai en toyto palin* Ei eiseleysontai eis ten katapaysin moy.
verses.translation: And in this place again, If they shall enter into my rest.

verses.original: ἐπεὶ οὖν ἀπολείπεται τινὰς εἰσελθεῖν εἰς αὐτήν, καὶ οἱ πρότερον εὐαγγελισθέντες οὐκ εἰσῆλθον διʼ ἀπείθειαν,
verses.translit: epei oun apoleipetai tinas eiselthein eis autin, kai oi proteron euaggelisthentes ouk eiselthon di' apeitheian,
verses.translation: Seeing therefore it remaineth that some must enter therein, and they to whom it was first preached entered not in because of unbelief:

verses.original: πάλιν τινὰ ὁρίζει ἡμέραν, Σήμερον, ἐν Δαυὶδ λέγων μετὰ τοσοῦτον χρόνον, καθὼς ⸀προείρηται, Σήμερον ἐὰν τῆς φωνῆς αὐτοῦ ἀκούσητε, μὴ σκληρύνητε τὰς καρδίας ὑμῶν·
verses.translit: palin tina orizei emeran, Simeron, en Dayid legon meta tosouton hronon, kathos proeiritai, Simeron ean tes fones autou akoysite, me sklirynite tas kardias umon*
verses.translation: Again, he limiteth a certain day, saying in David, To day, after so long a time; as it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts.

verses.original: εἰ γὰρ αὐτοὺς Ἰησοῦς κατέπαυσεν, οὐκ ἂν περὶ ἄλλης ἐλάλει μετὰ ταῦτα ἡμέρας.
verses.translit: ei gar autous Iisous katepaysen, ouk an peri allis elalei meta tauta emeras.
verses.translation: For if Jesus had given them rest, then would he not afterward have spoken of another day.

verses.original: ἄρα ἀπολείπεται σαββατισμὸς τῷ λαῷ τοῦ θεοῦ·
verses.translit: ara apoleipetai savvatismos to lao tou theou*
verses.translation: There remaineth therefore a rest to the people of God.

verses.original: ὁ γὰρ εἰσελθὼν εἰς τὴν κατάπαυσιν αὐτοῦ καὶ αὐτὸς κατέπαυσεν ἀπὸ τῶν ἔργων αὐτοῦ ὥσπερ ἀπὸ τῶν ἰδίων ὁ θεός.
verses.translit: o gar eiselthon eis ten katapaysin autou kai autos katepaysen apo ton ergon autou osper apo ton idion o theos.
verses.translation: For he that is entered into his rest, he also hath ceased from his own works, as God did from his.

verses.original: σπουδάσωμεν οὖν εἰσελθεῖν εἰς ἐκείνην τὴν κατάπαυσιν, ἵνα μὴ ἐν τῷ αὐτῷ τις ὑποδείγματι πέσῃ τῆς ἀπειθείας.
verses.translit: spoydasomen oun eiselthein eis ekeinin ten katapaysin, ina me en to auto tis upodeigmati pese tes apeitheias.
verses.translation: Let us labour therefore to enter into that rest, lest any man fall after the same example of unbelief.

verses.original: Ζῶν γὰρ ὁ λόγος τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ ἐνεργὴς καὶ τομώτερος ὑπὲρ πᾶσαν μάχαιραν δίστομον καὶ διϊκνούμενος ἄχρι μερισμοῦ ψυχῆς ⸀καὶ πνεύματος, ἁρμῶν τε καὶ μυελῶν, καὶ κριτικὸς ἐνθυμήσεων καὶ ἐννοιῶν καρδίας·
verses.translit: Zon gar o logos tou theou kai energes kai tomoteros uper pasan mahairan distomon kai diiknoymenos ahri merismou psyhes kai pneymatos, armon te kai myelon, kai kritikos enthymiseon kai ennoion kardias*
verses.translation: For the word of God is quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.

verses.original: καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν κτίσις ἀφανὴς ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ, πάντα δὲ γυμνὰ καὶ τετραχηλισμένα τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς αὐτοῦ, πρὸς ὃν ἡμῖν ὁ λόγος.
verses.translit: kai ouk estin ktisis afanes enopion autou, panta de gymna kai tetrahilismena tois ofthalmois autou, pros on emin o logos.
verses.translation: Neither is there any creature that is not manifest in his sight: but all things are naked and opened unto the eyes of him with whom we have to do.

verses.original: Ἔχοντες οὖν ἀρχιερέα μέγαν διεληλυθότα τοὺς οὐρανούς, Ἰησοῦν τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ θεοῦ, κρατῶμεν τῆς ὁμολογίας·
verses.translit: Ehontes oun arhierea megan dielilythota tous ouranoys, Iisoun ton yion tou theou, kratomen tes omologias*
