verses.translation: For it is better, if the will of God be so, that ye suffer for well doing, than for evil doing.

verses.original: ὅτι καὶ Χριστὸς ἅπαξ περὶ ἁμαρτιῶν ⸀ἔπαθεν, δίκαιος ὑπὲρ ἀδίκων, ἵνα ⸀ὑμᾶς προσαγάγῃ τῷ θεῷ, θανατωθεὶς μὲν σαρκὶ ζῳοποιηθεὶς δὲ πνεύματι·
verses.translit: oti kai Hristos apax peri amartion epathen, dikaios uper adikon, ina umas prosagage to theo, thanatotheis men sarki zoopoiitheis de pneymati*
verses.translation: For Christ also hath once suffered for sins, the just for the unjust, that he might bring us to God, being put to death in the flesh, but quickened by the Spirit:

verses.original: ἐν ᾧ καὶ τοῖς ἐν φυλακῇ πνεύμασιν πορευθεὶς ἐκήρυξεν,
verses.translit: en o kai tois en fylake pneymasin poreytheis ekiryxen,
verses.translation: By which also he went and preached unto the spirits in prison;

verses.original: ἀπειθήσασίν ποτε ὅτε ἀπεξεδέχετο ἡ τοῦ θεοῦ μακροθυμία ἐν ἡμέραις Νῶε κατασκευαζομένης κιβωτοῦ εἰς ἣν ⸀ὀλίγοι, τοῦτʼ ἔστιν ὀκτὼ ψυχαί, διεσώθησαν διʼ ὕδατος.
verses.translit: apeithisasin pote ote apexedeheto e tou theou makrothymia en emerais Noe kataskeyazomenis kivotou eis en oligoi, tout' estin okto psyhai, diesothisan di' udatos.
verses.translation: Which sometime were disobedient, when once the longsuffering of God waited in the days of Noah, while the ark was a preparing, wherein few, that is, eight souls were saved by water.

verses.original: ὃ ⸂καὶ ὑμᾶς ἀντίτυπον νῦν⸃ σῴζει βάπτισμα, οὐ σαρκὸς ἀπόθεσις ῥύπου ἀλλὰ συνειδήσεως ἀγαθῆς ἐπερώτημα εἰς θεόν, διʼ ἀναστάσεως Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ,
verses.translit: o kai umas antitypon nun sozei vaptisma, ou sarkos apothesis Rypoy alla syneidiseos agathes eperotima eis theon, di' anastaseos Iisou Hristou,
verses.translation: The like figure whereunto even baptism doth also now save us (not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God,) by the resurrection of Jesus Christ:

verses.original: ὅς ἐστιν ἐν ⸀δεξιᾷ θεοῦ πορευθεὶς εἰς οὐρανὸν ὑποταγέντων αὐτῷ ἀγγέλων καὶ ἐξουσιῶν καὶ δυνάμεων.
verses.translit: os estin en dexia theou poreytheis eis ouranon upotagenton auto aggelon kai exoysion kai dynameon.
verses.translation: Who is gone into heaven, and is on the right hand of God; angels and authorities and powers being made subject unto him.

verses.original: Χριστοῦ οὖν ⸀παθόντος σαρκὶ καὶ ὑμεῖς τὴν αὐτὴν ἔννοιαν ὁπλίσασθε, ὅτι ὁ ⸀παθὼν σαρκὶ πέπαυται ⸀ἁμαρτίας,
verses.translit: Hristou oun pathontos sarki kai umeis ten auten ennoian oplisasthe, oti o pathon sarki pepaytai amartias,
verses.translation: Forasmuch then as Christ hath suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves likewise with the same mind: for he that hath suffered in the flesh hath ceased from sin;

verses.original: εἰς τὸ μηκέτι ἀνθρώπων ἐπιθυμίαις ἀλλὰ θελήματι θεοῦ τὸν ἐπίλοιπον ἐν σαρκὶ βιῶσαι χρόνον.
verses.translit: eis to miketi anthropon epithymiais alla thelimati theou ton epiloipon en sarki viosai hronon.
verses.translation: That he no longer should live the rest of his time in the flesh to the lusts of men, but to the will of God.

verses.original: ἀρκετὸς ⸀γὰρ ὁ παρεληλυθὼς ⸀χρόνος τὸ ⸀βούλημα τῶν ἐθνῶν ⸀κατειργάσθαι, πεπορευμένους ἐν ἀσελγείαις, ἐπιθυμίαις, οἰνοφλυγίαις, κώμοις, πότοις, καὶ ἀθεμίτοις εἰδωλολατρίαις.
verses.translit: arketos gar o parelilythos hronos to voylima ton ethnon kateirgasthai, peporeymenoys en aselgeiais, epithymiais, oinoflygiais, komois, potois, kai athemitois eidololatriais.
verses.translation: For the time past of our life may suffice us to have wrought the will of the Gentiles, when we walked in lasciviousness, lusts, excess of wine, revellings, banquetings, and abominable idolatries:

verses.original: ἐν ᾧ ξενίζονται μὴ συντρεχόντων ὑμῶν εἰς τὴν αὐτὴν τῆς ἀσωτίας ἀνάχυσιν, βλασφημοῦντες·
verses.translit: en o xenizontai me syntrehonton umon eis ten auten tes asotias anahysin, vlasfimountes*
verses.translation: Wherein they think it strange that ye run not with them to the same excess of riot, speaking evil of you :

verses.original: οἳ ἀποδώσουσιν λόγον τῷ ἑτοίμως ⸂ἔχοντι κρῖναι⸃ ζῶντας καὶ νεκρούς·
verses.translit: oi apodosoysin logon to etoimos ehonti krinai zontas kai nekroys*
verses.translation: Who shall give account to him that is ready to judge the quick and the dead.

verses.original: εἰς τοῦτο γὰρ καὶ νεκροῖς εὐηγγελίσθη ἵνα κριθῶσι μὲν κατὰ ἀνθρώπους σαρκὶ ζῶσι δὲ κατὰ θεὸν πνεύματι.
verses.translit: eis touto gar kai nekrois euiggelisthi ina krithosi men kata anthropoys sarki zosi de kata theon pneymati.
verses.translation: For for this cause was the gospel preached also to them that are dead, that they might be judged according to men in the flesh, but live according to God in the spirit.

verses.original: Πάντων δὲ τὸ τέλος ἤγγικεν. σωφρονήσατε οὖν καὶ νήψατε ⸀εἰς προσευχάς·
verses.translit: Panton de to telos eggiken. sofronisate oun kai nipsate eis proseyhas*
verses.translation: But the end of all things is at hand: be ye therefore sober, and watch unto prayer.

verses.original: πρὸ ⸀πάντων τὴν εἰς ἑαυτοὺς ἀγάπην ἐκτενῆ ἔχοντες, ὅτι ἀγάπη ⸀καλύπτει πλῆθος ἁμαρτιῶν·
verses.translit: pro panton ten eis eaytous agapin ektene ehontes, oti agapi kalyptei plethos amartion*
verses.translation: And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves: for charity shall cover the multitude of sins.

verses.original: φιλόξενοι εἰς ἀλλήλους ἄνευ ⸀γογγυσμοῦ·
verses.translit: filoxenoi eis alliloys aney goggysmou*
verses.translation: Use hospitality one to another without grudging.

verses.original: ἕκαστος καθὼς ἔλαβεν χάρισμα, εἰς ἑαυτοὺς αὐτὸ διακονοῦντες ὡς καλοὶ οἰκονόμοι ποικίλης χάριτος θεοῦ·
verses.translit: ekastos kathos elaven harisma, eis eaytous auto diakonountes os kaloi oikonomoi poikilis haritos theou*
verses.translation: As every man hath received the gift, even so minister the same one to another, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God.

verses.original: εἴ τις λαλεῖ, ὡς λόγια θεοῦ· εἴ τις διακονεῖ, ὡς ἐξ ἰσχύος ⸀ἧς χορηγεῖ ὁ θεός· ἵνα ἐν πᾶσιν δοξάζηται ὁ θεὸς διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, ᾧ ἐστιν ἡ δόξα καὶ τὸ κράτος εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων· ἀμήν.
verses.translit: ei tis lalei, os logia theou* ei tis diakonei, os ex ishyos es horigei o theos* ina en pasin doxazitai o theos dia Iisou Hristou, o estin e doxa kai to kratos eis tous aionas ton aionon* amin.
verses.translation: If any man speak, let him speak as the oracles of God; if any man minister, let him do it as of the ability which God giveth: that God in all things may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom be praise and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.

verses.original: Ἀγαπητοί, μὴ ξενίζεσθε τῇ ἐν ὑμῖν πυρώσει πρὸς πειρασμὸν ὑμῖν γινομένῃ ὡς ξένου ὑμῖν συμβαίνοντος,
verses.translit: Agapitoi, me xenizesthe te en umin pyrosei pros peirasmon umin ginomene os xenoy umin symvainontos,
verses.translation: Beloved, think it not strange concerning the fiery trial which is to try you, as though some strange thing happened unto you:

verses.original: ἀλλὰ καθὸ κοινωνεῖτε τοῖς τοῦ Χριστοῦ παθήμασιν χαίρετε, ἵνα καὶ ἐν τῇ ἀποκαλύψει τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ χαρῆτε ἀγαλλιώμενοι.
verses.translit: alla katho koinoneite tois tou Hristou pathimasin hairete, ina kai en te apokalypsei tes doxis autou harete agalliomenoi.
verses.translation: But rejoice, inasmuch as ye are partakers of Christ’s sufferings; that, when his glory shall be revealed, ye may be glad also with exceeding joy.

verses.original: εἰ ὀνειδίζεσθε ἐν ὀνόματι Χριστοῦ, μακάριοι, ὅτι τὸ τῆς δόξης καὶ τὸ τοῦ θεοῦ πνεῦμα ἐφʼ ὑμᾶς ⸀ἀναπαύεται.
verses.translit: ei oneidizesthe en onomati Hristou, makarioi, oti to tes doxis kai to tou theou pneuma ef' umas anapayetai.
verses.translation: If ye be reproached for the name of Christ, happy are ye ; for the spirit of glory and of God resteth upon you: on their part he is evil spoken of, but on your part he is glorified.

verses.original: μὴ γάρ τις ὑμῶν πασχέτω ὡς φονεὺς ἢ κλέπτης ἢ κακοποιὸς ἢ ὡς ἀλλοτριεπίσκοπος·
verses.translit: me gar tis umon pasheto os foneus e kleptis e kakopoios e os allotriepiskopos*
verses.translation: But let none of you suffer as a murderer, or as a thief, or as an evildoer, or as a busybody in other men’s matters.

verses.original: εἰ δὲ ὡς Χριστιανός, μὴ αἰσχυνέσθω, δοξαζέτω δὲ τὸν θεὸν ἐν τῷ ⸀ὀνόματι τούτῳ.
verses.translit: ei de os Hristianos, me aishynestho, doxazeto de ton theon en to onomati toyto.
verses.translation: Yet if any man suffer as a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God on this behalf.

verses.original: ὅτι ὁ καιρὸς τοῦ ἄρξασθαι τὸ κρίμα ἀπὸ τοῦ οἴκου τοῦ θεοῦ· εἰ δὲ πρῶτον ἀφʼ ἡμῶν, τί τὸ τέλος τῶν ἀπειθούντων τῷ τοῦ θεοῦ εὐαγγελίῳ;
verses.translit: oti o kairos tou arxasthai to krima apo tou oikoy tou theou* ei de proton af' emon, ti to telos ton apeithoynton to tou theou euaggelio;
verses.translation: For the time is come that judgment must begin at the house of God: and if it first begin at us, what shall the end be of them that obey not the gospel of God?

verses.original: καὶ εἰ ὁ δίκαιος μόλις σῴζεται, ⸀ὁ ἀσεβὴς καὶ ἁμαρτωλὸς ποῦ φανεῖται;
verses.translit: kai ei o dikaios molis sozetai, o aseves kai amartolos pou faneitai;
verses.translation: And if the righteous scarcely be saved, where shall the ungodly and the sinner appear?

verses.original: ὥστε καὶ οἱ πάσχοντες κατὰ τὸ θέλημα τοῦ ⸀θεοῦ πιστῷ κτίστῃ παρατιθέσθωσαν τὰς ψυχὰς ⸀αὐτῶν ἐν ἀγαθοποιΐᾳ.
verses.translit: oste kai oi pashontes kata to thelima tou theou pisto ktiste paratithesthosan tas psyhas auton en agathopoiIa.
verses.translation: Wherefore let them that suffer according to the will of God commit the keeping of their souls to him in well doing, as unto a faithful Creator.

verses.original: Πρεσβυτέρους ⸀οὖν ἐν ὑμῖν παρακαλῶ ὁ συμπρεσβύτερος καὶ μάρτυς τῶν τοῦ Χριστοῦ παθημάτων, ὁ καὶ τῆς μελλούσης ἀποκαλύπτεσθαι δόξης κοινωνός,
verses.translit: Presvyteroys oun en umin parakalo o sympresvyteros kai martys ton tou Hristou pathimaton, o kai tes melloysis apokalyptesthai doxis koinonos,
verses.translation: The elders which are among you I exhort, who am also an elder, and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and also a partaker of the glory that shall be revealed:

verses.original: ποιμάνατε τὸ ἐν ὑμῖν ποίμνιον τοῦ θεοῦ, ⸀ἐπισκοποῦντες μὴ ἀναγκαστῶς ἀλλὰ ἑκουσίως ⸂κατὰ θεόν⸃, μηδὲ αἰσχροκερδῶς ἀλλὰ προθύμως,
verses.translit: poimanate to en umin poimnion tou theou, episkopountes me anagkastos alla ekoysios kata theon, mide aishrokerdos alla prothymos,
verses.translation: Feed the flock of God which is among you, taking the oversight thereof , not by constraint, but willingly; not for filthy lucre, but of a ready mind;

verses.original: μηδʼ ὡς κατακυριεύοντες τῶν κλήρων ἀλλὰ τύποι γινόμενοι τοῦ ποιμνίου·
verses.translit: mid' os katakyrieyontes ton kliron alla typoi ginomenoi tou poimnioy*
verses.translation: Neither as being lords over God’s heritage, but being ensamples to the flock.

verses.original: καὶ φανερωθέντος τοῦ ἀρχιποίμενος κομιεῖσθε τὸν ἀμαράντινον τῆς δόξης στέφανον.
verses.translit: kai fanerothentos tou arhipoimenos komieisthe ton amarantinon tes doxis stefanon.
verses.translation: And when the chief Shepherd shall appear, ye shall receive a crown of glory that fadeth not away.

verses.original: ὁμοίως, νεώτεροι, ὑποτάγητε πρεσβυτέροις. πάντες δὲ ⸀ἀλλήλοις τὴν ταπεινοφροσύνην ἐγκομβώσασθε, ὅτι Ὁ θεὸς ὑπερηφάνοις ἀντιτάσσεται ταπεινοῖς δὲ δίδωσιν χάριν.
verses.translit: omoios, neoteroi, upotagite presvyterois. pantes de allilois ten tapeinofrosynin egkomvosasthe, oti O theos uperifanois antitassetai tapeinois de didosin harin.
verses.translation: Likewise, ye younger, submit yourselves unto the elder. Yea, all of you be subject one to another, and be clothed with humility: for God resisteth the proud, and giveth grace to the humble.

verses.original: Ταπεινώθητε οὖν ὑπὸ τὴν κραταιὰν χεῖρα τοῦ θεοῦ, ἵνα ὑμᾶς ὑψώσῃ ἐν καιρῷ,
verses.translit: Tapeinothite oun upo ten krataian heira tou theou, ina umas upsose en kairo,
verses.translation: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time:

verses.original: πᾶσαν τὴν μέριμναν ὑμῶν ἐπιρίψαντες ἐπʼ αὐτόν, ὅτι αὐτῷ μέλει περὶ ὑμῶν.
verses.translit: pasan ten merimnan umon epiripsantes ep' auton, oti auto melei peri umon.
verses.translation: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.

verses.original: νήψατε, γρηγορήσατε. ὁ ἀντίδικος ὑμῶν διάβολος ὡς λέων ὠρυόμενος περιπατεῖ ζητῶν ⸀τινα ⸀καταπιεῖν·
verses.translit: nipsate, grigorisate. o antidikos umon diavolos os leon oryomenos peripatei ziton tina katapiein*
verses.translation: Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour:

verses.original: ᾧ ἀντίστητε στερεοὶ τῇ πίστει, εἰδότες τὰ αὐτὰ τῶν παθημάτων τῇ ἐν ⸀τῷ κόσμῳ ὑμῶν ἀδελφότητι ἐπιτελεῖσθαι.
verses.translit: o antistite stereoi te pistei, eidotes ta auta ton pathimaton te en to kosmo umon adelfotiti epiteleisthai.
verses.translation: Whom resist stedfast in the faith, knowing that the same afflictions are accomplished in your brethren that are in the world.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ θεὸς πάσης χάριτος, ὁ καλέσας ὑμᾶς εἰς τὴν αἰώνιον αὐτοῦ δόξαν ἐν ⸀Χριστῷ, ὀλίγον παθόντας αὐτὸς ⸀καταρτίσει, στηρίξει, σθενώσει, ⸀θεμελιώσει.
verses.translit: o de theos pasis haritos, o kalesas umas eis ten aionion autou doxan en Hristo, oligon pathontas autos katartisei, stirixei, sthenosei, themeliosei.
verses.translation: But the God of all grace, who hath called us unto his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after that ye have suffered a while, make you perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle you .

verses.original: ⸀αὐτῷ τὸ κράτος εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας ⸂τῶν αἰώνων⸃· ἀμήν.
verses.translit: auto to kratos eis tous aionas ton aionon* amin.
verses.translation: To him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.

verses.original: Διὰ Σιλουανοῦ ὑμῖν τοῦ πιστοῦ ἀδελφοῦ, ὡς λογίζομαι, διʼ ὀλίγων ἔγραψα, παρακαλῶν καὶ ἐπιμαρτυρῶν ταύτην εἶναι ἀληθῆ χάριν τοῦ θεοῦ· εἰς ἣν ⸀στῆτε.
verses.translit: Dia Siloyanou umin tou pistou adelfou, os logizomai, di' oligon egrapsa, parakalon kai epimartyron taytin einai alithe harin tou theou* eis en stete.
verses.translation: By Silvanus, a faithful brother unto you, as I suppose, I have written briefly, exhorting, and testifying that this is the true grace of God wherein ye stand.

verses.original: ἀσπάζεται ὑμᾶς ἡ ἐν Βαβυλῶνι συνεκλεκτὴ καὶ Μᾶρκος ὁ υἱός μου.
verses.translit: aspazetai umas e en Vavyloni syneklekte kai Markos o yios moy.
verses.translation: The church that is at Babylon, elected together with you , saluteth you; and so doth Marcus my son.

verses.original: ἀσπάσασθε ἀλλήλους ἐν φιλήματι ἀγάπης. εἰρήνη ὑμῖν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἐν ⸀Χριστῷ.
verses.translit: aspasasthe alliloys en filimati agapis. eirini umin pasin tois en Hristo.
verses.translation: Greet ye one another with a kiss of charity. Peace be with you all that are in Christ Jesus. Amen.

verses.original: ⸀Συμεὼν Πέτρος δοῦλος καὶ ἀπόστολος Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τοῖς ἰσότιμον ἡμῖν λαχοῦσιν πίστιν ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν καὶ σωτῆρος Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ·
verses.translit: Symeon Petros doulos kai apostolos Iisou Hristou tois isotimon emin lahousin pistin en dikaiosyne tou theou emon kai soteros Iisou Hristou*
verses.translation: Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ, to them that have obtained like precious faith with us through the righteousness of God and our Saviour Jesus Christ:

verses.original: χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη πληθυνθείη ἐν ἐπιγνώσει τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ Ἰησοῦ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν.
verses.translit: haris umin kai eirini plithyntheii en epignosei tou theou kai Iisou tou kyrioy emon.
verses.translation: Grace and peace be multiplied unto you through the knowledge of God, and of Jesus our Lord,

verses.original: Ὡς πάντα ἡμῖν τῆς θείας δυνάμεως αὐτοῦ τὰ πρὸς ζωὴν καὶ εὐσέβειαν δεδωρημένης διὰ τῆς ἐπιγνώσεως τοῦ καλέσαντος ἡμᾶς ⸂ἰδίᾳ δόξῃ καὶ ἀρετῇ⸃,
verses.translit: Os panta emin tes theias dynameos autou ta pros zoen kai euseveian dedorimenis dia tes epignoseos tou kalesantos emas idia doxe kai arete,
verses.translation: According as his divine power hath given unto us all things that pertain unto life and godliness, through the knowledge of him that hath called us to glory and virtue:

verses.original: διʼ ὧν τὰ ⸂τίμια καὶ μέγιστα ἡμῖν⸃ ἐπαγγέλματα δεδώρηται, ἵνα διὰ τούτων γένησθε θείας κοινωνοὶ φύσεως, ἀποφυγόντες τῆς ἐν ⸀τῷ κόσμῳ ἐν ἐπιθυμίᾳ φθορᾶς.
verses.translit: di' on ta timia kai megista emin epaggelmata dedoritai, ina dia toyton genisthe theias koinonoi fyseos, apofygontes tes en to kosmo en epithymia fthoras.
verses.translation: Whereby are given unto us exceeding great and precious promises: that by these ye might be partakers of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption that is in the world through lust.

verses.original: καὶ αὐτὸ τοῦτο δὲ σπουδὴν πᾶσαν παρεισενέγκαντες ἐπιχορηγήσατε ἐν τῇ πίστει ὑμῶν τὴν ἀρετήν, ἐν δὲ τῇ ἀρετῇ τὴν γνῶσιν,
verses.translit: kai auto touto de spoyden pasan pareisenegkantes epihorigisate en te pistei umon ten aretin, en de te arete ten gnosin,
verses.translation: And beside this, giving all diligence, add to your faith virtue; and to virtue knowledge;

verses.original: ἐν δὲ τῇ γνώσει τὴν ἐγκράτειαν, ἐν δὲ τῇ ἐγκρατείᾳ τὴν ὑπομονήν, ἐν δὲ τῇ ὑπομονῇ τὴν εὐσέβειαν,
verses.translit: en de te gnosei ten egkrateian, en de te egkrateia ten upomonin, en de te upomone ten euseveian,
verses.translation: And to knowledge temperance; and to temperance patience; and to patience godliness;

verses.original: ἐν δὲ τῇ εὐσεβείᾳ τὴν φιλαδελφίαν, ἐν δὲ τῇ φιλαδελφίᾳ τὴν ἀγάπην·
verses.translit: en de te euseveia ten filadelfian, en de te filadelfia ten agapin*
verses.translation: And to godliness brotherly kindness; and to brotherly kindness charity.

verses.original: ταῦτα γὰρ ὑμῖν ὑπάρχοντα καὶ πλεονάζοντα οὐκ ἀργοὺς οὐδὲ ἀκάρπους καθίστησιν εἰς τὴν τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐπίγνωσιν·
verses.translit: tauta gar umin uparhonta kai pleonazonta ouk argous oude akarpoys kathistisin eis ten tou kyrioy emon Iisou Hristou epignosin*
verses.translation: For if these things be in you, and abound, they make you that ye shall neither be barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.original: ᾧ γὰρ μὴ πάρεστιν ταῦτα, τυφλός ἐστιν μυωπάζων, λήθην λαβὼν τοῦ καθαρισμοῦ τῶν πάλαι αὐτοῦ ⸀ἁμαρτημάτων.
verses.translit: o gar me parestin tauta, tyflos estin myopazon, lithin lavon tou katharismou ton palai autou amartimaton.
verses.translation: But he that lacketh these things is blind, and cannot see afar off, and hath forgotten that he was purged from his old sins.

verses.original: διὸ μᾶλλον, ἀδελφοί, σπουδάσατε βεβαίαν ὑμῶν τὴν κλῆσιν καὶ ἐκλογὴν ποιεῖσθαι· ταῦτα γὰρ ποιοῦντες οὐ μὴ πταίσητέ ποτε·
verses.translit: dio mallon, adelfoi, spoydasate vevaian umon ten klesin kai eklogen poieisthai* tauta gar poiountes ou me ptaisite pote*
verses.translation: Wherefore the rather, brethren, give diligence to make your calling and election sure: for if ye do these things, ye shall never fall:

verses.original: οὕτως γὰρ πλουσίως ἐπιχορηγηθήσεται ὑμῖν ἡ εἴσοδος εἰς τὴν αἰώνιον βασιλείαν τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν καὶ σωτῆρος Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.
verses.translit: outos gar ploysios epihorigithisetai umin e eisodos eis ten aionion vasileian tou kyrioy emon kai soteros Iisou Hristou.
verses.translation: For so an entrance shall be ministered unto you abundantly into the everlasting kingdom of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ.

verses.original: Διὸ ⸀μελλήσω ἀεὶ ὑμᾶς ὑπομιμνῄσκειν περὶ τούτων, καίπερ εἰδότας καὶ ἐστηριγμένους ἐν τῇ παρούσῃ ἀληθείᾳ.
verses.translit: Dio melliso aei umas upomimneskein peri toyton, kaiper eidotas kai estirigmenoys en te paroyse alitheia.
verses.translation: Wherefore I will not be negligent to put you always in remembrance of these things, though ye know them , and be established in the present truth.

verses.original: δίκαιον δὲ ἡγοῦμαι, ἐφʼ ὅσον εἰμὶ ἐν τούτῳ τῷ σκηνώματι, διεγείρειν ὑμᾶς ἐν ὑπομνήσει,
verses.translit: dikaion de egoumai, ef' oson eimi en toyto to skinomati, diegeirein umas en upomnisei,
verses.translation: Yea, I think it meet, as long as I am in this tabernacle, to stir you up by putting you in remembrance;

verses.original: εἰδὼς ὅτι ταχινή ἐστιν ἡ ἀπόθεσις τοῦ σκηνώματός μου, καθὼς καὶ ὁ κύριος ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦς Χριστὸς ἐδήλωσέν μοι·
verses.translit: eidos oti tahini estin e apothesis tou skinomatos moy, kathos kai o kyrios emon Iisous Hristos edilosen moi*
verses.translation: Knowing that shortly I must put off this my tabernacle, even as our Lord Jesus Christ hath shewed me.

verses.original: σπουδάσω δὲ καὶ ἑκάστοτε ἔχειν ὑμᾶς μετὰ τὴν ἐμὴν ἔξοδον τὴν τούτων μνήμην ποιεῖσθαι.
verses.translit: spoydaso de kai ekastote ehein umas meta ten emen exodon ten toyton mnimin poieisthai.
verses.translation: Moreover I will endeavour that ye may be able after my decease to have these things always in remembrance.

verses.original: Οὐ γὰρ σεσοφισμένοις μύθοις ἐξακολουθήσαντες ἐγνωρίσαμεν ὑμῖν τὴν τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ δύναμιν καὶ παρουσίαν, ἀλλʼ ἐπόπται γενηθέντες τῆς ἐκείνου μεγαλειότητος.
verses.translit: Ou gar sesofismenois mythois exakoloythisantes egnorisamen umin ten tou kyrioy emon Iisou Hristou dynamin kai paroysian, all' epoptai genithentes tes ekeinoy megaleiotitos.
verses.translation: For we have not followed cunningly devised fables, when we made known unto you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but were eyewitnesses of his majesty.

verses.original: λαβὼν γὰρ παρὰ θεοῦ πατρὸς τιμὴν καὶ δόξαν φωνῆς ἐνεχθείσης αὐτῷ τοιᾶσδε ὑπὸ τῆς μεγαλοπρεποῦς δόξης· ⸂Ὁ υἱός μου ὁ ἀγαπητός μου οὗτός ἐστιν⸃, εἰς ὃν ἐγὼ εὐδόκησα—
verses.translit: lavon gar para theou patros timen kai doxan fones enehtheisis auto toiasde upo tes megaloprepous doxis* O yios moy o agapitos moy outos estin, eis on ego eudokisa--
verses.translation: For he received from God the Father honour and glory, when there came such a voice to him from the excellent glory, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.

verses.original: καὶ ταύτην τὴν φωνὴν ἡμεῖς ἠκούσαμεν ἐξ οὐρανοῦ ἐνεχθεῖσαν σὺν αὐτῷ ὄντες ἐν τῷ ⸂ἁγίῳ ὄρει⸃.
verses.translit: kai taytin ten fonen emeis ekoysamen ex ouranou enehtheisan sun auto ontes en to agio orei.
verses.translation: And this voice which came from heaven we heard, when we were with him in the holy mount.

verses.original: καὶ ἔχομεν βεβαιότερον τὸν προφητικὸν λόγον, ᾧ καλῶς ποιεῖτε προσέχοντες ὡς λύχνῳ φαίνοντι ἐν αὐχμηρῷ τόπῳ, ἕως οὗ ἡμέρα διαυγάσῃ καὶ φωσφόρος ἀνατείλῃ ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις ὑμῶν·
verses.translit: kai ehomen vevaioteron ton profitikon logon, o kalos poieite prosehontes os lyhno fainonti en auhmiro topo, eos ou emera diaygase kai fosforos anateile en tais kardiais umon*
verses.translation: We have also a more sure word of prophecy; whereunto ye do well that ye take heed, as unto a light that shineth in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day star arise in your hearts:

verses.original: τοῦτο πρῶτον γινώσκοντες ὅτι πᾶσα προφητεία γραφῆς ἰδίας ἐπιλύσεως οὐ γίνεται,
verses.translit: touto proton ginoskontes oti pasa profiteia grafes idias epilyseos ou ginetai,
verses.translation: Knowing this first, that no prophecy of the scripture is of any private interpretation.

verses.original: οὐ γὰρ θελήματι ἀνθρώπου ἠνέχθη ⸂προφητεία ποτέ⸃, ἀλλὰ ὑπὸ πνεύματος ἁγίου φερόμενοι ἐλάλησαν ⸀ἀπὸ θεοῦ ἄνθρωποι.
verses.translit: ou gar thelimati anthropoy enehthi profiteia pote, alla upo pneymatos agioy feromenoi elalisan apo theou anthropoi.
verses.translation: For the prophecy came not in old time by the will of man: but holy men of God spake as they were moved by the Holy Ghost.

verses.original: Ἐγένοντο δὲ καὶ ψευδοπροφῆται ἐν τῷ λαῷ, ὡς καὶ ἐν ὑμῖν ἔσονται ψευδοδιδάσκαλοι, οἵτινες παρεισάξουσιν αἱρέσεις ἀπωλείας, καὶ τὸν ἀγοράσαντα αὐτοὺς δεσπότην ἀρνούμενοι, ἐπάγοντες ἑαυτοῖς ταχινὴν ἀπώλειαν·
verses.translit: Egenonto de kai pseydoprofetai en to lao, os kai en umin esontai pseydodidaskaloi, oitines pareisaxoysin aireseis apoleias, kai ton agorasanta autous despotin arnoymenoi, epagontes eaytois tahinen apoleian*
verses.translation: But there were false prophets also among the people, even as there shall be false teachers among you, who privily shall bring in damnable heresies, even denying the Lord that bought them, and bring upon themselves swift destruction.

verses.original: καὶ πολλοὶ ἐξακολουθήσουσιν αὐτῶν ταῖς ἀσελγείαις, διʼ οὓς ἡ ὁδὸς τῆς ἀληθείας βλασφημηθήσεται·
verses.translit: kai polloi exakoloythisoysin auton tais aselgeiais, di' ous e odos tes alitheias vlasfimithisetai*
verses.translation: And many shall follow their pernicious ways; by reason of whom the way of truth shall be evil spoken of.

verses.original: καὶ ἐν πλεονεξίᾳ πλαστοῖς λόγοις ὑμᾶς ἐμπορεύσονται· οἷς τὸ κρίμα ἔκπαλαι οὐκ ἀργεῖ, καὶ ἡ ἀπώλεια αὐτῶν οὐ ⸀νυστάζει.
verses.translit: kai en pleonexia plastois logois umas emporeysontai* ois to krima ekpalai ouk argei, kai e apoleia auton ou nystazei.
verses.translation: And through covetousness shall they with feigned words make merchandise of you: whose judgment now of a long time lingereth not, and their damnation slumbereth not.

verses.original: Εἰ γὰρ ὁ θεὸς ἀγγέλων ἁμαρτησάντων οὐκ ἐφείσατο, ἀλλὰ ⸀σειραῖς ζόφου ταρταρώσας παρέδωκεν εἰς κρίσιν τηρουμένους,
verses.translit: Ei gar o theos aggelon amartisanton ouk efeisato, alla seirais zofoy tartarosas paredoken eis krisin tiroymenoys,
verses.translation: For if God spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment;

verses.original: καὶ ἀρχαίου κόσμου οὐκ ἐφείσατο, ἀλλὰ ὄγδοον Νῶε δικαιοσύνης κήρυκα ἐφύλαξεν, κατακλυσμὸν κόσμῳ ἀσεβῶν ἐπάξας,
verses.translit: kai arhaioy kosmoy ouk efeisato, alla ogdoon Noe dikaiosynis kiryka efylaxen, kataklysmon kosmo asevon epaxas,
verses.translation: And spared not the old world, but saved Noah the eighth person , a preacher of righteousness, bringing in the flood upon the world of the ungodly;

verses.original: καὶ πόλεις Σοδόμων καὶ Γομόρρας τεφρώσας ⸀καταστροφῇ κατέκρινεν, ὑπόδειγμα μελλόντων ⸀ἀσεβέσιν τεθεικώς,
verses.translit: kai poleis Sodomon kai Gomorras tefrosas katastrofe katekrinen, upodeigma mellonton asevesin tetheikos,
verses.translation: And turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrha into ashes condemned them with an overthrow, making them an ensample unto those that after should live ungodly;

verses.original: καὶ δίκαιον Λὼτ καταπονούμενον ὑπὸ τῆς τῶν ἀθέσμων ἐν ἀσελγείᾳ ἀναστροφῆς ἐρρύσατο—
verses.translit: kai dikaion Lot kataponoymenon upo tes ton athesmon en aselgeia anastrofes errysato--
verses.translation: And delivered just Lot, vexed with the filthy conversation of the wicked:

verses.original: βλέμματι γὰρ καὶ ἀκοῇ ⸀ὁ δίκαιος ἐγκατοικῶν ἐν αὐτοῖς ἡμέραν ἐξ ἡμέρας ψυχὴν δικαίαν ἀνόμοις ἔργοις ἐβασάνιζεν—
verses.translit: vlemmati gar kai akoe o dikaios egkatoikon en autois emeran ex emeras psyhen dikaian anomois ergois evasanizen--
verses.translation: (For that righteous man dwelling among them, in seeing and hearing, vexed his righteous soul from day to day with their unlawful deeds;)

verses.original: οἶδεν κύριος εὐσεβεῖς ἐκ πειρασμοῦ ῥύεσθαι, ἀδίκους δὲ εἰς ἡμέραν κρίσεως κολαζομένους τηρεῖν,
verses.translit: oiden kyrios euseveis ek peirasmou Ryesthai, adikoys de eis emeran kriseos kolazomenoys tirein,
verses.translation: The Lord knoweth how to deliver the godly out of temptations, and to reserve the unjust unto the day of judgment to be punished:

verses.original: μάλιστα δὲ τοὺς ὀπίσω σαρκὸς ἐν ἐπιθυμίᾳ μιασμοῦ πορευομένους καὶ κυριότητος καταφρονοῦντας. Τολμηταί, αὐθάδεις, δόξας οὐ τρέμουσιν, βλασφημοῦντες,
verses.translit: malista de tous opiso sarkos en epithymia miasmou poreyomenoys kai kyriotitos katafronountas. Tolmitai, authadeis, doxas ou tremoysin, vlasfimountes,
verses.translation: But chiefly them that walk after the flesh in the lust of uncleanness, and despise government. Presumptuous are they , selfwilled, they are not afraid to speak evil of dignities.

verses.original: ὅπου ἄγγελοι ἰσχύϊ καὶ δυνάμει μείζονες ὄντες οὐ φέρουσιν κατʼ ⸀αὐτῶν βλάσφημον κρίσιν.
verses.translit: opoy aggeloi ishyi kai dynamei meizones ontes ou feroysin kat' auton vlasfimon krisin.
verses.translation: Whereas angels, which are greater in power and might, bring not railing accusation against them before the Lord.

verses.original: οὗτοι δέ, ὡς ἄλογα ζῷα ⸂γεγεννημένα φυσικὰ⸃ εἰς ἅλωσιν καὶ φθοράν, ἐν οἷς ἀγνοοῦσιν βλασφημοῦντες, ἐν τῇ φθορᾷ αὐτῶν ⸂καὶ φθαρήσονται⸃,
verses.translit: outoi de, os aloga zoa gegennimena fysika eis alosin kai fthoran, en ois agnoousin vlasfimountes, en te fthora auton kai ftharisontai,
verses.translation: But these, as natural brute beasts, made to be taken and destroyed, speak evil of the things that they understand not; and shall utterly perish in their own corruption;

verses.original: ⸀ἀδικούμενοι μισθὸν ἀδικίας· ἡδονὴν ἡγούμενοι τὴν ἐν ἡμέρᾳ τρυφήν, σπίλοι καὶ μῶμοι ἐντρυφῶντες ἐν ταῖς ⸀ἀπάταις αὐτῶν συνευωχούμενοι ὑμῖν,
verses.translit: adikoymenoi misthon adikias* edonen egoymenoi ten en emera tryfin, spiloi kai momoi entryfontes en tais apatais auton syneyohoymenoi umin,
verses.translation: And shall receive the reward of unrighteousness, as they that count it pleasure to riot in the day time. Spots they are and blemishes, sporting themselves with their own deceivings while they feast with you;

verses.original: ὀφθαλμοὺς ἔχοντες μεστοὺς μοιχαλίδος καὶ ⸀ἀκαταπαύστους ἁμαρτίας, δελεάζοντες ψυχὰς ἀστηρίκτους, καρδίαν γεγυμνασμένην πλεονεξίας ἔχοντες, κατάρας τέκνα,
verses.translit: ofthalmous ehontes mestous moihalidos kai akatapaystoys amartias, deleazontes psyhas astiriktoys, kardian gegymnasmenin pleonexias ehontes, kataras tekna,
verses.translation: Having eyes full of adultery, and that cannot cease from sin; beguiling unstable souls: an heart they have exercised with covetous practices; cursed children:

verses.original: ⸀καταλιπόντες εὐθεῖαν ὁδὸν ἐπλανήθησαν, ἐξακολουθήσαντες τῇ ὁδῷ τοῦ Βαλαὰμ τοῦ ⸀Βοσὸρ ὃς μισθὸν ἀδικίας ἠγάπησεν
verses.translit: katalipontes eutheian odon eplanithisan, exakoloythisantes te odo tou Valaam tou Vosor os misthon adikias egapisen
verses.translation: Which have forsaken the right way, and are gone astray, following the way of Balaam the son of Bosor, who loved the wages of unrighteousness;

verses.original: ἔλεγξιν δὲ ἔσχεν ἰδίας παρανομίας· ὑποζύγιον ἄφωνον ἐν ἀνθρώπου φωνῇ φθεγξάμενον ἐκώλυσεν τὴν τοῦ προφήτου παραφρονίαν.
verses.translit: elegxin de eshen idias paranomias* upozygion afonon en anthropoy fone fthegxamenon ekolysen ten tou profitoy parafronian.
verses.translation: But was rebuked for his iniquity: the dumb ass speaking with man’s voice forbad the madness of the prophet.

verses.original: Οὗτοί εἰσιν πηγαὶ ἄνυδροι ⸂καὶ ὁμίχλαι⸃ ὑπὸ λαίλαπος ἐλαυνόμεναι, οἷς ὁ ζόφος τοῦ ⸀σκότους τετήρηται.
verses.translit: Outoi eisin pigai anydroi kai omihlai upo lailapos elaynomenai, ois o zofos tou skotoys tetiritai.
verses.translation: These are wells without water, clouds that are carried with a tempest; to whom the mist of darkness is reserved for ever.

verses.original: ὑπέρογκα γὰρ ματαιότητος φθεγγόμενοι δελεάζουσιν ἐν ἐπιθυμίαις σαρκὸς ἀσελγείαις τοὺς ⸀ὀλίγως ⸀ἀποφεύγοντας τοὺς ἐν πλάνῃ ἀναστρεφομένους,
verses.translit: uperogka gar mataiotitos ftheggomenoi deleazoysin en epithymiais sarkos aselgeiais tous oligos apofeygontas tous en plane anastrefomenoys,
verses.translation: For when they speak great swelling words of vanity, they allure through the lusts of the flesh, through much wantonness, those that were clean escaped from them who live in error.

verses.original: ἐλευθερίαν αὐτοῖς ἐπαγγελλόμενοι, αὐτοὶ δοῦλοι ὑπάρχοντες τῆς φθορᾶς· ᾧ γάρ τις ἥττηται, τούτῳ ⸀καὶ δεδούλωται.
verses.translit: eleytherian autois epaggellomenoi, autoi douloi uparhontes tes fthoras* o gar tis ettitai, toyto kai dedoylotai.
verses.translation: While they promise them liberty, they themselves are the servants of corruption: for of whom a man is overcome, of the same is he brought in bondage.

verses.original: εἰ γὰρ ἀποφυγόντες τὰ μιάσματα τοῦ κόσμου ἐν ἐπιγνώσει τοῦ ⸀κυρίου καὶ σωτῆρος Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τούτοις δὲ πάλιν ἐμπλακέντες ἡττῶνται, γέγονεν αὐτοῖς τὰ ἔσχατα χείρονα τῶν πρώτων.
verses.translit: ei gar apofygontes ta miasmata tou kosmoy en epignosei tou kyrioy kai soteros Iisou Hristou toytois de palin emplakentes ettontai, gegonen autois ta eshata heirona ton proton.
verses.translation: For if after they have escaped the pollutions of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ, they are again entangled therein, and overcome, the latter end is worse with them than the beginning.

verses.original: κρεῖττον γὰρ ἦν αὐτοῖς μὴ ἐπεγνωκέναι τὴν ὁδὸν τῆς δικαιοσύνης ἢ ἐπιγνοῦσιν ⸀ὑποστρέψαι ἐκ τῆς παραδοθείσης αὐτοῖς ἁγίας ἐντολῆς·
verses.translit: kreitton gar en autois me epegnokenai ten odon tes dikaiosynis e epignousin upostrepsai ek tes paradotheisis autois agias entoles*
verses.translation: For it had been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than, after they have known it , to turn from the holy commandment delivered unto them.

verses.original: ⸀συμβέβηκεν αὐτοῖς τὸ τῆς ἀληθοῦς παροιμίας· Κύων ἐπιστρέψας ἐπὶ τὸ ἴδιον ἐξέραμα, καί· Ὗς λουσαμένη εἰς ⸀κυλισμὸν βορβόρου.
verses.translit: symveviken autois to tes alithous paroimias* Kyon epistrepsas epi to idion exerama, kai* Us loysameni eis kylismon vorvoroy.
verses.translation: But it is happened unto them according to the true proverb, The dog is turned to his own vomit again; and the sow that was washed to her wallowing in the mire.

verses.original: Ταύτην ἤδη, ἀγαπητοί, δευτέραν ὑμῖν γράφω ἐπιστολήν, ἐν αἷς διεγείρω ὑμῶν ἐν ὑπομνήσει τὴν εἰλικρινῆ διάνοιαν,
verses.translit: Taytin edi, agapitoi, deyteran umin grafo epistolin, en ais diegeiro umon en upomnisei ten eilikrine dianoian,
verses.translation: This second epistle, beloved, I now write unto you; in both which I stir up your pure minds by way of remembrance:

verses.original: μνησθῆναι τῶν προειρημένων ῥημάτων ὑπὸ τῶν ἁγίων προφητῶν καὶ τῆς τῶν ἀποστόλων ὑμῶν ἐντολῆς τοῦ κυρίου καὶ σωτῆρος,
verses.translit: mnisthenai ton proeirimenon Rimaton upo ton agion profiton kai tes ton apostolon umon entoles tou kyrioy kai soteros,
verses.translation: That ye may be mindful of the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets, and of the commandment of us the apostles of the Lord and Saviour:

verses.original: τοῦτο πρῶτον γινώσκοντες ὅτι ἐλεύσονται ἐπʼ ⸀ἐσχάτων τῶν ἡμερῶν ⸂ἐν ἐμπαιγμονῇ⸃ ἐμπαῖκται κατὰ τὰς ἰδίας ἐπιθυμίας αὐτῶν πορευόμενοι
verses.translit: touto proton ginoskontes oti eleysontai ep' eshaton ton emeron en empaigmone empaiktai kata tas idias epithymias auton poreyomenoi
verses.translation: Knowing this first, that there shall come in the last days scoffers, walking after their own lusts,

verses.original: καὶ λέγοντες· Ποῦ ἐστιν ἡ ἐπαγγελία τῆς παρουσίας αὐτοῦ; ἀφʼ ἧς γὰρ οἱ πατέρες ἐκοιμήθησαν, πάντα οὕτως διαμένει ἀπʼ ἀρχῆς κτίσεως.
verses.translit: kai legontes* Pou estin e epaggelia tes paroysias autou; af' es gar oi pateres ekoimithisan, panta outos diamenei ap' arhes ktiseos.
verses.translation: And saying, Where is the promise of his coming? for since the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.

verses.original: λανθάνει γὰρ αὐτοὺς τοῦτο θέλοντας ὅτι οὐρανοὶ ἦσαν ἔκπαλαι καὶ γῆ ἐξ ὕδατος καὶ διʼ ὕδατος συνεστῶσα τῷ τοῦ θεοῦ λόγῳ,
verses.translit: lanthanei gar autous touto thelontas oti ouranoi esan ekpalai kai ge ex udatos kai di' udatos synestosa to tou theou logo,
verses.translation: For this they willingly are ignorant of, that by the word of God the heavens were of old, and the earth standing out of the water and in the water:

verses.original: ⸂διʼ ὧν⸃ ὁ τότε κόσμος ὕδατι κατακλυσθεὶς ἀπώλετο·
verses.translit: di' on o tote kosmos udati kataklystheis apoleto*
verses.translation: Whereby the world that then was, being overflowed with water, perished:

verses.original: οἱ δὲ νῦν οὐρανοὶ καὶ ἡ γῆ τῷ ⸀αὐτῷ λόγῳ τεθησαυρισμένοι εἰσὶν πυρὶ τηρούμενοι εἰς ἡμέραν κρίσεως καὶ ἀπωλείας τῶν ἀσεβῶν ἀνθρώπων.
verses.translit: oi de nun ouranoi kai e ge to auto logo tethisayrismenoi eisin pyri tiroymenoi eis emeran kriseos kai apoleias ton asevon anthropon.
verses.translation: But the heavens and the earth, which are now, by the same word are kept in store, reserved unto fire against the day of judgment and perdition of ungodly men.

verses.original: Ἓν δὲ τοῦτο μὴ λανθανέτω ὑμᾶς, ἀγαπητοί, ὅτι μία ἡμέρα παρὰ κυρίῳ ὡς χίλια ἔτη καὶ χίλια ἔτη ὡς ἡμέρα μία.
verses.translit: En de touto me lanthaneto umas, agapitoi, oti mia emera para kyrio os hilia eti kai hilia eti os emera mia.
verses.translation: But, beloved, be not ignorant of this one thing, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.

verses.original: οὐ βραδύνει ⸀κύριος τῆς ἐπαγγελίας, ὥς τινες βραδύτητα ἡγοῦνται, ἀλλὰ μακροθυμεῖ εἰς ⸀ὑμᾶς, μὴ βουλόμενός τινας ἀπολέσθαι ἀλλὰ πάντας εἰς μετάνοιαν χωρῆσαι.
verses.translit: ou vradynei kyrios tes epaggelias, os tines vradytita egountai, alla makrothymei eis umas, me voylomenos tinas apolesthai alla pantas eis metanoian horesai.
verses.translation: The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.

verses.original: ἥξει δὲ ⸀ἡμέρα κυρίου ὡς ⸀κλέπτης, ἐν ᾗ οἱ οὐρανοὶ ῥοιζηδὸν παρελεύσονται, στοιχεῖα δὲ καυσούμενα ⸀λυθήσεται, καὶ γῆ καὶ τὰ ἐν αὐτῇ ἔργα ⸀εὑρεθήσεται.
verses.translit: exei de emera kyrioy os kleptis, en e oi ouranoi Roizidon pareleysontai, stoiheia de kaysoymena lythisetai, kai ge kai ta en aute erga eurethisetai.
verses.translation: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night; in the which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat, the earth also and the works that are therein shall be burned up.

verses.original: Τούτων ⸀οὕτως πάντων λυομένων ποταποὺς δεῖ ὑπάρχειν ὑμᾶς ἐν ἁγίαις ἀναστροφαῖς καὶ εὐσεβείαις,
verses.translit: Toyton outos panton lyomenon potapous dei uparhein umas en agiais anastrofais kai euseveiais,
verses.translation: Seeing then that all these things shall be dissolved, what manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conversation and godliness,

verses.original: προσδοκῶντας καὶ σπεύδοντας τὴν παρουσίαν τῆς τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμέρας, διʼ ἣν οὐρανοὶ πυρούμενοι λυθήσονται καὶ στοιχεῖα καυσούμενα τήκεται·
verses.translit: prosdokontas kai speydontas ten paroysian tes tou theou emeras, di' en ouranoi pyroymenoi lythisontai kai stoiheia kaysoymena tiketai*
verses.translation: Looking for and hasting unto the coming of the day of God, wherein the heavens being on fire shall be dissolved, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat?

verses.original: καινοὺς δὲ οὐρανοὺς καὶ γῆν καινὴν κατὰ τὸ ἐπάγγελμα αὐτοῦ προσδοκῶμεν, ἐν οἷς δικαιοσύνη κατοικεῖ.
verses.translit: kainous de ouranous kai gen kainen kata to epaggelma autou prosdokomen, en ois dikaiosyni katoikei.
verses.translation: Nevertheless we, according to his promise, look for new heavens and a new earth, wherein dwelleth righteousness.

verses.original: Διό, ἀγαπητοί, ταῦτα προσδοκῶντες σπουδάσατε ἄσπιλοι καὶ ἀμώμητοι αὐτῷ εὑρεθῆναι ἐν εἰρήνῃ,
verses.translit: Dio, agapitoi, tauta prosdokontes spoydasate aspiloi kai amomitoi auto eurethenai en eirine,
verses.translation: Wherefore, beloved, seeing that ye look for such things, be diligent that ye may be found of him in peace, without spot, and blameless.

verses.original: καὶ τὴν τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν μακροθυμίαν σωτηρίαν ἡγεῖσθε, καθὼς καὶ ὁ ἀγαπητὸς ἡμῶν ἀδελφὸς Παῦλος κατὰ τὴν ⸂δοθεῖσαν αὐτῷ⸃ σοφίαν ἔγραψεν ὑμῖν,
verses.translit: kai ten tou kyrioy emon makrothymian sotirian egeisthe, kathos kai o agapitos emon adelfos Paulos kata ten dotheisan auto sofian egrapsen umin,
verses.translation: And account that the longsuffering of our Lord is salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also according to the wisdom given unto him hath written unto you;

verses.original: ὡς καὶ ἐν πάσαις ⸀ταῖς ἐπιστολαῖς λαλῶν ἐν αὐταῖς περὶ τούτων, ἐν ⸀αἷς ἐστιν δυσνόητά τινα, ἃ οἱ ἀμαθεῖς καὶ ἀστήρικτοι ⸀στρεβλοῦσιν ὡς καὶ τὰς λοιπὰς γραφὰς πρὸς τὴν ἰδίαν αὐτῶν ἀπώλειαν.
verses.translit: os kai en pasais tais epistolais lalon en autais peri toyton, en ais estin dysnoita tina, a oi amatheis kai astiriktoi strevlousin os kai tas loipas grafas pros ten idian auton apoleian.
verses.translation: As also in all his epistles, speaking in them of these things; in which are some things hard to be understood, which they that are unlearned and unstable wrest, as they do also the other scriptures, unto their own destruction.

verses.original: ὑμεῖς οὖν, ἀγαπητοί, προγινώσκοντες φυλάσσεσθε ἵνα μὴ τῇ τῶν ἀθέσμων πλάνῃ συναπαχθέντες ἐκπέσητε τοῦ ἰδίου στηριγμοῦ,
verses.translit: umeis oun, agapitoi, proginoskontes fylassesthe ina me te ton athesmon plane synapahthentes ekpesite tou idioy stirigmou,
verses.translation: Ye therefore, beloved, seeing ye know these things before, beware lest ye also, being led away with the error of the wicked, fall from your own stedfastness.

verses.original: αὐξάνετε δὲ ἐν χάριτι καὶ γνώσει τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν καὶ σωτῆρος Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ. αὐτῷ ἡ δόξα καὶ νῦν καὶ εἰς ἡμέραν αἰῶνος. ⸀ἀμήν.
verses.translit: auxanete de en hariti kai gnosei tou kyrioy emon kai soteros Iisou Hristou. auto e doxa kai nun kai eis emeran aionos. amin.
verses.translation: But grow in grace, and in the knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. To him be glory both now and for ever. Amen.

verses.original: Ὃ ἦν ἀπʼ ἀρχῆς, ὃ ἀκηκόαμεν, ὃ ἑωράκαμεν τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς ἡμῶν, ὃ ἐθεασάμεθα καὶ αἱ χεῖρες ἡμῶν ἐψηλάφησαν, περὶ τοῦ λόγου τῆς ζωῆς—
verses.translit: O en ap' arhes, o akikoamen, o eorakamen tois ofthalmois emon, o etheasametha kai ai heires emon epsilafisan, peri tou logoy tes zoes--
verses.translation: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we have looked upon, and our hands have handled, of the Word of life;

verses.original: καὶ ἡ ζωὴ ἐφανερώθη, καὶ ἑωράκαμεν καὶ μαρτυροῦμεν καὶ ἀπαγγέλλομεν ὑμῖν τὴν ζωὴν τὴν αἰώνιον ἥτις ἦν πρὸς τὸν πατέρα καὶ ἐφανερώθη ἡμῖν—
verses.translit: kai e zoe efanerothi, kai eorakamen kai martyroumen kai apaggellomen umin ten zoen ten aionion etis en pros ton patera kai efanerothi emin--
verses.translation: (For the life was manifested, and we have seen it , and bear witness, and shew unto you that eternal life, which was with the Father, and was manifested unto us;)

verses.original: ὃ ἑωράκαμεν καὶ ἀκηκόαμεν ἀπαγγέλλομεν ⸀καὶ ὑμῖν, ἵνα καὶ ὑμεῖς κοινωνίαν ἔχητε μεθʼ ἡμῶν· καὶ ἡ κοινωνία δὲ ἡ ἡμετέρα μετὰ τοῦ πατρὸς καὶ μετὰ τοῦ υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ·
verses.translit: o eorakamen kai akikoamen apaggellomen kai umin, ina kai umeis koinonian ehite meth' emon* kai e koinonia de e emetera meta tou patros kai meta tou yiou autou Iisou Hristou*
verses.translation: That which we have seen and heard declare we unto you, that ye also may have fellowship with us: and truly our fellowship is with the Father, and with his Son Jesus Christ.

verses.original: καὶ ταῦτα γράφομεν ⸀ἡμεῖς ἵνα ἡ χαρὰ ἡμῶν ᾖ πεπληρωμένη.
verses.translit: kai tauta grafomen emeis ina e hara emon e pepliromeni.
verses.translation: And these things write we unto you, that your joy may be full.

verses.original: Καὶ ἔστιν αὕτη ἡ ἀγγελία ἣν ἀκηκόαμεν ἀπʼ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀναγγέλλομεν ὑμῖν, ὅτι ὁ θεὸς φῶς ἐστιν καὶ σκοτία ⸂ἐν αὐτῷ οὐκ ἔστιν⸃ οὐδεμία.
verses.translit: Kai estin auti e aggelia en akikoamen ap' autou kai anaggellomen umin, oti o theos fos estin kai skotia en auto ouk estin oudemia.
verses.translation: This then is the message which we have heard of him, and declare unto you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.

verses.original: ἐὰν εἴπωμεν ὅτι κοινωνίαν ἔχομεν μετʼ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐν τῷ σκότει περιπατῶμεν, ψευδόμεθα καὶ οὐ ποιοῦμεν τὴν ἀλήθειαν·
verses.translit: ean eipomen oti koinonian ehomen met' autou kai en to skotei peripatomen, pseydometha kai ou poioumen ten alitheian*
verses.translation: If we say that we have fellowship with him, and walk in darkness, we lie, and do not the truth:

verses.original: ἐὰν ⸀δὲ ἐν τῷ φωτὶ περιπατῶμεν ὡς αὐτός ἐστιν ἐν τῷ φωτί, κοινωνίαν ἔχομεν μετʼ ἀλλήλων καὶ τὸ αἷμα ⸀Ἰησοῦ τοῦ υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ καθαρίζει ἡμᾶς ἀπὸ πάσης ἁμαρτίας.
verses.translit: ean de en to foti peripatomen os autos estin en to foti, koinonian ehomen met' allilon kai to aima Iisou tou yiou autou katharizei emas apo pasis amartias.
verses.translation: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship one with another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanseth us from all sin.

verses.original: ἐὰν εἴπωμεν ὅτι ἁμαρτίαν οὐκ ἔχομεν, ἑαυτοὺς πλανῶμεν καὶ ἡ ἀλήθεια ⸂οὐκ ἔστιν ἐν ἡμῖν⸃.
verses.translit: ean eipomen oti amartian ouk ehomen, eaytous planomen kai e alitheia ouk estin en emin.
verses.translation: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.

verses.original: ἐὰν ὁμολογῶμεν τὰς ἁμαρτίας ἡμῶν, πιστός ἐστιν καὶ δίκαιος ἵνα ἀφῇ ἡμῖν τὰς ἁμαρτίας καὶ καθαρίσῃ ἡμᾶς ἀπὸ πάσης ἀδικίας.
verses.translit: ean omologomen tas amartias emon, pistos estin kai dikaios ina afe emin tas amartias kai katharise emas apo pasis adikias.
verses.translation: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

verses.original: ἐὰν εἴπωμεν ὅτι οὐχ ἡμαρτήκαμεν, ψεύστην ποιοῦμεν αὐτὸν καὶ ὁ λόγος αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἔστιν ἐν ἡμῖν.
verses.translit: ean eipomen oti ouh emartikamen, pseystin poioumen auton kai o logos autou ouk estin en emin.
verses.translation: If we say that we have not sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.

verses.original: Τεκνία μου, ταῦτα γράφω ὑμῖν ἵνα μὴ ἁμάρτητε. καὶ ἐάν τις ἁμάρτῃ, παράκλητον ἔχομεν πρὸς τὸν πατέρα Ἰησοῦν Χριστὸν δίκαιον,
verses.translit: Teknia moy, tauta grafo umin ina me amartite. kai ean tis amarte, parakliton ehomen pros ton patera Iisoun Hriston dikaion,
verses.translation: My little children, these things write I unto you, that ye sin not. And if any man sin, we have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous:

verses.original: καὶ αὐτὸς ἱλασμός ἐστιν περὶ τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν ἡμῶν, οὐ περὶ τῶν ἡμετέρων δὲ μόνον ἀλλὰ καὶ περὶ ὅλου τοῦ κόσμου.
verses.translit: kai autos ilasmos estin peri ton amartion emon, ou peri ton emeteron de monon alla kai peri oloy tou kosmoy.
verses.translation: And he is the propitiation for our sins: and not for ours only, but also for the sins of the whole world.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐν τούτῳ γινώσκομεν ὅτι ἐγνώκαμεν αὐτόν, ἐὰν τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ τηρῶμεν.
verses.translit: Kai en toyto ginoskomen oti egnokamen auton, ean tas entolas autou tiromen.
verses.translation: And hereby we do know that we know him, if we keep his commandments.

verses.original: ὁ λέγων ⸀ὅτι Ἔγνωκα αὐτὸν καὶ τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ μὴ τηρῶν ψεύστης ἐστίν, καὶ ἐν τούτῳ ἡ ἀλήθεια οὐκ ἔστιν·
verses.translit: o legon oti Egnoka auton kai tas entolas autou me tiron pseystis estin, kai en toyto e alitheia ouk estin*
verses.translation: He that saith, I know him, and keepeth not his commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him.

verses.original: ὃς δʼ ἂν τηρῇ αὐτοῦ τὸν λόγον, ἀληθῶς ἐν τούτῳ ἡ ἀγάπη τοῦ θεοῦ τετελείωται. ἐν τούτῳ γινώσκομεν ὅτι ἐν αὐτῷ ἐσμεν·
verses.translit: os d' an tire autou ton logon, alithos en toyto e agapi tou theou teteleiotai. en toyto ginoskomen oti en auto esmen*
verses.translation: But whoso keepeth his word, in him verily is the love of God perfected: hereby know we that we are in him.

verses.original: ὁ λέγων ἐν αὐτῷ μένειν ὀφείλει καθὼς ἐκεῖνος περιεπάτησεν καὶ ⸀αὐτὸς περιπατεῖν.
verses.translit: o legon en auto menein ofeilei kathos ekeinos periepatisen kai autos peripatein.
verses.translation: He that saith he abideth in him ought himself also so to walk, even as he walked.

verses.original: ⸀Ἀγαπητοί, οὐκ ἐντολὴν καινὴν γράφω ὑμῖν, ἀλλʼ ἐντολὴν παλαιὰν ἣν εἴχετε ἀπʼ ἀρχῆς· ἡ ἐντολὴ ἡ παλαιά ἐστιν ὁ λόγος ὃν ⸀ἠκούσατε.
verses.translit: Agapitoi, ouk entolen kainen grafo umin, all' entolen palaian en eihete ap' arhes* e entole e palaia estin o logos on ekoysate.
verses.translation: Brethren, I write no new commandment unto you, but an old commandment which ye had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which ye have heard from the beginning.

verses.original: πάλιν ἐντολὴν καινὴν γράφω ὑμῖν, ὅ ἐστιν ἀληθὲς ἐν αὐτῷ καὶ ἐν ὑμῖν, ὅτι ἡ σκοτία παράγεται καὶ τὸ φῶς τὸ ἀληθινὸν ἤδη φαίνει.
verses.translit: palin entolen kainen grafo umin, o estin alithes en auto kai en umin, oti e skotia paragetai kai to fos to alithinon edi fainei.
verses.translation: Again, a new commandment I write unto you, which thing is true in him and in you: because the darkness is past, and the true light now shineth.

verses.original: ὁ λέγων ἐν τῷ φωτὶ εἶναι καὶ τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ μισῶν ἐν τῇ σκοτίᾳ ἐστὶν ἕως ἄρτι.
verses.translit: o legon en to foti einai kai ton adelfon autou mison en te skotia estin eos arti.
verses.translation: He that saith he is in the light, and hateth his brother, is in darkness even until now.

verses.original: ὁ ἀγαπῶν τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ φωτὶ μένει, καὶ σκάνδαλον ἐν αὐτῷ οὐκ ἔστιν·
verses.translit: o agapon ton adelfon autou en to foti menei, kai skandalon en auto ouk estin*
verses.translation: He that loveth his brother abideth in the light, and there is none occasion of stumbling in him.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ μισῶν τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ ἐν τῇ σκοτίᾳ ἐστὶν καὶ ἐν τῇ σκοτίᾳ περιπατεῖ, καὶ οὐκ οἶδεν ποῦ ὑπάγει, ὅτι ἡ σκοτία ἐτύφλωσεν τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτοῦ.
verses.translit: o de mison ton adelfon autou en te skotia estin kai en te skotia peripatei, kai ouk oiden pou upagei, oti e skotia etyflosen tous ofthalmous autou.
verses.translation: But he that hateth his brother is in darkness, and walketh in darkness, and knoweth not whither he goeth, because that darkness hath blinded his eyes.

verses.original: Γράφω ὑμῖν, τεκνία, ὅτι ἀφέωνται ὑμῖν αἱ ἁμαρτίαι διὰ τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ·
verses.translit: Grafo umin, teknia, oti afeontai umin ai amartiai dia to onoma autou*
verses.translation: I write unto you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name’s sake.

verses.original: γράφω ὑμῖν, πατέρες, ὅτι ἐγνώκατε τὸν ἀπʼ ἀρχῆς· γράφω ὑμῖν, νεανίσκοι, ὅτι νενικήκατε τὸν πονηρόν.
verses.translit: grafo umin, pateres, oti egnokate ton ap' arhes* grafo umin, neaniskoi, oti nenikikate ton poniron.
verses.translation: I write unto you, fathers, because ye have known him that is from the beginning. I write unto you, young men, because ye have overcome the wicked one. I write unto you, little children, because ye have known the Father.

verses.original: ⸀ἔγραψα ὑμῖν, παιδία, ὅτι ἐγνώκατε τὸν πατέρα· ἔγραψα ὑμῖν, πατέρες, ὅτι ἐγνώκατε τὸν ἀπʼ ἀρχῆς· ἔγραψα ὑμῖν, νεανίσκοι, ὅτι ἰσχυροί ἐστε καὶ ὁ λόγος τοῦ θεοῦ ἐν ὑμῖν μένει καὶ νενικήκατε τὸν πονηρόν.
verses.translit: egrapsa umin, paidia, oti egnokate ton patera* egrapsa umin, pateres, oti egnokate ton ap' arhes* egrapsa umin, neaniskoi, oti ishyroi este kai o logos tou theou en umin menei kai nenikikate ton poniron.
verses.translation: I have written unto you, fathers, because ye have known him that is from the beginning. I have written unto you, young men, because ye are strong, and the word of God abideth in you, and ye have overcome the wicked one.

verses.original: Μὴ ἀγαπᾶτε τὸν κόσμον μηδὲ τὰ ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ. ἐάν τις ἀγαπᾷ τὸν κόσμον, οὐκ ἔστιν ἡ ἀγάπη τοῦ πατρὸς ἐν αὐτῷ·
verses.translit: Me agapate ton kosmon mide ta en to kosmo. ean tis agapa ton kosmon, ouk estin e agapi tou patros en auto*
verses.translation: Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him.

verses.original: ὅτι πᾶν τὸ ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ, ἡ ἐπιθυμία τῆς σαρκὸς καὶ ἡ ἐπιθυμία τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν καὶ ἡ ἀλαζονεία τοῦ βίου, οὐκ ἔστιν ἐκ τοῦ πατρός, ἀλλὰ ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου ἐστίν·
verses.translit: oti pan to en to kosmo, e epithymia tes sarkos kai e epithymia ton ofthalmon kai e alazoneia tou vioy, ouk estin ek tou patros, alla ek tou kosmoy estin*
verses.translation: For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world.

verses.original: καὶ ὁ κόσμος παράγεται καὶ ἡ ἐπιθυμία αὐτοῦ, ὁ δὲ ποιῶν τὸ θέλημα τοῦ θεοῦ μένει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα.
verses.translit: kai o kosmos paragetai kai e epithymia autou, o de poion to thelima tou theou menei eis ton aiona.
verses.translation: And the world passeth away, and the lust thereof: but he that doeth the will of God abideth for ever.

verses.original: Παιδία, ἐσχάτη ὥρα ἐστίν, καὶ καθὼς ἠκούσατε ⸀ὅτι ἀντίχριστος ἔρχεται, καὶ νῦν ἀντίχριστοι πολλοὶ γεγόνασιν· ὅθεν γινώσκομεν ὅτι ἐσχάτη ὥρα ἐστίν.
verses.translit: Paidia, eshati ora estin, kai kathos ekoysate oti antihristos erhetai, kai nun antihristoi polloi gegonasin* othen ginoskomen oti eshati ora estin.
verses.translation: Little children, it is the last time: and as ye have heard that antichrist shall come, even now are there many antichrists; whereby we know that it is the last time.

verses.original: ἐξ ἡμῶν ἐξῆλθαν, ἀλλʼ οὐκ ἦσαν ἐξ ἡμῶν· εἰ γὰρ ⸂ἐξ ἡμῶν ἦσαν⸃, μεμενήκεισαν ἂν μεθʼ ἡμῶν· ἀλλʼ ἵνα φανερωθῶσιν ὅτι οὐκ εἰσὶν πάντες ἐξ ἡμῶν.
verses.translit: ex emon exelthan, all' ouk esan ex emon* ei gar ex emon esan, memenikeisan an meth' emon* all' ina fanerothosin oti ouk eisin pantes ex emon.
verses.translation: They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would no doubt have continued with us: but they went out , that they might be made manifest that they were not all of us.

verses.original: καὶ ὑμεῖς χρῖσμα ἔχετε ἀπὸ τοῦ ἁγίου ⸀καὶ οἴδατε ⸀πάντες·
verses.translit: kai umeis hrisma ehete apo tou agioy kai oidate pantes*
verses.translation: But ye have an unction from the Holy One, and ye know all things.

verses.original: οὐκ ἔγραψα ὑμῖν ὅτι οὐκ οἴδατε τὴν ἀλήθειαν, ἀλλʼ ὅτι οἴδατε αὐτήν, καὶ ὅτι πᾶν ψεῦδος ἐκ τῆς ἀληθείας οὐκ ἔστιν.
verses.translit: ouk egrapsa umin oti ouk oidate ten alitheian, all' oti oidate autin, kai oti pan pseudos ek tes alitheias ouk estin.
verses.translation: I have not written unto you because ye know not the truth, but because ye know it, and that no lie is of the truth.

verses.original: τίς ἐστιν ὁ ψεύστης εἰ μὴ ὁ ἀρνούμενος ὅτι Ἰησοῦς οὐκ ἔστιν ὁ χριστός; οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ ἀντίχριστος, ὁ ἀρνούμενος τὸν πατέρα καὶ τὸν υἱόν.
verses.translit: tis estin o pseystis ei me o arnoymenos oti Iisous ouk estin o hristos; outos estin o antihristos, o arnoymenos ton patera kai ton yion.
verses.translation: Who is a liar but he that denieth that Jesus is the Christ? He is antichrist, that denieth the Father and the Son.

verses.original: πᾶς ὁ ἀρνούμενος τὸν υἱὸν οὐδὲ τὸν πατέρα ἔχει· ⸂ὁ ὁμολογῶν τὸν υἱὸν καὶ τὸν πατέρα ἔχει⸃.
verses.translit: pas o arnoymenos ton yion oude ton patera ehei* o omologon ton yion kai ton patera ehei.
verses.translation: Whosoever denieth the Son, the same hath not the Father: (but) he that acknowledgeth the Son hath the Father also .

verses.original: ⸀ὑμεῖς ὃ ἠκούσατε ἀπʼ ἀρχῆς, ἐν ὑμῖν μενέτω· ἐὰν ἐν ὑμῖν μείνῃ ὃ ἀπʼ ἀρχῆς ἠκούσατε, καὶ ὑμεῖς ἐν τῷ υἱῷ καὶ ἐν τῷ πατρὶ μενεῖτε.
verses.translit: umeis o ekoysate ap' arhes, en umin meneto* ean en umin meine o ap' arhes ekoysate, kai umeis en to yio kai en to patri meneite.
verses.translation: Let that therefore abide in you, which ye have heard from the beginning. If that which ye have heard from the beginning shall remain in you, ye also shall continue in the Son, and in the Father.

verses.original: καὶ αὕτη ἐστὶν ἡ ἐπαγγελία ἣν αὐτὸς ἐπηγγείλατο ἡμῖν, τὴν ζωὴν τὴν αἰώνιον.
verses.translit: kai auti estin e epaggelia en autos epiggeilato emin, ten zoen ten aionion.
verses.translation: And this is the promise that he hath promised us, even eternal life.

verses.original: Ταῦτα ἔγραψα ὑμῖν περὶ τῶν πλανώντων ὑμᾶς.
verses.translit: Tauta egrapsa umin peri ton planonton umas.
verses.translation: These things have I written unto you concerning them that seduce you.

verses.original: καὶ ὑμεῖς τὸ χρῖσμα ὃ ἐλάβετε ἀπʼ αὐτοῦ ⸂μένει ἐν ὑμῖν⸃, καὶ οὐ χρείαν ἔχετε ἵνα τις διδάσκῃ ὑμᾶς· ἀλλʼ ὡς τὸ ⸀αὐτοῦ χρῖσμα διδάσκει ὑμᾶς περὶ πάντων, καὶ ἀληθές ἐστιν καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ψεῦδος, καὶ καθὼς ἐδίδαξεν ὑμᾶς, ⸀μένετε ἐν αὐτῷ.
verses.translit: kai umeis to hrisma o elavete ap' autou menei en umin, kai ou hreian ehete ina tis didaske umas* all' os to autou hrisma didaskei umas peri panton, kai alithes estin kai ouk estin pseudos, kai kathos edidaxen umas, menete en auto.
verses.translation: But the anointing which ye have received of him abideth in you, and ye need not that any man teach you: but as the same anointing teacheth you of all things, and is truth, and is no lie, and even as it hath taught you, ye shall abide in him.

verses.original: Καὶ νῦν, τεκνία, μένετε ἐν αὐτῷ, ἵνα ⸀ἐὰν φανερωθῇ ⸀σχῶμεν παρρησίαν καὶ μὴ αἰσχυνθῶμεν ἀπʼ αὐτοῦ ἐν τῇ παρουσίᾳ αὐτοῦ.
verses.translit: Kai nun, teknia, menete en auto, ina ean fanerothe shomen parrisian kai me aishynthomen ap' autou en te paroysia autou.
verses.translation: And now, little children, abide in him; that, when he shall appear, we may have confidence, and not be ashamed before him at his coming.

verses.original: ἐὰν εἰδῆτε ὅτι δίκαιός ἐστιν, γινώσκετε ⸀ὅτι πᾶς ὁ ποιῶν τὴν δικαιοσύνην ἐξ αὐτοῦ γεγέννηται.
verses.translit: ean eidete oti dikaios estin, ginoskete oti pas o poion ten dikaiosynin ex autou gegennitai.
verses.translation: If ye know that he is righteous, ye know that every one that doeth righteousness is born of him.

verses.original: ἴδετε ποταπὴν ἀγάπην δέδωκεν ἡμῖν ὁ πατὴρ ἵνα τέκνα θεοῦ κληθῶμεν, ⸂καὶ ἐσμέν⸃. διὰ τοῦτο ὁ κόσμος οὐ γινώσκει ⸀ἡμᾶς ὅτι οὐκ ἔγνω αὐτόν.
verses.translit: idete potapen agapin dedoken emin o pater ina tekna theou klithomen, kai esmen. dia touto o kosmos ou ginoskei emas oti ouk egno auton.
verses.translation: Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God: therefore the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.

verses.original: ἀγαπητοί, νῦν τέκνα θεοῦ ἐσμεν, καὶ οὔπω ἐφανερώθη τί ἐσόμεθα. ⸀οἴδαμεν ὅτι ἐὰν φανερωθῇ ὅμοιοι αὐτῷ ἐσόμεθα, ὅτι ὀψόμεθα αὐτὸν καθώς ἐστιν.
verses.translit: agapitoi, nun tekna theou esmen, kai oupo efanerothi ti esometha. oidamen oti ean fanerothe omoioi auto esometha, oti opsometha auton kathos estin.
verses.translation: Beloved, now are we the sons of God, and it doth not yet appear what we shall be: but we know that, when he shall appear, we shall be like him; for we shall see him as he is.

verses.original: καὶ πᾶς ὁ ἔχων τὴν ἐλπίδα ταύτην ἐπʼ αὐτῷ ἁγνίζει ἑαυτὸν καθὼς ἐκεῖνος ἁγνός ἐστιν.
verses.translit: kai pas o ehon ten elpida taytin ep' auto agnizei eayton kathos ekeinos agnos estin.
verses.translation: And every man that hath this hope in him purifieth himself, even as he is pure.

verses.original: Πᾶς ὁ ποιῶν τὴν ἁμαρτίαν καὶ τὴν ἀνομίαν ποιεῖ, καὶ ἡ ἁμαρτία ἐστὶν ἡ ἀνομία.
verses.translit: Pas o poion ten amartian kai ten anomian poiei, kai e amartia estin e anomia.
verses.translation: Whosoever committeth sin transgresseth also the law: for sin is the transgression of the law.

verses.original: καὶ οἴδατε ὅτι ἐκεῖνος ἐφανερώθη ἵνα τὰς ⸀ἁμαρτίας ἄρῃ, καὶ ἁμαρτία ἐν αὐτῷ οὐκ ἔστιν.
verses.translit: kai oidate oti ekeinos efanerothi ina tas amartias are, kai amartia en auto ouk estin.
verses.translation: And ye know that he was manifested to take away our sins; and in him is no sin.

verses.original: πᾶς ὁ ἐν αὐτῷ μένων οὐχ ἁμαρτάνει· πᾶς ὁ ἁμαρτάνων οὐχ ἑώρακεν αὐτὸν οὐδὲ ἔγνωκεν αὐτόν.
verses.translit: pas o en auto menon ouh amartanei* pas o amartanon ouh eoraken auton oude egnoken auton.
verses.translation: Whosoever abideth in him sinneth not: whosoever sinneth hath not seen him, neither known him.

verses.original: ⸀τεκνία, μηδεὶς πλανάτω ὑμᾶς· ὁ ποιῶν τὴν δικαιοσύνην δίκαιός ἐστιν, καθὼς ἐκεῖνος δίκαιός ἐστιν·
verses.translit: teknia, mideis planato umas* o poion ten dikaiosynin dikaios estin, kathos ekeinos dikaios estin*
verses.translation: Little children, let no man deceive you: he that doeth righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.

verses.original: ὁ ποιῶν τὴν ἁμαρτίαν ἐκ τοῦ διαβόλου ἐστίν, ὅτι ἀπʼ ἀρχῆς ὁ διάβολος ἁμαρτάνει. εἰς τοῦτο ἐφανερώθη ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ θεοῦ ἵνα λύσῃ τὰ ἔργα τοῦ διαβόλου.
verses.translit: o poion ten amartian ek tou diavoloy estin, oti ap' arhes o diavolos amartanei. eis touto efanerothi o yios tou theou ina lyse ta erga tou diavoloy.
verses.translation: He that committeth sin is of the devil; for the devil sinneth from the beginning. For this purpose the Son of God was manifested, that he might destroy the works of the devil.

verses.original: πᾶς ὁ γεγεννημένος ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ ἁμαρτίαν οὐ ποιεῖ, ὅτι σπέρμα αὐτοῦ ἐν αὐτῷ μένει, καὶ οὐ δύναται ἁμαρτάνειν, ὅτι ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ γεγέννηται.
verses.translit: pas o gegennimenos ek tou theou amartian ou poiei, oti sperma autou en auto menei, kai ou dynatai amartanein, oti ek tou theou gegennitai.
verses.translation: Whosoever is born of God doth not commit sin; for his seed remaineth in him: and he cannot sin, because he is born of God.

verses.original: ἐν τούτῳ φανερά ἐστιν τὰ τέκνα τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ τὰ τέκνα τοῦ διαβόλου· πᾶς ὁ μὴ ποιῶν δικαιοσύνην οὐκ ἔστιν ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ, καὶ ὁ μὴ ἀγαπῶν τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ.
verses.translit: en toyto fanera estin ta tekna tou theou kai ta tekna tou diavoloy* pas o me poion dikaiosynin ouk estin ek tou theou, kai o me agapon ton adelfon autou.
verses.translation: In this the children of God are manifest, and the children of the devil: whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of God, neither he that loveth not his brother.

verses.original: Ὅτι αὕτη ἐστὶν ἡ ἀγγελία ἣν ἠκούσατε ἀπʼ ἀρχῆς, ἵνα ἀγαπῶμεν ἀλλήλους·
verses.translit: Oti auti estin e aggelia en ekoysate ap' arhes, ina agapomen alliloys*
verses.translation: For this is the message that ye heard from the beginning, that we should love one another.

verses.original: οὐ καθὼς Κάϊν ἐκ τοῦ πονηροῦ ἦν καὶ ἔσφαξεν τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ· καὶ χάριν τίνος ἔσφαξεν αὐτόν; ὅτι τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ πονηρὰ ἦν, τὰ δὲ τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ δίκαια.
verses.translit: ou kathos Kain ek tou ponirou en kai esfaxen ton adelfon autou* kai harin tinos esfaxen auton; oti ta erga autou ponira en, ta de tou adelfou autou dikaia.
verses.translation: Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother’s righteous.

verses.original: ⸀μὴ θαυμάζετε, ⸀ἀδελφοί, εἰ μισεῖ ὑμᾶς ὁ κόσμος.
verses.translit: me thaymazete, adelfoi, ei misei umas o kosmos.
verses.translation: Marvel not, my brethren, if the world hate you.

verses.original: ἡμεῖς οἴδαμεν ὅτι μεταβεβήκαμεν ἐκ τοῦ θανάτου εἰς τὴν ζωήν, ὅτι ἀγαπῶμεν τοὺς ἀδελφούς· ὁ μὴ ⸀ἀγαπῶν μένει ἐν τῷ θανάτῳ.
verses.translit: emeis oidamen oti metavevikamen ek tou thanatoy eis ten zoin, oti agapomen tous adelfoys* o me agapon menei en to thanato.
verses.translation: We know that we have passed from death unto life, because we love the brethren. He that loveth not his brother abideth in death.

verses.original: πᾶς ὁ μισῶν τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ ἀνθρωποκτόνος ἐστίν, καὶ οἴδατε ὅτι πᾶς ἀνθρωποκτόνος οὐκ ἔχει ζωὴν αἰώνιον ἐν ⸀αὐτῷ μένουσαν.
verses.translit: pas o mison ton adelfon autou anthropoktonos estin, kai oidate oti pas anthropoktonos ouk ehei zoen aionion en auto menoysan.
verses.translation: Whosoever hateth his brother is a murderer: and ye know that no murderer hath eternal life abiding in him.

verses.original: ἐν τούτῳ ἐγνώκαμεν τὴν ἀγάπην, ὅτι ἐκεῖνος ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ ἔθηκεν· καὶ ἡμεῖς ὀφείλομεν ὑπὲρ τῶν ἀδελφῶν τὰς ψυχὰς ⸀θεῖναι.
verses.translit: en toyto egnokamen ten agapin, oti ekeinos uper emon ten psyhen autou ethiken* kai emeis ofeilomen uper ton adelfon tas psyhas theinai.
verses.translation: Hereby perceive we the love of God , because he laid down his life for us: and we ought to lay down our lives for the brethren.

verses.original: ὃς δʼ ἂν ἔχῃ τὸν βίον τοῦ κόσμου καὶ θεωρῇ τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ χρείαν ἔχοντα καὶ κλείσῃ τὰ σπλάγχνα αὐτοῦ ἀπʼ αὐτοῦ, πῶς ἡ ἀγάπη τοῦ θεοῦ μένει ἐν αὐτῷ;
verses.translit: os d' an ehe ton vion tou kosmoy kai theore ton adelfon autou hreian ehonta kai kleise ta splaghna autou ap' autou, pos e agapi tou theou menei en auto;
verses.translation: But whoso hath this world’s good, and seeth his brother have need, and shutteth up his bowels of compassion from him, how dwelleth the love of God in him?

verses.original: ⸀Τεκνία, μὴ ἀγαπῶμεν λόγῳ μηδὲ τῇ γλώσσῃ ἀλλὰ ἐν ἔργῳ καὶ ἀληθείᾳ.
verses.translit: Teknia, me agapomen logo mide te glosse alla en ergo kai alitheia.
verses.translation: My little children, let us not love in word, neither in tongue; but in deed and in truth.

verses.original: ⸀ἐν τούτῳ ⸀γνωσόμεθα ὅτι ἐκ τῆς ἀληθείας ἐσμέν, καὶ ἔμπροσθεν αὐτοῦ πείσομεν ⸂τὴν καρδίαν⸃ ἡμῶν
verses.translit: en toyto gnosometha oti ek tes alitheias esmen, kai emprosthen autou peisomen ten kardian emon
verses.translation: And hereby we know that we are of the truth, and shall assure our hearts before him.

verses.original: ὅτι ἐὰν καταγινώσκῃ ἡμῶν ἡ καρδία, ὅτι μείζων ἐστὶν ὁ θεὸς τῆς καρδίας ἡμῶν καὶ γινώσκει πάντα.
verses.translit: oti ean kataginoske emon e kardia, oti meizon estin o theos tes kardias emon kai ginoskei panta.
verses.translation: For if our heart condemn us, God is greater than our heart, and knoweth all things.

verses.original: ἀγαπητοί, ἐὰν ἡ καρδία ⸂μὴ καταγινώσκῃ ἡμῶν⸃, παρρησίαν ἔχομεν πρὸς τὸν θεόν,
verses.translit: agapitoi, ean e kardia me kataginoske emon, parrisian ehomen pros ton theon,
verses.translation: Beloved, if our heart condemn us not, then have we confidence toward God.

verses.original: καὶ ὃ ⸀ἐὰν αἰτῶμεν λαμβάνομεν ⸀ἀπʼ αὐτοῦ, ὅτι τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ τηροῦμεν καὶ τὰ ἀρεστὰ ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ ποιοῦμεν.
verses.translit: kai o ean aitomen lamvanomen ap' autou, oti tas entolas autou tiroumen kai ta aresta enopion autou poioumen.
verses.translation: And whatsoever we ask, we receive of him, because we keep his commandments, and do those things that are pleasing in his sight.

verses.original: καὶ αὕτη ἐστὶν ἡ ἐντολὴ αὐτοῦ, ἵνα ⸀πιστεύσωμεν τῷ ὀνόματι τοῦ υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ καὶ ἀγαπῶμεν ἀλλήλους, καθὼς ἔδωκεν ἐντολὴν ⸀ἡμῖν.
verses.translit: kai auti estin e entole autou, ina pisteysomen to onomati tou yiou autou Iisou Hristou kai agapomen alliloys, kathos edoken entolen emin.
verses.translation: And this is his commandment, That we should believe on the name of his Son Jesus Christ, and love one another, as he gave us commandment.

verses.original: καὶ ὁ τηρῶν τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ ἐν αὐτῷ μένει καὶ αὐτὸς ἐν αὐτῷ· καὶ ἐν τούτῳ γινώσκομεν ὅτι μένει ἐν ἡμῖν, ἐκ τοῦ πνεύματος οὗ ἡμῖν ἔδωκεν.
verses.translit: kai o tiron tas entolas autou en auto menei kai autos en auto* kai en toyto ginoskomen oti menei en emin, ek tou pneymatos ou emin edoken.
verses.translation: And he that keepeth his commandments dwelleth in him, and he in him. And hereby we know that he abideth in us, by the Spirit which he hath given us.

verses.original: Ἀγαπητοί, μὴ παντὶ πνεύματι πιστεύετε, ἀλλὰ δοκιμάζετε τὰ πνεύματα εἰ ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ ἐστιν, ὅτι πολλοὶ ψευδοπροφῆται ἐξεληλύθασιν εἰς τὸν κόσμον.
verses.translit: Agapitoi, me panti pneymati pisteyete, alla dokimazete ta pneymata ei ek tou theou estin, oti polloi pseydoprofetai exelilythasin eis ton kosmon.
verses.translation: Beloved, believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of God: because many false prophets are gone out into the world.

verses.original: ἐν τούτῳ ⸀γινώσκετε τὸ πνεῦμα τοῦ θεοῦ· πᾶν πνεῦμα ὃ ὁμολογεῖ Ἰησοῦν Χριστὸν ἐν σαρκὶ ἐληλυθότα ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ ἐστιν,
verses.translit: en toyto ginoskete to pneuma tou theou* pan pneuma o omologei Iisoun Hriston en sarki elilythota ek tou theou estin,
verses.translation: Hereby know ye the Spirit of God: Every spirit that confesseth that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is of God:

verses.original: καὶ πᾶν πνεῦμα ὃ μὴ ὁμολογεῖ ⸀τὸν ⸀Ἰησοῦν ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ οὐκ ἔστιν· καὶ τοῦτό ἐστιν τὸ τοῦ ἀντιχρίστου, ὃ ἀκηκόατε ὅτι ἔρχεται, καὶ νῦν ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ ἐστὶν ἤδη.
verses.translit: kai pan pneuma o me omologei ton Iisoun ek tou theou ouk estin* kai touto estin to tou antihristoy, o akikoate oti erhetai, kai nun en to kosmo estin edi.
verses.translation: And every spirit that confesseth not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is not of God: and this is that spirit of antichrist, whereof ye have heard that it should come; and even now already is it in the world.

verses.original: ὑμεῖς ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ ἐστε, τεκνία, καὶ νενικήκατε αὐτούς, ὅτι μείζων ἐστὶν ὁ ἐν ὑμῖν ἢ ὁ ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ·
verses.translit: umeis ek tou theou este, teknia, kai nenikikate autoys, oti meizon estin o en umin e o en to kosmo*
verses.translation: Ye are of God, little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the world.

verses.original: αὐτοὶ ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου εἰσίν· διὰ τοῦτο ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου λαλοῦσιν καὶ ὁ κόσμος αὐτῶν ἀκούει.
verses.translit: autoi ek tou kosmoy eisin* dia touto ek tou kosmoy lalousin kai o kosmos auton akoyei.
verses.translation: They are of the world: therefore speak they of the world, and the world heareth them.

verses.original: ἡμεῖς ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ ἐσμεν· ὁ γινώσκων τὸν θεὸν ἀκούει ἡμῶν, ὃς οὐκ ἔστιν ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ οὐκ ἀκούει ἡμῶν. ἐκ τούτου γινώσκομεν τὸ πνεῦμα τῆς ἀληθείας καὶ τὸ πνεῦμα τῆς πλάνης.
verses.translit: emeis ek tou theou esmen* o ginoskon ton theon akoyei emon, os ouk estin ek tou theou ouk akoyei emon. ek toytoy ginoskomen to pneuma tes alitheias kai to pneuma tes planis.
verses.translation: We are of God: he that knoweth God heareth us; he that is not of God heareth not us. Hereby know we the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.

verses.original: Ἀγαπητοί, ἀγαπῶμεν ἀλλήλους, ὅτι ἡ ἀγάπη ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ ἐστιν, καὶ πᾶς ὁ ἀγαπῶν ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ γεγέννηται καὶ γινώσκει τὸν θεόν.
verses.translit: Agapitoi, agapomen alliloys, oti e agapi ek tou theou estin, kai pas o agapon ek tou theou gegennitai kai ginoskei ton theon.
verses.translation: Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of God; and every one that loveth is born of God, and knoweth God.

verses.original: ὁ μὴ ἀγαπῶν οὐκ ἔγνω τὸν θεόν, ὅτι ὁ θεὸς ἀγάπη ἐστίν.
verses.translit: o me agapon ouk egno ton theon, oti o theos agapi estin.
verses.translation: He that loveth not knoweth not God; for God is love.

verses.original: ἐν τούτῳ ἐφανερώθη ἡ ἀγάπη τοῦ θεοῦ ἐν ἡμῖν, ὅτι τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ τὸν μονογενῆ ἀπέσταλκεν ὁ θεὸς εἰς τὸν κόσμον ἵνα ζήσωμεν διʼ αὐτοῦ.
verses.translit: en toyto efanerothi e agapi tou theou en emin, oti ton yion autou ton monogene apestalken o theos eis ton kosmon ina zisomen di' autou.
verses.translation: In this was manifested the love of God toward us, because that God sent his only begotten Son into the world, that we might live through him.

verses.original: ἐν τούτῳ ἐστὶν ἡ ἀγάπη, οὐχ ὅτι ἡμεῖς ⸀ἠγαπήκαμεν τὸν θεόν, ἀλλʼ ὅτι αὐτὸς ἠγάπησεν ἡμᾶς καὶ ἀπέστειλεν τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ ἱλασμὸν περὶ τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν ἡμῶν.
verses.translit: en toyto estin e agapi, ouh oti emeis egapikamen ton theon, all' oti autos egapisen emas kai apesteilen ton yion autou ilasmon peri ton amartion emon.
verses.translation: Herein is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son to be the propitiation for our sins.

verses.original: ἀγαπητοί, εἰ οὕτως ὁ θεὸς ἠγάπησεν ἡμᾶς, καὶ ἡμεῖς ὀφείλομεν ἀλλήλους ἀγαπᾶν.
verses.translit: agapitoi, ei outos o theos egapisen emas, kai emeis ofeilomen alliloys agapan.
verses.translation: Beloved, if God so loved us, we ought also to love one another.

verses.original: θεὸν οὐδεὶς πώποτε τεθέαται· ἐὰν ἀγαπῶμεν ἀλλήλους, ὁ θεὸς ἐν ἡμῖν μένει καὶ ἡ ἀγάπη αὐτοῦ ⸂ἐν ἡμῖν τετελειωμένη ἐστιν⸃.
verses.translit: theon oudeis popote tetheatai* ean agapomen alliloys, o theos en emin menei kai e agapi autou en emin teteleiomeni estin.
verses.translation: No man hath seen God at any time. If we love one another, God dwelleth in us, and his love is perfected in us.

verses.original: Ἐν τούτῳ γινώσκομεν ὅτι ἐν αὐτῷ μένομεν καὶ αὐτὸς ἐν ἡμῖν, ὅτι ἐκ τοῦ πνεύματος αὐτοῦ δέδωκεν ἡμῖν.
verses.translit: En toyto ginoskomen oti en auto menomen kai autos en emin, oti ek tou pneymatos autou dedoken emin.
verses.translation: Hereby know we that we dwell in him, and he in us, because he hath given us of his Spirit.

verses.original: καὶ ἡμεῖς τεθεάμεθα καὶ μαρτυροῦμεν ὅτι ὁ πατὴρ ἀπέσταλκεν τὸν υἱὸν σωτῆρα τοῦ κόσμου.
verses.translit: kai emeis tetheametha kai martyroumen oti o pater apestalken ton yion sotera tou kosmoy.
verses.translation: And we have seen and do testify that the Father sent the Son to be the Saviour of the world.

verses.original: ὃς ⸀ἐὰν ὁμολογήσῃ ὅτι ⸀Ἰησοῦς ἐστιν ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ θεοῦ, ὁ θεὸς ἐν αὐτῷ μένει καὶ αὐτὸς ἐν τῷ θεῷ.
verses.translit: os ean omologise oti Iisous estin o yios tou theou, o theos en auto menei kai autos en to theo.
verses.translation: Whosoever shall confess that Jesus is the Son of God, God dwelleth in him, and he in God.

verses.original: καὶ ἡμεῖς ἐγνώκαμεν καὶ πεπιστεύκαμεν τὴν ἀγάπην ἣν ἔχει ὁ θεὸς ἐν ἡμῖν. Ὁ θεὸς ἀγάπη ἐστίν, καὶ ὁ μένων ἐν τῇ ἀγάπῃ ἐν τῷ θεῷ μένει καὶ ὁ θεὸς ἐν αὐτῷ ⸀μένει.
verses.translit: kai emeis egnokamen kai pepisteykamen ten agapin en ehei o theos en emin. O theos agapi estin, kai o menon en te agape en to theo menei kai o theos en auto menei.
verses.translation: And we have known and believed the love that God hath to us. God is love; and he that dwelleth in love dwelleth in God, and God in him.

verses.original: ἐν τούτῳ τετελείωται ἡ ἀγάπη μεθʼ ἡμῶν, ἵνα παρρησίαν ἔχωμεν ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῆς κρίσεως, ὅτι καθὼς ἐκεῖνός ἐστιν καὶ ἡμεῖς ἐσμεν ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ τούτῳ.
verses.translit: en toyto teteleiotai e agapi meth' emon, ina parrisian ehomen en te emera tes kriseos, oti kathos ekeinos estin kai emeis esmen en to kosmo toyto.
verses.translation: Herein is our love made perfect, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment: because as he is, so are we in this world.

verses.original: φόβος οὐκ ἔστιν ἐν τῇ ἀγάπῃ, ἀλλʼ ἡ τελεία ἀγάπη ἔξω βάλλει τὸν φόβον, ὅτι ὁ φόβος κόλασιν ἔχει, ὁ δὲ φοβούμενος οὐ τετελείωται ἐν τῇ ἀγάπῃ.
verses.translit: fovos ouk estin en te agape, all' e teleia agapi exo vallei ton fovon, oti o fovos kolasin ehei, o de fovoymenos ou teteleiotai en te agape.
verses.translation: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear: because fear hath torment. He that feareth is not made perfect in love.

verses.original: ἡμεῖς ⸀ἀγαπῶμεν, ὅτι αὐτὸς πρῶτος ἠγάπησεν ἡμᾶς.
verses.translit: emeis agapomen, oti autos protos egapisen emas.
verses.translation: We love him, because he first loved us.

verses.original: ἐάν τις εἴπῃ ὅτι Ἀγαπῶ τὸν θεόν, καὶ τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ μισῇ, ψεύστης ἐστίν· ὁ γὰρ μὴ ἀγαπῶν τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ ὃν ἑώρακεν, τὸν θεὸν ὃν οὐχ ἑώρακεν ⸀οὐ δύναται ἀγαπᾶν.
verses.translit: ean tis eipe oti Agapo ton theon, kai ton adelfon autou mise, pseystis estin* o gar me agapon ton adelfon autou on eoraken, ton theon on ouh eoraken ou dynatai agapan.
verses.translation: If a man say, I love God, and hateth his brother, he is a liar: for he that loveth not his brother whom he hath seen, how can he love God whom he hath not seen?

verses.original: καὶ ταύτην τὴν ἐντολὴν ἔχομεν ἀπʼ αὐτοῦ, ἵνα ὁ ἀγαπῶν τὸν θεὸν ἀγαπᾷ καὶ τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ.
verses.translit: kai taytin ten entolen ehomen ap' autou, ina o agapon ton theon agapa kai ton adelfon autou.
verses.translation: And this commandment have we from him, That he who loveth God love his brother also.

verses.original: Πᾶς ὁ πιστεύων ὅτι Ἰησοῦς ἐστιν ὁ χριστὸς ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ γεγέννηται, καὶ πᾶς ὁ ἀγαπῶν τὸν γεννήσαντα ἀγαπᾷ ⸀καὶ τὸν γεγεννημένον ἐξ αὐτοῦ.
verses.translit: Pas o pisteyon oti Iisous estin o hristos ek tou theou gegennitai, kai pas o agapon ton gennisanta agapa kai ton gegennimenon ex autou.
verses.translation: Whosoever believeth that Jesus is the Christ is born of God: and every one that loveth him that begat loveth him also that is begotten of him.

verses.original: ἐν τούτῳ γινώσκομεν ὅτι ἀγαπῶμεν τὰ τέκνα τοῦ θεοῦ, ὅταν τὸν θεὸν ἀγαπῶμεν καὶ τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ ⸀ποιῶμεν·
verses.translit: en toyto ginoskomen oti agapomen ta tekna tou theou, otan ton theon agapomen kai tas entolas autou poiomen*
verses.translation: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God, and keep his commandments.

verses.original: αὕτη γάρ ἐστιν ἡ ἀγάπη τοῦ θεοῦ ἵνα τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ τηρῶμεν, καὶ αἱ ἐντολαὶ αὐτοῦ βαρεῖαι οὐκ εἰσίν,
verses.translit: auti gar estin e agapi tou theou ina tas entolas autou tiromen, kai ai entolai autou vareiai ouk eisin,
verses.translation: For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments: and his commandments are not grievous.

verses.original: ὅτι πᾶν τὸ γεγεννημένον ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ νικᾷ τὸν κόσμον. καὶ αὕτη ἐστὶν ἡ νίκη ἡ νικήσασα τὸν κόσμον, ἡ πίστις ἡμῶν·
verses.translit: oti pan to gegennimenon ek tou theou nika ton kosmon. kai auti estin e niki e nikisasa ton kosmon, e pistis emon*
verses.translation: For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world: and this is the victory that overcometh the world, even our faith.

verses.original: τίς ⸂δέ ἐστιν⸃ ὁ νικῶν τὸν κόσμον εἰ μὴ ὁ πιστεύων ὅτι Ἰησοῦς ἐστιν ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ θεοῦ;
verses.translit: tis de estin o nikon ton kosmon ei me o pisteyon oti Iisous estin o yios tou theou;
verses.translation: Who is he that overcometh the world, but he that believeth that Jesus is the Son of God?

verses.original: Οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ ἐλθὼν διʼ ὕδατος καὶ αἵματος, Ἰησοῦς Χριστός· οὐκ ἐν τῷ ὕδατι μόνον ἀλλʼ ἐν τῷ ὕδατι καὶ ⸀ἐν τῷ αἵματι· καὶ τὸ πνεῦμά ἐστιν τὸ μαρτυροῦν, ὅτι τὸ πνεῦμά ἐστιν ἡ ἀλήθεια.
verses.translit: Outos estin o elthon di' udatos kai aimatos, Iisous Hristos* ouk en to udati monon all' en to udati kai en to aimati* kai to pneuma estin to martyroun, oti to pneuma estin e alitheia.
verses.translation: This is he that came by water and blood, even Jesus Christ; not by water only, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit that beareth witness, because the Spirit is truth.

verses.original: ὅτι τρεῖς εἰσιν οἱ μαρτυροῦντες,
verses.translit: oti treis eisin oi martyrountes,
verses.translation: For there are three that bear record in heaven, the Father, the Word, and the Holy Ghost: and these three are one.

verses.original: τὸ πνεῦμα καὶ τὸ ὕδωρ καὶ τὸ αἷμα, καὶ οἱ τρεῖς εἰς τὸ ἕν εἰσιν.
verses.translit: to pneuma kai to udor kai to aima, kai oi treis eis to en eisin.
verses.translation: And there are three that bear witness in earth, the Spirit, and the water, and the blood: and these three agree in one.

verses.original: εἰ τὴν μαρτυρίαν τῶν ἀνθρώπων λαμβάνομεν, ἡ μαρτυρία τοῦ θεοῦ μείζων ἐστίν, ὅτι αὕτη ἐστὶν ἡ μαρτυρία τοῦ θεοῦ ⸀ὅτι μεμαρτύρηκεν περὶ τοῦ υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ.
verses.translit: ei ten martyrian ton anthropon lamvanomen, e martyria tou theou meizon estin, oti auti estin e martyria tou theou oti memartyriken peri tou yiou autou.
verses.translation: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater: for this is the witness of God which he hath testified of his Son.

verses.original: ὁ πιστεύων εἰς τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ θεοῦ ἔχει τὴν μαρτυρίαν ἐν ⸀αὑτῷ· ὁ μὴ πιστεύων τῷ θεῷ ψεύστην πεποίηκεν αὐτόν, ὅτι οὐ πεπίστευκεν εἰς τὴν μαρτυρίαν ἣν μεμαρτύρηκεν ὁ θεὸς περὶ τοῦ υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ.
verses.translit: o pisteyon eis ton yion tou theou ehei ten martyrian en auto* o me pisteyon to theo pseystin pepoiiken auton, oti ou pepisteyken eis ten martyrian en memartyriken o theos peri tou yiou autou.
