verses.translation: He that believeth on the Son of God hath the witness in himself: he that believeth not God hath made him a liar; because he believeth not the record that God gave of his Son.

verses.original: καὶ αὕτη ἐστὶν ἡ μαρτυρία, ὅτι ζωὴν αἰώνιον ἔδωκεν ⸂ὁ θεὸς ἡμῖν⸃, καὶ αὕτη ἡ ζωὴ ἐν τῷ υἱῷ αὐτοῦ ἐστιν.
verses.translit: kai auti estin e martyria, oti zoen aionion edoken o theos emin, kai auti e zoe en to yio autou estin.
verses.translation: And this is the record, that God hath given to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.

verses.original: ὁ ἔχων τὸν υἱὸν ἔχει τὴν ζωήν· ὁ μὴ ἔχων τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ θεοῦ τὴν ζωὴν οὐκ ἔχει.
verses.translit: o ehon ton yion ehei ten zoin* o me ehon ton yion tou theou ten zoen ouk ehei.
verses.translation: He that hath the Son hath life; and he that hath not the Son of God hath not life.

verses.original: Ταῦτα ἔγραψα ⸀ὑμῖν ἵνα εἰδῆτε ὅτι ζωὴν ⸂ἔχετε αἰώνιον⸃, ⸂τοῖς πιστεύουσιν⸃ εἰς τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ υἱοῦ τοῦ θεοῦ.
verses.translit: Tauta egrapsa umin ina eidete oti zoen ehete aionion, tois pisteyoysin eis to onoma tou yiou tou theou.
verses.translation: These things have I written unto you that believe on the name of the Son of God; that ye may know that ye have eternal life, and that ye may believe on the name of the Son of God.

verses.original: καὶ αὕτη ἐστὶν ἡ παρρησία ἣν ἔχομεν πρὸς αὐτόν, ὅτι ἐάν τι αἰτώμεθα κατὰ τὸ θέλημα αὐτοῦ ἀκούει ἡμῶν.
verses.translit: kai auti estin e parrisia en ehomen pros auton, oti ean ti aitometha kata to thelima autou akoyei emon.
verses.translation: And this is the confidence that we have in him, that, if we ask any thing according to his will, he heareth us:

verses.original: καὶ ἐὰν οἴδαμεν ὅτι ἀκούει ἡμῶν ὃ ⸀ἐὰν αἰτώμεθα, οἴδαμεν ὅτι ἔχομεν τὰ αἰτήματα ἃ ᾐτήκαμεν ⸀ἀπʼ αὐτοῦ.
verses.translit: kai ean oidamen oti akoyei emon o ean aitometha, oidamen oti ehomen ta aitimata a etikamen ap' autou.
verses.translation: And if we know that he hear us, whatsoever we ask, we know that we have the petitions that we desired of him.

verses.original: ἐάν τις ἴδῃ τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ ἁμαρτάνοντα ἁμαρτίαν μὴ πρὸς θάνατον, αἰτήσει, καὶ δώσει αὐτῷ ζωήν, τοῖς ἁμαρτάνουσιν μὴ πρὸς θάνατον. ἔστιν ἁμαρτία πρὸς θάνατον· οὐ περὶ ἐκείνης λέγω ἵνα ἐρωτήσῃ.
verses.translit: ean tis ide ton adelfon autou amartanonta amartian me pros thanaton, aitisei, kai dosei auto zoin, tois amartanoysin me pros thanaton. estin amartia pros thanaton* ou peri ekeinis lego ina erotise.
verses.translation: If any man see his brother sin a sin which is not unto death, he shall ask, and he shall give him life for them that sin not unto death. There is a sin unto death: I do not say that he shall pray for it.

verses.original: πᾶσα ἀδικία ἁμαρτία ἐστίν, καὶ ἔστιν ἁμαρτία οὐ πρὸς θάνατον.
verses.translit: pasa adikia amartia estin, kai estin amartia ou pros thanaton.
verses.translation: All unrighteousness is sin: and there is a sin not unto death.

verses.original: Οἴδαμεν ὅτι πᾶς ὁ γεγεννημένος ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ οὐχ ἁμαρτάνει, ἀλλʼ ὁ γεννηθεὶς ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ τηρεῖ ⸀αὐτόν, καὶ ὁ πονηρὸς οὐχ ἅπτεται αὐτοῦ.
verses.translit: Oidamen oti pas o gegennimenos ek tou theou ouh amartanei, all' o gennitheis ek tou theou tirei auton, kai o poniros ouh aptetai autou.
verses.translation: We know that whosoever is born of God sinneth not; but he that is begotten of God keepeth himself, and that wicked one toucheth him not.

verses.original: οἴδαμεν ὅτι ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ ἐσμεν, καὶ ὁ κόσμος ὅλος ἐν τῷ πονηρῷ κεῖται.
verses.translit: oidamen oti ek tou theou esmen, kai o kosmos olos en to poniro keitai.
verses.translation: And we know that we are of God, and the whole world lieth in wickedness.

verses.original: οἴδαμεν δὲ ὅτι ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ θεοῦ ἥκει, καὶ δέδωκεν ἡμῖν διάνοιαν ἵνα ⸀γινώσκωμεν τὸν ἀληθινόν· καὶ ἐσμὲν ἐν τῷ ἀληθινῷ, ἐν τῷ υἱῷ αὐτοῦ Ἰησοῦ Χριστῷ. οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ ἀληθινὸς θεὸς καὶ ζωὴ αἰώνιος.
verses.translit: oidamen de oti o yios tou theou ekei, kai dedoken emin dianoian ina ginoskomen ton alithinon* kai esmen en to alithino, en to yio autou Iisou Hristo. outos estin o alithinos theos kai zoe aionios.
verses.translation: And we know that the Son of God is come, and hath given us an understanding, that we may know him that is true, and we are in him that is true, even in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God, and eternal life.

verses.original: Τεκνία, φυλάξατε ἑαυτὰ ἀπὸ τῶν ⸀εἰδώλων.
verses.translit: Teknia, fylaxate eayta apo ton eidolon.
verses.translation: Little children, keep yourselves from idols. Amen.
